Τὸ κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς ἓν οὐκ ἀνήκει τοῖς πρώτοις καὶ καθ᾽ αὑτὰ εἴδεσι τοῦ ἑνός.
Τὸ ἁφῇ, δεσμῷ ἢ βίᾳ συνεχὲς οὐχ ὁμοίως ἓν τῷ φύσει συνεχῶς ἔχοντι ἐστίν.
Οὐ ταὐτὸν ἐστὶ τὸ ποῖα λέγεται ἓν καὶ τὸ τί ἐστι τὸ ἑνὶ εἶναι.
Ἡ Πυθαγορείων καὶ Πλάτωνος ὑπόθεσις, καθ᾽ ἣν αὐτὸ τὸ ἓν χωριστὴ οὐσία ἐστίν, ἀποβάλλεται.
Οὔτε τὸ ἓν οὔτε τὸ ὂν γένος ἐστίν.
Τὰ καθ᾽ ἕκαστα μέτρα οὐ μετέχει κοινῆς τινος χωριστῆς οὐσίας τοῦ ἑνός.
Τὸ μέτρον οὐκ ἀεὶ ἀριθμῷ ἕν ἐστιν, οὐδὲ πάντως ἁπλῶς ἀμερές.
Ἡ ἐπιστήμη καὶ ἡ αἴσθησις οὐ κυρίως τὰ πράγματα μετροῦσιν, ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον ὑπ᾽ αὐτῶν μετροῦνται.
Ὁ Πρωταγόρου ἄνθρωπος-μέτρον οὐδὲν πέρα τοῦ ἐπιστήμονος ἢ αἰσθανομένου προστίθησιν.
Τὸ ἓν οὐκ ἔστιν ὀλίγον, οὐδὲ τὰ πολλὰ ἁπλῶς ταὐτὰ τῷ πολλῷ.
Τὸ ἓν καὶ τὰ πολλὰ οὐ πάντως ὡς ἐναντία ἀντίκειται.
Ἡ ἑτερότης οὐ ταὐτὸν τῇ διαφορᾷ ἐστίν, οὐδὲ τὸ ἕτερον ἀντίφασις τοῦ ταὐτοῦ.
Ἡ ἐναντίωσις οὐκ ἔστιν ἀντίφασις, καὶ οὐ πᾶσα στέρησις ἐναντίωσίς ἐστιν.
Ἡ συναπόφασις δύο ἀνομογενῶν οὐ ποιεῖ καθ᾽ αὑτὸ μεταξύ.
Αἱ ἐν τῇ ὕλῃ, τῷ σώματι ἢ τοῖς συμβεβηκόσιν ἐναντιώσεις οὐκ ἐξ ἀνάγκης εἴδη διαιροῦσιν.
Χωριστὸν ἄφθαρτον εἶδος οὐ δύναται τῷ φθαρτῷ καθ᾽ ἕκαστον ταὐτὸν εἴδει εἶναι.
Τὸ φύσει συνεχὲς καὶ ἐν αὑτῷ τὴν αἰτίαν τῆς συνεχείας ἔχον μᾶλλον ἕν ἐστι τοῦ δεσμῷ συγκειμένου, ὅτι ἡ κίνησις αὐτοῦ ἀδιαιρετωτέρα ἐστίν.
Τὸ ποσὸν ᾗ ποσὸν τῷ ἑνὶ γιγνώσκεται, ἐπεὶ πᾶς ἀριθμὸς διὰ μονάδος μετρεῖται.
Ἡ μονὰς ἀρχὴ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ ἐστίν, οὐκ ἀριθμὸς ᾗ ἀδιαίρετός ἐστιν.
Τὸ ἓν καὶ τὸ ὂν οὐ δηλοῖ πρόσθετον πρᾶγμα, ἀλλὰ τὸ ἑκάστου ὡρισμένως εἶναι.
Ἐν τοῖς ἀριθμοῖς τὸ ἓν καὶ τὰ πολλὰ ὡς μέτρον καὶ μετρητὸν ἀντίκειται, οὐχ ὡς ἁπλῶς ἐναντία.
Πᾶν ὂν πρὸς πᾶν ὂν ἢ ταὐτὸν ἢ ἕτερον λέγεται, διαφέρειν δὲ δύναται μόνον ᾗ κοινόν τι ὑπάρχει.
Ἑνὶ μόνον ἓν ἐναντίον ὑπάρχει, ἐπεὶ ἓν τέλειον διάστημα δύο μόνον ἔσχατα ἔχει.
Πᾶσα ἐναντιότης στέρησίς πώς ἐστιν, ἀλλ᾽ οὐ πᾶσα στέρησις τελεία διαφορὰ γίνεται.
Τὸ ἴσον ἀμφοῖν, τοῦ μεγάλου καὶ τοῦ μικροῦ, ὡς στερητικὴ συναπόφασις ἀντίκειται καὶ διὰ τοῦτο μεταξύ ἐστιν.
Τὰ μεταξύ καὶ αἱ ὑφειμέναι διαφοραὶ ἐκ τῶν πρώτων ἐναντίων τοῦ γένους παράγονται.
Τὰ ἄτομα ἐν ταὐτῷ γένει ἕτερα τῷ εἴδει ἐστίν, ἐὰν ἐναντίωσιν ἐν τῷ λόγῳ ἔχῃ.
Τὸ ἄρρεν καὶ τὸ θῆλυ, ἡ λευκότης καὶ ἡ μελανία οὐκ εἰδοποιοῦσιν, ὅταν ἡ ἐναντίωσις ἐν τῇ ὕλῃ καὶ οὐκ ἐν τῷ λόγῳ ᾖ.
Τὸ φθαρτὸν καὶ τὸ ἄφθαρτον, ἐπειδὴ οὐ κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς ἀλλ᾽ ἐν τῇ οὐσίᾳ ἀντίκειται, γένει ἕτερα τίθεται.
Ἀδύνατον χωριστὸν ἄφθαρτον παράδειγμα καὶ φθαρτὸν καθ᾽ ἕκαστον ὡς συνώνυμα τῷ αὐτῷ εἴδει περιέχεσθαι.
Ἡ ἑνότης οὐ πρᾶγμα κοινὸν ὑπὲρ τὰ γένη, ἀλλὰ ἐν ἑκάστῳ γένει ἐνέργεια ὁρισμοῦ, ἀδιαιρεσίας καὶ μετρήσεώς ἐστιν.
Ἡ αὐτὴ ἀδιαίρετος ἀρχὴ ἣ τὸ ὂν ὡς ἓν ὁρίζει καὶ τὴν γνῶσιν ὡς μέτρησιν δυνατὴν ποιεῖ.
Ἡ τῶν ἀντικειμένων χώρα οὐχ ἑνὶ σχήματι ἀποφάσεως τάττεται, ἀλλὰ διαιρεῖται εἰς ἀντίφασιν, στέρησιν, ἐναντιότητα καὶ σχέσιν.
Ὁ λόγος ὁρίζει τὰ τῶν εἰδῶν πέρατα, ἡ δὲ ὕλη διαφοροποιεῖ τὰ καθ᾽ ἕκαστα ἄνευ ἀναγκαίας εἰδοποιήσεως.
Αἱ μεταβολαί, τὰ μεταξύ καὶ αἱ ὕστεραι διαφοραὶ προϋποτίθενται πρώτας ἐναντιώσεις ὡς ἀρχὰς τοῦ γένους.
Ἡ θεωρία τῶν χωριστῶν εἰδῶν καταπίπτει, ἐὰν τὸ παράδειγμα ἄφθαρτον ᾖ καὶ τὸ συνώνυμον καθ᾽ ἕκαστον φθαρτόν.
Οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτὸ καθ᾽ αὑτὸ ἓν παρὰ τὰς φύσεις ἐν αἷς ἡ ἑνότης ὁρίζεται.
Οὐκ ἔστι κοινὸν γένος ὃ τὸ ὂν καὶ τὸ ἓν ὡς εἴδη περιέχει.
Οὐκ ἔστι μέτρον ἀπηλλαγμένον τοῦ οἰκείου γένους καὶ τοῦ καθ᾽ ἕκαστον βαθμοῦ ἀκριβείας.
Οὐκ ἔστι διαφορὰ ὅπου μηδὲν ταὐτὸν ὑπάρχει καθ᾽ ὃ γίγνεται ἡ σύγκρισις.
Οὐκ ἔστι καθ᾽ αὑτὸ μεταβολὴ ἐξ ἄλλου γένους εἰς ἄλλο, ἀλλὰ μόνον κατὰ συμβεβηκός.
Οὐκ ἔστι μεταξύ ἄνευ ἑνὸς δεκτικοῦ πεφυκότος ἀμφότερα τὰ ἐναντία δέχεσθαι.
Οὐδεμία ἐνδεχομένη ἢ ὑλικὴ διαφορὰ δύναται μόνη τὴν οὐσίαν διαιρεῖν.
Οὐ δύναται μία εἰδοποιὸς φύσις ᾗ τοιαύτη τῷ μὲν φθορὰν ἐξ ἀνάγκης, τῷ δὲ ἀφθαρσίαν ἐξ ἀνάγκης παρέχειν.
Ἡ χωριστὴ οὐσία τοῦ ἑνὸς προαποκλείεται, ἵνα ἡ ἑνότης κατὰ τὰ ὄντα καὶ οὐ παρὰ τὰ ὄντα λέγηται.
Ἡ ἀναγωγὴ πασῶν τῶν κατηγοριῶν εἰς ἓν γένος τοῦ ὄντος ἢ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀδύνατος τίθεται.
Ἡ τοῦ γιγνώσκοντος κυριότης ὡς αἰτία τῆς ἀληθείας ἀποκλείεται, ἐπεὶ ἡ γνῶσις ὑπὸ τοῦ γνωστοῦ ὁρίζεται.
Ἀποκλείεται καθόλου διαλεκτικὴ καθ᾽ ἣν πᾶσα ἀπόφασις ἐναντίωσις καὶ πᾶσα συναπόφασις μεταξύ γίνεται.
Ἀποκλείεται ταυτότης εἴδους ἡ διαμένουσα ἀδιάφορος πρὸς τὴν ἐν οὐσίᾳ ἀναγκαίαν φθαρτότητα ἢ ἀφθαρσίαν.
Ἡ συναγωγὴ τοῦ συνεχοῦς, τοῦ ὅλου, τοῦ καθ᾽ ἕκαστον καὶ τοῦ καθόλου ἀνάγει τοὺς πολλοὺς τρόπους τοῦ ἑνὸς εἰς τὸ ἀδιαίρετον.
Τὸ ἀδιαίρετον, ὅταν πρῶτον καὶ συγγενὲς ᾖ, γίνεται μέτρον, τὸ δὲ μέτρον τὸ ποσὸν εἰς ἀριθμὸν ἀνάγει.
Ἡ καθόλου κατηγορία τοῦ ἑνὸς συντεθεῖσα τῇ ἀδυναμίᾳ χωριστῆς καθόλου οὐσίας παράγει τὸ ἓν ὡς ἐνδογενῆ φύσιν ἑκάστου γένους.
Ἡ σχέσις μέτρου καὶ μετρητοῦ ἀνατάσσει τὸ ἓν καὶ τὰ πολλὰ, ἡ δὲ κοινὴ ταυτότης ἀνατάσσει τὴν ἑτερότητα εἰς διαφοράν.
Ἡ τελεία διαφορὰ παράγει δύο ἔσχατα, ἡ στέρησις ὁρίζει θάτερον, καὶ ἡ διάκρισις ἀντιφάσεως καὶ ἐναντιότητος ἀποφαίνεται πότε μεταξύ ἐνδέχεται.
Ἡ ἐναντίωσις ἐν τῷ λόγῳ εἴδη διαιρεῖ, ἡ δὲ ἐναντίωσις ἐν τῇ ὕλῃ μόνον τὰ καθ᾽ ἕκαστα διαφοροποιεῖ.
Ἡ ἀναγκαία ἀντίθεσις φθαρτοῦ καὶ ἀφθάρτου ἐν τῇ οὐσίᾳ παράγει γένει ἑτερότητα, ἡ δὲ γένει ἑτερότης ἀποκλείει τὴν συνωνυμίαν χωριστοῦ εἴδους καὶ φθαρτοῦ καθ᾽ ἕκαστον.
Ἡ πρώτη φορὰ τοῦ λόγου ἐστίν· πολλαχῶς λεγόμενον ἕν → ἀδιαίρετον → πρῶτον μέτρον → ἀρχὴ ἀριθμοῦ → ἐνδογενὴς ἑνότης ἑκάστου γένους.
Ἡ δευτέρα φορὰ τοῦ λόγου ἐστίν· ἓν καὶ πλῆθος → μέτρον καὶ μετρητόν → ταὐτὸν καὶ ἕτερον → διαφορά → τελεία διαφορά → ἐναντίωσις → μεταξύ.
Ἡ τελικὴ φορὰ τοῦ λόγου ἐστίν· ἐναντίωσις ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ὕλῃ → εἰδοποιὸς ἢ μὴ εἰδοποιὸς διαφορά → φθαρτὸν καὶ ἄφθαρτον → ἀπόρριψις συνωνύμων χωριστῶν εἰδῶν.
Τὸ ἓν μετατίθεται ἐκ χωριστοῦ πράγματος εἰς ἀρχὴν ἀδιαιρεσίας καὶ μετρήσεως ἐν ἑκάστῳ γένει.
Ἡ γνῶσις τοῦ ποσοῦ διαγράφεται ὡς ἀναγωγὴ τοῦ πλήθους εἰς πρῶτον συγγενὲς μέτρον.
Τὸ πλῆθος διαιρεῖται εἰς ἀριθμὸν μετρητὸν ἑνὶ καὶ εἰς πλῆθος ὑπεροχὴν ἢ ἔλλειψιν ἔχον.
Ἡ ἀντίθεσις παύεται μία ἀδιαίρετος σχέσις εἶναι καὶ διακρίνεται εἰς ἀντίφασιν, στέρησιν, ἐναντίωσιν καὶ πρός τι.
Ἡ ἑτερότης μετατίθεται ἐκ ψιλῆς ἀνομοιότητος εἰς διαφορὰν ἀπαιτοῦσαν κοινὸν γένος ἢ κοινὸν ὑποκείμενον.
Τὸ πέρας τοῦ εἴδους τίθεται ἐν τῷ λόγῳ, οὐκ ἐν τῇ ὕλῃ, τῷ σώματι ἢ τῷ συμβεβηκότι.
Ἡ διάκρισις φθαρτοῦ καὶ ἀφθάρτου μεταβάλλεται ἐκ πάθους εἰς κριτήριον οὐσιώδους καὶ γενικῆς ἑτερότητος.
Surface — Τὰ ἄμεσα ζητούμενα εἰσὶν οἱ τρόποι τοῦ ἑνός, ἡ φύσις τοῦ μέτρου, καὶ οἱ ὅροι τοῦ ταὐτοῦ, τοῦ ἑτέρου, τοῦ ὁμοίου καὶ τοῦ ἐναντίου.
Structural — Ἡ διάταξις ἐνεργεῖ διὰ συγγενῶν μέτρων, κοινῶν γενῶν, δεκτικῶν ὑποκειμένων καὶ τελείων διαφορῶν.
Metastrategic — Ὁ λόγος λύει τὰς ἀπορίας διακρίνων τὸ πολλαχῶς λεγόμενον ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου λόγου καὶ μετατιθεὶς τὴν ζήτησιν ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων εἰς τὰς γεννώσας σχέσεις.
Ontological/Temporal — Ἡ οὐσία καθορίζεται διὰ τοῦ λόγου, ἡ δὲ φθορά καὶ ἡ ἀφθαρσία τίθενται ὡς ἀναγκαῖοι τρόποι τοῦ εἶναι, οἳ οὐ δύνανται ὑπὸ μίαν συνώνυμον φύσιν ἀδιαφόρως περιέχεσθαι.
Τὸ τῶν ἀξιωμάτων σύστημα ἱκανόν ἐστι πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς κινήσεως ἀπὸ τοῦ ἑνὸς εἰς τὸ μέτρον, τὴν ἐναντίωσιν καὶ τὴν εἰδοποιὸν διαφοράν.
Ἡ διάκρισις τοῦ ποῖα λέγεται ἓν ἀπὸ τοῦ τί ἐστι τὸ ἑνὶ εἶναι κωλύει τὴν πολυσημίαν ἀντὶ ὁρισμοῦ λαμβάνεσθαι.
Ἡ διάταξις ἰσχυροτάτη ἐστὶν ἐν τῇ διακρίσει μέτρου καὶ μετρητοῦ καὶ ἐν τῇ διαιρέσει τῶν τρόπων τῆς ἀντιθέσεως.
Ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ τοῦ ποσοῦ εἰς τὰ ἄλλα γένη διὰ τοῦ μέτρου ἀληθῶς δηλοῦται, ὁ δὲ τρόπος τῆς ἀναλογίας οὐ πλήρως ὁρίζεται.
Ἡ ταύτισις ἐναντιότητος καὶ μεγίστης διαφορᾶς, καθάπερ καὶ ἡ καθολικὴ εἰδοποιὸς δύναμις τῆς ἐναντιώσεως, ἐπαγωγῇ μᾶλλον ἢ πλήρει ἀποδείξει στηρίζεται.
Ἡ θέσις ὅτι τὰ ἐναντία ἐν ταὐτῷ γένει ἐστὶ δυσχερῶς συνάπτεται τῷ συμπεράσματι ὅτι τὸ φθαρτὸν καὶ τὸ ἄφθαρτον γένει διαφέρει, καὶ ἡ μεσίτευσις τῆς οὐσιώδους ἀνάγκης οὐ πλήρως ἐκτίθεται.
Ἡ ἀπόδοσις τοῦ ἄρρενος καὶ τοῦ θήλεος εἰς τὴν ὕλην ἐξαρτᾶται ἐκ φυσικῆς αἰτιολογίας ἣ ἐνταῦθα τίθεται μᾶλλον ἢ ἀποδείκνυται.
Ἡ σύνθεσις πάντων τῶν μεταξύ ἐκ τῶν ἐναντίων μένει ἀδιοριστοτέρα περὶ τοῦ πότερον ποσοτική, εἰδοποιὸς ἢ γενετικὴ σύνθεσίς ἐστιν.
Ἡ ἀπόρριψις τῶν χωριστῶν εἰδῶν ἰσχύει ὑπὸ τὴν προϋπόθεσιν ὅτι τὸ εἶδος καὶ τὸ καθ᾽ ἕκαστον συνωνύμως καὶ κυρίως ταὐτὸν εἶδος ἔχει.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις σῴζει τὴν ἀληθῆ φοράν τοῦ λόγου, ἐπειδὴ ἐκ τοῦ ὁρισμοῦ τῆς ἑνότητος παράγει τὴν τάξιν τῶν διαφορῶν καὶ ἐκ ταύτης τὰ περὶ οὐσίας συμπεράσματα.
The account investigates what it is to be one, how it relates to being, and how from it the arrangements of the same, the other, and contraries arise.
The one said in many ways is reduced to the indivisible, and most properly to the first measure of each genus.
The one is neither a separate substance nor a genus, but accompanies being in all the figures of predication.
The distinction between measure and measurable determines the relation of the one to the many, while the distinction between otherness and difference determines the order of opposites.
Contrariety, as complete difference, orders the extremes, the intermediates, privations, and specific divisions.
The distinction between account and matter judges which contrarieties produce species and which affect only particulars.
The reasoning is metaphysical and divisive, proceeding from equivocity to definition, from definition to an order of oppositions, and thence to a judgment concerning substance and species.
Every primary and per se mode of the one is reduced to something indivisible.
To be one is to be a determinate this something by being indivisible.
Most properly, the one is the first measure of each genus, and primarily of quantity.
Every measure is connatural with what is measured.
The first thing in each genus is indivisible either simply or relative to perception.
Number is a plurality measurable by one.
No universal can be a separate substance.
The one and being are predicated equally and add nothing else to the being of each thing.
In each genus the one is a certain nature of that genus, not a common nature apart from all genera.
Every difference presupposes some sameness according to which the different things are compared.
Contrariety is a complete and greatest difference in the same genus.
A complete difference has two extremes and no more.
Every contrariety contains a complete privation in one of the extremes.
There is no intermediate of contradiction, but there may be one of contraries.
Every intermediate is in the same genus as the extremes and is composed from the contraries.
The equal is neither great nor small, but is naturally capable of receiving either.
Only contrariety in the account is species-making; contrariety in matter is not species-making.
The corruptible and the incorruptible belong necessarily in substance to things so constituted.
The accidental one does not belong among the primary and per se kinds of the one.
What is continuous by contact, binding, or force is not one in the same way as what is continuous by nature.
What things are called one is not the same as what it is to be one.
The hypothesis of the Pythagoreans and Plato, according to which the one itself is a separate substance, is rejected.
Neither the one nor being is a genus.
Particular measures do not participate in any common separate substance of the one.
A measure is not always one in number, nor in every case simply without parts.
Knowledge and perception do not properly measure things; rather, they are measured by them.
Protagoras' man-as-measure adds nothing beyond the knower or perceiver.
The one is not a few, nor are the many simply the same as the multitude.
The one and the many are not in every respect opposed as contraries.
Otherness is not the same as difference, nor is the other the contradiction of the same.
Contrariety is not contradiction, and not every privation is contrariety.
The joint denial of two things not in the same genus does not by itself produce an intermediate.
Contrarieties in matter, body, or accidents do not necessarily divide species.
A separate incorruptible species cannot be the same in species as a corruptible particular.
What is naturally continuous and has in itself the cause of its continuity is more one than what is compounded by binding, because its motion is more indivisible.
Quantity qua quantity is known by the one, since every number is measured by the unit.
The unit is the principle of number, not a number insofar as it is indivisible.
The one and being do not signify an additional thing, but the determinate being of each thing.
In numbers, the one and the many are opposed as measure and measurable, not as contraries simply.
Every being in relation to every being is called either the same or other, but it can differ only insofar as something common belongs to them.
Only one contrary belongs to one thing, since one complete interval has only two extremes.
Every contrariety is in some way a privation, but not every privation becomes a complete difference.
The equal is opposed to both the great and the small as a privative joint denial, and for this reason is intermediate.
The intermediates and subordinate differences are derived from the primary contraries of the genus.
Individuals in the same genus are different in species if they possess contrariety in the account.
Male and female, whiteness and blackness, do not make species when the contrariety is in matter and not in the account.
The corruptible and the incorruptible, because they are opposed not accidentally but in substance, are posited as different in genus.
It is impossible for a separate incorruptible paradigm and a corruptible particular to be contained as synonymous under the same species.
Unity is not a common thing above the genera, but in each genus it is an activity of definition, indivisibility, and measurement.
The same indivisible principle both defines being as one and makes knowledge possible as measurement.
The domain of opposites is not ordered according to one form of negation, but is divided into contradiction, privation, contrariety, and relation.
The account determines the boundaries of species, while matter differentiates particulars without necessary species-making.
Changes, intermediates, and subsequent differences presuppose primary contrarieties as principles of the genus.
The theory of separate species collapses if the paradigm is incorruptible and the synonymous particular is corruptible.
There is no one itself by itself apart from the natures in which unity is defined.
There is no common genus that contains being and the one as species.
There is no measure detached from its proper genus and its particular degree of precision.
There is no difference where no sameness belongs according to which comparison takes place.
There is no per se change from one genus into another, but only accidental change.
There is no intermediate without one receptive thing naturally fitted to receive both contraries.
No contingent or material difference can by itself divide substance.
One species-making nature, insofar as it is such, cannot necessarily confer corruption on one thing and incorruptibility on another.
The separate substance of the one is precluded, so that unity may be spoken of according to beings and not apart from beings.
The reduction of all categories to one genus of being or of the one is declared impossible.
The sovereignty of the knower as a cause of truth is excluded, since knowledge is determined by the knowable.
Any dialectic according to which every negation becomes contrariety and every joint denial an intermediate is excluded.
Sameness of species that remains indifferent to necessary corruptibility or incorruptibility in substance is excluded.
The collection of the continuous, the whole, the particular, and the universal reduces the many modes of the one to the indivisible.
The indivisible, when it is first and connatural, becomes a measure, and the measure reduces quantity to number.
The universal predication of the one, combined with the impossibility of a separate universal substance, yields the one as an immanent nature of each genus.
The relation of measure and measurable orders the one and the many, while common sameness orders otherness into difference.
Complete difference yields two extremes, privation determines one of them, and the distinction between contradiction and contrariety declares when an intermediate is possible.
Contrariety in the account divides species, whereas contrariety in matter differentiates only particulars.
The necessary opposition of corruptible and incorruptible in substance yields difference in genus, and difference in genus excludes the synonymy of a separate species and a corruptible particular.
The first course of the account is: one said in many ways → indivisible → first measure → principle of number → immanent unity of each genus.
The second course of the account is: one and plurality → measure and measurable → same and other → difference → complete difference → contrariety → intermediate.
The final course of the account is: contrariety in account or in matter → species-making or non-species-making difference → corruptible and incorruptible → rejection of synonymous separate species.
The one is shifted from a separate thing to a principle of indivisibility and measurement in each genus.
Knowledge of quantity is outlined as a reduction of plurality to a first connatural measure.
Plurality is divided into number measurable by one and plurality possessing excess or deficiency.
Opposition ceases to be one undivided relation and is distinguished into contradiction, privation, contrariety, and relation.
Otherness is shifted from bare dissimilarity to difference requiring a common genus or common subject.
The boundary of species is posited in the account, not in matter, body, or accident.
The distinction between corruptible and incorruptible is transformed from an affection into a criterion of substantial and generic otherness.
Surface — The immediate questions are the modes of the one, the nature of measure, and the terms of the same, the other, the similar, and the contrary.
Structural — The arrangement operates through connatural measures, common genera, receptive subjects, and complete differences.
Metastrategic — The account resolves the aporiai by distinguishing what is said in many ways from the primary account and by shifting the inquiry from names to the generating relations.

Ontological/Temporal — Substance is determined through the account, while corruption and incorruptibility are posited as necessary modes of being, which cannot indifferently be contained under one synonymous nature.
The system of axioms is sufficient for reconstructing the movement from the one to measure, contrariety, and species-making difference.
The distinction between what is called one and what it is to be one prevents equivocity from being taken in place of definition.
The arrangement is strongest in the distinction between measure and measurable and in the division of the modes of opposition.
The transition from quantity to the other genera through measure is truly indicated, but the mode of analogy is not fully defined.
The identification of contrariety with greatest difference, as also the universal species-making power of contrariety, rests more on induction than on complete demonstration.

The position that contraries are in the same genus is connected with difficulty to the conclusion that the corruptible and the incorruptible differ in genus, and the mediation of substantial necessity is not fully expounded.
The attribution of male and female to matter depends upon a natural explanation that is posited here rather than demonstrated.
The composition of all intermediates from contraries remains indeterminate as to whether it is quantitative, species-making, or generative composition.
The rejection of separate species holds under the presupposition that the species and the particular have the same species synonymously and properly.
The reconstruction preserves the true course of the account, because from the definition of unity it derives the order of differences and from this the conclusions concerning substance.
Ζητεῖται πῶς μία σοφία δύναται περὶ πολλὰ καὶ γένει διαφέροντα ὄντα, περὶ τὰς ἀρχὰς αὐτῶν καὶ περὶ τὰς κοινὰς ἀρχὰς τῆς ἀποδείξεως εἶναι.
Τὸ ὂν, καίπερ πολλαχῶς λεγόμενον, πρὸς ἕν τι καὶ κοινὸν ἀνάγεται, ὥστε μίαν ἐπιστήμην δέχεσθαι.
Ἡ πρώτη φιλοσοφία θεωρεῖ τὸ ὂν ᾗ ὄν, τὰ τούτῳ καθ᾽ αὑτὸ συμβεβηκότα, τὰς πρώτας ἐναντιώσεις καὶ τὰς κοινὰς ἀποδεικτικὰς ἀρχάς.
Ἡ βεβαιοτάτη ἀρχὴ οὐκ ἀποδείκνυται ἁπλῶς, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὸν ἀντιλέγοντα ἐλέγχεται διὰ τῶν ἀναγκαίων ὅρων τοῦ σημαίνειν καὶ τοῦ διαλέγεσθαι.
Ἡ τάξις τῶν θεωρητικῶν ἐπιστημῶν ἐξαρτᾶται ἐκ τοῦ εἰ ἔστι χωριστὴ καὶ ἀκίνητος οὐσία· ταύτης γὰρ οὔσης ἡ θεολογικὴ πρώτη καὶ καθόλου γίνεται.
Τὸ κατὰ συμβεβηκός, ἡ κίνησις, τὸ ἄπειρον καὶ αἱ μεταβολαὶ διορίζονται διὰ τοῦ ἀποκλείειν τὴν ἀναγκαίαν αἰτιότητα, τὴν οὐσιοποίησιν τῶν ἀφαιρέσεων καὶ τὴν σύγχυσιν δυνάμεως καὶ ἐνεργείας.
Ὁ συλλογισμὸς διαγνωστικῶς καὶ ἀνασυστατικῶς κινεῖται ἐξ ἀπορίας εἰς διάκρισιν τῶν σημαινομένων, ἐκ ταύτης εἰς ἀναγωγὴν πρὸς ἕν, καὶ ἐκ τῆς ἀναγωγῆς εἰς ὁρισμοὺς καὶ ἀποκλεισμούς.
Ἑκάστη μερικὴ ἐπιστήμη περιγράφει τι γένος καὶ τὸ τί ἐστιν αὐτοῦ λαβοῦσα ὡς ὑποκείμενον τὰ λοιπὰ ἀποδείκνυσιν.
Ἡ πρώτη φιλοσοφία θεωρεῖ τὸ ὂν καθόλου ᾗ ὄν, οὐχ ᾗ τοιόνδε τι ὄν.
Τὸ ὂν πολλαχῶς μὲν λέγεται, πάντα δὲ τὰ σημαινόμενα πρὸς ἕν τι καὶ κοινὸν ἀνάγεται.
Τῶν πρὸς ἓν λεγομένων μία δύναται εἶναι ἐπιστήμη.
Τὰ ἐναντία μιᾶς ἐπιστήμης ἐστίν, ἐπειδὴ αἱ ἐναντιώσεις εἰς πρώτας διαφορὰς καὶ στερήσεις ἀνάγονται.
Αἱ κοινόταται ἀποδεικτικαὶ ἀρχαὶ τοῖς οὖσιν ᾗ ὄντα ὑπάρχουσι καὶ διὰ τοῦτο τῇ πρώτῃ φιλοσοφίᾳ προσήκουσιν.
Ἀδύνατον τὸ αὐτὸ καθ᾽ ἕνα καὶ τὸν αὐτὸν χρόνον εἶναί τε καὶ μὴ εἶναι.
Τῆς βεβαιοτάτης ἀρχῆς οὐκ ἔστιν ἁπλῆ ἀπόδειξις ἐκ πιστοτέρας ἀρχῆς, ἔστι δὲ ἔλεγχος πρὸς τὸν ἀντιλέγοντα.
Κοινωνία λόγου ἀπαιτεῖ ἕκαστον ὄνομα γνώριμόν τι καὶ ἓν ὡρισμένον σημαίνειν.
Ποιητικὴ μὲν ἐπιστήμη τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς κινήσεως ἐν τῷ ποιοῦντι, πρακτικὴ δὲ ἐν τῷ πράττοντι, φυσικὴ δὲ ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ κινουμένῳ τίθησιν.
Τρία γένη θεωρητικῶν ἐπιστημῶν ἐστίν, φυσική, μαθηματικὴ καὶ θεολογική.
Εἰ ἔστι χωριστὴ καὶ ἀκίνητος οὐσία, ἡ περὶ αὐτὴν ἐπιστήμη πρώτη καὶ καθόλου ἐστὶ τῷ προτέρα εἶναι.
Πᾶσα ἐπιστήμη τοῦ ἀεὶ ὄντος ἢ τοῦ ὡς ἐπὶ τὸ πολύ ἐστιν.
Τὸ κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς οὔτε ἀεὶ οὔτε ἐξ ἀνάγκης οὔτε ὡς ἐπὶ τὸ πολὺ γίνεται, καὶ τὰ αἴτια αὐτοῦ ἄτακτα καὶ ἀόριστά ἐστιν.
Κίνησίς ἐστιν ἡ τοῦ δυνάμει ὄντος ᾗ τοιοῦτον ἐντελέχεια ἐν τῷ κινητῷ ὑπὸ τοῦ κινητικοῦ.
Κίνησις καθ᾽ αὑτὴν μόνον κατὰ ποιόν, ποσὸν ἢ τόπον ὑπάρχει.
Μεταβολῆς μεταβολὴ καὶ κινήσεως κίνησις καθ᾽ αὑτὰς οὐκ εἰσίν.
Τὸ ἄπειρον οὔτε χωριστὴ οὐσία οὔτε ἐνεργείᾳ σῶμά ἐστιν, ἀλλὰ πάθος ποσότητος καθ᾽ ἕτερόν τι.
Συνεχῆ ἐστιν ὧν τὰ ἁπτόμενα πέρατα ταὐτὸ καὶ ἓν γίγνεται.
Ἡ ἑνότης τῆς σοφίας οὐκ ἀπαιτεῖ τὰς πάντων τῶν ὄντων ἀρχὰς ἓν γένος ἢ ἐναντία εἶναι.
Τὸ ὂν καὶ τὸ ἓν οὐ γένη ἐστίν, ἐπεὶ αἱ διαφοραὶ γένους οὐ μετέχουσιν.
Τὰ χωριστὰ εἴδη καὶ τὰ μεταξύ τιθέμενα μαθηματικὰ οὐ παρέχει βέβαιον ὑποκείμενον τῇ ζητουμένῃ ἐπιστήμῃ.
Ἡ πρώτη φιλοσοφία οὐ ταὐτίζεται οὔτε τῇ περὶ τὰ φθαρτὰ αἰσθητὰ φυσικῇ οὔτε τῇ περὶ τὰ μὴ χωριστὰ μαθηματικῇ.
Οὔτε ἡ ὕλη ὡς μόνον δυνάμει οὖσα οὔτε τὸ φθαρτὸν εἶδος ἱκανὴ ἀΐδιος καὶ χωριστὴ ἀρχή ἐστιν.
Τὸ ὂν καὶ τὸ ἓν οὐ δύναται ὡς χωριστὴ οὐσία κατηγορεῖσθαι πάντων, ἐπεὶ οὐ πάντα τὰ ὄντα οὐσίαι εἰσίν.
Οὔτε ἡ φυσικὴ οὔτε ἡ διαλεκτικὴ οὔτε ἡ σοφιστικὴ θεωρεῖ τὸ ὂν ᾗ ὄν.
Ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς μὴ ἀντιφάσεως οὐκ ἀποδείκνυται δι᾽ ἑτέρας προτέρας καὶ πιστοτέρας ἀρχῆς.
Ἡ Ἡρακλείτειος συναλήθευσις τῶν ἀντικειμένων φάσεων ἀναιρεῖ τὸ ἴδιον αὐτῆς λεγόμενον καὶ πᾶσαν ὡρισμένην σημασίαν.
Τὸ φαινόμενον ἑκάστῳ οὐκ ἔστι μέτρον τοῦ ὄντος, οὐδὲ πᾶσαι αἱ ἀντιμαχόμεναι δόξαι ὁμοίως ἀληθεῖς εἰσίν.
Τοῦ κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπιστήμη, καὶ ἡ τύχη οὐκ ἔστι πρώτη καθ᾽ αὑτὴν αἰτία τῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ κίνησις οὔτε ἑτερότης οὔτε ἀνισότης οὔτε μὴ ὂν οὔτε ψιλὴ δύναμις οὔτε τελεία ἐνέργεια ἐστίν.
Ἄπειρος χωριστὴ οὐσία, ἄπειρον ἐνεργείᾳ σῶμα καὶ ἄπειρος κεχωρισμένος ἀριθμὸς οὐκ εἰσίν.
Γένεσις καὶ φθορὰ οὐ κινήσεις εἰσίν, οὐδὲ μεταβολὴ δύναται καθ᾽ αὑτὴν ὑποκείμενον ἑτέρας μεταβολῆς γενέσθαι.
Ἡ πολλαχῶς λεγομένη τοῦ ὄντος φύσις μίαν ἐπιστήμην δέχεται, ἐπειδὴ ἡ πολλαχότης αὐτῆς ἀναφορικὴ καὶ οὐ ψιλῶς ὁμώνυμός ἐστιν.
Ὁ φιλόσοφος δύναται τὸ ἓν καὶ τὸ πλῆθος, τὸ ταὐτὸν καὶ τὸ ἕτερον, καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς πρώτας ἐναντιώσεις θεωρεῖν.
Ἡ θεωρία τῶν κοινῶν ἀποδεικτικῶν ἀρχῶν οὐκ ἄλλῃ μερικῇ ἐπιστήμῃ ἀλλὰ τῇ πρώτῃ φιλοσοφίᾳ ἀνήκει.
Ὁ τὴν μὴ ἀντίφασιν ἀρνούμενος ἐλέγχεται ἐξ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ὡρισμένον τι σημαίνειν.
Ἡ καθόλου ἄρνησις τῆς ἀληθείας αὐτὴν ἑαυτὴν ἀναιρεῖ, ἐπειδὴ ἀληθῆ τινὰ ἀπόφανσιν ποιεῖσθαι ἀναγκάζεται.
Ἡ ἐξίσωσις πάσης φάσεως καὶ ἀποφάσεως ἀναιρεῖ τὰς διαφορὰς τῶν πραγμάτων καὶ τὴν περὶ αὐτὰ προαίρεσιν.
Ἡ φυσικὴ καὶ ἡ μαθηματικὴ μέρη σοφίας εἰσίν, ἐπειδὴ τὸ ὂν θεωροῦσιν ὑφ᾽ ὡρισμένην μόνον ὄψιν.
Ἡ θεολογικὴ τῆς φυσικῆς προτέρα γίνεται μόνον ἐὰν χωριστὴ καὶ ἀκίνητος οὐσία ὑπάρχῃ.
Ἡ πρώτη φιλοσοφία καθόλου ἐστὶν οὐχ ὡς γένος πάντα περιέχουσα, ἀλλὰ τῷ περὶ τὸ φύσει πρότερον εἶναι.
Τὸ κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς ἔξω τῆς ἀποδεικτικῆς ἐπιστήμης πίπτει.
Ἡ ἀόριστος αἰτιότης τοῦ συμβεβηκότος διασῴζει τὸ ἐνδέχεσθαι γενέσθαι καὶ μὴ γενέσθαι.
Ἡ κίνησις μέση τίς ἐστι μεταξὺ ψιλῆς δυνάμεως καὶ τετελεσμένης ἐνεργείας.
Ἀλλοίωσις, αὔξησις ἢ φθίσις, καὶ φορὰ τὰ τρία γένη κινήσεώς εἰσιν.
Ἡ γένεσις καὶ ἡ φθορὰ κατ᾽ ἀντίφασιν μεταβολαί εἰσιν, οὐ κινήσεις ἐν ὑποκειμένῳ.
Ἡ κίνησις οὐ δύναται ἑαυτὴν ὡς ὑποκείμενον ἔχειν ἄνευ ἀπείρου ἀναδρομῆς.
Τὸ ἄπειρον οὐ δύναται πρώτη οὐσία ἢ στοιχεῖον εἶναι.
Πᾶν συνεχὲς ἁπτόμενόν ἐστιν, οὐ πᾶν δὲ ἁπτόμενον συνεχές.
Ἡ καθολικότης τῆς μεταφυσικῆς συνίσταται ἐν ἀναγωγῇ καὶ προτεραιότητι, οὐκ ἐν ἑνὶ ἀνωτάτῳ γένει.
Ἡ ἑνότης ἐπιστήμης κρίνεται ἐκ τοῦ κοινοῦ τρόπου ἀναφορᾶς τῶν ὑποκειμένων, οὐκ ἐκ τῆς ὁμογενείας αὐτῶν.
Ἡ ὡρισμένη σημασία τοῦ λόγου καὶ ἡ μὴ ἀντίφασις ἀλλήλας στηρίζουσιν, ὥστε ἡ ἀναίρεσις τῆς μιᾶς καὶ τὴν ἄλλην ἀναιρεῖν.
Ἡ τοῦ συμβεβηκότος ἀοριστία ἀποτελεῖ ὅρον τῆς ἐνδεχομενικότητος καὶ ἀποκλείει καθολικὴν αἰτιακὴν ἀνάγκην.
Ἡ πρωτεία τῆς θεολογικῆς οὐκ ἔστιν ἀπροϋπόθετος, ἀλλ᾽ ἀκολουθεῖ τῇ ἀποδείξει χωριστῆς καὶ ἀκινήτου οὐσίας.
Ἡ κίνησις ὑπάρχει ὡς ἀτελὴς ἐνέργεια, ἐπειδὴ ἐντελέχεια μέν ἐστι, τοῦ δυνάμει δὲ ᾗ δυνάμει.
Ἡ ἀπαγόρευσις τοῦ ἐνεργείᾳ ἀπείρου κωλύει τὰ πάθη τῆς ποσότητος καὶ τὰ πέρατα τῶν σωμάτων οὐσιοποιεῖσθαι.
Οὐ δεῖ πᾶσαν μίαν ἐπιστήμην ἓν γένος μονοσήμως λεγόμενον ἔχειν.
Οὐ δεῖ τὸ ὂν ὡς ἀνώτατον γένος νοεῖν, ἵνα καθόλου ἐπιστήμη δυνατὴ γένηται.
Οὐ πᾶσα ἀρχὴ λόγον ἑτέρας προτέρας ἀρχῆς ἀπαιτεῖ, ἐπεὶ οὕτως ἡ ἀπόδειξις εἰς ἄπειρον προβαίνει.
Ὁ μηδὲν ὡρισμένον σημαίνων οὐκ ἀντίκειται λόγῳ, ἀλλ᾽ ἔξω τῆς κοινωνίας τοῦ λόγου τίθεται.
Ἡ διαφορὰ τῶν φαινομένων οὐκ ἀναιρεῖ τὸ ψεῦδος, οὐδὲ μεταβάλλει πᾶσαν αἴσθησιν εἰς ἴσον κριτήριον.
Ἡ αἰτιότης οὐ δύναται πᾶν γεγονὸς εἰς ἀναγκαίαν ἅλυσιν κλείειν ἄνευ ἀναιρέσεως τοῦ ἐνδεχομένου.
Τὰ ἐξ ἀφαιρέσεως νοούμενα, τὰ πέρατα καὶ τὸ ἄπειρον οὐ δεῖ μεταβάλλειν εἰς χωριστὰς οὐσίας.
Οὐκ ἔστι μεταβολὴ μεταβολῆς, ἐπειδὴ οὔτε ὑποκείμενον οὔτε ἔσχατον εἶδος αὐτῇ ἀποδοθῆναι δύναται ἄνευ ἀπείρου ἀναδρομῆς.
Ἡ ἀόριστος ταυτότης, καθ᾽ ἣν τὸ αὐτὸ ἅμα ἐστὶ καὶ οὐκ ἔστι, ἀδύνατος τίθεται, ἐπειδὴ λόγον, ἐπιστήμην καὶ πρᾶξιν ἅμα ἀφανίζει.
Τὸ μὴ ὂν καὶ τὸ συμβεβηκὸς οὐ δύναται πρώτη χώρα τῆς ἐξηγήσεως γενέσθαι.
Ἡ πρώτη φιλοσοφία οὐ δύναται τὴν θεολογικὴν μορφὴν ἀπολύτως λαβεῖν πρὶν δειχθῆναι χωριστὴ καὶ ἀκίνητος οὐσία.
Ἡ κίνησις οὐ δύναται εἰς στέρησιν, δύναμιν ἢ τετελεσμένην ἐνέργειαν ἁπλῶς ἀναχθῆναι.
Ἡ τάξις τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐ δύναται ἐκ τύχης ὡς πρώτης αἰτίας γεννᾶσθαι, ἐπειδὴ τὸ κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς τοῦ καθ᾽ αὑτὸ ὕστερόν ἐστιν.
Ἡ πρώτη γένεσις τοῦ συλλογισμοῦ ἔχει οὕτως· πολλὰ γένη ὄντων → ἀπορία περὶ μιᾶς σοφίας → ζήτησις ἑνότητος μὴ γενικῆς.
Ἡ λύσις τῆς ἐπιστημονικῆς πολλαχότητος ἔχει οὕτως· πολλαχῶς λεγόμενον ὄν → ἀναφορὰ πρὸς ἕν → μία θεωρία τοῦ ὄντος ᾗ ὄν.
Ἡ ἀναγωγὴ τῶν ἐναντίων ἔχει οὕτως· πολλαὶ ἐναντιώσεις → στέρησις καὶ πρώται διαφοραί → μία ἐπιστήμη τῶν ἀντικειμένων.
Ἡ ἀνάθεσις τῶν κοινῶν ἀρχῶν ἔχει οὕτως· καθόλου ἰσχύς → τὸ ὂν ᾗ ὄν → πρώτη φιλοσοφία.
Ὁ ἔλεγχος τῆς ἀντιφάσεως ἔχει οὕτως· ἄρνησις τῆς ἀρχῆς → ἀνάγκη ὡρισμένης σημασίας → χρήση τῆς ἀρχῆς → αὐτοαναίρεσις τῆς ἀρνήσεως.
Ἡ ἀναίρεσις τοῦ σχετικισμοῦ ἔχει οὕτως· διαφωνία φαινομένων → διάκρισις κριτηρίου καὶ πάθους → ἀποκλεισμὸς τῆς ἴσης ἀληθείας πάντων.
Ἡ τάξις τῶν ἐπιστημῶν ἔχει οὕτως· διαφορὰ τῶν ἀρχῶν κινήσεως → διάκρισις πρακτικῆς, ποιητικῆς καὶ θεωρητικῆς → φυσικὴ, μαθηματικὴ καὶ θεολογική → ὑπόθεσις χωριστοῦ ἀκινήτου.
Ὁ διορισμὸς τοῦ συμβεβηκότος ἔχει οὕτως· ἔλλειψις ἀναγκαιότητος καὶ συχνότητος → ἀόριστα αἴτια → ἀδυναμία ἐπιστήμης → διατήρησις τοῦ ἐνδεχομένου.
Ὁ ὁρισμὸς τῆς κινήσεως ἔχει οὕτως· δύναμις → ἐντελέχεια τοῦ δυνατοῦ ᾗ δυνατόν → ἀτελὴς ἐνέργεια → κίνησις κατὰ ποιόν, ποσὸν ἢ τόπον.
Ἡ ἀναίρεσις τοῦ ἐνεργείᾳ ἀπείρου ἔχει οὕτως· οὐσιοποίησις τοῦ ἀπείρου → ἀντίφασις διαιρετοῦ καὶ ἀδιαιρέτου → ἀδυναμία χωριστῆς ὑπάρξεως → πάθος ποσότητος.
Ἡ τάξις τῆς μεταβολῆς ἔχει οὕτως· ἀντίφασις → γένεσις ἢ φθορά· ἐναντία ἐν ὑποκειμένῳ → κίνησις· κοινὸν πέρας → συνέχεια.
Ἡ φορά ἄρχεται ἀπὸ τῆς ἀπορίας εἰ μία ἐπιστήμη δύναται πολλῶν ἀνομοίων ἀρχῶν καὶ οὐσιῶν εἶναι.
Ἡ ἀπορία μετατίθεται ἀπὸ τῆς ἑνότητος τοῦ γένους εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πρὸς ἓν ἀναφορᾶς.
Ἡ πρὸς ἓν ἀναφορὰ θεμελιοῖ μίαν θεωρίαν τοῦ ὄντος, τῶν παθῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν πρώτων ἐναντιώσεων.
Ἡ θεωρία τοῦ ὄντος ἀναλαμβάνει τὰς κοινὰς ἀρχάς, καὶ ἡ μὴ ἀντίφασις ἐλέγχεται διὰ τῆς ἀναγκαίας σημασίας τοῦ λόγου.
Ἡ ἐπιστήμη τῶν ὄντων διακρίνεται εἰς μερικὰς θεωρίας καὶ εἰς πρώτην θεωρίαν, ἧς ἡ πρωτεία ἐξαρτᾶται ἐκ χωριστῆς ἀκινήτου οὐσίας.
Τὸ ὂν διαιρεῖται εἰς καθ᾽ αὑτὸ καὶ κατὰ συμβεβηκός, καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ἐκβάλλεται ἐκ τῆς ἀναγκαίας ἐπιστήμης.
Ἡ δύναμις καὶ ἡ ἐνέργεια παρέχουσι τὸν ὁρισμὸν τῆς κινήσεως καὶ τοὺς ὅρους τῶν εἰδῶν αὐτῆς.
Ἡ τελικὴ φορά ἀποκλείει τὸ χωριστὸν ἄπειρον καὶ τάττει γένεσιν, φθοράν, κίνησιν, ἠρεμίαν, ἁφήν καὶ συνέχεια κατὰ διακεκριμένους λόγους.
Ἡ ἑνότης τῆς ἐπιστήμης μετατίθεται ἀπὸ τὴν ὁμογένειαν τῶν πραγμάτων εἰς τὴν κοινὴν πρὸς ἓν ἀναφοράν.
Τὸ ὂν καὶ τὸ ἓν παύει νοούμενον ὡς γένος καὶ τίθεται ὡς διακατηγορικὸς ὅρος τῶν ὄντων.
Ἡ πρώτη φιλοσοφία μετατίθεται ἐκ μιᾶς παραλλήλου ἐπιστήμης εἰς θεωρίαν τῶν κοινῶν ὅρων πάσης ἀποδείξεως.
Ἡ διαφωνία τῶν φαινομένων παύει ἀποτελοῦσα ἴσην πολλαπλότητα ἀληθειῶν καὶ γίνεται ζήτημα διαθέσεως τοῦ κρίνοντος.
Τὸ συμβεβηκὸς καὶ ἡ τύχη μετατίθενται ἐκ τῶν πρώτων αἰτίων εἰς τὴν ἀόριστον καὶ παράγωγον περιφέρειαν τοῦ ὄντος.
Ἡ κίνησις μετατίθεται ἐκ τοῦ μὴ ὄντος καὶ τῆς ἑτερότητος εἰς ὡρισμένην σχέσιν δυνάμεως καὶ ἐντελεχείας.
Τὸ ἄπειρον μετατίθεται ἐκ χωριστῆς οὐσίας καὶ ἐνεργείᾳ ὅλου εἰς ἐξαρτώμενον πάθος μεγέθους, ἀριθμοῦ, κινήσεως καὶ χρόνου.
Ἡ μεταβολὴ διαγράφεται ἐκ νέου διὰ τῆς διακρίσεως ἀντιφάσεως, ἐναντιότητος, κινήσεως, γενέσεως, φθορᾶς καὶ συνεχείας.
Ἐν τῷ ἐπιφανειακῷ βαθμῷ ὁ λόγος ἀπορεῖ περὶ τῆς μιᾶς σοφίας καὶ ὁρίζει τὸ συμβεβηκός, τὴν κίνησιν, τὸ ἄπειρον καὶ τὰ εἴδη μεταβολῆς.
Ἐν τῷ τῆς διατάξεως βαθμῷ αἱ ἐπιστῆμαι τάττονται κατὰ τὸ ὑφ᾽ ὃ θεωροῦσι τὸ ὄν καὶ κατὰ τὴν προτεραιότητα τοῦ ἐπιστητοῦ.
Ἐν τῷ ὑπερστρατηγικῷ βαθμῷ ἡ ἀντίρρησις μετατίθεται ἀπὸ τὸ λεγόμενον εἰς τοὺς ὅρους ὑφ᾽ οὓς σημασία, διάλογος καὶ ἀπόδειξις δυνατὰ γίγνονται.
Ἐν τῷ περὶ ὄντος καὶ χρόνου βαθμῷ ἡ πραγματικότης διαιρεῖται εἰς καθ᾽ αὑτὸ καὶ συμβεβηκός, δύναμιν καὶ ἐνέργειαν, φθαρτὸν καὶ ἀκίνητον, ἀναγκαῖον καὶ ἐνδεχόμενον.
Τὰ ἐξαιρεθέντα ἀξιώματα ἱκανά ἐστι πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς ἀναγωγῆς τοῦ ὄντος πρὸς μίαν ἐπιστήμην καὶ τῶν ἐφεξῆς διορισμῶν.
Ἀδιοριστότερον τοῦ δέοντος μένει τί ποτε ἀκριβῶς ἐστὶ τὸ ἓν πρὸς ὃ πάντα τὰ σημαινόμενα τοῦ ὄντος ἀνάγεται.
Ἡ διάταξις μάλιστα συμφωνεῖ ὅπου διακρίνει τὴν πρὸς ἓν ἑνότητα ἀπὸ τῆς τοῦ γένους ἑνότητος.
Ἡ ἰσχυροτάτη ἀπόδειξις ἐστὶν ὁ ἐλεγκτικὸς δεσμὸς μεταξὺ ὡρισμένης σημασίας, κοινωνίας λόγου καὶ μὴ ἀντιφάσεως.
Ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄνομα ἓν σημαίνειν εἰς τὸ ἐξ ἀνάγκης εἶναι τὸ σημαινόμενον πυκνοτέρα τοῦ ἀποδεδειγμένου μένει.
Ἡ ὕπαρξις χωριστῆς καὶ ἀκινήτου οὐσίας οὐ δείκνυται ἐνταῦθα, ὥστε ἡ πρωτεία τῆς θεολογικῆς ὑποθετικὴ παραμένει.
Ἡ ἀπόκρουσις τοῦ Πρωταγόρου ἰσχύει μάλιστα περὶ διεφθαρμένων αἰσθητηρίων καὶ πρακτικῶν ἀτοπιῶν, οὐ λύει δὲ πλήρως πᾶσαν διαφωνίαν περὶ καλοῦ καὶ ἀγαθοῦ.
Ἡ θεωρία τοῦ συμβεβηκότος συμφωνεῖ ἐντὸς ἑαυτῆς, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀδυναμία ἐπιστήμης, ἡ ἀοριστία τῶν αἰτίων καὶ ἡ σωτηρία τοῦ ἐνδεχομένου ἀλλήλαις ἕπονται.
Οἱ περὶ κινήσεως, ἀπείρου καὶ συνεχείας λόγοι προϋποτίθενται πλείονας φυσικὰς διαιρέσεις καὶ ἐπαγωγὰς ἢ ὅσας αὐτοτελῶς ἐνταῦθα θεμελιοῦσιν.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις σῴζει τὴν ἀληθῆ κίνησιν τοῦ λόγου, ἐπειδὴ ἐξ ἀποριῶν περὶ ἑνότητος διὰ ἀποφατικῶν ὅρων εἰς ἱεραρχίαν ἐπιστημῶν καὶ ὀντολογικῶν διορισμῶν προβαίνει.
It is asked how one wisdom can concern many beings differing in genus, their principles, and the common principles of demonstration.
Being, although spoken of in many ways, is referred to some one common thing, so as to admit one science.
First philosophy contemplates being qua being, its attributes in itself, the primary contrarieties, and the common demonstrative principles.
The most certain principle is not simply demonstrated, but is refutatively established against one who denies it through the necessary conditions of signifying and discoursing.
The ordering of the theoretical sciences depends on whether there is separate and unmoved substance; for if there is, theology becomes primary and universal.
The accidental, motion, the infinite, and changes are delimited by excluding necessary causation, the substantialization of abstractions, and the confusion of potency and actuality.
The reasoning proceeds diagnostically and reconstructively from aporia to distinction of meanings, thence to reference to one, and from the reference to definitions and exclusions.
Each particular science delimits some genus and, taking what it is as its subject, demonstrates the rest.
First philosophy contemplates being universally qua being, not qua some particular kind of being.
Being is spoken of in many ways, but all its significations are referred to some one common thing.
Of things spoken of with reference to one, there can be one science.
Contraries belong to one science, since contrarieties are referred to primary differences and privations.
The most common demonstrative principles belong to beings qua beings and therefore pertain to first philosophy.
It is impossible for the same thing both to be and not to be in the same respect and at the same time.
Of the most certain principle there is no simple demonstration from a more certain principle, but there is a refutation against one who denies it.
Communion in discourse requires each name to signify something known and one determinate thing.
Productive science places the principle of motion in the producer, practical science in the agent, and natural science in the thing moved itself.
There are three kinds of theoretical sciences: natural science, mathematics, and theology.
If there is separate and unmoved substance, the science concerning it is primary and universal by being prior.
Every science concerns what is always or what is for the most part.
The accidental comes to be neither always nor necessarily nor for the most part, and its causes are disorderly and indeterminate.
Motion is the actuality in the moved thing, caused by the mover, of that which is potentially being qua such.
Motion in itself exists only in respect of quality, quantity, or place.
A change of change and a motion of motion do not exist in themselves.
The infinite is neither separate substance nor an actually existing body, but an attribute of quantity relative to something else.
Things are continuous when their touching limits become the same and one.
The unity of wisdom does not require the principles of all beings to be one genus or contraries.
Being and one are not genera, since the differences of a genus do not participate in it.
Separate Forms and the intermediate mathematical objects posited do not provide a secure subject for the science sought.
First philosophy is identified neither with natural science concerning perishable sensibles nor with mathematics concerning non-separate things.
Neither matter, as existing only potentially, nor perishable form is an adequate eternal and separate principle.
Being and one cannot be predicated of all as separate substance, since not all beings are substances.
Neither natural science, nor dialectic, nor sophistry contemplates being qua being.
The principle of non-contradiction is not demonstrated through another prior and more certain principle.
The Heraclitean simultaneous truth of opposed assertions destroys its own assertion and every determinate signification.
What appears to each person is not a measure of being, nor are all conflicting opinions equally true.
There is no science of the accidental, and chance is not a primary cause in itself of order.
Motion is neither otherness, nor inequality, nor non-being, nor bare potency, nor complete actuality.
There is no infinite separate substance, actually infinite body, or infinite separate number.
Coming-to-be and perishing are not motions, nor can a change itself become the subject of another change.
The nature of being, spoken of in many ways, admits one science, because its multiplicity is relational and not merely homonymous.
The philosopher can contemplate the one and the many, the same and the other, and the remaining primary contrarieties.
The study of common demonstrative principles belongs not to another particular science but to first philosophy.
One who denies non-contradiction is refuted from the very fact of signifying something determinate.
The universal denial of truth destroys itself, since it is compelled to make some true assertion.
The equalization of every affirmation and negation destroys the differences among things and choice concerning them.
Natural science and mathematics are parts of wisdom, because they contemplate being only under a determinate aspect.
Theology becomes prior to natural science only if separate and unmoved substance exists.
First philosophy is universal not as a genus containing everything, but by concerning what is prior by nature.
The accidental falls outside demonstrative science.
The indeterminate causality of the accidental preserves the possibility of coming to be and not coming to be.
Motion is something intermediate between bare potency and completed actuality.
Alteration, increase or diminution, and locomotion are the three kinds of motion.
Coming-to-be and perishing are changes according to contradiction, not motions in a subject.
Motion cannot have itself as subject without infinite regress.
The infinite cannot be primary substance or an element.
Everything continuous is touching, but not everything touching is continuous.
The universality of metaphysics consists in reference and priority, not in one highest genus.
The unity of a science is judged from the common mode of reference of its subjects, not from their homogeneity.
The determinate signification of discourse and non-contradiction support one another, so that the destruction of one destroys the other also.
The indeterminacy of the accidental constitutes a condition of contingency and excludes universal causal necessity.
The primacy of theology is not unconditioned, but follows upon the demonstration of separate and unmoved substance.
Motion exists as incomplete actuality, because it is actuality, but of what is potential qua potential.
The prohibition of an actually infinite prevents the attributes of quantity and the limits of bodies from being substantialized.
Not every one science must have one genus spoken of univocally.
Being need not be conceived as the highest genus for a universal science to be possible.
Not every principle requires an account from another prior principle, since then demonstration proceeds to infinity.
One who signifies nothing determinate does not oppose discourse, but is placed outside communion in discourse.
The difference among appearances does not eliminate falsity, nor does it turn every perception into an equal criterion.
Causality cannot enclose every event in a necessary chain without destroying contingency.
Things conceived by abstraction, limits, and the infinite must not be transformed into separate substances.
There is no change of change, because neither a subject nor a final form can be assigned to it without infinite regress.
Indeterminate identity, according to which the same thing is and is not at once, is posited as impossible, since it simultaneously obliterates discourse, science, and action.
Non-being and the accidental cannot become the primary domain of explanation.
First philosophy cannot absolutely assume the theological form before separate and unmoved substance has been shown.
Motion cannot simply be reduced to privation, potency, or completed actuality.
The order of the heaven cannot arise from chance as a primary cause, because the accidental is posterior to what is in itself.
The first generation of the reasoning is as follows: many genera of beings → aporia concerning one wisdom → search for a unity that is not generic.
The solution of scientific multiplicity is as follows: being spoken of in many ways → reference to one → one theory of being qua being.
The reduction of contraries is as follows: many contrarieties → privation and primary differences → one science of opposites.
The assignment of common principles is as follows: universal validity → being qua being → first philosophy.
The refutation concerning contradiction is as follows: denial of the principle → necessity of determinate signification → use of the principle → self-destruction of the denial.
The refutation of relativism is as follows: disagreement of appearances → distinction between criterion and affection → exclusion of the equal truth of all things.

The ordering of the sciences is as follows: difference among principles of motion → distinction of practical, productive, and theoretical → natural science, mathematics, and theology → hypothesis of the separate unmoved.
The delimitation of the accidental is as follows: absence of necessity and frequency → indeterminate causes → impossibility of science → preservation of contingency.
The definition of motion is as follows: potency → actuality of the possible qua possible → incomplete actuality → motion in respect of quality, quantity, or place.
The refutation of the actually infinite is as follows: substantialization of the infinite → contradiction of divisible and indivisible → impossibility of separate existence → attribute of quantity.
The ordering of change is as follows: contradiction → coming-to-be or perishing; contraries in a subject → motion; common limit → continuity.
The course begins from the aporia whether one science can concern many dissimilar principles and substances.
The aporia is transferred from unity of genus to unity of reference to one.
Reference to one grounds one theory of being, its attributes, and the primary contrarieties.
The theory of being takes up the common principles, and non-contradiction is refutatively established through the necessary signification of discourse.
The science of beings is distinguished into particular theories and a first theory, whose primacy depends on separate unmoved substance.
Being is divided into what is in itself and what is accidental, and the latter is excluded from necessary science.
Potency and actuality provide the definition of motion and the terms of its kinds.
The final course excludes the separate infinite and orders coming-to-be, perishing, motion, rest, contact, and continuity according to distinct accounts.
The unity of science is transferred from the homogeneity of things to their common reference to one.
Being and one cease to be conceived as genera and are posited as transcategorial terms of beings.
First philosophy is transferred from one parallel science to a theory of the common terms of every demonstration.
The disagreement of appearances ceases to constitute an equal multiplicity of truths and becomes a question of the disposition of the judge.
The accidental and chance are transferred from primary causes to the indeterminate and derivative periphery of being.
Motion is transferred from non-being and otherness to a determinate relation of potency and actuality.
The infinite is transferred from separate substance and an actual whole to a dependent attribute of magnitude, number, motion, and time.
Change is redrawn through the distinction of contradiction, contrariety, motion, coming-to-be, perishing, and continuity.
At the surface level, the argument raises an aporia concerning one wisdom and defines the accidental, motion, the infinite, and the kinds of change.
At the level of arrangement, the sciences are ordered according to that under which they contemplate being and according to the priority of the knowable.
At the hyper-strategic level, the objection is transferred from what is said to the conditions under which signification, dialogue, and demonstration become possible.
At the level concerning being and time, reality is divided into what is in itself and accidental, potency and actuality, perishable and unmoved, necessary and contingent.
The selected axioms are sufficient for reconstructing the reference of being to one science and the subsequent delimitations.
What exactly is the one to which all the significations of being are referred remains more indeterminate than it should.
The arrangement is most coherent where it distinguishes unity of reference to one from unity of genus.
The strongest demonstration is the refutative bond between determinate signification, communion in discourse, and non-contradiction.
The transition from a name's signifying one thing to the signified's being necessarily remains denser than what has been demonstrated.
The existence of separate and unmoved substance is not shown here, so the primacy of theology remains hypothetical.
The refutation of Protagoras is strongest concerning corrupted sense-organs and practical absurdities, but does not fully resolve every disagreement concerning the beautiful and the good.
The theory of the accidental is internally coherent, because the impossibility of science, the indeterminacy of causes, and the preservation of contingency follow one another.
The accounts concerning motion, the infinite, and continuity presuppose more physical divisions and inductions than they independently establish here.
The reconstruction preserves the true movement of the argument, because it proceeds from aporias concerning unity through apophatic terms to a hierarchy of sciences and ontological delimitations.
Ὁ λόγος ζητεῖ τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰ αἴτια τῶν οὐσιῶν, ἐπεὶ ἡ οὐσία τῶν ὄντων πρώτη ἐστίν.
Ἡ τῶν οὐσιῶν διαίρεσις εἰς αἰσθητὰς μεταβλητάς τε καὶ ἀϊδίους καὶ εἰς ἀκίνητον οὐσίαν τὴν ὅλην ἀπόδειξιν τάττει.
Ἡ τῆς αἰσθητῆς οὐσίας μεταβολὴ ἐκ τῆς ὕλης, τοῦ εἴδους, τῆς στερήσεως καὶ τοῦ κινοῦντος ἀνασυνίσταται.
Αἱ ἀρχαὶ τῶν καθ᾽ ἕκαστα ἕτεραι μὲν ἀριθμῷ καὶ γένει, αἱ αὐταὶ δὲ κατὰ λόγον καὶ ἀναλογίαν εἰσίν.
Ἡ ἀϊδιότης χρόνου καὶ κινήσεως ἀπαιτεῖ ἀΐδιον ἀρχὴν ἧς ἡ οὐσία ἐνέργειά ἐστιν.
Ἡ ἀκίνητος ἐνέργεια κινεῖ ὡς νοητὸν καὶ ἐφετόν, καὶ νοεῖ ἑαυτὴν ὡς νόησις νοήσεως.
Ὁ μεταφυσικὸς καὶ ἀνασυστατικὸς συλλογισμὸς ἀπὸ τῆς προτεραιότητος τῆς οὐσίας διὰ τῆς μεταβολῆς καὶ τῆς ἐνεργείας εἰς τὴν μίαν πρώτην ἀρχὴν καὶ τὴν τάξιν τοῦ ὅλου προχωρεῖ.
Ἡ οὐσία τῶν λοιπῶν κατηγοριῶν προτέρα ἐστίν, ἐπεὶ πάθη καὶ κινήσεις χωρὶς οὐσίας οὐκ εἰσίν.
Τρεῖς εἰσὶν οὐσίαι, ἡ αἰσθητὴ φθαρτή, ἡ αἰσθητὴ ἀΐδιος καὶ ἡ ἀκίνητος.
Πᾶσα μεταβολὴ εἰς ἐναντίωσιν γίνεται καὶ ὑποκείμενόν τι ἀπαιτεῖ τὸ ἐν τῇ μεταβολῇ ὑπομένον.
Ἡ ὕλη τρίτον τι παρὰ τὰ ἐναντία ἐστὶ καὶ δυνάμει ἀμφότερα δύναται εἶναι.
Πᾶν μεταβάλλει ἐκ τοῦ δυνάμει ὄντος εἰς τὸ ἐνεργείᾳ ὄν.
Ἡ ἐσχάτη ὕλη καὶ τὸ ἔσχατον εἶδος οὐ γίγνονται, ἐπεὶ πᾶσα γένεσις ὕλην, κινοῦν καὶ εἶδος προϋποτίθεται.
Ἡ φυσικὴ οὐσία ἐκ συνωνύμου ἐνεργείᾳ οὐσίας γίγνεται, ἡ δὲ τεχνητὴ ἐκ τοῦ ἐν τῇ τέχνῃ λόγου.
Αἱ αἰσθηταὶ μεταβολαὶ κατὰ λόγον ἔχουσιν ὕλην, εἶδος, στέρησιν καὶ κινοῦν.
Αἱ ἀρχαὶ τῶν καθ᾽ ἕκαστα καθ᾽ ἕκαστά εἰσιν, τὰ δὲ καθόλου μόνον κοινὸν λόγον παρέχει.
Ὁ χρόνος καὶ ἡ κίνησις ἀΐδιά εἰσι, καὶ μόνη ἡ κατὰ τόπον κυκλικὴ φορὰ δύναται συνεχὴς εἶναι.
Ἡ ἀΐδιος κίνησις ἀρχὴν ἀπαιτεῖ ἧς ἡ οὐσία ἐνέργεια καὶ ἄνευ ὕλης ἐστίν.
Τὸ πρῶτον ἀκίνητον κινεῖ ὡς νοητὸν καὶ ἐφετόν, οὐχ ὡς αὐτὸ κινούμενον.
Τὸ πρῶτον κινοῦν ἐξ ἀνάγκης ἐστὶ καὶ οὐκ ἐνδέχεται ἄλλως ἔχειν.
Ἐν τῷ ἀΰλῳ νῷ τὸ νοοῦν καὶ τὸ νοούμενον ταὐτόν ἐστιν, ὥστε ἡ πρώτη νόησις ἑαυτὴν νοεῖ.
Ἑκάστη ἀΐδιος οὐράνιος φορὰ ὑπὸ ἀϊδίου καὶ καθ᾽ αὑτὸ ἀκινήτου οὐσίας κινεῖται.
Τὸ πρῶτον κινοῦν, ἐπεὶ ἄυλον, ἓν καὶ κατὰ λόγον καὶ κατ᾽ ἀριθμόν ἐστιν, ὥστε εἷς οὐρανός ἐστιν.
Τὸ ἀγαθὸν τοῦ ὅλου καὶ ὡς κεχωρισμένη πρώτη ἀρχὴ καὶ ὡς ἡ ἐξ αὐτῆς τάξις ὑπάρχει.
Τὸ ποιόν, τὸ ποσόν, τὸ πρός τι, τὰ πάθη καὶ αἱ κινήσεις οὔτε χωριστὰ οὔτε ἁπλῶς πρότερα τῆς οὐσίας εἰσίν.
Ἡ γένεσις οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ τυχόντος μὴ ὄντος οὐδ᾽ ἐκ τῶν ἐναντίων ἄνευ ὑποκειμένου γίνεται.
Ἡ ὕλη οὐδενὶ τῶν ἐναντίων ἐναντία ἐστίν.
Ἡ ὕλη καὶ τὸ εἶδος οὐ γίγνονται εἰς ἄπειρον ἐξ ἄλλης ὕλης καὶ ἄλλου εἴδους.
Τὸ ὂν καὶ τὸ ἓν οὐκ εἰσὶ κοινὰ στοιχεῖα πάντων, ἐπεὶ καὶ τοῖς συνθέτοις ὑπάρχουσιν.
Αἱ χωρισταὶ ἰδέαι οὔτε τὴν γένεσιν τῶν καθ᾽ ἕκαστα οὔτε τὴν κίνησιν ἱκανῶς αἰτιῶνται.
Ἡ δύναμις καθ᾽ αὑτὴν οὐκ ἐξαρκεῖ πρὸς ἀΐδιον κίνησιν, ἐπεὶ ἐνδέχεται τὸ δυνάμενον μὴ ἐνεργεῖν.
Ψυχὴ ὕστερον οὖσα ἢ ἅμα τῷ οὐρανῷ οὐ δύναται εἶναι ἡ πρώτη ἀρχὴ τῆς κινήσεως.
Τὸ ἓν καὶ τὸ ἁπλοῦν οὐ ταὐτόν ἐστιν, ἐπεὶ τὸ μὲν μέτρον σημαίνει, τὸ δὲ ποιάν τινα ἀμεριστίαν.
Τὸ πρῶτον κινοῦν οὐκ ἔχει ὕλην, μέγεθος, μέρη, πάθος, μεταβολὴν ἢ ἐναντίον.
Ὁ πρῶτος νοῦς οὔτε ἀργὸς οὔτε ὑπὸ χείρονος νοητοῦ κυριευόμενος οὔτε ἐξ ἄλλου εἰς ἄλλο νοούμενον μεταβάλλων ἐστίν.
Οὐδεμία φορὰ φορᾶς ἕνεκα εἰς ἄπειρον ὑπάρχει, ἀλλὰ πᾶσα οὐράνιος φορὰ εἰς φερόμενόν τι τελευτᾷ.
Τὰ ἀνθρωπόμορφα καὶ ζωόμορφα περὶ θεῶν μυθεύματα οὐ μέρος τῆς ἀποδείξεως ἐστίν.
Αἱ πρῶται ἀρχαὶ οὐκ εἰσὶ πλῆθος ἀσύντακτον καὶ ἀλλήλοις ἀσύμβλητον.
Τὰ αἴτια τῶν οὐσιῶν αἴτια καὶ τῶν παθῶν καὶ τῶν κινήσεων γίγνεται, ἐπεὶ ταῦτα ἄνευ οὐσιῶν ἀναιρεῖται.
Αἱ αἰτίαι τέτταρες μέν εἰσι κατὰ διαίρεσιν, τρόπον δέ τινα τρεῖς, ὅταν τὸ κινοῦν τῷ εἴδει κατὰ λόγον συμπίπτῃ.
Τὸ γίγνεσθαι ἐκ μὴ ὄντος σημαίνει γένεσιν ἐκ τοῦ μὴ ἐνεργείᾳ ὄντος, οὐκ ἐκ ἁπλῶς μηδενός.
Αἱ ἰδέαι πρὸς τὴν γένεσιν περιττεύουσιν, ἐπεὶ τὸ συνώνυμον γεννῶν καὶ ὁ ἐν τῇ τέχνῃ λόγος τὴν αἰτίαν παρέχουσιν.
Αἱ ἀρχαὶ πάντων αἱ αὐταὶ λέγονται μόνον κατ᾽ ἀναλογίαν, ἕτεραι δὲ κατὰ γένος, ἀριθμὸν καὶ ὑποκείμενον.
Ἡ συνύπαρξις ἀϊδίου περιόδου καὶ γενέσεως καὶ φθορᾶς ἀπαιτεῖ τὸ μὲν πρῶτον ἀεὶ ὡσαύτως ἐνεργεῖν, τὸ δὲ δεύτερον ἄλλως καὶ ἄλλως.
Ἡ τάξις τῶν ἀκινήτων οὐσιῶν ἀκολουθεῖ τῇ τάξει τῶν οὐρανίων φορῶν, ἡ δὲ πᾶσα τάξις ἐξαρτᾶται ἐκ μιᾶς πρώτης ἀρχῆς.
Ἡ τοῦ ὅλου τάξις οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοτελὴς παρὰ τὴν πρώτην οὐσίαν, ἀλλ᾽ ὥσπερ ἡ τάξις στρατεύματος ἐκ τοῦ ἄρχοντος ἔχει τὸ εὖ.
Ἡ προτεραιότης τῆς οὐσίας συνάπτει τὴν φυσικὴν θεωρίαν τῆς μεταβολῆς πρὸς τὴν περὶ τῆς πρώτης ἀκινήτου ἀρχῆς θεωρίαν.
Ἡ προτεραιότης τῆς ἐνεργείας λύει ἅμα τὴν ἀπορίαν τῆς γενέσεως καὶ τὴν ἀπορίαν τῆς ἀϊδίου κινήσεως.
Ἡ αἰτιότης κατὰ βαθμοὺς τάττεται, ὥστε αἱ ἐνυπάρχουσαι ἀρχαὶ τὴν μεταβολὴν διορίζειν, τὸ προσεχὲς κινοῦν αὐτὴν ἐνεργεῖν, τὸ δὲ πρῶτον ἐφετὸν τὴν ὅλην τάξιν τελειοῦν.
Ἡ κοινότης τῶν ἀρχῶν οὐ κοινὴ ὕλη ἢ κοινὸν γένος ἐστίν, ἀλλὰ ταὐτότης σχέσεως μεταξὺ ὕλης, εἴδους, στερήσεως καὶ κινοῦντος.
Ἡ πρώτη οὐσία ἐστὶν ἅμα ἀναγκαῖον ὄν, ἀκίνητον αἴτιον, ἄριστον νοητόν, αὐτονοουμένη νόησις καὶ ἀΐδιος ζωή.
Ἡ τῶν οὐρανίων κινήσεων πολλότης εἰς πλῆθος ἀκινήτων οὐσιῶν ἀνάγεται, ἡ δὲ ἑνότης τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦτο ὑπὸ μίαν πρώτην ἀρχὴν τάττει.
Εἰ μηδεμία οὐσία παρὰ τὰ αἰσθητὰ εἴη, οὐκ ἂν εἴη πρώτη ἀρχή, ἀΐδιος τάξις ἢ ἱκανὴ αἰτία τῆς οὐρανίου κινήσεως.
Εἰ ἡ δύναμις ἁπλῶς προτέρα τῆς ἐνεργείας εἴη, ἐνδέχοιτο μηδὲν ἐνεργείᾳ εἶναι καὶ μηδεμίαν κίνησιν ἀρχὴν λαβεῖν.
Εἰ ταὐτὰ ἀριθμῷ στοιχεῖα πασῶν τῶν κατηγοριῶν εἴη, κοινόν τι πρότερον οὐσίας καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν κατηγοριῶν ὑπάρχειν ἔδει.
Εἰ τὰ ἐναντία αὐτὰ ἄνευ ὕλης μεταβάλλοι, τὸ ἀπαθὲς ὑπ᾽ ἀλλήλων ἔδει ἑαυτὸ ποιεῖν τὸ ἐναντίον.
Εἰ ὁ πρῶτος νοῦς ἄλλο τι κρεῖττον ἑαυτοῦ νοοῖ, τὸ τίμιον αὐτοῦ ἐκτὸς αὐτοῦ κεῖται καὶ αὐτὸς οὐκ ἔστιν ἡ ἀρίστη οὐσία.
Εἰ πλείους οὐρανοὶ τοῦ αὐτοῦ εἴδους εἴησαν, αἱ πρῶται ἀρχαὶ ἀριθμῷ πολλαὶ καὶ ὕλην ἔχουσαι εἶναι ἔδει.
Εἰ ἀκίνητοι οὐσίαι μηδεμιᾷ ἀϊδίῳ φορᾷ συντείνοιεν, οὔτε ὡς κινοῦσαι οὔτε ὡς τέλη θέσιν ἐν τῷ ὅλῳ ἕξουσιν.
Εἰ τὸ πρῶτον ἔχοι ἐναντίον, ὕλην καὶ δύναμιν τῶν ἐναντίων ἔχοι καὶ οὐκ ἂν εἴη καθαρὰ ἐνέργεια.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἁπλῆ γένεσις ἐξ ἀπολύτου μὴ ὄντος, ἐπεὶ πᾶσα γένεσις δυνάμει ὂν προϋποτίθεται.
Ἀποκλείεται χάος ἢ νὺξ ἄπειρον χρόνον πρὸ τῆς ἐνεργείας, ἐπεὶ οὐδὲν δυνάμει ὂν αὐτὸ ἑαυτὸ εἰς ἐνέργειαν ἄγει.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ εἰς ἄπειρον ἀναγωγὴ γενέσεων, κινήσεων, ἀρχῶν καὶ τελῶν, ἐπεὶ ἄνευ πρώτου οὐδὲ τὰ ἑπόμενα ἐνεργεῖ.
Ἀποκλείεται χωριστὴ ἀρχὴ αἰτιωδῶς ἀργή, ἐπεὶ τὸ χωριστὸν ὃ μήτε κινεῖ μήτε τέλος ἐστὶν οὐδὲν πρὸς τὴν τάξιν συντελεῖ.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ὕπαρξις πολλῶν ἀσυντάκτων πρώτων κυρίων, ἐπεὶ ἡ τοῦ ὅλου τάξις μίαν ἀρχὴν ἀπαιτεῖ.
Ἀποκλείεται τὸ ἀτελὲς καὶ σπερματικὸν εἶναι ἁπλῶς πρῶτον, ἐπεὶ τὸ σπέρμα ἐκ προτέρας τελείας οὐσίας γίγνεται.
Ἡ ἀχωριστία τῶν παθῶν καὶ τῶν κινήσεων γεννᾷ τὴν προτεραιότητα τῆς οὐσίας, ἡ δὲ προτεραιότης τὴν ζήτησιν τῶν ἀρχῶν αὐτῆς.
Ἡ μεταβλητότης τῆς αἰσθητῆς οὐσίας γεννᾷ τὴν ἐναντίωσιν, ἡ δὲ ἀδυναμία τῶν ἐναντίων αὐτῶν μεταβάλλειν γεννᾷ τὴν ὕλην.
Ἡ ὕλη ὡς δύναμις καὶ τὸ εἶδος ὡς ἐνέργεια γεννῶσι τὸ σχῆμα τῆς μεταβολῆς ἐκ δυνάμει ὄντος εἰς ἐνεργείᾳ ὄν.
Ἡ διαφορὰ τῶν γενῶν καὶ τῶν καθ᾽ ἕκαστα γεννᾷ ἑτέρας ἀριθμῷ ἀρχάς, ἡ δὲ κοινὴ αἰτιακὴ σχέσις τὴν κατ᾽ ἀναλογίαν ταυτότητα.
Ἡ ἀϊδιότης χρόνου καὶ κυκλικῆς φορᾶς ἀναιρεῖ τὴν καθαρὰν δύναμιν ὡς πρώτην καὶ γεννᾷ τὴν καθαρὰν ἐνέργειαν.
Ἡ ἀκινησία τῆς πρώτης ἐνεργείας μετατίθησι τὴν κίνησιν εἰς τὸ ἐφετὸν καὶ νοητόν, ἐξ οὗ ἡ ἀναγκαία καὶ αὐτονοουμένη ζωή συνάγεται.
Αἱ πολλαὶ οὐράνιοι φοραὶ γεννῶσι πλείονας ἀκινήτους οὐσίας, ἡ δὲ μία πρώτη φορὰ καὶ ἡ ἀϋλία τοῦ πρώτου γεννῶσι μίαν ἀρχὴν καὶ ἕνα οὐρανόν.
Ἡ ζήτησις τῶν ἀρχῶν τῶν ὄντων μετατίθεται εἰς τὴν ζήτησιν τῶν ἀρχῶν τῆς οὐσίας.
Ἡ διαίρεσις τῶν οὐσιῶν ἄγει πρῶτον εἰς τὴν ἀνάλυσιν τῆς μεταβλητῆς αἰσθητῆς οὐσίας.
Ἡ ἀνάλυσις τῆς μεταβολῆς ἄγει ἐκ τῶν ἐναντίων εἰς τὴν ὕλην καὶ ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν δύναμιν καὶ τὴν ἐνέργειαν.
Ἡ τῶν αἰσθητῶν αἰτιῶν διάταξις μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ τῆς ἀριθμητικῆς διαφορᾶς εἰς τὴν κατ᾽ ἀναλογίαν κοινότητα.
Ἡ ἀϊδιότης τῆς κινήσεως ἄγει ἐκ τῆς προτεραιότητος τῆς ἐνεργείας εἰς τὸ ἀκίνητον κινοῦν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν θείαν νόησιν.
Ἡ πολλότης τῶν οὐρανίων κινήσεων τάττεται ὑπὸ μίαν πρώτην ἀρχήν, καὶ ἡ ἑνότης αὕτη περαίνει τὴν κριτικὴν τῶν πολλῶν καὶ ἀσυνδέτων ἀρχῶν.
Τὰ ὄντα διαγράφονται οὐκέτι ὡς ὁμοτίμως παρακείμενα, ἀλλὰ περὶ τὴν προτέραν οὐσίαν τεταγμένα.
Τὸ μὴ ὂν διαιρεῖται εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐνεργείᾳ καὶ τὸ ἁπλῶς μὴ ὄν, ὥστε ἡ γένεσις μὴ σημαίνειν δημιουργίαν ἐκ μηδενός.
Ἡ δυὰς τῶν ἐναντίων μεταγράφεται εἰς τριάδα, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ὕλη ὡς κοινὸν ὑποκείμενον μεταξὺ αὐτῶν τίθεται.
Ἡ ἀντίθεσις ταὐτῶν καὶ ἑτέρων ἀρχῶν λύεται διὰ τῆς διακρίσεως τοῦ ταὐτοῦ κατ᾽ ἀναλογίαν καὶ τοῦ ἑτέρου καθ᾽ ὑποκείμενον.
Ἡ ἐνέργεια ἐκ ψιλοῦ τρόπου τοῦ εἶναι μετατίθεται εἰς ἀρχὴν ὀντολογικῶς προτέραν τῆς δυνάμεως.
Τὸ κινεῖν ἄνευ κινήσεως γίνεται νοητόν, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ποιητικὴ ὠθία ἀντικαθίσταται ὑπὸ τῆς κινήσεως ὡς πρὸς ἐφετὸν τέλος.
Ἡ ἀστρολογικὴ διαγραφὴ τῶν φορῶν μεταβάλλεται εἰς τάξιν ἀκινήτων οὐσιῶν καὶ βαθμῶν προτεραιότητος.
Τὸ ἀγαθὸν οὐκέτι διαιρεῖται εἰς κεχωρισμένον τέλος καὶ ἐνυπάρχουσαν τάξιν, ἀλλ᾽ ὡς πρώτη ἀρχὴ ἀμφότερα συνάπτει.
Ἐν τῷ ἐπιφανειακῷ βαθμῷ ἐξετάζονται αἱ αἰσθηταὶ μεταβολαί, αἱ οὐράνιοι φοραὶ καὶ αἱ ἀπορίαι περὶ τοῦ θείου νοῦ.
Ἐν τῷ τῆς διατάξεως βαθμῷ αἱ μεταβολαὶ τάττονται διὰ τῆς ὕλης, τοῦ εἴδους, τῆς στερήσεως, τοῦ κινοῦντος, τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ τῆς ἐνεργείας.
Ἐν τῷ ὑπερστρατηγικῷ βαθμῷ ἡ διαμάχη περὶ μιᾶς ἢ πολλῶν ἀρχῶν μετατίθεται εἰς διάκρισιν ἀριθμητικῆς ἑτερότητος, ἀναλογικῆς ταυτότητος καὶ τάξεως πρὸς μίαν ἀρχήν.
Ἐν τῷ περὶ ὄντος καὶ χρόνου βαθμῷ ἡ ἐνέργεια προτέρα τῆς δυνάμεως, ὁ χρόνος καὶ ἡ κίνησις ἀΐδια, ἡ δὲ πρώτη οὐσία ἄχρονος κατὰ γένεσιν καὶ ἀΐδιος κατὰ ζωήν τίθεται.
Τὰ ἐξαιρεθέντα ἀξιώματα ἱκανά ἐστι πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς φορᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς αἰσθητῆς οὐσίας εἰς τὴν ἀκίνητον ἀρχήν.
Ἰσχυρόταται εἰσὶν ἡ ἀπόδειξις τοῦ ὑποκειμένου ἐκ τῆς μεταβολῆς καὶ ἡ ἀναίρεσις τῆς δυνάμεως ὡς ἱκανῆς αἰτίας ἀϊδίου κινήσεως.
Ἡ διάκρισις τῶν αὐτῶν κατ᾽ ἀναλογίαν καὶ τῶν ἑτέρων καθ᾽ ὑποκείμενον διατηρεῖ τὴν ἐντὸς τοῦ συστήματος συμφωνίαν.
Ἡ οὐσία λέγεται καὶ ὕλη καὶ εἶδος καὶ σύνθετον καὶ καθαρὰ ἐνέργεια, καὶ ἡ ἀναλογία συνάπτει μὲν ταῦτα, οὐ μὴν ἕνα παντάπασιν ἀκριβῆ ὁρισμὸν παρέχει.
Τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀκινήτων οὐσιῶν ἐξαρτᾶται ἐκ μεταβλητῶν ἀστρολογικῶν ὑποθέσεων, διὸ οἱ ἀριθμοὶ πεντήκοντα πέντε ἢ ἑπτὰ καὶ τεσσαράκοντα οὐκ ἀναγκαῖον συμπέρασμα αποτελοῦσιν.
Ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ ἑκάστης ἀϊδίου φορᾶς εἰς ἰδίαν ἀκίνητον οὐσίαν προϋποτίθησιν ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἀποδεικνύει πλήρως τὴν μονοσήμαντον ἀντιστοιχίαν κινήσεως καὶ κινοῦντος.
Ὁ τρόπος καθ᾽ ὃν τὸ ἐφετὸν καὶ νοητὸν παράγει ἀκριβῶς τὴν κυκλικὴν φορὰν καὶ τὰς μεταβολὰς γενέσεως καὶ φθορᾶς πυκνῶς μόνον δηλοῦται.
Ἡ συνύπαρξις πολλῶν ἀκινήτων οὐσιῶν καὶ μιᾶς πρώτης ἀρχῆς τάξει μὲν συμβιβάζεται, ἡ δὲ περάτωσις εἰς ἕνα κοίρανον καὶ στρατιωτικῇ εἰκόνι καὶ ῥητορικῇ ἰσχύι στηρίζεται.
Ἡ ταυτότης νοῦ καὶ νοητοῦ ἐκ τῆς ἀϋλίας συνάγεται, ἡ δὲ ἀκριβὴς σχέσις αὐτονοήσεως καὶ νοητοῦ οὐ περαιτέρω διαιρεῖται.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις σῴζει τὴν ἀληθῆ κίνησιν τοῦ λόγου, ἐὰν ἡ ἀϊδιότης τῆς κυκλικῆς φορᾶς, ἡ προτεραιότης τῆς ἐνεργείας καὶ ἡ τελικὴ αἰτιότης τοῦ πρώτου γένωνται δεκταί.
The account seeks the principles and causes of substances, since substance is primary among beings.
The division of substances into perceptible mutable and eternal substances, and into immovable substance, orders the whole demonstration.
The change of perceptible substance is reconstructed from matter, form, privation, and the moving cause.
The principles of particulars are different in number and genus, but the same in account and analogy.
The eternity of time and motion requires an eternal principle whose substance is actuality.
The immovable actuality moves as an object of thought and desire, and thinks itself as thought thinking thought.
The metaphysical and reconstructive reasoning proceeds from the priority of substance, through change and actuality, to the one first principle and the order of the whole.
Substance is prior to the remaining categories, since affections and motions do not exist apart from substance.
There are three substances: the perishable perceptible, the eternal perceptible, and the immovable.
Every change occurs into contrariety and requires some underlying subject that persists in the change.
Matter is a third thing besides the contraries and can potentially be both.
Everything changes from what is potentially being into what is actually being.
Ultimate matter and ultimate form do not come to be, since every coming-to-be presupposes matter, a mover, and form.
Natural substance comes to be from a synonymously actual substance, whereas artificial substance comes to be from the account in the art.
Perceptible changes have, according to account, matter, form, privation, and a mover.
The principles of particulars are particular, while the universal provides only a common account.
Time and motion are eternal, and only circular locomotion can be continuous.
Eternal motion requires a principle whose substance is actuality and which is without matter.
The first unmoved mover moves as an object of thought and desire, not as itself being moved.
The first mover exists of necessity and cannot be otherwise.
In immaterial intellect, that which thinks and that which is thought are the same, so that first thought thinks itself.
Each eternal celestial motion is moved by an eternal substance that is immovable in itself.
The first mover, since it is immaterial, is one both in account and in number, so that there is one heaven.
The good of the whole exists both as a separate first principle and as the order deriving from it.
Quality, quantity, relation, affections, and motions are neither separable nor simply prior to substance.
Coming-to-be does not occur from any chance non-being, nor from contraries without an underlying subject.
Matter is contrary to none of the contraries.
Matter and form do not come to be to infinity from other matter and another form.
Being and one are not common elements of all things, since they also belong to composites.
Separate Ideas do not adequately explain either the coming-to-be of particulars or motion.
Potentiality by itself is not sufficient for eternal motion, since what is capable may fail to be actual.
A soul that is later than, or simultaneous with, the heaven cannot be the first principle of motion.
The one and the simple are not the same, since the former signifies measure, while the latter signifies a certain indivisibility.
The first mover has no matter, magnitude, parts, affection, change, or contrary.
The first intellect is neither inactive, nor dominated by an inferior object of thought, nor changing from one object of thought to another.
No motion exists for the sake of motion to infinity, but every celestial motion terminates in some moved thing.
Anthropomorphic and zoomorphic myths concerning gods are not part of the demonstration.
The first principles are not an unordered multitude incompatible with one another.
The causes of substances become causes also of affections and motions, since these are removed without substances.
The causes are four according to division, but in a way three, when the mover coincides with the form in account.
Coming to be from non-being signifies coming-to-be from what is not actually being, not from absolutely nothing.
Ideas are superfluous for coming-to-be, since the synonymous generator and the account in the art provide the cause.
The principles of all things are said to be the same only by analogy, but different in genus, number, and underlying subject.
The coexistence of eternal revolution and generation and corruption requires the first to be always actual in the same way, and the second differently at different times.
The order of immovable substances follows the order of celestial motions, while the whole order depends upon one first principle.
The order of the whole is not self-complete apart from the first substance, but, just as the order of an army, has its good from the commander.
The priority of substance connects the natural inquiry into change with the inquiry concerning the first immovable principle.
The priority of actuality resolves at once the aporia of coming-to-be and the aporia of eternal motion.
Causality is ordered in degrees, so that the immanent principles delimit change, the proximate mover actualizes it, and the first object of desire completes the whole order.
The commonality of principles is not common matter or a common genus, but identity of relation among matter, form, privation, and mover.
The first substance is at once necessary being, an unmoved cause, the best object of thought, self-thinking thought, and eternal life.
The plurality of celestial motions is referred to a plurality of immovable substances, but the unity of heaven orders this plurality under one first principle.
If there were no substance besides perceptible things, there would be no first principle, eternal order, or sufficient cause of celestial motion.
If potentiality were simply prior to actuality, it would be possible for nothing to be actual and for no motion to take its beginning.
If the elements of all categories were the same in number, some common thing prior to substance and the remaining categories would have to exist.
If the contraries themselves changed without matter, what is impassible would have to make itself contrary through one another.
If the first intellect thinks something better than itself, its excellence lies outside itself, and it is not the best substance.
If there were several heavens of the same form, the first principles would have to be many in number and possess matter.
If immovable substances did not correspond to any eternal motion, they would have no position in the whole either as movers or as ends.
If the first had a contrary, it would have matter and potentiality for the contraries and would not be pure actuality.
Simple coming-to-be from absolute non-being is excluded, since every coming-to-be presupposes potential being.
Chaos or night for an infinite time before actuality is excluded, since nothing potentially being brings itself into actuality.
An infinite regress of generations, motions, principles, and ends is excluded, since without a first, not even the subsequent things are actual.
A separate principle that is causally inactive is excluded, since what is separate and neither moves nor is an end contributes nothing to order.
The existence of many unordered first rulers is excluded, since the order of the whole requires one principle.
That which is imperfect and seminal is excluded from being simply first, since seed comes to be from a prior complete substance.
The inseparability of affections and motions generates the priority of substance, and this priority generates the inquiry into its principles.
The mutability of perceptible substance generates contrariety, and the impossibility of the contraries themselves changing generates matter.
Matter as potentiality and form as actuality generate the schema of change from potential being to actual being.
The difference of genera and particulars generates principles different in number, while common causal relation generates identity according to analogy.
The eternity of time and circular motion eliminates pure potentiality as first and generates pure actuality.
The immobility of first actuality transfers motion to the desirable and intelligible, from which necessary and self-thinking life is inferred.
The many celestial motions generate several immovable substances, while the one first motion and the immateriality of the first generate one principle and one heaven.
The inquiry into the principles of beings is transferred to the inquiry into the principles of substance.
The division of substances leads first to the analysis of mutable perceptible substance.
The analysis of change leads from contraries to matter and thence to potentiality and actuality.
The arrangement of perceptible causes passes from numerical difference to commonality according to analogy.
The eternity of motion leads from the priority of actuality to the unmoved mover and thence to divine thought.
The plurality of celestial motions is ordered under one first principle, and this unity concludes the critique of the many disconnected principles.
Beings are no longer mapped as equivalently juxtaposed, but as ordered around prior substance.
Non-being is divided into what is not actually being and what is simply non-being, so that coming-to-be does not signify creation from nothing.
The pair of contraries is rewritten as a triad, because matter is posited between them as a common underlying subject.
The opposition between same and different principles is resolved through the distinction between what is the same by analogy and what is different according to underlying subject.
Actuality is transferred from a mere mode of being into a principle ontologically prior to potentiality.
Moving without being moved becomes intelligible, because productive impulsion is replaced by motion toward a desirable end.
The astronomical mapping of motions is transformed into an order of immovable substances and degrees of priority.
The good is no longer divided into separate end and immanent order, but as first principle joins both.
At the surface level, perceptible changes, celestial motions, and aporiai concerning divine intellect are examined.
At the level of arrangement, changes are ordered through matter, form, privation, mover, potentiality, and actuality.
At the super-strategic level, the dispute concerning one or many principles is transferred to a distinction between numerical difference, analogical identity, and order toward one principle.
At the level concerning being and time, actuality is prior to potentiality, time and motion are eternal, and first substance is posited as without temporal coming-to-be and eternal in life.
The selected axioms are sufficient for reconstructing the course from perceptible substance to the immovable principle.
Strongest are the demonstration of the underlying subject from change and the refutation of potentiality as a sufficient cause of eternal motion.
The distinction between principles that are the same by analogy and those different according to underlying subject preserves coherence within the system.
Substance is said to be both matter and form and composite and pure actuality, and analogy joins these, though it does not provide one wholly precise definition.
The plurality of immovable substances depends on variable astronomical hypotheses; therefore, the numbers fifty-five or forty-seven do not constitute a necessary conclusion.
The transition from each eternal motion to its own immovable substance presupposes, but does not fully demonstrate, the univocal correspondence of motion and mover.
The way in which the desirable and intelligible precisely produces circular motion and the changes of generation and corruption is only tersely indicated.
The coexistence of many immovable substances and one first principle is reconciled in order, but the conclusion in favor of one commander rests on both a military image and rhetorical force.
The identity of intellect and intelligible is inferred from immateriality, but the precise relation between self-thinking and the intelligible is not further divided.
The reconstruction preserves the true movement of the account if the eternity of circular motion, the priority of actuality, and the final causality of the first are accepted.
Ἡ ζήτησις σκοπεῖ πότερον παρὰ τὰς αἰσθητὰς οὐσίας ἔστιν ἀκίνητός τις καὶ ἀΐδιος οὐσία, καὶ εἰ ἔστι, τίς ἐστιν.
Ἡ ἔρευνα πρότερον ἐλέγχει τὰς ἀλλοτρίας δόξας περὶ μαθηματικῶν, ἰδεῶν καὶ ἀριθμῶν, ἵνα μήτε τὰ αὐτὰ σφάλληται μήτε τὰ κοινὰ ἀδίκως ἀποβάλλῃ.
Τὰ μαθηματικὰ ἢ ἐν τοῖς αἰσθητοῖς ὡς οὐσίαι ἢ χωριστὰ παρ’ αὐτὰ ἢ μηδαμῶς ἢ ἄλλον τρόπον εἶναι ἀνάγκη· τῶν δύο πρώτων ἀναιρεθέντων, ζητητέος ὁ ἄλλος τρόπος.
Ὁ ἄλλος τρόπος σῴζει τὰ μαθηματικὰ ὡς ἀληθῶς ὄντα, οὐ χωριστά, ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ ᾗ καὶ διὰ νοητῆς ἀφαιρέσεως θεωρούμενα.
Ἡ τῶν ἰδεῶν δόξα γεννᾶται ἐκ τῆς ἀνάγκης τοῦ καθόλου πρὸς ἐπιστήμην, σφάλλεται δὲ χωρίζουσα τὸ καθόλου καὶ ποιοῦσα αὐτὸ οὐσίαν.
Αἱ δυναταὶ θέσεις περὶ χωριστῶν ἀριθμῶν καὶ μεγεθῶν διαιροῦνται ἐξαντλητικῶς καὶ ἑκάστη ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων ἀρχῶν ἀδύνατα γεννᾷ.
Ὁ συλλογισμὸς διαγνωστικῶς, γενεαλογικῶς καὶ ἐλεγκτικῶς κινεῖται ἐκ τῆς ἀνάγκης ἐπιστήμης πρὸς τὴν πλάνην τοῦ χωρισμοῦ, ἐκεῖθεν δὲ πρὸς τὴν ἀνασύστασιν τοῦ εἶναι κατὰ λόγον, δύναμιν καὶ ἐνέργειαν.
Τὸ εἶναι πολλαχῶς λέγεται.
Τὸ μὴ χωριστὸν δύναται εἶναι, καίπερ μὴ καθ’ αὑτὸ κεχωρισμένον.
Τὸ τῷ λόγῳ πρότερον οὐ διὰ τοῦτο τῇ οὐσίᾳ πρότερόν ἐστιν.
Τῇ οὐσίᾳ πρότερά ἐστιν ὅσα χωριζόμενα τῷ εἶναι ὑπερβάλλει.
Ἐπιστήμη δύναται τὸ αὐτὸ πρᾶγμα θεωρεῖν οὐχ ᾗ αἰσθητόν, ἀλλ’ ᾗ τοιόνδε.
Τὸ τῇ διανοίᾳ χωρίζειν τὸ μὴ χωριστὸν οὐ ψεῦδος ποιεῖ, ἐὰν τὸ πρᾶγμα ᾗ τοιοῦτον θεωρῆται.
Ὅσῳ ἁπλούστερον καὶ πρότερον τῷ λόγῳ τὸ θεωρούμενον, τοσούτῳ ἀκριβεστέρα ἡ ἐπιστήμη.
Ἄνευ τοῦ καθόλου οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπιστήμην λαβεῖν.
Τὸ καθόλου, ᾗ καθόλου, οὐκ ἔστι χωριστὴ οὐσία.
Ἡ οὐσία πράγματος οὐ χωρίζεται ἀπὸ τούτου οὗ ἐστιν οὐσία.
Ἡ γένεσις οὐκ ἐκ παραδείγματος μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐκ κινοῦντος αἰτίου γίνεται.
Ἐὰν ὑπόθεσις ἐξ ἀνάγκης ἀδύνατα γεννᾷ, ἀδύνατοι καὶ αἱ ἀρχαὶ αὐτῆς εἰσιν.
Ὁ μαθηματικὸς ἀριθμὸς ἐξ ἀδιαφόρων καὶ συμβλητῶν μονάδων κατὰ πρόσθεσιν ἀριθμεῖται.
Διαφορὰ μονάδων ἢ κατὰ ποσὸν ἢ κατὰ ποιὸν εἶναι ἀνάγκη, ὧν οὐδέτερον μονάδι ᾗ μονάδι ὑπάρχει.
Μέγεθος οὐ δύναται ἐξ ἀδιαιρέτων μεγεθῶν συγκεῖσθαι.
Ἡ δυνάμει ἐπιστήμη τοῦ καθόλου καὶ ἀορίστου, ἡ δ’ ἐνεργείᾳ τοῦ ὡρισμένου καὶ τοῦδέ τινος ἐστίν.
Ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ στοιχεῖον πρότερά ἐστιν ὧν ἐστὶν ἀρχὴ καὶ στοιχεῖον.
Τὰ μαθηματικὰ οὐκ ἔνεστι τοῖς αἰσθητοῖς ὡς ἕτεραι ἐνυπάρχουσαι οὐσίαι.
Τὰ μαθηματικὰ οὐκ εἰσὶ χωρισταὶ φύσεις παρὰ τὰ αἰσθητά.
Ἡ χωριστὴ θέσις στερεῶν, ἐπιπέδων, γραμμῶν καὶ στιγμῶν οὐ σῴζεται, διότι ἀναγκαίαν καὶ ἄτοπον σώρευσιν ὁμοίων γενῶν παράγει.
Οὔτε χωριστὸς οὐρανὸς οὔτε χωριστὴ φωνὴ οὔτε χωριστὴ ὄψις ἀπαιτεῖται, ἵνα ἀστρολογία, ἁρμονικὴ καὶ ὀπτικὴ ὦσιν ἐπιστῆμαι.
Τὰ μαθηματικὰ οὔτε μᾶλλον οὐσίαι τῶν σωμάτων οὔτε τῷ εἶναι πρότερα τῶν αἰσθητῶν εἰσιν.
Οἱ καθόλου ὁρισμοὶ οὐκ εἰσὶ διὰ τοῦτο χωρισταὶ ἰδέαι.
Οἱ λόγοι οἱ τιθέμενοι τὰ εἴδη οὐ μόνον οὐκ ἀποδεικνύουσιν ἃ βούλονται, ἀλλὰ καὶ ἀποφάσεων, πρός τι καὶ φθαρτῶν εἴδη γεννῶσιν.
Τὰ εἴδη οὔτε κινήσεως οὔτε μεταβολῆς οὔτε γενέσεως αἴτια τοῖς αἰσθητοῖς εἰσιν.
Τὸ λέγειν τὰ εἴδη παραδείγματα καὶ τὰ ἄλλα μετέχειν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἀποδίδωσι τὸ ἐργαζόμενον αἴτιον.
Ὁ χωριστὸς ἀριθμὸς οὔτε μαθηματικὸς οὔτε εἰδητικὸς οὔτε ἀμφότερος ἅμα συνεπῶς δύναται εἶναι.
Αἱ μονάδες οὔτε πᾶσαι συμβληταὶ οὔτε πᾶσαι ἀσύμβλητοι οὔτε κατ’ ἀριθμὸν μόνον συμβληταὶ δύνανται τὰς ἰδέας ἀριθμοὺς ποιεῖν.
Τὸ ἓν καὶ ἡ ἀόριστος δυὰς οὐ δύνανται τὴν λεγομένην γένεσιν τῶν χωριστῶν ἀριθμῶν ἀποδοῦναι.
Τὰ σώματα οὐκ ἐκ μαθηματικῶν μονάδων οὐδὲ τὰ μεγέθη ἐκ στιγμῶν ἢ ἀδιαιρέτων συνίσταται.
Τὰ μαθηματικὰ ἔστι τρόπον τινά, οὐχ ὡς χωρισταὶ ἐντελέχειαι, ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐν τοῖς πράγμασιν ὑλικῶς ὑπάρχοντα καὶ τῇ διανοίᾳ ἀφαιρούμενα.
Ἡ γεωμετρία περὶ αἰσθητῶν μεγεθῶν ἐστίν, οὐχ ᾗ αἰσθητά, οὐδὲ περὶ ἑτέρων χωριστῶν μεγεθῶν.
Γραμμή, ἐπίπεδον καὶ ἀριθμὸς δύνανται τῷ λόγῳ πρότερα εἶναι τοῦ σώματος, οὐ μὴν τῇ οὐσίᾳ.
Ἡ μαθηματικὴ ἀκρίβεια ἐκ τῆς ἀφαιρέσεως κινήσεως, μεγέθους καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν συνθέτων προσδιορισμῶν αὔξεται.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη μονίμου καὶ καθόλου λόγου πρὸς ἐπιστήμην οὐ συνεπάγεται χωριστὴν φύσιν, ἀλλ’ ἡ σύγχυσις τούτων ἐγέννησε τὴν δόξαν τῶν ἰδεῶν.
Τὸ χωρίζειν τὰ καθόλου πολλαπλασιάζει τὰ ζητούμενα μᾶλλον ἢ τὰς αἰτίας τῶν αἰσθητῶν ἀποδίδωσιν.
Τὰ εἴδη ὡς χωριστὰ οὔτε τὴν οὐσίαν τῶν μετεχόντων οὔτε τὴν γένεσιν αὐτῶν ἐξηγεῖται.
Ἡ ἐξαντλητικὴ διαίρεσις τῶν σχέσεων τῶν μονάδων ἀποκλείει πᾶσαν συνεπῆ κατασκευὴν εἰδητικοῦ ἢ χωριστοῦ μαθηματικοῦ ἀριθμοῦ.
Ἡ ἀδυναμία συνθέσεως μεγέθους ἐξ ἀδιαιρέτων ἀναιρεῖ τήν τε Πυθαγόρειον σύστασιν τῶν σωμάτων ἐξ ἀριθμῶν καὶ τὴν χωριστὴν γένεσιν γραμμῶν καὶ ἐπιπέδων.
Ἡ καθολικότης τῆς ἐπιστήμης οὐκ ἀπαιτεῖ καθόλου χωριστὰς οὐσίας, ἐπεὶ ἡ μὲν δυνάμει γνῶσις καθόλου, ἡ δ’ ἐνεργείᾳ ὡρισμένη ἐστίν.
Ἡ σταθερὰ νοητότης τῶν πραγμάτων οὐκ ἀπαιτεῖ δεύτερον κόσμον ὁμοίων χωριστῶν οὐσιῶν, ἀλλὰ σῴζεται διὰ τοῦ καθόλου λόγου καὶ τῆς κατὰ τὸ ᾗ θεωρίας.
Ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ τοῦ τῷ λόγῳ προτέρου εἰς τὸ τῇ οὐσίᾳ πρότερον γεννᾷ σωρεύσεις φύσεων, ἀπείρους μεσιτείας καὶ ἀναστροφὴν τῆς ἀληθοῦς τάξεως.
Χωριστὴ φύσις ἥτις οὔτε ἐνυπάρχει τοῖς πράγμασιν οὔτε κινεῖ οὔτε τὴν γένεσιν αὐτῶν ἀποδίδωσιν οὐ δύναται εἶναι πρώτη αἰτία αὐτῶν.
Ἡ ἀναίρεσις μαθηματικῶν, ἰδεῶν καὶ ἀριθμῶν ὡς χωριστῶν οὐσιῶν οὐκ ἀναιρεῖ πᾶσαν ἀκίνητον καὶ ἀΐδιον οὐσίαν, ἀλλὰ μόνον τοὺς ἐνταῦθα ἐξεταζομένους ὑποψηφίους.
Οἱ διαφορετικοὶ τρόποι προτεραιότητος κατὰ λόγον, γένεσιν, ὕλην καὶ οὐσίαν οὐ δύνανται ἀδιακρίτως εἰς μίαν ἀρχὴν συναχθῆναι.
Ἡ διάκρισις δυνάμεως καὶ ἐνεργείας μεταθέτει τὸ πρόβλημα τῆς ἐπιστήμης ἀπὸ τὴν χωριστὴν ὕπαρξιν τοῦ καθόλου εἰς τὸν τρόπον καθ’ ὃν τὸ καθόλου καὶ τὸ ὡρισμένον γινώσκεται.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι πᾶν περὶ οὗ ἐπιστήμη ἐστὶ χωριστὴν οὐσίαν ἔχει.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι ὃ τῇ διανοίᾳ χωρίζεται καὶ τῷ εἶναι χωριστόν ἐστιν.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι πᾶν ἁπλούστερον καὶ πρότερον τῷ λόγῳ πρότερόν ἐστι καὶ τῇ οὐσίᾳ.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι τὸ ἓν ἐπὶ πολλῶν ἀριθμητικῶς ἓν καὶ παρὰ τὰ πολλὰ κεχωρισμένον εἶναι δεῖ.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι ἡ ὁμοιότης πρὸς παράδειγμα ἱκανὴ αἰτία γενέσεώς ἐστιν ἄνευ τοῦ κινοῦντος.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι μονάδες δύνανται διαφέρειν ἀλλήλων μήτε κατὰ ποσὸν μήτε κατὰ ποιόν.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι τὸ αὐτὸ ἓν δύναται ἅμα καὶ κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ εἶναι ὕλη τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ καὶ εἶδος αὐτοῦ.
Οὐκ ἀληθὲς ὅτι ἡ ἀπόρριψις χωριστῶν μαθηματικῶν ἀναιρεῖ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τῶν μαθηματικῶν ἐπιστημῶν.
Ἡ διάταξις ἀποκλείει νοητὸν τόπον ὃς μόνον διπλασιάζει τὰ αἰσθητὰ χωρὶς αἰτιακὴν δύναμιν.
Ἡ διάταξις ἀποκλείει μονοσήμαντον προτεραιότητα κοινὴν τῷ λόγῳ, τῇ γενέσει, τῇ ὕλῃ καὶ τῇ οὐσίᾳ.
Ἡ διάταξις ἀποκλείει τὸ καθόλου εἶναι ἅμα καθόλου κατηγορούμενον, τόδε τι καὶ χωριστὴν οὐσίαν.
Ἡ διάταξις ἀποκλείει τὸ ὄνομα τῆς μεθέξεως ἢ τοῦ παραδείγματος ἀντὶ ἀποδόσεως τοῦ αἰτίου τίθεσθαι.
Ἡ πρώτη μετάθεσις ἐκ τῆς αἰσθητῆς οὐσίας ἐπὶ τὴν ζήτησιν ἀκινήτου καὶ ἀϊδίου οὐσίας γίνεται.
Ἡ μαθηματικὴ φύσις διαιρεῖται εἰς ἐνύπαρξιν, χωρισμὸν, ἀνυπαρξίαν ἢ ἄλλον τρόπον τοῦ εἶναι.
Ἡ ἐνύπαρξις ὡς ἑτέρας οὐσίας ἀναιρεῖται διὰ τῆς συμπτώσεως σωμάτων καὶ τῆς ἀδυναμίας τῆς διαιρέσεως.
Ὁ χωρισμὸς ἀναιρεῖται διὰ σωρεύσεως ἐπιπέδων, γραμμῶν, στιγμῶν καὶ ἀριθμῶν, διὰ τῆς ἐλλείψεως ἑνότητος καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀδυναμίας αἰσθητῶν μαθηματικῶν.
Τῶν δύο πρώτων τρόπων ἀναιρεθέντων, τὰ μαθηματικὰ ἀνασυστάται ὡς τὰ αἰσθητὰ θεωρούμενα οὐχ ᾗ αἰσθητά, ἀλλ’ ᾗ μήκη, ἐπίπεδα, στερεὰ ἢ ἀριθμητά.
Ἡ γένεσις τῶν ἰδεῶν ἀνάγεται ἐκ τῆς ῥοῆς τῶν αἰσθητῶν καὶ τῆς Σωκρατικῆς ζητήσεως τοῦ καθόλου εἰς τὸν ἀδικαιολόγητον χωρισμὸν τῶν ὁρισμῶν.
Τὰ εἴδη δοκιμάζεται κατὰ τὴν ἔκτασιν τῶν ἀποδείξεων, τὴν συμφωνίαν πρὸς τὰς ἰδίας ἀρχὰς καὶ τὴν αἰτιακὴν αὐτῶν δύναμιν, καὶ κατὰ πάντα ταῦτα ἀποτυγχάνει.
Οἱ χωριστοὶ ἀριθμοὶ διαιροῦνται κατὰ τὴν συμβλητότητα τῶν μονάδων, τὴν σχέσιν εἰδητικοῦ καὶ μαθηματικοῦ ἀριθμοῦ καὶ τὸν χωρισμὸν ἢ ἐνυπάρχειν, καὶ ἕκαστος συνδυασμὸς ἀδύνατα παράγει.
Ἡ τελικὴ ἀπορία περὶ καθόλου ἐπιστήμης καὶ καθ’ ἕκαστον οὐσίας μετατίθεται διὰ τῆς διακρίσεως δυνάμει καὶ ἐνεργείᾳ γνῶσεως.
Ἡ καθόλου φορὰ οὕτως ἔχει· ζήτησις ἀκινήτου οὐσίας → ἔλεγχος προτεινομένων χωριστῶν φύσεων → ἀναίρεσις ἐνυπάρξεως καὶ χωρισμοῦ → ἀνασύστασις τοῦ κατὰ λόγον εἶναι → διάκρισις δυνάμεως καὶ ἐνεργείας.
Ἡ περὶ τῶν μαθηματικῶν φορὰ οὕτως ἔχει· διαιρετικὴ τῶν τρόπων τοῦ εἶναι → ἀδύνατον τῆς ἐνυπάρξεως → ἄτοπον τοῦ χωρισμοῦ → τὸ ᾗ τῆς θεωρίας → ἀληθὴς ἀφαίρεσις.
Ἡ περὶ τῶν ἰδεῶν φορὰ οὕτως ἔχει· ῥοὴ τῶν αἰσθητῶν → ἀνάγκη καθόλου ὁρισμοῦ → χωρισμὸς τοῦ καθόλου → πολλαπλασιασμὸς καὶ ἀντίφασις → αἰτιακὴ ἀδυναμία.
Ἡ περὶ τῶν ἀριθμῶν φορὰ οὕτως ἔχει· ἐξαντλητικὴ διαίρεσις μονάδων καὶ ἀριθμῶν → ἔλεγχος ἑκάστου τρόπου → ἀδύνατα περὶ γενέσεως, προτεραιότητος καὶ συνθέσεως → ἀναίρεσις χωριστοῦ ἀριθμοῦ.
Τὰ μαθηματικὰ μετατίθεται ἐκ τοῦ γένους τῶν χωριστῶν οὐσιῶν εἰς τὸ γένος τῶν κατὰ τὸ ᾗ θεωρουμένων προσδιορισμῶν.
Ἡ προτεραιότης διακρίνεται εἰς προτεραιότητα λόγου, γενέσεως, ὕλης καὶ οὐσίας.
Ὁ νοητὸς χωρισμὸς διακρίνεται ἀπὸ τοῦ χωρισμοῦ κατὰ τὸ εἶναι.
Αἱ ἰδέαι μετατίθεται ἐκ τῆς θέσεως τῶν αἰτίων εἰς τὴν θέσιν διπλασιασμῶν οἳ αὐτοὶ δεῖται αἰτίας.
Ἡ διαφωνία τῶν δοξῶν περὶ ἀριθμῶν γίνεται σημεῖον ψευδῶν ἀρχῶν μᾶλλον ἢ πολλῶν ἀληθῶν γενῶν ἀριθμοῦ.
Ἡ καθολικότης τῆς ἐπιστήμης μετατίθεται ἀπὸ χωριστὸν ἀντικείμενον εἰς δύναμιν γνώσεως, ἡ δὲ ἐνεργὸς γνῶσις πρὸς τόδε τι ὁρίζεται.
Ἡ ζήτησις τῆς ἀκινήτου οὐσίας στενοῦται διὰ τῆς ἀποβολῆς μαθηματικῶν, ἰδεῶν καὶ ἀριθμῶν, οὐ μὴν περαίνεται.
Ὁ ἐπιφανειακὸς βαθμὸς ἐξετάζει εἰ μαθηματικά, ἰδέαι, ἀριθμοὶ καὶ μεγέθη εἰσὶν οὐσίαι χωρισταί.
Ὁ τῆς διατάξεως βαθμὸς διακρίνει τὸ ᾗ τῆς ἐπιστήμης, τὸν νοητὸν χωρισμόν, τὴν οὐσιώδη προτεραιότητα καὶ τὴν αἰτιακὴν ἰσχύν.
Ὁ ὑπερστρατηγικὸς βαθμὸς μεταβάλλει τὴν ἔρευναν ἀπὸ τὴν προσθήκην χωριστῶν φύσεων εἰς τὸν ἔλεγχον τοῦ τρόπου καθ’ ὃν ἡ νόησις ἀφαιρεῖ καὶ ἡ ἐπιστήμη ὁρίζει.
Ὁ περὶ ὄντος καὶ χρόνου βαθμὸς διακρίνει τὸ ἐντελεχείᾳ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὑλικῶς, τὸ τῷ λόγῳ πρότερον ἀπὸ τοῦ τῇ οὐσίᾳ πρότερον, καὶ τὴν δυνάμει καθολικὴν γνῶσιν ἀπὸ τῆς ἐνεργείᾳ ὡρισμένης.
Τὰ ἀξιώματα ἱκανά ἐστι πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς ἀναιρέσεως τῶν χωριστῶν μαθηματικῶν, ἰδεῶν, ἀριθμῶν καὶ μεγεθῶν.
Ἡ θετικὴ ἀνασύστασις τῶν μαθηματικῶν ἰσχυρότατα στηρίζεται ἐπὶ τῇ διακρίσει τοῦ πράγματος καὶ τοῦ ᾗ θεωρεῖται.
Ἡ ἀναίρεσις τοῦ χωριστοῦ ἀριθμοῦ ἰσχυρότατα στηρίζεται ἐπὶ τῇ ἐξαντλητικῇ διαιρέσει τῆς συμβλητότητος καὶ διαφορᾶς τῶν μονάδων.
Ἀδιοριστότερον τοῦ δέοντος μένει πῶς ἀκριβῶς τὸ ὑλικῶς εἶναι τῶν μαθηματικῶν συνάπτεται πρὸς τὴν νοητὴν ἀφαίρεσιν.
Ἡ ἀπορία περὶ τοῦ πῶς αἱ οὐσίαι εἰσὶ χωρισταί, αἱ δὲ ἀρχαὶ γνωσταὶ καθόλου, μόνον κατὰ τὸν τρόπον τῆς γνώσεως διακρίνεται, οὐ πλήρως κατὰ τὸν τρόπον τῆς οὐσίας λύεται.
Μέρος τῆς ἀποδείξεως στηρίζεται ἐπὶ σωρεύσει ἀδυνάτων καὶ ἐπὶ προτέρων διαπορημάτων, ὧν οἱ πλήρεις λόγοι ἐνταῦθα οὐκ ἀναλαμβάνονται.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις σῴζει τὴν ἀληθῆ κίνησιν τοῦ λόγου, ἐὰν μὴ ἐκ τῆς ἀποβολῆς τῶν ἐξετασθέντων χωριστῶν φύσεων συναχθῇ ἡ ἀνυπαρξία πάσης ἀκινήτου καὶ ἀϊδίου οὐσίας.
The inquiry examines whether, besides sensible substances, there is some immovable and eternal substance, and, if there is, what it is.
