Time is discontinuous, destructive, and recurrent; the past can become present only through renewed narration.
The possibility of contest lies in the preservation, reconstruction, and common testing of discourse.
The present axial terms suffice for reconstructing the movement from constitution and war to memory, destruction, and intercultural testimony.
The precise content of the great deed, the literal historicity of the narrative, and the scope of the cosmic explanation remain underdetermined.
The structure is coherent, because the sequence destruction → forgetting → apparent youth → recovery recurs on many scales.
The compression preserves the generative logic, but cannot remove the tension between historical truth, poetic form, and political use.
The reconstruction preserves the actual movement of the system, because uncertainty is not resolved but functions as a mechanism of common testing.
Ἡ κεντρικὴ ἀπορία ζητεῖ πῶς παλαιὰ πολιτικὰ μεγέθη δύνανται νὰ ἀναγνωρισθῶσιν ὅταν ἡ κοινὴ μνήμη ἀποτυγχάνῃ.
Ἡ ἱστορικὴ ἄγνοια ἀναπλαισιοῦται ὡς ἀποτέλεσμα περιοδικῆς καταστροφῆς, ἀπωλείας γραφῶν καὶ διακοπῆς παιδείας.
Ἡ μνήμη δὲν διατηρεῖται φυσικῶς, ἀλλὰ διὰ θεσμῶν, ἀρχείων καὶ ἱερατικῶν φορέων.
Ἡ πόλις συγκροτεῖται ὡς ἱεραρχικὴ σύνθεσις λειτουργιῶν, κοσμολογικῆς παιδείας καὶ πολεμικῆς ἀποστολῆς.
Ἡ τοπικὴ πολιτεία ἀναβαθμίζεται εἰς παγκόσμιον πολιτικὸν ὑποκείμενον διὰ τῆς ἀντιθέσεως πρὸς καθολικὴν δύναμιν δουλώσεως.
Ἡ παλαιὰ Ἀθήνα προβάλλεται ὡς λανθάνουσα μορφὴ πολιτικῆς ἀριστείας, ἥτις ἀναγνωρίζεται μόνον διὰ ἀνακτήσεως καὶ ἐπαναφορᾶς.
Ἡ καταστροφὴ ἀφανίζει ἅμα τὸν δυνάστην, τὸν ἀμυνόμενον καὶ τὰς ὁδοὺς ἐμπειρικῆς ἐπαληθεύσεως.
Ἡ κίνησις εἶναι σπειροειδής· λήθη, ἀνάκτησις, πολιτικὴ ἐπανερμηνεία καὶ νέα ἀπώλεια συγκροτοῦσιν ἀνοικτὸν κύκλον.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀπουσία μνήμης δὲν ἀποδεικνύει τὴν ἀπουσίαν γεγονότων, ἀλλὰ δύναται νὰ μαρτυρῇ διακοπὴν τῶν φορέων αὐτῶν.
[Persistent] Ἡ φυσικὴ φθορὰ ἀφανίζει κυρίως γραφήν, παιδείαν καὶ θεσμικὴν συνέχεια, οὐχὶ ἀναγκαίως τὸ ἀνθρώπινον γένος.
[Mutating] Ἡ γραφὴ μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ μέσον ἐπικοινωνίας εἰς μηχανὴν πολιτικῆς συνέχειας καὶ ἐξουσίας ἐπὶ τοῦ παρελθόντος.
[Emergent] Ἡ πολιτεία γίνεται ὅλον ἐν ᾧ κοινωνικὴ διαίρεσις, παιδεία, θεία τάξις, πολεμικὴ ἰσχύς καὶ μνήμη ἀλληλοπαράγονται.
[Persistent] Ἡ πολιτικὴ τάξις ἀπαιτεῖ διακεκριμένα γένη καὶ ἔργα, ὥστε ἡ ἑνότης νὰ μὴ ταυτίζηται μὲ σύγχυσιν.
[Mutating] Ἡ φρόνησις ἐκτείνεται ἀπὸ κοσμικὴν θεωρίαν εἰς ἐπιστήμας, θεσμοὺς καὶ στρατηγικὴν πράξιν.
[Emergent] Ἡ Ἀθηναϊκὴ ἀρετὴ συγκροτεῖται ὡς ἱκανότης ἐλευθερώσεως ἄλλων, ἀλλὰ διὰ μορφῆς ἰσχύος ἥτις δύναται νὰ λάβῃ ἡγεμονικὰ γνωρίσματα.
[Terminal] Ἡ καταστροφὴ ἀφανίζει καὶ τὴν Ἀτλαντικὴν ἡγεμονίαν καὶ τὸ ἀρχικὸν Ἀθηναϊκὸν πολεμικὸν ὑποκείμενον, ἀφήνουσα μόνον διαμεσολαβημένην μνήμην.
[Attractor] Ἡ πολιτικὴ ἀριστεία ἐμφανίζεται ὡς λανθάνουσα δυνατότης, ἣν ἡ λήθη ἀποκρύπτει ἀλλὰ δὲν δημιουργεῖ ἐκ μηδενός.
[Mutating] Ὁ γεωγραφικὸς τόπος μετασχηματίζεται εἰς παγκόσμιον χάρτην πολιτικῶν ζωνῶν, ἡγεμονιῶν καὶ ἀντιστάσεων.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἱστορικὴ ἀλήθεια ἀναδύεται ἐκ συνδυασμοῦ ἀφανισμοῦ, ἀποσπασματικῆς μεταδόσεως καὶ νεωτέρας ἐρμηνευτικῆς ἐπανασυνδέσεως.
[Attractor] Ἡ ἐλευθερία δὲν προϋπάρχει ὡς ἀσφαλὴς κατάστασις, ἀλλὰ παράγεται διὰ ἀντιστάσεως πρὸς συγκεντρωμένην δύναμιν.
Ἡ μνήμη ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ὡς γραπτόν ἀρχείον, ἱερατικὴ κατοχή, προφορικὴ μετάδοσις καὶ ἐρμηνευτικὸς φακός· ἡ λειτουργία της μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ φύλαξιν εἰς νομιμοποίησιν.
Ἡ φυσικὴ καταστροφὴ ἐπαναλαμβάνεται, ἀλλὰ μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ αἰτία λήθης εἰς μηχανισμὸν ἐξισώσεως καὶ ἀδυναμίας ἐλέγχου.
Ἡ Ἀθήνα μετατοπίζεται ἀπὸ λησμονημένη πόλις εἰς ὑπόδειγμα πολιτείας καὶ ἔπειτα εἰς φορέα καθολικῆς ἐλευθερώσεως.
Ἡ διάκρισις λειτουργιῶν ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ὡς κοινωνικὴ ἱεράρχησις, ὡς διανομή γνώσεως καὶ ὡς κατανομή πολιτικῆς ἐξουσίας.
Ὁ πόλεμος μεταβάλλει σημασίαν: ἀπὸ ἔργον τοῦ μαχίμου γένους γίνεται τεκμήριον ἀρετῆς καὶ ὄργανον ἐλευθερώσεως.
Ὁ τόπος ἀποσπᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν γεωγραφικὴν ἰδιαιτερότητα καὶ μετατρέπεται εἰς περιβαλλοντικὸν, κοσμολογικὸν καὶ στρατηγικὸν παράγοντα.
Ἡ Ἀτλαντὶς δὲν παραμένει αὐτοτελὴς τόπος, ἀλλὰ ἀπορροφᾶται ὡς ἀντίθετον μοντέλον καθολικῆς πολιτικῆς ἐπεκτάσεως.
Ἡ διόρθωσις τῆς ἀτομικῆς ἀγνοίας τοῦ Σόλωνος παραμένει τοπικὴ· ἀναβαίνει μόνον ὅταν ἐξηγῇ τὴν πολιτικὴν ἐξουσίαν τῆς μνήμης.
Ἡ ἀκριβὴς διάταξις τῶν ἐπιμέρους γενῶν εἶναι κατώτερον σχῆμα, ἐνῶ ἡ ἀρχὴ τοῦ λειτουργικοῦ χωρισμοῦ κλιμακοῦται εἰς παγκόσμιον ἀρχιτεκτονικήν.
Ἡ κυκλικὴ ἐναλλαγὴ καταστροφῆς καὶ ἐπανεκκινήσεως ἀποτελεῖ τρέχουσαν ἀρχὴν τοῦ συμπλέγματος, οὐχὶ ἁπλῶς μοτίβον ἑνὸς κεφαλαίου.
Ἡ ἱερατικὴ γνώσις γεφυροῖ τὴν ἀπωλεσθεῖσαν ἱστορίαν καὶ τὴν πολιτικὴν ἀξίωσιν, ἄρα μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ τοπικὸς φορεὺς εἰς δομικὴν ἀρχὴν ἐπικυρώσεως.
Ἡ ἐξωτερικὴ ἀπειλὴ καταλύει τὸν περιορισμὸν τῆς ἐσωτερικῆς ἀρετῆς καὶ μετατρέπει τὴν πολιτείαν εἰς ἱστορικὴν ἀποστολήν.
Ἡ ἁπλῆ ἀντίθεσις Ἀθηναίων καὶ Ἀτλάντων ὑπερβαίνεται ὑπὸ τῆς ἀσταθοῦς συγγενείας μεταξὺ ἐλευθερωτικῆς καὶ ἡγεμονικῆς ἰσχύος.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ γραμμικὴ ἰδέα ἱστορικῆς προόδου, ἐπειδὴ ὁ πολιτισμὸς δύναται νὰ ἀφανισθῇ καὶ νὰ ἐπανεκκινήσῃ.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ταύτισις τοῦ παρόντος μὲ τὸ μέτρον τοῦ δυνατοῦ, ἐπειδὴ τὸ λησμονημένον παρελθὸν περιέχει ἀνενεργοποίητους μορφὰς πολιτικῆς ἀριστείας.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ αὐτοφυὴς καὶ ἀθέσμως συγκροτημένη πόλις, ἐπειδὴ ἡ πολιτεία ἀπαιτεῖ θείαν τάξιν, νόμον καὶ παιδείαν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἁπλὴ στρατιωτικὴ ὑπεροχὴ ὡς κριτήριον ἀρετῆς· ἡ ἰσχὺς ὀφείλει νὰ ἐντάσσηται εἰς τάξιν καὶ ἐλευθέρωσιν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ φυσικὴ καὶ προϋπάρχουσα ἐλευθερία, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἐλευθερία ἀναφαίνεται μόνον ὅταν ἀντιμετωπίζεται δύναμις δουλώσεως.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἱστορία ὡς πλήρης καὶ ἀπρόσκοπτος ἀποθήκη γεγονότων, ἐπειδὴ ἡ πρόσβασις εἰς αὐτὴν ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ σωζομένας μεταδόσεις.
Ἀποκλείεται ὅτι τὸ παρὸν ἐπαρκεῖ ὡς μέτρον τῆς ἀνθρωπίνης πολιτικῆς δυνατότητος.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἀμιγῶς φυσικὴ ἢ ἀμιγῶς γνωστικὴ ἐξήγησις τῆς λήθης· ἡ φθορὰ συμπλέκεται μὲ τὴν ἀπώλειαν θεσμῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ὁ ἱστορικὸς λόγος ὡς ἀνεξάρτητος τοῦ φορέως τῶν ἀρχείων, ἐπειδὴ ἡ γνώσις ἀκολουθεῖ τὴν κατοχὴν τῆς μνήμης.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ταύτισις πολιτικῆς ἀξίας καὶ συγχρόνου ἀναγνωρίσεως, ἐπειδὴ ἡ λήθη δύναται νὰ κρύψῃ τὴν ἀριστείαν.
Ἀποκλείεται πολιτεία ἀρετῆς ἄνευ ἱεραρχικῆς διακρίσεως καὶ λειτουργικοῦ χωρισμοῦ, ὅπως ἀποκλείεται καὶ ἡ ἀδιάκριτος κοινωνικὴ ἑνότης.
Ἀποκλείεται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἐλευθερία ἀποχωρίζεται ἀπὸ κίνδυνον, πόλεμον καὶ συλλογικὴν ἰσχύν.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ αὐτάρκης νεωτέρα αὐτοσυνειδησία, ἐπειδὴ τὸ παρὸν δύναται νὰ κατοικῇ ἐπάνω ἐρειπίων λησμονημένων πολιτειῶν.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ ἀνθρωπίνη αὐτοθεμελίωσις τῆς πόλεως· ἡ ἀρχὴ μετατίθεται εἰς θείαν τάξιν, τόπον καὶ κληρονομημένην παιδείαν.
Ἀπουσιάζει κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ δικαία ἡγεμονία δύναται νὰ διαχωρισθῇ ἀπολύτως ἀπὸ τὴν ἐπεκτατικὴν κυριαρχίαν.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ ἀμεσότης μεταξὺ παρελθόντος καὶ παρόντος· ἡ πολιτικὴ σημασία γεννᾶται διὰ ἀναμνήσεως καὶ ἐρμηνείας.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ ὁριστικὴ νίκη, ἐπειδὴ ἡ καταστροφὴ δύναται νὰ ἀφανίσῃ καὶ τὸν φορέα τῆς νίκης.
Ἡ καταστροφὴ γίνεται ὄχι ἁπλὸν ὑπόβαθρον τῆς ἱστορίας, ἀλλὰ μηχανισμὸς ὃς καθορίζει ποῖα πολιτεύματα δύνανται νὰ γνωσθῶσιν.
Ἡ ἐσωτερικὴ τάξις ἀποκτᾷ καθολικὴν ἀξίωσιν μόνον ὅταν ἡ ἐξωτερικὴ ἀπειλὴ ἀναγκάζῃ αὐτὴν νὰ πράξῃ ὑπὲρ ἄλλων.
Ἡ ἱερατικὴ φύλαξις τῆς γραφῆς καὶ ὁ λειτουργικὸς χωρισμὸς τῆς πόλεως σχηματίζουσιν ἀνάλογον ἀρχιτεκτονικήν: ἡ συνέχεια ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ κατανεμημένους φορεῖς.
Ἡ Ἀθηναϊκὴ πολιτεία ἀνακτᾶται ὡς παράδειγμα μόνον ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀπωλεσθεῖσα πράξις ἐπανασυνδέεται μὲ νεωτέραν θεωρίαν.
Ἡ φυσικὴ φθορὰ ἐξισοῖ δυνάστην καὶ ἀμυνόμενον, ἀλλὰ ἡ μνήμη ἐπαναφέρει ἀσύμμετρον πολιτικὴν ἀξίαν μεταξὺ αὐτῶν.
Ἡ ἐλευθερωτικὴ καὶ ἡ ἡγεμονικὴ ἐπέκτασις δὲν χωρίζονται διὰ τῆς ἰσχύος, ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦ πολιτικοῦ σκοποῦ καὶ τῆς σχέσεως πρὸς τοὺς ἄλλους.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ πραγματικότης συγκροτεῖται τριπλῶς: ὡς θεσμικὴ τάξις, ὡς δοκιμασία ἐξωτερικῆς ἀπειλῆς καὶ ὡς ἐπιβίωσις μνήμης.
Ἡ ἱστορία τοῦ συμπλέγματος εἶναι μετακαταστροφική· τὸ γεγονὸς ἀποκτᾷ πλήρη πολιτικὴν σημασίαν μόνον ὅταν ἐπανέλθῃ διὰ τοῦ ἀρχείου.
Ἡ ἀρετὴ δὲν εἶναι οὐσία ἀποκεκλεισμένη ἐντὸς πόλεως, ἀλλὰ σχέσις ἀντιστάσεως, ἐλευθερώσεως καὶ ἀναλήψεως κινδύνου.
Ἡ ἀρχειακὴ συνέχεια εἶναι πολιτικὸν πεδίον μάχης, ἐπειδὴ ὁ κρατῶν τὴν μνήμην κρατεῖ καὶ τὴν ἐρμηνείαν τῆς πολιτικῆς ἀξίας.
Ἡ καταστροφὴ παράγει διπλὸν ἀποτέλεσμα: ἀφανίζει τὰ πολιτικὰ σώματα, ἀλλὰ καθιστᾷ ἀναγκαίαν τὴν ἐξουσίαν τῆς διαμεσολαβημένης μνήμης.
Ὁ χρόνος δὲν προάγει ἀναγκαίως τὴν πολιτείαν· ἐπαναφέρει θραύσματα, τὰ ὁποῖα ἀπαιτοῦσιν ἐκ νέου πολιτικὴν σύνθεσιν.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Καταστροφή → ἀπώλεια γραφῆς → λήθη → ἀρχειακὴ ἀσυμμετρία → ἀνάκτησις παρελθόντος → νέα πολιτικὴ νομιμοποίησις.
Ἐσωτερικὴ διάταξις → ἐξωτερικὴ ἀπειλή → πολεμικὴ ἀπόδειξις → ἐλευθέρωσις ἄλλων → ἡγεμονικὴ ἀμφισημία.
Ὁ γεωγραφικὸς ὁρίζων διευρύνεται, ἡ ἀπειλὴ καθολικοποιεῖται, καὶ ἡ πόλις ἀναγκάζεται νὰ μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τοπικὸν νόμον εἰς παγκόσμιον ἔργον.
Ἡ γραφὴ γίνεται μηχανή: ἀπὸ ἀποθήκη γεγονότων μετατρέπεται εἰς ρυθμιστὴν τοῦ ποῖος ἔχει παρελθὸν καὶ ποῖος ἔχει πολιτικὴν ἀξίωσιν.
Ἡ φυσικὴ φθορὰ ἀποτελεῖ σημεῖον φάσεως: ἀπὸ τὴν ἱστορίαν τῶν πράξεων μεταβαίνει ἡ διήγησις εἰς ἱστορίαν τῆς μνήμης.
Ὁ κρυφὸς ἑλκυστὴς τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι ἡ παλαιὰ Ἀθηναϊκὴ πολιτεία, ἥτις ἐπανέρχεται ὡς ἀπόδειξις, ὑπόδειγμα καὶ ἀνοικτὸν πρόβλημα.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Περιοδικὴ φυσικὴ φθορὰ καταλύει γραφήν, παιδείαν καὶ πολιτικὴν συνέχεια.
Ἡ διακοπὴ τῆς μνήμης μετατρέπει τὸ ἱστορικὸν γεγονὸς εἰς μῦθον καὶ ἀναγκάζει τοὺς ἐπιζῶντας νὰ ἐπανεκκινήσωσιν.
Ἡ ἀδιάκοπος ἀρχειακὴ κοινότης συσσωρεύει γνώσιν καὶ παράγει ἀσύμμετρον ἐρμηνευτικὴν δύναμιν.
Ἡ πολιτεία συναρμόζει λειτουργικὸν χωρισμόν, κοσμικὴν παιδείαν, θείαν ἐκλογὴν καὶ πολεμικὴν ἱκανότητα.
Ἡ διευρυμένη γεωγραφία παράγει καθολικὴν ἀπειλήν, ἥτις δοκιμάζει τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν πολιτικὴν τάξιν.
Ἡ Ἀθηναϊκὴ ἀντίστασις μετατρέπει τὴν ἀρετὴν ἀπὸ ἐσωτερικὴν διάταξιν εἰς ἐλευθερωτικὴν πράξιν.
Ἡ νέα καταστροφὴ ἀφανίζει τοὺς φορεῖς, ἀλλὰ ἀφήνει τὴν μνήμην ὡς ἐρμηνευτικὸν ὑπόβαθρον νεωτέρας πολιτικῆς θεωρίας.
Ἀνεπαρκὴς μνήμη → περιοδικὴ καταστροφὴ → ἀπώλεια γραφῆς → ἱερατικὴ ἀρχειακὴ ἀσυμμετρία.
Ἀρχειακὴ ἀνάκτησις → ἀποκάλυψις ἱεραρχικῆς πολιτείας → σύνδεσις κοσμολογίας καὶ φρονήσεως.
Διεύρυνσις κόσμου → Ἀτλαντικὴ καθολικὴ ἀπειλή → Ἀθηναϊκὴ ἀντίστασις → ἐλευθέρωσις.
Φυσικὴ καταστροφή → ἀφανισμὸς πολιτικῶν σωμάτων → μνημονικὴ ἐπανενεργοποίησις → ἀνοικτὴ ἐρμηνεία τῆς πολιτικῆς ἀρετῆς.
Ἡ ἱστορία ἀναταξινομεῖται ἀπὸ γραμμικὴν διαδοχὴν εἰς κύκλον καταστροφῆς, λήθης καὶ ἐπανεκκινήσεως.
Ἡ ἄγνοια παύει νὰ σημαίνῃ ἀπουσίαν καὶ γίνεται σύμπτωμα ἀπωλεσθείσης ἀρχειακῆς συνέχειας.
Ἡ γραφὴ καθίσταται πολιτικὸς μηχανισμὸς, ὁ δὲ ἀρχειακὸς φορεὺς ἀποκτᾷ ἐρμηνευτικὴν κυριαρχίαν.
Ἡ κοινωνικὴ διαίρεσις ἀναφαίνεται ὡς ὅρος εὐνομίας, ἐνῶ ἡ ἀδιαίρετος ἑνότης ἀποκαλύπτεται ὡς σύγχυσις λειτουργιῶν.
Ἡ στρατιωτικὴ νίκη ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἀπόδειξις συνολικῆς πολιτικῆς ἀρετῆς καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς ἁπλὴ κατοχὴ ἰσχύος.
Ὁ γεωγραφικὸς χάρτης γίνεται ἀνοικτὸ σύστημα πολιτικῶν ζωνῶν, ὅπου ἡ τοπικὴ πόλις δύναται νὰ ἀναλάβῃ παγκόσμιον ἔργον.
Ἡ ἀντίθεσις ἐλευθερίας καὶ ἡγεμονίας παύει νὰ εἶναι ἁπλῆ διχοτομία, ἐπειδὴ ἀμφότεραι προϋποθέτουσιν ὑπεροχὴν ἰσχύος.
**Surface level:** Ἡ διήγησις ἐξετάζει Ἀθήνας, Ἀτλαντίδα, νόμους, γένη, ἱερεῖς, πολέμους καὶ κατακλυσμούς.
**Structural level:** Ὑπὸ τὰ ἐπιμέρους πρόσωπα ἐνεργοῦσι μηχανισμοὶ ἀρχειακῆς διατηρήσεως, λειτουργικοῦ χωρισμοῦ, κοσμολογικῆς παιδείας καὶ στρατηγικῆς ἀναμετρήσεως.
**Metastrategic level:** Ἡ πολιτικὴ ἀρετὴ κρίνεται ἐκ τοῦ εἰ δύναται νὰ ἀναχαιτίσῃ καθολικὴν ἀπειλὴν καὶ νὰ μετατρέψῃ τὴν ἰσχὺν εἰς ἐλευθέρωσιν.
**Ontological / Temporal level:** Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι καταστροφικὸς καὶ ἐπαναληπτικός, ἐνῶ ἡ πολιτικὴ τάξις παραμένει θνητὴ καὶ ἡ μνήμη μεταγενέστερα ἀνασυνθετική.
**Methodological / Performative level:** Ὁ λόγος μιμεῖται τὸ ἀρχειακὸν ἔργον ὃ περιγράφει, ἐπειδὴ ἀπὸ θραύσματα, μεταδόσεις καὶ ἀναλογίας ἀνακατασκευάζει πολιτικὸν παρελθόν.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ πόλις ἐλευθεροῖ τοὺς ἄλλους διὰ ὑπεροχῆς, ἀλλὰ ἡ ὑπεροχὴ αὕτη δύναται νὰ λάβῃ ἡγεμονικὴν μορφήν.
Ἡ ἱερατικὴ μαρτυρία καθίσταται ἀναγκαία πρὸς ἀνάκτησιν τῆς ἀληθείας, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἀκριβὴς ἀπόδειξις τῆς μαρτυρίας μένει ἀνοικτή.
Ἡ ἱεραρχικὴ τάξις θεμελιώνει τὴν ἀρετήν, ἀλλὰ ἡ καθολικὴ σωτηριολογικὴ ἀξίωσις ἀπαιτεῖ ἀξίαν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἐσωτερικῶν ὁρίων.
Ἡ καταστροφὴ ἀκυροῖ τὴν ἐμπειρικὴν συνέχεια, ἀλλὰ ταυτοχρόνως παράγει τὴν ἀνάγκην τῆς ἀφηγηματικῆς διασώσεως.
Ἡ μνήμη μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἔλλειψιν εἰς ἐνεργὸν ἀρχὴν ἀναταξινομήσεως τοῦ παρόντος.
Ἡ πολεμικὴ δύναμις μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἰδιότητα τάξεως εἰς δημόσιον τεκμήριον ἀρετῆς.
Ἡ πόλις μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ τοπικὴ κοινότης εἰς φορέα καθολικῆς ἀπελευθερώσεως, χωρὶς νὰ ἀποβάλῃ τὸ ἡγεμονικὸν στοιχεῖον.
Ἡ φυσικὴ καταστροφὴ μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἐξωτερικὴ διακοπὴ εἰς συστατικὸν μηχανισμὸν τοῦ ἱστορικοῦ χρόνου.
Ἡ πραγματικότης νοεῖται ὡς κυκλικὴ μηχανὴ ἐν ᾗ καταστροφή, λήθη, ἀρχειακὴ φύλαξις καὶ πολιτικὴ ἐπανενεργοποίησις ἀλληλοδιαδέχονται.
Ὁ ἄνθρωπος γίνεται οὐχὶ αὐτόνομος κύριος τοῦ χρόνου, ἀλλὰ φύλαξ, μαχητής, μάρτυς ἢ ἐρμηνευτὴς θραυσμένης συνέχειας.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι σπειροειδής: τὰ γεγονότα ἀφανίζονται, ἀλλὰ ἐπανέρχονται ὡς ἀνακατασκευασμένα πρότυπα πολιτικῆς πράξεως.
Ἡ διαφυγὴ ἀπαιτεῖ ἀντίστασιν καὶ διατήρησιν μνήμης, ἀλλὰ οὐδέποτε ἐγγυᾶται ὁριστικὴν νίκην ἐπὶ τῆς φθορᾶς.
Τὰ παρόντα ἀξιώματα ἐπαρκοῦσιν ὥστε νὰ ἀνασυστήσωσι τὴν κύριαν κίνησιν ἀπὸ λήθην καὶ ἱερατικὴν μνήμην εἰς θεσμικὴν τάξιν καὶ καθολικὴν ἀντίστασιν.
Ὑπομένει ἀπροσδιόριστον ὁ ἀκριβὴς τρόπος καθʼ ὃν ἡ κοσμολογικὴ γνώσις μεταβαίνει εἰς συγκεκριμένους θεσμούς καὶ ἡ ἱερατικὴ μαρτυρία γίνεται ἀπόδειξις.
Ἡ συνοχὴ τοῦ συμπλέγματος εἶναι ἰσχυροτάτη στὴν σύνδεσιν φυσικῆς φθορᾶς, ἀπωλείας γραφῶν, λειτουργικοῦ χωρισμοῦ καὶ ἀντιμετωπίσεως δουλώσεως.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευὴ διατηρεῖ τὴν πραγματικὴν κίνησιν, ἀλλὰ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ διαμεσολαβημένην μνήμην, ἐπιλεκτικὴν συμπύκνωσιν καὶ ἀνοικτὴν ἐρμηνείαν.
Ἀντιστέκεται εἰς πλήρη ἀξιωματικὴν μείωσιν ἡ ἀμφισημία τῆς Ἀθηναϊκῆς ἰσχύος, ἥτις εἶναι ἅμα ἐλευθερωτικὴ καὶ ἐνδεχομένως ἡγεμονική.
The central aporia asks how ancient political magnitudes can be recognized when collective memory fails.
Historical ignorance is reframed as the result of periodic catastrophe, loss of writings, and interruption of education.
Memory is preserved not naturally, but through institutions, archives, and priestly bearers.
The city is constituted as a hierarchical composition of functions, cosmological education, and military mission.
The local polity is elevated into a global political subject through opposition to a universal power of enslavement.
Ancient Athens is presented as a latent form of political excellence, which is recognized only through recovery and restoration.
The catastrophe simultaneously obliterates the tyrant, the defender, and the means of empirical verification.
The movement is spiral-shaped: forgetting, recovery, political reinterpretation, and new loss constitute an open cycle.
[Persistent] The absence of memory does not prove the absence of events, but can testify to an interruption of their bearers.
[Persistent] Natural decay chiefly obliterates writing, education, and institutional continuity, not necessarily the human race.
[Mutating] Writing shifts from a means of communication into a mechanism of political continuity and power over the past.
[Emergent] The polity becomes a whole in which social division, education, divine order, military strength, and memory mutually produce one another.
[Persistent] Political order requires distinct kinds and functions, so that unity is not identified with confusion.
[Mutating] Prudence extends from cosmic contemplation to sciences, institutions, and strategic action.
[Emergent] Athenian virtue is constituted as the capacity to liberate others, but by means of a form of power that can acquire hegemonic features.
[Terminal] The catastrophe obliterates both the Atlantic hegemony and the original Athenian military subject, leaving only mediated memory.
[Attractor] Political excellence appears as a latent possibility, which forgetting conceals but does not create from nothing.
[Mutating] Geographical place is transformed into a global map of political zones, hegemonies, and resistances.
[Emergent] Historical truth emerges from the combination of obliteration, fragmentary transmission, and later interpretive reconnection.
[Attractor] Freedom does not pre-exist as a secure condition, but is produced through resistance to concentrated power.
Memory recurs as written archive, priestly possession, oral transmission, and interpretive lens; its function shifts from preservation to legitimation.
Natural catastrophe recurs, but shifts from a cause of forgetting to a mechanism of leveling and of inability to verify.
Athens shifts from a forgotten city to a model polity and then to a bearer of universal liberation.
The distinction of functions recurs as social hierarchy, as distribution of knowledge, and as allocation of political power.
War changes meaning: from the task of the fighting kind, it becomes evidence of virtue and an instrument of liberation.
Place is detached from geographical particularity and converted into an environmental, cosmological, and strategic factor.
Atlantis does not remain an autonomous place, but is absorbed as the contrary model of universal political expansion.
The correction of Solon's individual ignorance remains local; it ascends only when it explains the political power of memory.
The precise arrangement of the particular kinds is a lower-level schema, whereas the principle of functional separation scales into a global architecture.
The cyclical alternation of catastrophe and restarting constitutes a current principle of the complex, not merely a motif of one chapter.
Priestly knowledge bridges lost history and political claim, and thus shifts from a local bearer into a structural principle of validation.
The external threat dissolves the limitation of internal virtue and transforms the polity into a historical mission.
The simple opposition of Athenians and Atlanteans is surpassed by the unstable kinship between liberating and hegemonic power.
The linear idea of historical progress is rejected, because civilization can be obliterated and restarted.
The identification of the present with the measure of the possible is rejected, because the forgotten past contains unactivated forms of political excellence.
The self-generated and lawlessly constituted city is rejected, because the polity requires divine order, law, and education.
Simple military superiority as a criterion of virtue is rejected; strength must be integrated into order and liberation.
Natural and pre-existing freedom is rejected, because freedom appears only when a power of enslavement is confronted.
History as a complete and unobstructed repository of events is rejected, because access to it depends on surviving transmissions.
It is excluded that the present suffices as the measure of human political possibility.
A purely natural or purely epistemic explanation of forgetting is excluded; decay is intertwined with the loss of institutions.
Historical discourse as independent of the bearer of archives is excluded, because knowledge follows possession of memory.
The identification of political worth and contemporary recognition is excluded, because forgetting can conceal excellence.
A polity of virtue without hierarchical distinction and functional separation is excluded, just as indiscriminate social unity is excluded.
A world in which freedom is separated from danger, war, and collective strength is excluded.
Self-sufficient modern self-consciousness is absent, because the present can dwell upon the ruins of forgotten polities.
The human self-foundation of the city is absent; the principle is displaced into divine order, place, and inherited education.
A world is absent in which just hegemony can be absolutely separated from expansionist domination.
Immediacy between past and present is absent; political significance is generated through recollection and interpretation.
Final victory is absent, because catastrophe can obliterate even the bearer of victory.
Catastrophe becomes not a mere background of history, but a mechanism that determines which polities can be known.
Internal order acquires a universal claim only when the external threat compels it to act on behalf of others.
The priestly preservation of writing and the functional separation of the city form an analogous architecture: continuity depends on distributed bearers.
The Athenian polity is recovered as a paradigm only because lost action is reconnected with later theory.
Natural decay levels tyrant and defender, but memory restores asymmetric political worth between them.
Liberating and hegemonic expansion are distinguished not by strength, but by political purpose and relation to others.
Political reality is constituted threefold: as institutional order, as the testing of external threat, and as the survival of memory.
The history of the complex is post-catastrophic; the event acquires full political significance only when it returns through the archive.
Virtue is not an essence enclosed within a city, but a relation of resistance, liberation, and assumption of risk.
Archival continuity is a political battlefield, because whoever holds memory also holds the interpretation of political worth.
Catastrophe produces a double result: it obliterates political bodies, but makes necessary the power of mediated memory.
Time does not necessarily advance the polity; it restores fragments that require political synthesis anew.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Catastrophe → loss of writing → forgetting → archival asymmetry → recovery of the past → new political legitimation.
Internal arrangement → external threat → military proof → liberation of others → hegemonic ambiguity.
The geographical horizon expands, the threat is universalized, and the city is compelled to shift from local law to a global task.
Writing becomes a mechanism: from a repository of events it is transformed into a regulator of who has a past and who has a political claim.
Natural decay constitutes a phase point: from the history of actions, the account shifts into the history of memory.
The hidden attractor of the system is the ancient Athenian polity, which returns as proof, model, and open problem.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Periodic natural decay destroys writing, education, and political continuity.
The interruption of memory transforms the historical event into myth and compels survivors to restart.
The uninterrupted archival community accumulates knowledge and produces asymmetric interpretive power.
The polity coordinates functional separation, cosmic education, divine selection, and military capacity.
Expanded geography produces a universal threat, which tests the internal political order.
Athenian resistance transforms virtue from internal arrangement into liberating action.
The new catastrophe obliterates the bearers, but leaves memory as the interpretive basis of later political theory.
Insufficient memory → periodic catastrophe → loss of writing → priestly archival asymmetry.
Archival recovery → revelation of hierarchical polity → connection of cosmology and prudence.
Expansion of the world → Atlantic universal threat → Athenian resistance → liberation.
Natural catastrophe → obliteration of political bodies → mnemonic reactivation → open interpretation of political virtue.
History is reclassified from linear succession into a cycle of catastrophe, forgetting, and restarting.
Ignorance ceases to signify absence and becomes a symptom of lost archival continuity.
Writing becomes a political mechanism, and the archival bearer acquires interpretive sovereignty.
Social division appears as a condition of good order, while undivided unity is disclosed as confusion of functions.
Military victory is reclassified as evidence of total political virtue and not as mere possession of strength.
The geographical map becomes an open system of political zones, in which the local city can undertake a global task.
The opposition of freedom and hegemony ceases to be a simple dichotomy, because both presuppose superiority of strength.
**Surface level:** The account examines Athens, Atlantis, laws, kinds, priests, wars, and floods.
**Structural level:** Beneath the particular persons operate mechanisms of archival preservation, functional separation, cosmological education, and strategic confrontation.
**Metastrategic level:** Political virtue is judged by whether it can check a universal threat and transform strength into liberation.
**Ontological / Temporal level:** Time is destructive and repetitive, while political order remains mortal and memory is subsequently reconstructive.
**Methodological / Performative level:** The discourse imitates the archival work it describes, because from fragments, transmissions, and analogies it reconstructs a political past.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The city liberates others through superiority, but this superiority can take a hegemonic form.
Priestly testimony becomes necessary for recovery of the truth, but the exact proof of the testimony remains open.
Hierarchical order grounds virtue, but the universal soteriological claim requires worth beyond internal limits.
Catastrophe nullifies empirical continuity, but simultaneously produces the need for narrative preservation.
Memory mutates from a deficiency into an active principle of reclassifying the present.
Military power mutates from an attribute of an order into a public token of virtue.
The city mutates from a local community into a bearer of universal liberation, without shedding its hegemonic element.
Natural catastrophe mutates from an external interruption into a constitutive mechanism of historical time.
Reality is conceived as a cyclical mechanism in which catastrophe, forgetting, archival preservation, and political reactivation succeed one another.
The human being becomes not an autonomous master of time, but a guardian, fighter, witness, or interpreter of broken continuity.
Time is spiral-shaped: events disappear, but return as reconstructed models of political action.
Escape requires resistance and preservation of memory, but never guarantees final victory over decay.
These axioms suffice to reconstruct the principal movement from forgetting and priestly memory to institutional order and universal resistance.
The precise manner in which cosmological knowledge passes into concrete institutions and priestly testimony becomes proof remains indeterminate.
The coherence of the complex is strongest in the connection of natural decay, loss of writings, functional separation, and confrontation with enslavement.
The reconstruction preserves the actual movement, but depends on mediated memory, selective condensation, and open interpretation.
The ambiguity of Athenian power resists complete axiomatic reduction, being at once liberating and potentially hegemonic.
Τὸ σύστημα ζητεῖ νὰ καταστήσῃ τὸν λόγον ἀληθῆ διὰ ἀναμνήσεως, τάξεως, αἰτιολογίας καὶ κοινῆς δοκιμῆς.
Ἡ ἀνάμνησις οὐκέτι σημαίνει παθητικὴν φύλαξιν, ἀλλὰ ἐνεργὸν ἀνασύνθεσιν τοῦ παρελθόντος.
Ὁ μῦθος μεταφέρεται εἰς τὸ ἀληθὲς μόνον ὅταν ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ ἀκριβῶς καὶ πρεπόντως ἀποδοθῇ.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ διήγησις ἀναβαίνει ἀπὸ τὴν πόλιν εἰς τὴν κοσμολογίαν καὶ τὴν ἀνθρωπολογίαν.
Ἡ κοσμολογία παρέχει τὸ ὀντολογικὸν ἔδαφος, ἐπειδὴ τὸ αἰσθητὸν γιγνόμενον ἀπαιτεῖ αἴτιον καὶ παράδειγμα.
Ἡ πολιτεία παρουσιάζεται ὡς ὕστερον προϊόν κοσμικῆς γενέσεως, παιδείας, νόμου καὶ μνήμης.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ λόγου παραμένει σχεσιακή, διότι ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ θείαν εὔνοιαν, λέγοντα καὶ ἀκούοντας.
Ἡ κίνησις εἶναι σπειροειδής· ἀπὸ μνήμην ἐπανέρχεται εἰς αἰτιολογίαν καὶ ἀπὸ αἰτιολογίαν εἰς πολιτικὴν ταυτότητα, ἥτις πάλιν ὑποβάλλεται εἰς ἔλεγχον.
[Persistent] Ὁ ἀληθὴς λόγος ἀπαιτεῖ ἀνασύνθεσιν καὶ οὐχὶ πλαστὴν μυθοποιίαν.
[Mutating] Ἡ μνήμη μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ χρονικὴν ἐδραίωσιν εἰς μέθοδον ἐνεργοῦ γνώσεως.
[Emergent] Ἡ πολιτικὴ ταυτότης παράγεται διὰ τῆς συνδέσεως γενέσεως, παιδείας, νόμου καὶ προγονικῆς μνήμης.
[Persistent] Πᾶν τὸ γιγνόμενον ἀπαιτεῖ αἴτιον καὶ οὐ δύναται νὰ εἶναι ἀρχὴ ἑαυτοῦ.
[Mutating] Ὁ μῦθος ἀπὸ κλειστὴ μυθικὴ διήγησις μεταβάλλεται εἰς ἐρμηνευτικὸν προσχέδιον τοῦ ἀληθινοῦ κόσμου.
[Emergent] Ἡ παραγωγὴ γνώσεως εἶναι κοινὴ ἐνέργεια θείας ἐπικλήσεως, λέγοντος καὶ ἀκουόντων.
[Persistent] Ἡ ὀντολογικὴ τάξις ἀπὸ τὸ ἀγέννητον καὶ νοητὸν εἰς τὸ γενητὸν καὶ αἰσθητὸν θεμελιοῖ τὴν ὕστερον πολιτικὴν τάξιν.
[Attractor] Ἡ καταλληλότης τοῦ λόγου λειτουργεῖ ὡς τελικὸν κριτήριον τῆς ἀνασυνθέσεως.
[Emergent] Ὁ κόσμος, ὡς γενητὸς καὶ αἰσθητός, ὑποτάσσεται εἰς ὑπερκείμενον αἰτιακὸν λόγον.
[Terminal] Ἡ ἀνάγκη αἰτίας ἀποδεικνύεται ἰσχυρότερον ἢ ὁ πλήρης προσδιορισμὸς τῆς φύσεως αὐτῆς.
[Attractor] Τὸ σύστημα κυκλοφορεῖ περὶ τῆς ἀπουσίας ἀπολύτου ἐγγυήσεως τοῦ ἀληθοῦς λόγου.
[Emergent] Ἡ πόλις ἀναγιγνώσκεται ὡς ἱστορικὴ συνέχεια ἣ συνδέει τὸ παρόν, τὸ προγονικόν, τὸ κοσμικὸν καὶ τὸ θεῖον.
[Terminal] Ἡ συμπυκνωμένη μηχανὴ διασώζει τὴν φοράν τοῦ λόγου, ἀλλὰ ἀφίησιν ἀπροσδιόριστον τὴν τελικὴν πολιτικὴν διήγησιν.
Ἡ μνήμη ἐπανέρχεται ἀρχικῶς ὡς ἀνάκλησις, ἔπειτα ὡς ἀνασύνθεσις, καὶ τέλος ὡς θεμέλιον πολιτικῆς συνέχειας.
Ἡ ἐπανάληψις τῆς διδασκαλίας μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ μηχανισμὸν διατηρήσεως εἰς ἐγγύησιν ἀκριβείας.
Ὁ μῦθος μετατοπίζεται ἀπὸ ἀφήγησιν τοῦ παρελθόντος εἰς μηχανὴν ἐρμηνείας τοῦ παρόντος.
Ἡ διάκρισις μύθου καὶ ἀληθείας δὲν παραμένει ἀπόλυτος· μετασχηματίζεται εἰς διάκρισιν πλαστοῦ λόγου καὶ ἐλεγχόμενης μεταφορᾶς.
Τὸ ἀμετάβλητον παράδειγμα καὶ τὸ γενητὸν εἴδωλον καθίστανται τὸ ὀντολογικὸν πρότυπον τῆς ἀντιθέσεως μνήμης καὶ παρόντος.
Ἡ αἰσθητὴ παρουσία, ἥτις ἀρχικῶς φαίνεται βεβαίωσις, ἀναστρέφεται εἰς τεκμήριον γενέσεως καὶ ἐξαρτήσεως.
Ἡ ὑπόθεσις ταυτότητος δὲν τελεσιουργεῖται ὡς βεβαιότης, ἀλλὰ παραμένει ὑπὸ ἔλεγχον καὶ δύναται νὰ μεταβληθῇ.
Ἡ σιωπὴ μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἔλλειψιν λόγου εἰς ὅρον μεταβιβάσεως καὶ ἀναλήψεως νέας ἀφηγήσεως.
Ἡ ἀκρίβεια ἐπιτελεῖ ἔργον, ἀλλὰ δὲν ἐξαλείφει τὴν ἀβεβαιότητα περὶ τοῦ πραγματικοῦ περιεχομένου τοῦ ἀληθοῦς.
Τοπικὴ μένει ἡ ἀνάγκη ἀκριβοῦς ἀνακλήσεως συγκεκριμένου λόγου· ἀναβαίνει δὲ εἰς τὸ παρὸν ἐπίπεδον ἡ μετατροπὴ τῆς μνήμης εἰς πολιτικὸν μηχανισμόν.
Τοπικὴ μένει ἡ σκηνικὴ κατανομὴ τῶν ὁμιλητῶν· γεφυροῦσα δὲ γίνεται ἡ ἀμοιβαία ξενία, ἥτις μετατρέπει τὴν διήγησιν εἰς κοινὴν ἐνέργειαν.
Τοπικὴ μένει ἡ ἀπόδειξις ὅτι ὁ οὐρανὸς γέγονεν· ἀναβαίνει δὲ ἡ γενικὴ ἀρχὴ ὅτι τὸ αἰσθητὸν ὂν ἀπαιτεῖ ἐξήγησιν.
Ἡ ἀκολουθία κόσμος–ἄνθρωπος–πόλις δὲν εἶναι ἁπλὴ παράθεσις θεμάτων, ἀλλὰ ἀναγκαία κλίμαξ θεμελιώσεως.
Ἡ τοπικὴ ἀνάγνωσις τοῦ μύθου ὡς παραδόσεως ὑπερβαίνεται ὅταν ὁ μῦθος γίνεται ὄργανον πολιτικῆς ταυτότητος.
Ἡ τοπικὴ κοσμογονικὴ αἰτιολογία δὲν ἀρκεί καθ᾽ ἑαυτήν· ἐντὸς τοῦ συμπλέγματος recodificata γίνεται ὡς ὅρος πολιτικῆς νομιμοποιήσεως.
Ὑποκαθίσταται ἡ ἰδέα τῆς ἁπλῆς ἀναπαραγωγῆς ὑπὸ τὴν ἰδέαν τῆς διαδοχικῆς ἀνασυνθέσεως καὶ ἐξετάσεως.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ὁ λόγος ὃς ἀπαιτεῖ ἀλήθειαν διὰ πλαστοῦ μύθου.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ πολιτικὴ διήγησις ἡ ἀποκεκομμένη ἀπὸ κοσμογονίαν καὶ ἀνθρωπογονίαν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀνάμνησις ἡ περιοριζομένη εἰς κεφαλαιώδη σχήματα ἄνευ τῶν καθ᾽ ἕκαστα.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ αὐτάρκεια τοῦ αἰσθητοῦ κόσμου, ἐπειδὴ τὸ γιγνόμενον ἀπαιτεῖ αἴτιον.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀπόλυτος κυριότης τοῦ λέγοντος, ἐπειδὴ ὁ λόγος ἀπαιτεῖ θείαν εὔνοιαν καὶ ἀκροατῶν μάθησιν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ αὐτόματη ταύτισις τοῦ μυθικοῦ τόπου πρὸς τὴν παροῦσαν πόλιν.
Δεῖ ψευδὲς εἶναι ὅτι τὸ παρόν δύναται νὰ νοηθῇ ἄνευ προγονικῆς καὶ κοσμολογικῆς ἀναφορᾶς.
Δεῖ ψευδὲς εἶναι ὅτι ἡ πολιτικὴ κοινότης ἔχει ἀρχὴν ἐν ἑαυτῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ γένεσιν καὶ παιδείαν.
Δεῖ ψευδὲς εἶναι ὅτι τὸ γιγνόμενον καὶ τὸ ἀεὶ ὂν ἀνήκουσιν εἰς ἓν ὀντολογικὸν γένος.
Δεῖ ψευδὲς εἶναι ὅτι ἡ ἀλήθεια ἰσοδυναμεῖ πρὸς ἀπλήρωτον βεβαιότητα, ἄνευ ἐλέγχου καὶ ἐξαρτήσεως.
Δεῖ ψευδὲς εἶναι ὅτι ἡ αἴσθησις ἀποκαλύπτει αὐτομάτως τὸ ὄντως ὂν.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ δυνατότης λόγου ὃς ἐγγυᾶται ἑαυτὸν ἄνευ μνήμης, παραδείγματος, αἰτίας καὶ κοινῆς κρίσεως.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ καθαρὰ διάκρισις ἡ ἀποκόπτουσα τὸν μῦθον ἀπὸ τῆς ἀληθείας· ὁ μῦθος ἐπιβιοῖ ὡς ἐλεγχόμενον πρότυπον.
Ἀπουσιάζει κόσμος ὃς εἶναι ἅμα αἰσθητὸς καὶ ἀγέννητος, αὐτάρκης καὶ ἀναίτιος.
Ἡ ἀπουσία ἀπολύτου ἐγγυήσεως κινεί τὸ σύστημα πρὸς διαρκῆ ἀνασύνθεσιν καὶ ἐπανέλεγχον.
Ἐπειδὴ ἡ μνήμη γίνεται ἐνεργὸς ἀνασύνθεσις καὶ ἡ πολιτικὴ ταυτότης ἀπαιτεῖ προγονικὴν ἀναφοράν, ἡ ἀνάκλησις μετατρέπεται εἰς μηχανισμὸν πολιτικῆς νομιμοποιήσεως.
Ἐπειδὴ ὁ λόγος ἀπαιτεῖ ἀλήθειαν καὶ ὁ κόσμος αἴτιον, ἡ ἀληθοφάνεια τοῦ πολιτικοῦ λόγου ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ κοσμικὴν ἀρχὴν ἣν αὐτὸς δὲν παράγει.
Ἡ μετάθεσις τοῦ μύθου εἰς τὸ ἀληθὲς καὶ ἡ διάκρισις ἀγεννήτου παραδείγματος καὶ γενητοῦ κόσμου συγκροτοῦσι κοινὴν λογικὴν μεταφορᾶς ἀπὸ πρότυπον εἰς εἴδωλον.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία κόσμου–ἀνθρώπου–πόλεως καθιστᾷ τὴν πολιτικὴν ἱστορία ἀποτέλεσμα καὶ οὐχὶ ἀρχήν.
Ἡ ἀπαίτησις ἀληθοῦς λόγου συμπλέκεται μὲ τὴν ἀναγνώρισιν ὅτι ὁ ἀνθρώπινος λόγος δὲν δύναται νὰ ἐγγυηθῇ μόνος τὴν ἐπιτυχίαν του.
Ἡ ἀκρίβεια τῆς ἀναδιηγήσεως δὲν λύνει τὴν ὀντολογικὴν ἀβεβαιότητα· μόνον μεταφέρει τὸ πρόβλημα ἀπὸ τὴν μνήμην εἰς τὴν αἰτιολογίαν.
Ἡ κοινὴ δοκιμὴ τοῦ λόγου λειτουργεῖ ὡς πολιτικὸ ἀνάλογον τῆς κοσμικῆς αἰτιολογίας: ἀμφότερα ζητοῦσιν ἀρχὴν ἔξωθεν τῆς ἁπλῆς ἐμφανίσεως.
Ἡ ἀνοιχτὴ δυνατότης ἄλλης ἐξηγήσεως δὲν ἀκυροῖ τὴν ἀνάγκην λόγου, ἀλλὰ καθιστᾷ τὴν ἀνασύνθεσιν ἀναθεωρήσιμον.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια μετασχηματίζεται ἀπὸ ἰδιότητα προτάσεως εἰς διαδικασίαν ἀνασυνθέσεως, θεμελιώσεως καὶ ἐλέγχου.
Ἡ πόλις ἀναφαίνεται ὡς ὀντολογικὸν παράγωγον: ἡ πολιτικὴ ταυτότης ἔχει ἀρχὴν ἐν κόσμῳ, ἐν προγόνους καὶ ἐν παιδείᾳ.
Ἡ ἀποκάλυψις τοῦ κόσμου ὡς γενητοῦ ἀνατρέπει τὴν ἰδέαν ὅτι ἡ αἰσθητὴ παρουσία ἀποτελεῖ ἔσχατον κριτήριον πραγματικότητος.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ ἱστορία καθίσταται ἔγκυρος λόγος μόνον ὅταν ἐνσωματῶνῃ τὴν ἀλυσίδα παράδειγμα–γένεσις–παιδεία–μνήμη.
Ἡ ἐπιστημικὴ ἀξίωσις τοῦ λόγου συνοδεύεται ὑπὸ ἐπιστημολογικῆς ταπεινώσεως, ἐπειδὴ ἡ αἰτία ἀναγκαία μένει ἀλλ᾽ ἀπροσδιόριστος.
Ἡ συνολικὴ μηχανὴ ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὴν ἀναζήτησιν ἑνὸς τελικοῦ θεμελίου διὰ διαδοχικῆς ἀναφορᾶς ἀπὸ λόγον εἰς μνήμην, ἀπὸ μνήμην εἰς παράδειγμα, καὶ ἀπὸ παράδειγμα εἰς πόλιν.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Ἀκρόασις → μνήμη → ἀνασύνθεσις → λόγος → ἔλεγχος → νέα ἀνάγκη μνήμης.
Μῦθος → μεταφορὰ → πολιτικὴ ταυτότης → ἱστορικὴ ἀναφορά → ἐπανερμηνεία τοῦ μύθου.
Αἴσθησις → γένεσις → αἴτιον → παράδειγμα → κριτήριον ποιότητος τοῦ κόσμου.
Κόσμος → ἄνθρωπος → παιδεία → πόλις· ἡ πολιτικὴ ὕπαρξις ἐπιστρέφει εἰς τὴν ἀνάγκην κοσμολογικῆς θεμελιώσεως.
Ἡ ἐπίκλησις τοῦ θείου δὲν κλείει τὸν λόγον, ἀλλὰ ἀνοίγει τὴν συνεργασίαν θεῶν, λέγοντος καὶ ἀκροατῶν.
Ὁ ἔλεγχος τῆς καταλληλότητος γίνεται ἀτραπὸς ἀναθεωρήσεως, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀκριβὴς μνήμη δὲν ἀρκεί πρὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν.
Ἀ attractor τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι λόγος ἀκριβής, πρέπων, αἰτιολογημένος καὶ κοινῇ ἐξεταζόμενος, ὅστις ὅμως οὐδέποτε παγιώνεται ὡς ἀπόλυτος.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Πρόσφατος ἀκρόασις ἀποδεικνύεται ἀνεπαρκής· ἡ χρονικὴ ἐδραίωσις τῆς μαθήσεως παράγει ἰσχυροτέραν μνήμην.
Ἡ μνήμη διὰ ἐσωτερικῆς ἐπισκοπήσεως γίνεται ἀκριβὴς ἀνασύνθεσις καὶ ἀναδιήγησις.
Ἡ ἀνασύνθεσις μεταφέρει τὸν μῦθον εἰς τὸ ἀληθὲς, ἀλλὰ ὑποβάλλει τὴν μεταφορὰν εἰς κοινὸν ἔλεγχον.
Ἡ ἀπαίτησις ἀληθοῦς λόγου ἀναγκάζει τὴν ἀφήγησιν νὰ ἀναβῇ ἀπὸ τὴν πολιτικὴν πόλιν εἰς κόσμον καὶ ἄνθρωπον.
Ἡ ὀντολογικὴ διαίρεσις τοῦ ἀγεννήτου καὶ τοῦ γενητοῦ θεμελιοῖ τὴν ἀνάγκην αἰτίας καὶ παραδείγματος.
Ἡ κοσμολογικὴ θεμελίωσις ἐπιστρέφει εἰς τὴν πόλιν ὡς παιδευμένην, μνημονικὴν καὶ προγονικὴν κοινότητα.
Ἡ μηχανὴ κλείνει προσωρινῶς μὲ κριτήριον καταλληλότητος, ἀλλὰ παραμένει ἀνοικτὴ διὰ τὴν ἀδυναμίαν πλήρους προσδιορισμοῦ τοῦ αἰτίου καὶ τοῦ ἀληθοῦς.
Ἀνεπαρκὴς πρόσφατος μνήμη → χρονικὴ ἐδραίωσις → ἐσωτερικὴ ἀνασύνθεσις.
Ἀκριβὴς ἀναδιήγησις → μετάθεσις τοῦ μύθου εἰς τὸ ἀληθές → κοινὸς ἔλεγχος καταλληλότητος.
Ἱερὰ περίστασις → ἀπαίτησις ἀληθοῦς λόγου → κοσμολογία → ἀνθρωπολογία → πολιτικὴ ἱστορία.
Ὀντολογικὴ διαίρεσις → γνωστικὴ ἀντιστοίχησις → καθολικὴ αἰτιακὴ ἀνάγκη → παράδειγμα.
Γενητὸς κόσμος → ἀναγκαία αἰτία → παιδευμένη πόλις → ἀναθεωρήσιμος πολιτικὴ ταυτότης.
Ἡ μνήμη ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἐνεργὸς παραγωγὴ νοήματος καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς ἁπλὴ διατήρησις παρελθόντος.
Ἡ διάκρισις μύθου καὶ ἀληθείας μετασχηματίζεται εἰς διαδικασίαν μεταφορᾶς, θεμελιώσεως καὶ ἐλέγχου.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ ταυτότης παύει νὰ εἶναι αὐτοτελὴς καὶ γίνεται ἀποτέλεσμα κοσμικῆς, ἀνθρωπολογικῆς καὶ παιδευτικῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ αἴσθησις παύει νὰ λειτουργῇ ὡς ἔνδειξις αὐταρκείας καὶ γίνεται σημεῖον γενέσεως καὶ ἐξαρτήσεως.
Ἡ ἀφήγησις τοῦ κόσμου, τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ τῆς πόλεως γίνεται μία ἱεραρχικὴ μηχανὴ καὶ οὐχὶ τρία χωριστὰ πεδία.
Ἡ μέθοδος τοῦ συστήματος ἀπαιτεῖ ἀνάγνωσιν ἡ ὁποία παρακολουθεῖ μετατοπίσεις, ἀναστροφὰς καὶ ἐπανελέγχους, οὐχὶ μόνον θέματα.
Ἐπιφανειακῶς, τὸ σύστημα πραγματεύεται ἀναδιήγησιν παλαιοῦ λόγου, ἱερὰν ὁμιλίαν, γένεσιν κόσμου καὶ ταυτότητα πόλεως.
Δομικῶς, ἐνεργοῦσι χρόνος, μνήμη, παράδειγμα, αἰτία, παιδεία, νόμος καὶ συλλογικὸς ἔλεγχος.
Μεταστρατηγικῶς, ὁ μῦθος χρησιμεύει ὡς ὄργανον ἐπαναπροσδιορισμοῦ τῆς παρούσης πολιτικῆς θέσεως, ἐνώ ἡ κατανομὴ λόγων ρυθμίζει τὴν ἀνάληψιν τῆς ἐρμηνείας.
Ὀντολογικῶς καὶ χρονικῶς, τὸ ἀγέννητον παράδειγμα ἀντιτίθεται πρὸς τὸ γενητὸν παρόν, ἐνώ ἡ μνήμη γεφυροῖ παρελθὸν καὶ πόλιν.
Μεθοδολογικῶς καὶ ἐπιτελεστικῶς, ἡ μορφὴ τοῦ λόγου ἐκτελεῖ αὐτὸ ποὺ διδάσκει: ἀνασυνθέτει, ἱεραρχεῖ, μεταφέρει καὶ ἐλέγχει.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ὁ λόγος ζητεῖται ὡς ἀληθής, ἀλλ᾽ ἡ ἐπιτυχία του ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ θείαν εὔνοιαν καὶ ἀνθρωπίνην ἱκανότητα.
Ἡ ταύτισις τῆς παλαιᾶς πόλεως πρὸς τὴν παροῦσαν εἶναι παραγωγικὴ ὡς ὑπόθεσις, ἀλλὰ ἀσταθὴς ὡς ἀπόδειξις.
Ἡ αἰτία τοῦ κόσμου καθίσταται ἀναγκαία, ἀλλὰ ἡ φύσις αὐτῆς μένει ἀπροσδιόριστος.
Ἡ συλλογικὴ ἀλήθεια ἀπαιτεῖ κοινὸν λόγον, ἀλλὰ ὁ κοινὸς λόγος δὲν ἐξασφαλίζει μόνος του τὴν ἀλήθειαν.
Ἡ μνήμη μεταλλάσσεται ὅταν παύει νὰ εἶναι ἀνάκλησις καὶ γίνεται πολιτικὴ ἀνασύνθεσις.
Ὁ μῦθος μεταλλάσσεται ὅταν ἀπὸ ἀντικείμενον ἀπομνημονεύσεως γίνεται πρότυπον ἐρμηνείας τοῦ ἀληθινοῦ.
Ἡ αἴσθησις μεταλλάσσεται ὅταν ἀπὸ φαινομενικὴν βεβαίωσιν γίνεται τεκμήριον γενητότητος.
Ἡ πολιτεία μεταλλάσσεται ὅταν ἀπὸ παροῦσα κοινότης γίνεται ἀποτέλεσμα κοσμικῆς γενέσεως καὶ παιδευτικῆς διαδοχῆς.
Ἡ πραγματικότης εἰκονίζεται ὡς ἱεραρχικὴ μηχανὴ μεταφορᾶς, ἐν ᾗ τὸ ἀγέννητον παράδειγμα παράγει γενητὸν κόσμον.
Ὁ κόσμος εἶναι γεγονὸς ἐξαρτώμενον, ὁ δὲ ἄνθρωπος ὂν ἐνδιάμεσον μεταξὺ κοσμικῆς αἰτίας καὶ πολιτικῆς μορφῆς.
Ὁ χρόνος δὲν εἶναι γραμμὴ ἀπὸ παρελθὸν εἰς παρόν, ἀλλὰ κύκλος ἀνακλήσεως, μεταφορᾶς καὶ ἐπανελέγχου.
Ἡ μόνη δυνατὴ στρατηγικὴ ἐλευθερία εἶναι ἡ ἀνασύνθεσις καὶ ὁ ἔλεγχος τῶν γεφυρῶν μεταξὺ μνήμης, κόσμου καὶ πόλεως.
Τὰ παρόντα ἀξιώματα ἀρκοῦσιν πρὸς ἀνακατασκευὴν τῆς κύριας κινήσεως ἀπὸ μνήμην εἰς πολιτικὴν καὶ κοσμολογικὴν θεμελίωσιν.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευὴ διασώζει τὴν διάκρισιν ἀναμνήσεως, ἀναδιηγήσεως, μεταφορᾶς, αἰτιολογίας καὶ ἐλέγχου.
Ὑποκαθορίζονται ἡ ἀκριβὴς φύσις τοῦ ἀληθοῦς λόγου, ἡ ταυτότης τοῦ κοσμικοῦ αἰτίου καὶ τὰ πραγματολογικὰ κριτήρια τοῦ πρέποντος.
Συνεκτικὸν μένει τὸ σύστημα ὅταν διατηρῇ τὴν ἱεράρχησιν ἀγέννητον ὄν → γενητὸς κόσμος → ἄνθρωπος → πόλις, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἀνοιχτὴ ἀναθεώρησις παραμένει ἀναγκαία.
The system seeks to make the account true through recollection, order, causal explanation, and common testing.
Recollection no longer signifies passive preservation, but active reconstruction of the past.
Myth is transferred into the true only when its account is rendered precisely and fittingly.
The political narrative ascends from the city to cosmology and anthropology.
Cosmology provides the ontological ground, since the perceptible becoming requires a cause and a paradigm.
The polity is presented as a subsequent product of cosmic generation, education, law, and memory.
The truth of the account remains relational, because it depends on divine favor, speaker, and hearers.
The movement is spiral: from memory it returns to causal explanation, and from causal explanation to political identity, which in turn is subjected to examination.
[Persistent] The true account requires reconstruction and not fabricated myth-making.
[Mutating] Memory changes from temporal consolidation into a method of active knowledge.
[Emergent] Political identity is produced through the linkage of generation, education, law, and ancestral memory.
[Persistent] Everything that comes to be requires a cause and cannot be its own principle.
[Mutating] Myth changes from a closed mythical narrative into an interpretive outline of the true world.
[Emergent] The production of knowledge is a common activity of divine invocation, speaker, and hearers.
[Persistent] The ontological order from the ungenerated and intelligible to the generated and perceptible grounds the subsequent political order.
[Attractor] The appropriateness of the account functions as the final criterion of reconstruction.
[Emergent] The cosmos, as generated and perceptible, is subject to a superordinate causal account.
[Terminal] The necessity of a cause is demonstrated more strongly than the complete determination of its nature.
[Attractor] The system circulates around the absence of an absolute guarantee of the true account.
[Emergent] The city is read as a historical continuity linking the present, the ancestral, the cosmic, and the divine.
[Terminal] The condensed mechanism preserves the direction of the account, but leaves the final political narrative indeterminate.
Memory recurs first as recollection, then as reconstruction, and finally as the foundation of political continuity.
The repetition of teaching mutates from a mechanism of preservation into a guarantee of precision.
Myth shifts from a narration of the past into a mechanism for interpreting the present.
The distinction between myth and truth does not remain absolute; it is transformed into a distinction between fabricated account and tested transfer.
The unchanging paradigm and the generated image become the ontological model for the opposition between memory and the present.
Perceptible presence, which initially appears as confirmation, is reversed into evidence of generation and dependence.
The hypothesis of identity is not brought to completion as certainty, but remains under examination and can change.
Silence mutates from a lack of account into a condition of transmission and of undertaking a new narrative.
Precision accomplishes work, but does not eliminate uncertainty concerning the actual content of the true.
The need for precise recollection of a particular account remains local; the transformation of memory into a political mechanism rises to the present level.
The dramatic distribution of speakers remains local; mutual hospitality becomes bridging, transforming the narrative into a common activity.
The proof that the heaven has come to be remains local; the general principle that perceptible being requires explanation rises up.
The sequence cosmos–human–city is not a simple juxtaposition of themes, but a necessary scale of grounding.
The local reading of myth as tradition is surpassed when myth becomes an instrument of political identity.
Local cosmogonic causal explanation is not sufficient in itself; within the complex recodificata it becomes a condition of political legitimation.
The idea of simple reproduction is replaced by the idea of successive reconstruction and examination.
The account that demands truth through fabricated myth is rejected.
The political narrative cut off from cosmogony and anthropogony is rejected.
Recollection restricted to general outlines without particulars is rejected.
The self-sufficiency of the perceptible cosmos is rejected, because what comes to be requires a cause.
The absolute sovereignty of the speaker is rejected, because the account requires divine favor and the learning of hearers.
The automatic identification of the mythical place with the present city is rejected.
It must be false that the present can be understood without ancestral and cosmological reference.
It must be false that the political community has its principle in itself and does not depend on generation and education.
It must be false that what comes to be and what always is belong to one ontological genus.
It must be false that truth is equivalent to unqualified certainty, without examination and dependence.
It must be false that perception automatically reveals what truly is.
There is absent the possibility of an account that guarantees itself without memory, paradigm, cause, and common judgment.
There is absent a pure distinction cutting myth off from truth; myth survives as a tested model.
There is absent a cosmos that is at once perceptible and ungenerated, self-sufficient and uncaused.
The absence of an absolute guarantee moves the system toward continual reconstruction and re-examination.
Because memory becomes active reconstruction and political identity requires ancestral reference, recollection is transformed into a mechanism of political legitimation.
Because the account requires truth and the cosmos a cause, the plausibility of political discourse depends on a cosmic principle which it itself does not produce.
The transfer of myth into the true and the distinction between ungenerated paradigm and generated cosmos constitute a common logic of transfer from model to image.
The hierarchy of cosmos–human–city makes political history an outcome and not a principle.
The requirement of a true account is intertwined with the recognition that human discourse cannot by itself guarantee its success.
The precision of retelling does not resolve ontological uncertainty; it merely transfers the problem from memory to causal explanation.
The common testing of the account functions as a political analogue of cosmic causal explanation: both seek a principle beyond mere appearance.
The open possibility of another explanation does not invalidate the need for an account, but makes reconstruction revisable.
Truth is transformed from a property of a proposition into a process of reconstruction, grounding, and examination.
The city appears as an ontological derivative: political identity has its principle in cosmos, in ancestors, and in education.
The disclosure of the cosmos as generated overturns the idea that perceptible presence constitutes the ultimate criterion of reality.
Political history becomes a valid account only when it incorporates the chain paradigm–generation–education–memory.
The epistemic claim of the account is accompanied by epistemological humility, because the cause remains necessary but indeterminate.
The overall mechanism replaces the search for a single final foundation with successive reference from account to memory, from memory to paradigm, and from paradigm to city.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Hearing → memory → reconstruction → account → examination → new need for memory.
Myth → transfer → political identity → historical reference → reinterpretation of myth.
Perception → generation → cause → paradigm → criterion of the cosmos's quality.
Cosmos → human → education → city; political existence returns to the need for cosmological grounding.
The invocation of the divine does not close the account, but opens the cooperation of gods, speaker, and hearers.
The examination of appropriateness becomes a path of revision, because precise memory is not sufficient for truth.
An attractor of the system is an account that is precise, fitting, causally explained, and commonly examined, yet never fixed as absolute.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Recent hearing proves insufficient; the temporal consolidation of learning produces stronger memory.
Through internal review, memory becomes precise reconstruction and retelling.
Reconstruction transfers myth into the true, but subjects the transfer to common examination.
The requirement of a true account compels the narrative to ascend from the political city to cosmos and human.
The ontological division of the ungenerated and the generated grounds the necessity of cause and paradigm.
Cosmological grounding returns to the city as an educated, memorial, and ancestral community.
The mechanism closes provisionally with a criterion of appropriateness, but remains open because of the inability fully to determine the cause and the true.
Insufficient recent memory → temporal consolidation → internal reconstruction.
Precise retelling → transfer of myth into the true → common examination of appropriateness.
Sacred occasion → requirement of a true account → cosmology → anthropology → political history.
Ontological division → cognitive correspondence → universal causal necessity → paradigm.
Generated cosmos → necessary cause → educated city → revisable political identity.
Memory is reclassified as active production of meaning and not as simple preservation of the past.
The distinction between myth and truth is transformed into a process of transfer, grounding, and examination.
Political identity ceases to be self-contained and becomes the outcome of cosmic, anthropological, and educational order.
Perception ceases to function as an indication of self-sufficiency and becomes a sign of generation and dependence.
The narrative of cosmos, human, and city becomes one hierarchical mechanism and not three separate fields.
The system's method requires a reading that tracks shifts, reversals, and re-examinations, not themes alone.
On the surface, the system treats the retelling of an old account, sacred speech, the generation of the cosmos, and the identity of the city.
Structurally, time, memory, paradigm, cause, education, law, and collective examination are operative.
Metastrategically, myth serves as an instrument for redefining the present political position, while the distribution of accounts regulates the undertaking of interpretation.
Ontologically and temporally, the ungenerated paradigm is opposed to the generated present, while memory bridges past and city.
Methodologically and performatively, the form of the account performs what it teaches: it reconstructs, hierarchizes, transfers, and examines.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The account is sought as true, but its success depends on divine favor and human capacity.
The identification of the old city with the present one is productive as a hypothesis, but unstable as proof.
The cause of the cosmos becomes necessary, but its nature remains indeterminate.
Collective truth requires common account, but common account does not by itself secure truth.
Memory mutates when it ceases to be recollection and becomes political reconstruction.
Myth mutates when, from an object of memorization, it becomes a model for interpreting the true.
Perception mutates when, from apparent confirmation, it becomes evidence of generatedness.
The polity mutates when, from a present community, it becomes the outcome of cosmic generation and educational succession.
Reality is figured as a hierarchical mechanism of transfer, in which the ungenerated paradigm produces a generated cosmos.
The cosmos is a dependent fact, and the human is an intermediate being between cosmic cause and political form.
Time is not a line from past to present, but a cycle of recollection, transfer, and re-examination.
The only possible strategic freedom is the reconstruction and examination of the bridges between memory, cosmos, and city.
The present axioms suffice for reconstruction of the principal movement from memory to political and cosmological grounding.
The reconstruction preserves the distinction among recollection, retelling, transfer, causal explanation, and examination.
The precise nature of the true account, the identity of the cosmic cause, and the pragmatic criteria of the fitting are underdetermined.
The system remains coherent when it preserves the hierarchy ungenerated being → generated cosmos → human → city, but open revision remains necessary.
Τὸ κύριον πρόβλημα εἶναι πῶς ἡ ἄτακτος πολλότης δύναται νὰ συγκροτηθῇ ὡς ἓν κάλλιστον καὶ νοερὸν ὅλον.
Ἡ ἀπάντησις μεταφέρει τὸ κριτήριον ἀπὸ τὰ φαινόμενα εἰς τὸ ἀίδιον καὶ νοητὸν παράδειγμα.
Ἡ ἀγαθότης τοῦ δημιουργοῦ λειτουργεῖ ὡς παραγωγικὴ ἀρχὴ, ἥτις μεταβάλλει τὴν ἀταξίαν εἰς τάξιν καὶ κάλλος.
Ὁ κόσμος ἀνασυντίθεται ὡς εἰκὼν τοῦ ἀϊδίου, ἔμψυχος, ἔννους καὶ καθολικῶς περιεκτικός.
Ἡ μοναδικότης τοῦ κόσμου ἐξάγεται ἐκ τῆς καθολικῆς περιεκτικότητος τοῦ παραδείγματος καὶ οὐκ ἐκ ἀριθμητικῆς ἀποφάσεως.
Ἡ ὑλικὴ σύστασις ἀπαιτεῖ μέσον δεσμὸν, διὰ τοῦ ὁποίου τὰ διεστῶτα συνάγονται εἰς ἑνότητα.
Ἡ ἀναλογία συνδέει τὸ νοητὸν εἶδος πρὸς τὸ σωματικὸν γίγνεσθαι καὶ καθιστᾷ τὴν ἑνότητα παραγόμενον δεσμόν.
Ἡ τελικὴ κίνησις εἶναι ἀπὸ τὴν ἀγαθότητα εἰς τὴν ὁμοίωσιν, ἀπὸ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα, καὶ ἀπὸ τὴν ἑνότητα εἰς τὸν εἰκότα λόγον.
[Persistent] Ἡ θεία ἀγαθότης οὐ φθονεῖ, ἀλλὰ βούλεται τὰ γενόμενα ὅτι μάλιστα ὁμοιωθῆναι πρὸς τὸ ἄριστον.
[Persistent] Τὸ ἀίδιον καὶ νοητὸν παράδειγμα προηγείται ὡς μέτρον τοῦ γεγονότος κόσμου.
[Mutating] Ὁ κόσμος μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ εἰκόνα τοῦ ἀϊδίου εἰς ἔμψυχον καὶ ἔννουν ὅλον.
[Persistent] Ἡ τάξις καὶ τὸ κάλλος ὑπερέχουν τῆς ἀταξίας καὶ τοῦ ἀτελοῦς.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἀγαθότης λειτουργεῖ ὡς νόμος δημιουργικός, ὁ ὁποῖος ἀναγκάζει τὸ γινόμενον πρὸς τὸ κάλλιστον.
[Persistent] Τὸ ὅλον ἔχει προτεραιότητα ἔναντι τῶν μερῶν, ἐπειδὴ τὰ μέρη νοοῦνται ὡς περιεχόμενα ἐν αὐτῷ.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἑνότης δὲν εἶναι ἁπλὴ ἀπουσία διαιρέσεως, ἀλλὰ ἔργον μέσου καὶ ἀναλογικοῦ δεσμοῦ.
[Mutating] Ἡ πολλαπλότης μετακινείται ἀπὸ ἐξωτερικὴν ἀριθμητικὴν διάστασιν εἰς ἐσωτερικὴν περιεκτικότητα ἑνὸς ὅλου.
[Persistent] Ἡ ὀντολογικὴ διαφορὰ παραδείγματος καὶ εἰκόνος καθορίζει τὸ μέτρον τοῦ ἀνθρωπίνου λόγου.
[Terminal] Ὁ εἰκὼς μῦθος ἀποτελεῖ τὸ προσήκον πέρας τῆς γνώσεως περὶ τοῦ γεγονότος καὶ τῶν θεῶν.
[Attractor] Ἡ κοσμικὴ πραγματικότης τείνει πρὸς ἓν καθολικὸν ὅλον, ὃ συνάπτει παράδειγμα, ψυχήν, νοῦν καὶ σῶμα.
[Emergent] Ἡ ὁμοίωσις δὲν εἶναι ἁπλὴ μορφικὴ ἀντιγραφή, ἀλλὰ καθολικὴ περιεκτικότης καὶ ἀναλογικὴ σύστασις.
Ἡ ἀγαθότης ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἀρχικῶς ὡς ἠθικὴ ἰδιότης, μεταλλάσσεται δὲ εἰς κοσμογονικὸν νόμον.
Ἡ τάξις μετακινείται ἀπὸ ἀξιολογικὴ προτίμησις εἰς ὀντολογικὴ ἀναγκαιότητα τοῦ κόσμου.
Ἡ εἰκών ἀρχικῶς δηλοῖ σχέσιν πρὸς τὸ παράδειγμα, ἀλλὰ ὕστερον γίνεται ἔμψυχος φορεὺς τοῦ νοητοῦ.
Ἡ ἑνότης μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ μοναδικότητα εἰς δεσμόν, ὥστε τὸ ἓν νὰ περιλαμβάνῃ καὶ νὰ συνάγῃ τὰ πολλά.
Ἡ πολλαπλότης δὲν καταργεῖται, ἀλλὰ ἀπορροφᾶται ὑπὸ τὴν καθολικὴν περιεκτικότητα τοῦ ἑνὸς κόσμου.
Ἡ ὕλη παύει νὰ εἶναι ἀσύνδετον ὑπόστρωμα καὶ γίνεται ἀκολουθία ἀπαιτήσεων πρὸς τὴν ἑνότητα.
Ὁ λόγος περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἀπὸ ἀξίωσιν ἀκριβείας μετατοπίζεται εἰς ἀναλογίαν καὶ εἰκότα μῦθον.
Ἡ ἀδυναμία πλήρους γνώσεως δὲν παραμένει ἔλλειμμα, ἀλλὰ γίνεται μεθοδολογικὸς κανὼν τοῦ προσήκοντος λόγου.
Τοπικὴ μένει ἡ ἀκριβὴς διάταξις πυρός, γῆς καὶ τοῦ τρίτου δεσμοῦ· καθολικὴ γίνεται ἡ ἀνάγκη σχέσεως καὶ συνδέσεως.
Τοπικὴ μένει ἡ ἀπόδειξις περὶ τοῦ ἑνὸς οὐρανοῦ, ἐνώ κεντρικὴ γίνεται ἡ ἀρχὴ ὅτι τὸ τέλειον ὁμοίωμα δὲν διπλασιάζεται ἐξωτερικῶς.
Ἡ σύνδεσις νοῦ, ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος ἀναβαίνει ἀπὸ εἰδικὴ κοσμολογικὴ ἀκολουθία εἰς γενικὸν πρότυπον ὁλοκληρώσεως.
Ἡ διάκριση εἰκόνος καὶ παραδείγματος γεφυροῖ τὰ κεφάλαια, ἐπειδὴ συνδέει τὴν ὀντολογίαν τοῦ κόσμου μὲ τὴν ἐπιστημολογίαν τοῦ λόγου.
Ἡ ἀναλογία καταλύει τὸ φαινομενικὸν χάσμα μεταξὺ νοητοῦ εἴδους καὶ σωματικῆς συνθέσεως.
Ἡ ἀρχικὴ ἀταξία παύει νὰ λειτουργῇ ὡς αὐτάρκης ἀρχή καὶ recoditur ὡς ὕλη ἐπιδεχομένη μορφήν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται κόσμος αὐτόνομος, ἄψυχος καὶ ἄλογος, ὁ ὁποῖος δὲν ἀναφέρεται εἰς παράδειγμα.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀταξία ὡς τελικὴ κοσμικὴ κατάστασις καὶ ἀναγνωρίζεται μόνον ὡς ἀρχικὸν ὑλικόν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ πολλαπλότης ὡς ἐξωτερικὴ παράθεσις ἀνεξαρτήτων κόσμων.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἑνότης ὡς ἁπλὴ ἀπουσία διαφορᾶς· ἡ ἑνότης ἀπαιτεῖ σχέσιν, μέσον καὶ δεσμόν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀξίωσις ὅτι ὁ λόγος δύναται νὰ ἔχῃ ἴσην ἀκρίβειαν περὶ τοῦ ἀϊδίου καὶ τοῦ γεγονότος.
Τὸ γεγονὸς δὲν δύναται νὰ κατέχῃ τὴν αὐτὴν ὀντολογικὴν βεβαιότητα μὲ τὸ ἀίδιον παράδειγμα.
Ἡ ὕλη δὲν δύναται νὰ ἀποτελέσῃ μόνη τὸν ἔσχατον ὅρον τοῦ κόσμου.
Τὸ μερικὸν δὲν δύναται νὰ χρησιμεύσῃ ὡς τέλειον πρότυπον τοῦ παντός.
Ἡ ἑνότης δὲν δύναται νὰ παραχθῇ ἄνευ σχέσεως μεταξὺ τῶν ὅρων οὓς ἑνοποιεῖ.
Ἡ κοσμολογία καταρρέει ἐὰν ἡ ἀγαθότης ἀποσυνδεθῇ ἀπὸ τὴν δημιουργικὴν ἐνέργειαν.
Ἀδύνατος μένει κόσμος ἴσος, πλήρης καὶ ἀνεξάρτητος παρὰ τὸ τέλειον παράδειγμα.
Ἀδύνατος μένει κόσμος ὃς ἂν ἦν πολλότης ἔξωθεν τοῦ ἑνὸς καθολικοῦ ὅλου.
Ἀδύνατος μένει λόγος ὁ ὁποῖος ἀπαιτεῖ πλήρη ἐπιστήμην περὶ τοῦ γεγονότος καὶ τοῦ θείου.
Ἡ ἀπουσία ταυτότητος εἰκόνος καὶ παραδείγματος διατηρεῖ τὸ πεδίον τῆς ἀναλογίας καὶ τοῦ εἰκότος μύθου.
Ἡ θεία ἀγαθότης γίνεται ἀναγκαιότης κοσμικῆς τάξεως, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀγαθὴ βούλησις καὶ τὸ κάλλιστον ἔργον συγκλίνουν.
Ἡ εἰκών ἀποκτᾷ διπλῆν λειτουργίαν· δηλοῖ μὲν ὀντολογικὴν ἐξάρτησιν, συγκροτεῖ δὲ τὸ ὁρατὸν ὡς ζῷον.
Ἡ καθολικότης τοῦ παραδείγματος μετατρέπει τὴν μοναδικότητα τοῦ κόσμου ἀπὸ ἀριθμητικὸν συμπέρασμα εἰς ὀντολογικὴν ἀπαίτησιν.
Ἡ ἀναλογία μεταφέρει τὴν ἀρχὴ τῆς ὁμοιώσεως ἐκ τοῦ νοητοῦ πεδίου εἰς τὴν ὑλικὴν σύνδεσιν τῶν στοιχείων.
Ἡ ἄρνησις τοῦ ἀσυνδέτου ὑποστρώματος καὶ ἡ ἄρνησις τῆς ἀτάκτου τελικότητος συγκροτοῦν κοινὴν ἀποφατικὴν ἀρχὴν: οὐδὲν μέρος ἑρμηνεύεται ἄνευ τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ ἀδυναμία πλήρους γνώσεως δὲν ἀκυροῖ τὴν κοσμικὴν τάξιν, ἀλλὰ ἐπιβάλλει λόγον ἀνάλογον πρὸς τὸ ὂν καὶ τὸ εἶδος αὐτοῦ.
Ἡ κοσμικὴ ἑνότης παράγεται ἐκ συμπτώσεως δύο κινήσεων: ὁμοιώσεως πρὸς ἓν παράδειγμα καὶ δεσμεύσεως τῶν πολλῶν εἰς ἓν σῶμα.
Ἡ πολλαπλότης ἀποβάλλει τὸ καθεστὼς αὐτοτελοῦς ἀρχῆς καὶ γίνεται ἐσωτερικὸ περιεχόμενον τοῦ κοσμικοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ δημιουργία μετασχηματίζεται ἀπὸ ἐλεύθερον γεγονὸς εἰς ἀναγκαίαν ἐκτύπωσιν τῆς ἀγαθότητος καὶ τοῦ παραδείγματος.
Ἡ ὀντολογία καὶ ἡ ἐπιστημολογία ἀκολουθοῦν κοινὴν ἱεραρχίαν: ὅσῳ κατωτέρον τὸ ὂν, τοσούτῳ ἀναλογικώτερος ὁ λόγος.
Ἡ τέλειος κόσμος δὲν ὁρίζεται ὡς ἄθροισμα τελείων μερῶν, ἀλλὰ ὡς ὅλον ὃ τὰ μέρη καθιστᾷ συγγενῆ καὶ λειτουργικά.
Ἡ γνώσις τοῦ κόσμου ἀποκτᾷ ἀποφατικὴν ἀκρίβειαν: γνωρίζει τὸ μέτρον της ἐπειδὴ γνωρίζει τὴν ἀπόστασιν ἀπὸ τὸ παράδειγμα.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Ἡ ἀγαθότης παράγει ὁμοίωσιν, ἡ ὁμοίωσις παράγει τάξιν, καὶ ἡ τάξις ἐπιβεβαιοῖ τὴν ἀγαθότητα τοῦ δημιουργοῦ.
Ἡ ἀναφορὰ εἰς τὸ παράδειγμα γεννᾷ τὸν κόσμον ὡς εἰκόνα, καὶ ἡ εἰκών ἐπιστρέφει πρὸς τὸ παράδειγμα διὰ τῆς ὁμοιώσεως.
Ἡ ἑνότης ἐντείνεται διὰ διαδοχικῶν μεταβάσεων: ἓν παράδειγμα, ἓν ὅλον, ἓν δεδεμένον σῶμα.
Ἡ πολλαπλότης ἀντιστέκεται πρὸς τὴν ἑνότητα, ἀλλὰ ἀπορροφᾶται τελικῶς ὡς ἐσωτερικὴ διαφορά τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ ἀδυναμία ἀκριβείας ἐπαναφέρει τὸ σύστημα εἰς τὸν εἰκότα μῦθον, ὅπου ἡ ἀποφατικὴ ἔλλειψις γίνεται τελικὸς κανών.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Ἀγαθότης τοῦ δημιουργοῦ → ἀπουσία φθόνου → βούλησις ὁμοιώσεως.
Ἀίδιον παράδειγμα → ὁμοίωσις → κόσμος ὡς εἰκών, ἔμψυχος καὶ ἔννους.
Καθολικὴ περιεκτικότης τοῦ παραδείγματος → μοναδικότης τοῦ ὁμοιώματος → ἓν κοσμικὸν ὅλον.
Ὁρατὸν καὶ ἁπτὸν σῶμα → πῦρ καὶ γῆ → ἀνάγκη μέσου δεσμοῦ.
Ἀναλογικὸς δεσμός → ἑνότης διατηροῦσα τὴν διαφοράν → καλὴ κοσμικὴ σύστασις.
Ὀντολογικὴ ἀπόστασις → γνωσιολογικὸς περιορισμός → εἰκὼς μῦθος ὡς τελικὴ μορφὴ λόγου.
Ἄτακτος πολλότης → θεία ἀγαθότης → ἐπιβολὴ τάξεως.
Τάξις → νοῦς ἐν ψυχῇ → ψυχὴ ἐν σώματι → κόσμος ἔμψυχος καὶ ἔννους.
Καθολικὸν νοητὸν παράδειγμα → μοναδικὸν ὁμοίωμα → ἓν κοσμικὸν ὅλον.
Δύο στοιχεῖα → ἔλλειψις αὐταρκείας → τρίτος δεσμός → ἀναλογία → ἑνότης.
Ὀντολογικὴ διαφορά → ὅρος γνώσεως → εἰκὼς μῦθος → παῦσις τῆς ἀπαιτήσεως πλήρους ἀκριβείας.
Ὁ κόσμος ἀναταξινομεῖται ἀπὸ σύνολον πραγμάτων εἰς ἓν ζῷον ἔχον ἐσωτερικὴν ζωὴν καὶ νόησιν.
Ἡ σχέσις μέρους καὶ ὅλου ἀναστρέφεται, ἐπειδὴ τὰ μέρη λαμβάνουν νόημα ἐκ τῆς συμμετοχῆς εἰς τὸ ὅλον.
Τὸ ἐρώτημα περὶ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἢ τῶν πολλῶν μετατρέπεται εἰς ἐρώτημα παραδείγματος, ὁμοιώματος καὶ περιεκτικότητος.
Ἡ ὕλη ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς σύστημα σχέσεων καὶ ἀπαιτήσεων, οὐχὶ ὡς παθητικὸν ἢ αὐτάρκες ὑπόστρωμα.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια ἀναδιατάσσεται κατὰ βαθμίδας: τὸ ἀίδιον ἐπιδέχεται σταθερὸν λόγον, τὸ γεγονὸς εἰκότα λόγον.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ὁ λόγος πραγματεύεται κόσμον, οὐρανόν, στοιχεῖα καὶ γένεσιν.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ πραγματικότης παράγεται διὰ σχέσεων παραδείγματος, εἰκόνος, ψυχῆς, νοῦ καὶ δεσμοῦ.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ σύστημα ἀναγκάζει τὴν κρίσιν νὰ ἀρχίζῃ ἀπὸ τὸ ὅλον καὶ οὐχὶ ἀπὸ τὰ μέρη.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ ἀίδιον προηγείται, τὸ γεγονὸς ἀκολουθεῖ, καὶ ἡ γένεσις ἐμφανίζεται ὡς μετάβασις εἰς σταθερὴν τάξιν.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεθοδολογικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ὁ λόγος μιμεῖται τὸ ἀντικείμενον, ἐπιλέγων εἰκότα μῦθον ἀντὶ ψευδοῦς ἀπολύτου ἀκριβείας.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ δημιουργία παρουσιάζεται ὡς λογικῶς ἀναγκαία ἐκ τῆς ἀγαθότητος, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἐλευθερία τῆς θείας βουλήσεως μένει ἀνεπίλυτος.
Ὁ λόγος ἀπαιτεῖ ἀναγκαίαν κοσμικὴν δομήν, ἐνώ ταὐτοχρόνως ὁμολογεῖ ὅτι ἡ πλήρης ἀκρίβεια περὶ αὐτῆς εἶναι ἀδύνατος.
Ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ τὸ καθόλου ὡς κάλλιστον εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὡς ὁμοίωμα παραμένει ἀναπόδεικτος γέφυρα.
Ἡ ἀταξία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἀντίπαλον κοσμικὸν καθεστὼς εἰς ἀρχικὸν ὑλικόν, ὃ δὲν ἔχει πλέον αὐτοτελῆ ἐξηγητικὴν δύναμιν.
Ἡ εἰκών μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ παθητικὴν ἀναπαράστασιν εἰς ἐνεργὸν ἀρχὴν ὁργανώσεως τοῦ κόσμου.
Ἡ ἑνότης μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἀριθμητικὴν μοναδικότητα εἰς παραγόμενον δεσμὸν, ὁ ὁποῖος διατηρεῖ τὴν διαφοράν.
Τὸ σύστημα ὑπολαμβάνει τὴν πραγματικότητα ὡς εἰκόνα ἡ ὁποία ἀναζητεῖ τὸ παράδειγμα διὰ διαδοχικῶν σχέσεων ὁμοιώσεως.
Ὁ κόσμος εἶναι ζῷον κοσμικόν, ἐν ᾧ τὸ σῶμα ἐμψυχοῦται καὶ νοεῖται διὰ τῆς ἐσωτερικῆς συνθέσεως.
Ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐντὸς τοῦ συστήματος γίνεται λόγος πεπερασμένος, ὁ ὁποῖος δύναται νὰ ἀποδίδῃ μόνον εἰκότα ἀλήθειαν περὶ τοῦ γεγονότος.
Ὁ χρόνος φανερώνει μετάβασιν ἀπὸ ἀταξίαν εἰς τάξιν, ἐνώ ἡ τελικὴ τάξις ἀναφέρεται ἀναδρομικῶς εἰς τὸ ἀίδιον πρότυπον.
Τὰ παρόντα ἀξιώματα ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευὴν τῆς κύριας κινήσεως ἀπὸ τὴν ἀγαθότητα καὶ τὸ παράδειγμα εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα καὶ τὸν εἰκότα λόγον.
Ἡ ἰσχυροτέρα δομὴ εὑρίσκεται στὴν ἀλληλουχία παραδείγματος, ὁμοιώματος, ὅλου καὶ δεσμοῦ.
Ὑποκαθορισμένα μένουν ὁ χαρακτὴρ τοῦ τρίτου δεσμοῦ, ἡ φύσις τῆς ἀρχικῆς ἀταξίας καὶ τὸ περιθώριον θείας ἐπιλογῆς.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευὴ διασῴζει τὴν πραγματικὴν κίνησιν τοῦ συστήματος, ἀλλὰ δὲν ἐξαλείφει τὴν ἔντασιν μεταξὺ φιλοσοφικῆς ἀποδείξεως καὶ εἰκότος μύθου.
The principal problem is how disordered multiplicity can be constituted as one most beautiful and intelligible whole.
The answer transfers the criterion from phenomena to the eternal and intelligible paradigm.
The goodness of the demiurge functions as a productive principle, which transforms disorder into order and beauty.
The cosmos is reconstituted as an image of the eternal, ensouled, intelligent, and universally comprehensive.
The uniqueness of the cosmos is inferred from the universal comprehensiveness of the paradigm, and not from a numerical decision.
Material composition requires an intermediate bond, through which the separated things are brought together into unity.
Proportion connects the intelligible form with corporeal becoming and renders unity a produced bond.
The final movement is from goodness to likeness, from likeness to unity, and from unity to the likely account.
[Persistent] Divine goodness does not begrudge, but wishes that what has come to be should become as much as possible like the best.
[Persistent] The eternal and intelligible paradigm precedes as the measure of the generated cosmos.
[Mutating] The cosmos passes from being an image of the eternal to being an ensouled and intelligent whole.
[Persistent] Order and beauty surpass disorder and the incomplete.
[Emergent] Goodness functions as a demiurgic law, which compels what comes to be toward the most beautiful.
[Persistent] The whole has priority over the parts, because the parts are conceived as contained within it.
[Emergent] Unity is not a mere absence of division, but the work of an intermediate and proportional bond.
[Mutating] Multiplicity shifts from an external numerical dimension to the internal comprehensiveness of one whole.
[Persistent] The ontological difference between paradigm and image determines the measure of human discourse.
[Terminal] The likely myth constitutes the fitting limit of knowledge concerning what has come to be and the gods.
[Attractor] Cosmic reality tends toward one universal whole, which conjoins paradigm, soul, intellect, and body.
[Emergent] Likeness is not mere formal copying, but universal comprehensiveness and proportional composition.
Goodness recurs initially as an ethical property, but is transformed into a cosmogonic law.
Order shifts from an evaluative preference to an ontological necessity of the cosmos.
The image initially signifies a relation to the paradigm, but later becomes an ensouled bearer of the intelligible.
Unity is transformed from uniqueness into a bond, so that the one may encompass and gather together the many.
Multiplicity is not abolished, but absorbed under the universal comprehensiveness of the one cosmos.
Matter ceases to be an unconnected substratum and becomes a sequence of requirements directed toward unity.
The discourse concerning the cosmos shifts from a claim to precision to proportion and likely myth.
The incapacity for complete knowledge does not remain a deficiency, but becomes a methodological rule of fitting discourse.
The precise arrangement of fire, earth, and the third bond remains local; the necessity of relation and connection becomes universal.
The proof concerning the one heaven remains local, while the principle that the perfect likeness is not externally duplicated becomes central.
The connection of intellect, soul, and body rises from a specific cosmological sequence to a general model of integration.
The distinction between image and paradigm bridges the chapters, because it connects the ontology of the cosmos with the epistemology of discourse.
Proportion abolishes the apparent gap between intelligible form and corporeal composition.
Initial disorder ceases to function as a self-sufficient principle and is recoditur as matter receptive of form.
A self-governing, soulless, and irrational cosmos that does not refer to a paradigm is rejected.
Disorder is rejected as a final cosmic state and recognized only as initial material.
Multiplicity is rejected as an external juxtaposition of independent cosmoses.
Unity is rejected as a mere absence of difference; unity requires relation, an intermediate, and a bond.
The claim that discourse can possess equal precision concerning the eternal and what has come to be is rejected.
What has come to be cannot possess the same ontological certainty as the eternal paradigm.
Matter cannot by itself constitute the ultimate term of the cosmos.
The partial cannot serve as a perfect model of the whole.
Unity cannot be produced without a relation between the terms that it unifies.
Cosmology collapses if goodness is disconnected from demiurgic activity.
A cosmos equal, complete, and independent alongside the perfect paradigm remains impossible.
A cosmos that would be a multiplicity outside the one universal whole remains impossible.
A discourse demanding complete knowledge concerning what has come to be and the divine remains impossible.
The absence of identity between image and paradigm preserves the field of proportion and likely myth.
Divine goodness becomes the necessity of cosmic order, because good will and the most beautiful work converge.
The image acquires a double function: it signifies ontological dependence, while it constitutes the visible as a living being.
The universality of the paradigm converts the uniqueness of the cosmos from a numerical conclusion into an ontological requirement.
Proportion transfers the principle of likeness from the intelligible domain to the material connection of the elements.
The negation of the unconnected substratum and the negation of disordered finality constitute a common apophatic principle: no part is interpreted without the whole.
The incapacity for complete knowledge does not invalidate cosmic order, but imposes a discourse proportionate to the being and its form.
Cosmic unity is produced from the concurrence of two movements: likeness to one paradigm and the binding of the many into one body.
Multiplicity sheds the status of a self-complete principle and becomes the internal content of the cosmic whole.
Creation is transformed from a free event into a necessary imprint of goodness and the paradigm.
Ontology and epistemology follow a common hierarchy: the lower the being, the more proportional the discourse.
The perfect cosmos is defined not as a sum of perfect parts, but as a whole that renders the parts akin and functional.
Knowledge of the cosmos acquires apophatic precision: it knows its measure because it knows the distance from the paradigm.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Goodness produces likeness, likeness produces order, and order confirms the goodness of the demiurge.
Reference to the paradigm generates the cosmos as an image, and the image returns to the paradigm through likeness.
Unity is intensified through successive transitions: one paradigm, one whole, one bound body.
Multiplicity resists unity, but is finally absorbed as an internal difference of the whole.
The incapacity for precision returns the system to likely myth, where apophatic deficiency becomes the final rule.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Goodness of the demiurge → absence of begrudging → will of likeness.
Eternal paradigm → likeness → cosmos as image, ensouled and intelligent.
Universal comprehensiveness of the paradigm → uniqueness of the likeness → one cosmic whole.
Visible and tangible body → fire and earth → necessity of an intermediate bond.
Proportional bond → unity preserving difference → beautiful cosmic composition.
Ontological distance → epistemological limitation → likely myth as the final form of discourse.
Disordered multiplicity → divine goodness → imposition of order.
Order → intellect in soul → soul in body → cosmos ensouled and intelligent.
Universal intelligible paradigm → unique likeness → one cosmic whole.
Two elements → lack of self-sufficiency → third bond → proportion → unity.
Ontological difference → limit of knowledge → likely myth → cessation of the demand for complete precision.
The cosmos is reclassified from a collection of things into one living being possessing internal life and intellection.
The relation of part and whole is reversed, because the parts receive meaning from participation in the whole.
The question concerning the one or the many is transformed into a question of paradigm, likeness, and comprehensiveness.
Matter is reclassified as a system of relations and requirements, not as a passive or self-sufficient substratum.
Truth is rearranged in grades: the eternal admits stable discourse, what has come to be likely discourse.
At the surface level, the discourse treats the cosmos, heaven, elements, and generation.
At the structural level, reality is produced through relations of paradigm, image, soul, intellect, and bond.
At the metastrategic level, the system compels judgment to begin from the whole and not from the parts.
At the ontological and temporal level, the eternal precedes, what has come to be follows, and generation appears as a transition into stable order.
At the methodological level, discourse imitates its object, choosing likely myth instead of falsely absolute precision.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Creation is presented as logically necessary from goodness, but the freedom of divine will remains unresolved.
The discourse requires a necessary cosmic structure, while at the same time admitting that complete precision concerning it is impossible.
The transition from the universal as most beautiful to the cosmos as a likeness remains an unproved bridge.
Disorder is transformed from an opposing cosmic regime into initial material, which no longer possesses autonomous explanatory power.
The image is transformed from a passive representation into an active principle of the organization of the cosmos.
Unity is transformed from numerical uniqueness into a produced bond, which preserves difference.
The system conceives reality as an image that seeks the paradigm through successive relations of likeness.
The cosmos is a cosmic living being, in which the body is ensouled and made intelligible through internal composition.
The human being within the system becomes finite discourse, which can render only likely truth concerning what has come to be.
Time reveals a transition from disorder to order, while the final order refers retrospectively to the eternal model.
The present axioms suffice for reconstructing the principal movement from goodness and the paradigm to unity and likely discourse.
The strongest structure is found in the sequence of paradigm, likeness, whole, and bond.
The character of the third bond, the nature of initial disorder, and the scope of divine choice remain underdetermined.
The reconstruction preserves the actual movement of the system, but does not eliminate the tension between philosophical demonstration and likely myth.
Τὸ κεντρικὸν πρόβλημα ἐστὶ πῶς ἡ διαφορὰ τῶν στοιχείων δύναται νὰ συγκροτήσῃ ἓν τέλειον καὶ αὐτάρκες ὅλον.
Ἡ ἀναλογία μετατρέπει τὴν ἑτερογένειαν εἰς σχέσιν, καὶ ἡ σχέσις εἰς ἑνότητα.
Ἡ στερεὰ μορφὴ ἀπαιτεῖ διαδοχικὰς μεσότητας, ὥστε ὁ δεσμὸς νὰ μὴν εἶναι ἁπλὸς ἀλλὰ δομικῶς πλήρης.
Ἡ κοσμικὴ ὁλότης ὁρίζεται διὰ τοῦ ἀποκλεισμοῦ παντὸς ἐξωτερικοῦ ὑπολείμματος, ἐπιδράσεως καὶ συμπληρώματος.
Ἡ τελειότης μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ πληρότητα μερῶν εἰς ἀπουσίαν ἐξωτερικῆς χρείας.
Ἡ σφαῖρα καὶ ἡ κυκλικὴ κίνησις ἐνοποιοῦν μορφὴν καὶ ἐνέργειαν εἰς αὐτάρκη αὐτοκίνησιν.
Ἡ ψυχὴ ἀναδεικνύεται εἰς ἐσωτερικὴν καὶ συγχρόνως περιέχουσαν ἀρχήν, ἥτις κυβερνᾷ τὸ σῶμα.
Ἡ κίνησις τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι σωρευτική καὶ ἀναβατική: ἀναλογία, κλειστότης, αὐτάρκεια, ψυχικὴ κυριαρχία, ὀντολογικὴ ἑνότης.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀναλογία μετατρέπει τὴν διαφορὰν τῶν μερῶν εἰς ἀμοιβαίαν σχέσιν καὶ ἐκ ταύτης παράγει ἑνότητα.
[Persistent] Ἡ στερεὰ ὁλότης ἀπαιτεῖ δύο μεσότητας, διότι ἡ ἁπλὴ σύνδεσις οὐκ ἀρκεῖ πρὸς τὴν πλήρη σύστασιν.
[Mutating] Ἡ ἑνότης οὐκ ἔστι συνύπαρξις στοιχείων, ἀλλὰ ἐσωτερικὴ τάξις σχέσεων ἥτις ἀνακαθορίζει τὰ μέρη.
[Persistent] Τὸ τέλειον ὅλον οὐκ ἐπιδέχεται στοιχεῖον, δύναμιν ἢ περιβάλλον ἔξωθεν αὐτοῦ.
[Mutating] Ἡ ἀπουσία ἐξωτερικῆς χρείας μετασχηματίζει τὴν τελειότητα εἰς αὐτάρκειαν καὶ αὐτοπαραγωγὴν.
[Emergent] Ἡ κλειστότης, ἀρχικῶς ὅρος ἀφθαρσίας, γίνεται γενικὸς ὀντολογικὸς ὅρος τοῦ εἶναι.
[Emergent] Ἡ γεωμετρικὴ ἑνότης καὶ ἡ κυκλικὴ κίνησις συγκλίνουσιν εἰς μορφὴν αὐτοκινήτου καὶ αὐταρκοῦς τάξεως.
[Emergent] Ἡ ψυχὴ περιέχει καὶ κυβερνᾷ τὸ σῶμα, ὥστε ἡ συνοχὴ νὰ ἀποκτᾷ ἱεραρχικὴν καὶ οὐχὶ μόνον χωρικὴν μορφήν.
[Attractor] Ἡ αὐτοταυτότης, ἡ αὐτογνωσία καὶ ἡ αὐτάρκεια συνιστῶσι τὸ τελικὸν μέτρον τελειότητος.
[Terminal] Ὁ κόσμος γίνεται ἓν ἔμψυχον, ἐσωτερικῶς πλήρες καὶ ἐξωτερικῶς ἀνενδεὲς ὅλον.
Ἡ ἀναλογία ἐπανέρχεται ὡς δεσμὸς στοιχείων, ἀλλὰ μεταλλάσσεται εἰς γενεσιουργὸν ἀρχὴν ταυτότητος καὶ ἑνότητος.
Τὸ μέσον μετακινεῖται ἀπὸ μεταβατικὸς δεσμὸς στοιχείων εἰς ἐσωτερικὴν ἀρχὴν περιεκτικῆς ψυχικῆς συνοχῆς.
Ἡ ἔλλειψις ἐξωτερικοῦ στοιχείου ἐπανέρχεται ὡς ἀπουσία φθορᾶς, αἰσθήσεως, διατροφῆς, ὀργάνων καὶ τελικῶς ἑτερότητος.
Ἡ σφαῖρα ἀρχικῶς δηλοῖ πληρότητα μορφῆς, ἔπειτα δὲ μεταβάλλεται εἰς σχῆμα αὐτοταυτότητος καὶ αὐτοκινήσεως.
Ἡ αὐτάρκεια μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ πληρότητα τῶν τεσσάρων στοιχείων εἰς μηδενικὴν ἐξάρτησιν ἀπὸ ἕτερον ὄν.
Ἡ φαινομένη χρονικὴ ἀκολουθία ἀκυροῦται ὅταν ἡ ψυχὴ μετατίθεται εἰς ὀντολογικῶς προτέραν καὶ κυρίαν θέσιν.
Ἡ ἀκριβὴς ἀκολουθία πυρός, ἀέρος, ὕδατος καὶ γῆς παραμένει τοπικὴ μηχανὴ, ἐνώ ἡ σχέσις καὶ ἡ ἀναλογία κλιμακοῦνται.
Ἡ σφαιρικότης καὶ ἡ ἀφαίρεσις τῶν ἓξ κινήσεων εἶναι τοπικαὶ λύσεις, αἱ ὁποῖαι ἀναβαθμίζονται εἰς γενικὴν ἀρχὴν ἐσωτερικῆς αὐτοκινήσεως.
Ἡ κατάργησις ὀφθαλμῶν, ἀκοῆς, τροφῆς καὶ μελῶν δὲν εἶναι αὐτοτελὴς θέσις, ἀλλὰ ἐπιμέρους ἀποτέλεσμα τῆς γενικῆς κλειστότητος.
Ἡ ἀναλογικὴ σύνδεσις καὶ ἡ ψυχικὴ κυριαρχία γεφυροῦσι τὴν κοσμολογικὴν σύνθεσιν μὲ τὴν ὀντολογικὴν ἱεραρχίαν.
Ἡ ἀρχικὴ ἀντίθεσις ἀναλογίας καὶ αὐταρκείας παύει νὰ εἶναι τοπικὴ καὶ γίνεται κεντρικὴ γέφυρα τοῦ συστήματος.
Ἡ τοπικὴ ἀνάγκη ἐσωτερικῆς συντηρήσεως παραμένει ἀνολοκλήρωτος μηχανισμός, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἐνδογενὴς φθορὰ δὲν ἐξηγεῖται πλήρως.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ὁ κόσμος ὡς ἄτακτος συνάθροισις ἀνεξαρτήτων μερῶν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ τελειότης ὡς ἐξωτερικὴ ἱκανότης, ἀντίστασις, λῆψις ἢ ἐξάρτησις.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἑνότης ὡς ἀπλὴ συνάφεια· ἡ ἑνότης ἀπαιτεῖ ἀναλογικὴν καὶ ἐσωτερικὴν διάταξιν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ αἴσθησις, ἡ τροφή, ἡ ἄμυνα καὶ ἡ κίνησις ὡς καθολικοὶ ὅροι ζωῆς.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ φαινομένη χρονολογικὴ σειρά ὡς ἀσφαλὴς εἰκὼν τῆς ὀντολογικῆς τάξεως.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι ἡ διαφορὰ δύναται καθ’ ἑαυτὴν νὰ γεννήσῃ κόσμον.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι τὸ τέλειον ὅλον χρειάζεται ἐξωτερικὸν περιβάλλον πρὸς τὴν διατήρησίν του.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι τὸ σῶμα ἀποτελεῖ τὸ ἔσχατον ὑποκείμενον τάξεως, κινήσεως καὶ νοῦ.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι ἡ τελειότης ἀπαιτεῖ ἑτερότητα, ἀνταλλαγὴν ἢ ἀμοιβαίαν ἐξάρτησιν.
Ἀπουσιάζει ὁ ἔξωθεν κόσμος ὡς ἀναγκαῖος ὅρος ὑπάρξεως, κινήσεως ἢ τελειότητος.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἡ ἀσύνδετος πολλαπλότης, ἐπειδὴ πᾶσα διαφορὰ ὀφείλει νὰ μετασχηματισθῇ εἰς ἐσωτερικὴν ἑνότητα.
Ἀδύνατον καθίσταται ὅλον ὃ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ ἄλλον, διότι ἡ τελειότης ἀπαιτεῖ πλήρη αὐτοσχέσιν καὶ αὐτάρκειαν.
Ἡ ἀναλογικὴ ἑνότης καὶ ἡ κοσμικὴ κλειστότης συντίθενται εἰς ἀρχὴν ἐσωτερικῆς σχέσεως ἄνευ ἐξωτερικῆς ἐξαρτήσεως.
Ἡ ἀπουσία αἰσθητηρίων καὶ ὀργάνων παύει νὰ σημαίνῃ ἔλλειψιν καὶ γίνεται ἀπόδειξις τελειότητος.
Ἡ σφαῖρα καὶ ἡ κυκλικὴ κίνησις συγκροτοῦσι κοινὸν σχῆμα αὐτοκινήσεως, ὅπου τὸ περιέχον καὶ τὸ κινούμενον συμπίπτουσιν.
Ἡ ψυχὴ λύει τὴν ἀντίθεσιν μεταξὺ ἐσωτερικῆς συνοχῆς καὶ κυριαρχίας, διότι περιέχει τὸ σῶμα ἐκ τῶν ἔνδον καὶ ὑπερβαίνει αὐτὸ ἐξουσιαστικῶς.
Ἡ διόρθωσις τῆς διηγήσεως ὑποτάσσει τὸν χρόνον εἰς τὴν ὀντολογικὴν ἱεραρχίαν καὶ ἀποσυνδέει τὸ πρῶτον ἀπὸ τὸ πρῶτον λεγόμενον.
Ἡ ἀναλογικὴ μεσότης καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ ἀποτελοῦσι δύο βαθμίδας τοῦ αὐτοῦ μηχανισμοῦ: ἡ διαφορὰ συνδέεται διὰ ἐσωτερικῆς ἀρχῆς, ἥτις τελικῶς κυβερνᾷ τὸ ὅλον.
Ἡ ἑνότης τοῦ κόσμου μετασχηματίζεται ἀπὸ σχέσιν μεταξὺ μερῶν εἰς κλειστὴν αὐτοσχέσιν τοῦ ὅλου πρὸς ἑαυτό.
Ἡ τελειότης ἀνακαθορίζεται ὡς μηδενικὴ ἐξάρτησις ἀπὸ ἕτερον, καὶ ὄχι ὡς διευρυμένη δύναμις ἐπὶ τοῦ ἔξω.
Τὸ κοσμικὸν σῶμα γίνεται μηχανὴ αὐτοπαραγωγῆς, ἐν ᾗ μορφή, κίνησις, τροφή, συνοχὴ καὶ νόησις ἐξαρτῶνται ἀπὸ ἐσωτερικὴν τάξιν.
Ἡ ψυχὴ γίνεται ὁ φορεὺς ὃς μετατρέπει τὴν γεωμετρικὴν ὁλότητα εἰς διοικούμενον καὶ ἔμψυχον κόσμον.
Ὁ χρόνος ὑποβιβάζεται εἰς ἀφηγηματικὸν ἐπίπεδον, ἐνώ ἡ ὀντολογικὴ τάξις ἀνασυντίθεται ἱεραρχικῶς.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Διαφορὰ στοιχείων → ἀναλογία → μεσότης → ἑνότης → ὁλότης → ἀπουσία ἐξωτερικοῦ ὑπολείμματος.
Ἐξωτερικὴ φθορά → ἀποκλεισμὸς τοῦ ἔξω → ἀπουσία ὀργάνων → αὐτοτροφία → κλειστὴ αὐτοσυντήρησις.
Σφαιρικὴ μορφή → κυκλικὴ κίνησις → αὐτοκίνησις → ἑνιαῖος οὐρανός → αὐτάρκεια.
Σῶμα → ψυχὴ ἐντός → ψυχὴ περιέχουσα → κυριαρχία → ἀναδρομικὴ ἀνασύστασις τοῦ σώματος ὡς κόσμου.
Ἡ ἀναδρομὴ τοῦ «ὅλου» ἀπὸ στοιχεῖα εἰς σῶμα, ἀπὸ σῶμα εἰς ψυχὴν καὶ ἀπὸ ψυχὴν εἰς θείαν αὐτογνωσίαν λειτουργεῖ ὡς κύριος ἐλκυστής.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Ἑτερογένεια στοιχείων → ἀναλογικὴ σχέσις → ἀμοιβαία μετατροπὴ διαφορῶν εἰς ἑνότητα.
Στερεὰ ὁλότης → δύο μεσότητες → συνεχὴς δεσμὸς → ἓν ὁρατὸν καὶ ἁπτὸν σῶμα.
Ὁλότης στοιχείων → ἀπουσία ἐξωτερικοῦ ὑπολείμματος → σφαιρικὴ περιεκτικότης → αὐτάρκεια.
Ἐξωτερικὴ δύναμις → φθορά → ἀποκλεισμὸς τοῦ ἔξω → ἐνδογενὴς λειτουργία καὶ αὐτοτροφία.
Ἀυτάρκης σφαῖρα → κυκλικὴ αὐτοκίνησις → ψυχὴ ἐντὸς καὶ διὰ παντός → συνοχὴ καὶ κυριαρχία.
Φαινομένη χρονικὴ σειρά → ἀναθεώρησις → ὀντολογικὴ προτεραιότης ψυχῆς → θεῖον ὅλον αὐτάρκες καὶ αὐτογνώμον.
Διαφορὰ στοιχείων → ἀναλογικὴ μεσότης → διπλὸς δεσμός → κοσμικὴ ὁλότης → ἀποκλεισμὸς τοῦ ἔξω → αὐτάρκεια.
