items.text: Τὸ πρόβλημα τοῦ συστήματος ἐστὶν ὅπως ἡ τάξις ἐνδέχηται τὴν θνητὴν γένεσιν, τὴν σωματικὴν διατάραξιν, τὴν ἀνάγκην καὶ τὴν ἀσταθῆ φανέρωσιν χωρὶς ἀφανισμὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς.
Ἡ δημιουργία παύει εἶναι ἁπλῆ ἐπιβολὴ μορφῆς, καὶ γίνεται κατανεμημένη μετάδοσις αἰτιότητος διὰ σωμάτων, αἰσθήσεων, ψυχῶν καὶ δεκτικῶν πεδίων.
Τὸ σῶμα μετασχηματίζεται ἀπὸ κατώτερον περίβλημα εἰς μεσίτην, ὃς μεταδίδωσι κινήσεις, παράγει πάθη, καὶ ἐπιβάλλει τὴν ἀνάγκην κρίσεως.
Ἡ αἴσθησις ἀναβαίνει ἀπὸ σωματικὴν προσβολὴν εἰς ὁδὸν κοσμικῆς μετρήσεως, ἀλλὰ ταὐτὸν ἐπιμένει πηγὴ πλάνης διὰ τὴν σχετικὴν φύσιν τῆς μεταδόσεως.
Ἡ τάξις δὲν δηλοῖ ἀπουσίαν ἀνάγκης, ἀλλὰ πειθὼν καὶ ἀνάταξιν ἐπὶ πεδίου ἀντιστεκομένων δυνάμεων.
Ἡ ἀναζήτησις τῆς τάξεως ἀναγκάζει τὸν λόγον νὰ εἰσάγῃ τὴν χώραν ὡς ἄμορφον ὅρον δυνατότητος, ὃς δέχεται μορφὰς χωρὶς αὐτὸς εἶναι μία μορφή.
Ὁ λόγος μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ ἀριθμητὴν καὶ τελεολογικὴν σύλληψιν εἰς εἰκότα καὶ ἀποφατικὸν τρόπον, ἐπειδὴ τὸ γιγνόμενον καὶ ἡ χώρα ἀντιστέκονται εἰς πλήρη καθήλωσιν.
Ἡ κίνησις τοῦ ὅλου εἶναι σπειροειδής: τάξις μεταδίδεται, διαταράσσεται, μετρεῖται, διορθοῦται, καὶ τέλος ἐπιστρέφει εἰς ἀποφατικὴν ἀναγνώρισιν τοῦ θεμελίου.
[Persistent] Πᾶσα γένεσις ἀπαιτεῖ αἰτιακὴν διανομὴν καὶ δεκτικὸν πεδίον· οὔτε αὐτογένεσις οὔτε ἄμεσος παραγωγὴ ἐξαντλοῦσι τὴν πραγματικότητα.
[Persistent] Τὸ σῶμα καὶ ἡ αἴσθησις εἰσὶν ἐνεργοὶ μεσίται μεταξὺ κοσμικῶν κινήσεων καὶ ψυχικῆς τάξεως.
[Mutating] Ἡ θνητότης εἶναι ἅμα ὅρος κοσμικῆς πληρότητος καὶ τόπος φθορᾶς, ὥστε τὸ ἀναγκαῖον μὴ ταυτίζεσθαι πρὸς τὸ ἀκίνδυνον.
[Emergent] Ἡ τάξις εἶναι ῥύθμισις καὶ πειθὼ ἐπὶ ἀντιστεκομένης ἀνάγκης, οὐχὶ ἄκαμπτος κατάστασις προϋπάρχουσα τῆς κινήσεως.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀλήθεια τῶν φαινομένων ἀπαιτεῖ διάκρισιν αἰτίων, μεσιτειῶν, προτύπων καὶ δεκτικῶν, οὐχὶ ἁπλῆν προσκόλλησιν εἰς τὴν αἴσθησιν.
[Mutating] Ἡ αἴσθησις εἶναι διττὴ δύναμις: μέτρον κοσμικῆς παιδείας καὶ ἀγωγὸς διαταράξεως καὶ πλάνης.
[Emergent] Ἡ πραγματικότης συγκροτεῖται τριμερῶς ἐκ ἀμεταβλήτου προτύπου, δεκτικῆς χώρας καὶ φθαρτοῦ γιγνομένου.
[Attractor] Ἡ ἀνάταξις τῶν ψυχικῶν κινήσεων κατὰ κοσμικὸν μέτρον ἐλκύει τὴν φυσιολογίαν, τὴν ἠθικὴν, τὴν παιδείαν καὶ τὴν κοσμολογίαν πρὸς μίαν λειτουργικὴν σύγκλεισιν.
[Terminal] Ὁ περὶ γενέσεως λόγος οὐ δύναται νὰ γίνῃ ἀπόλυτος ἀπόδειξις, ἀλλὰ δεῖ νὰ ἀκολουθῇ τὴν μεταβολὴν διὰ εἰκότος καὶ ἀποφατικοῦ λόγου.
[Attractor] Ἡ ἀπουσία ἰδίου εἴδους τῆς χώρας καθίσταται ὁ κρυφὸς ὅρος, δι᾽ οὗ πολλαὶ μορφαὶ δύνανται νὰ φαίνωνται χωρὶς τὸ θεμέλιον νὰ ταυτίζηται πρὸς αὐτάς.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία ἐκ τῆς δημιουργικῆς διανομῆς μεταναστεύει εἰς τὴν σχέσιν κεφαλῆς καὶ σώματος, πρώτων καὶ δευτέρων αἰτίων, καὶ τέλος προτύπου, χώρας καὶ γιγνομένου.
Ἡ αἴσθησις διατηρεῖ τὴν λειτουργίαν τῆς μεταδόσεως, ἀλλὰ μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ σωματικὴν διάσεισιν εἰς ὄργανον ἀριθμοῦ, χρόνου καὶ φιλοσοφικῆς διορθώσεως.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ σωματικὴν καὶ μηχανικὴν συναίτιον εἰς ἀντιστεκόμενον πεδίον, ὃ ὁ νοῦς οὐ καταλύει ἀλλὰ πείθει.
Ἡ τάξις ἀντιστρέφει τὴν σημασίαν της: ἀπὸ προϋποτεθειμένη ἀρμονία γίνεται ἐπίτευγμα ῥυθμίσεως ἐντός ἀσταθοῦς καὶ παθητικοῦ πεδίου.
Ἡ ὑποδοχὴ ἀπορροφᾷ τὴν ἁπλῆν ἔννοιαν ὕλης καὶ τόπου, γιγνομένη ὀντολογικὸς ὅρος φανερώσεως καὶ δυναμικὸν πεδίον ἀντιδράσεων.
Ὁ λόγος διατηρεῖ τὴν ἀξίωσιν διακρίσεως, ἀλλὰ ἀποβάλλει τὴν ἀξίωσιν ἀκινητοποιήσεως τοῦ γιγνομένου.
Αἱ συγκεκριμέναι στοιχειακαὶ, ἀνατομικαὶ καὶ ἀστρονομικαὶ περιγραφαὶ μένουσι τοπικαὶ τεχνικαί, ἐνῶ ἡ μεσιτεία κινήσεως διὰ σώματος καὶ αἰσθήσεως κλιμακοῦται εἰς καθολικὴν ἀρχήν.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ τοῦ λόγου καὶ τοῦ ἀλόγου παύει εἶναι μόνον κρίσις χαρακτῆρος καὶ γίνεται μηχανισμὸς ἀνατάξεως ἐνὸς κοσμικῶς ἐνσωματωμένου ὑποκειμένου.
Ἡ διάκρισις πρώτων καὶ δευτέρων αἰτίων γεφυροῖ τὴν φυσιολογίαν πρὸς τὴν κοσμολογίαν, ἀλλὰ ἡ τριμερὴς διάταξις ὑπερβαίνει τὴν διπλῆν αἰτιολογίαν.
Ἡ θεραπεία διὰ μουσικῆς καὶ ἡ παρατήρησις τῶν ἄστρων μένουσιν τοπικαὶ πρακτικαί, ἀλλὰ συναθροίζονται ὡς τρόποι ρυθμιστικῆς μιμήσεως τῆς κοσμικῆς περιοδικότητος.
Ἡ χώρα καταργεῖ τὴν τοπικὴν ὑπόθεσιν τῆς ὕλης ὡς αὐτοτελοῦς στοιχείου καὶ γίνεται ὁ κοινὸς ὅρος, ὃς συνδέει γένεσιν, φαινόμενον καὶ γνωστικὸν ὅριον.
Ἀποκλείεται αὐτόνομος γένεσις ἢ ὕλη αὐτομορφοποιός, διότι τὸ γιγνόμενον ἀπαιτεῖ αἰτίαν, δεκτικότητα καὶ σχέσιν πρὸς πρότυπον.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἐκδοχὴ τοῦ σώματος καὶ τῆς αἰσθήσεως ὡς παθητικῶν δοχείων ἄνευ μετασχηματιστικῆς ἐνεργείας.
Ἀποκλείεται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ τάξις ὑφίσταται ἄνευ ἀνάγκης, ἀντιστάσεως, φθορᾶς ἢ δεκτικοῦ πεδίου.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ταύτισις φαινομένου, ὀνόματος καὶ σταθερᾶς οὐσίας, διότι τὰ φαινόμενα εἰσὶ μεταβαλλόμενα μιμήματα.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἀπόλυτος βεβαιότης περὶ τοῦ γιγνομένου, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀστάθεια τοῦ ἀντικειμένου μεταβάλλει τὸν πρέποντα τρόπον λόγου.
Δεῖ ψεῦδος εἶναι ὅτι ἡ αἰτιακὴ ἀνάγκη καὶ ὁ νοῦς ἀλλήλοις πολέμιοι εἰσίν, διότι τὸ σύστημα χρῆται τῇ ἀνάγκῃ ὡς ὑποτεταγμένῳ ἀλλ᾽ ἐνεργῷ συναἰτίῳ.
Δεῖ ψεῦδος εἶναι ὅτι ἡ ψυχὴ ἢ ὁ ἄνθρωπος δύναται νὰ εἶναι αὐτάρκης, ἐπεὶ ἡ ψυχὴ διαμορφοῦται ἐν σώματι, χρόνῳ καὶ κοσμικῇ διανομῇ.
Δεῖ ψεῦδος εἶναι ὅτι τὸ φαινόμενον δύναται νὰ ἔχῃ αὐτοτελῆν οὐσίαν, ἐπεὶ ἡ φανέρωσις ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ χώραν καὶ πρότυπον.
Δεῖ ψεῦδος εἶναι ὅτι ἡ χώρα δύναται θετικῶς ὁρισθῆναι ὡς μία οὐσία παρὰ ταῖς ἄλλαις, ἐπεὶ τὸ ἴδιον εἶδος ἀναιρεῖ τὴν καθολικὴν δεκτικότητα.
Ἡ βαθύτατη ἀπουσία εἶναι ἡ ἀδύνατος ἀμεσότης μεταξὺ νοῦ, κόσμου καὶ ὄντος· πᾶσα πρόσβασις διέρχεται διὰ μεσιτειῶν.
Ἡ χώρα εἶναι τὸ ἀναγκαῖον ἀλλὰ ἀνέκφραστον θεμέλιον, ὃ οὔτε ἐμφανίζεται καθ᾽ αὑτὸ οὔτε δύναται ἀποβληθῆναι ἄνευ καταρρεύσεως τῆς γενέσεως.
Ἀδύνατος μένει ἡ τελεία συμπτωσις ἀληθείας, ὀνόματος καὶ φαινομένου, διότι ἡ γένεσις διατηρεῖ ἀπόστασιν μεταξὺ εἴδους καὶ εἰκόνος.
Ἡ διανεμημένη δημιουργία καὶ ἡ τριμερὴς ὀντολογία συνεπάγονται ὅτι ἡ αἰτιότης δὲν ῥεῖ ἐκ κορυφῆς μόνον, ἀλλὰ πραγματοῦται διὰ τῆς ἀντιδράσεως προτύπου, σώματος, χώρας καὶ γιγνομένου.
Ἡ σωματικὴ μετάδοσις καὶ ἡ σχετικὴ φύσις τοῦ φαινομένου καθιστῶσι τὴν πλάνην ὄχι γυμνὴν ἔλλειψιν γνώσεως, ἀλλὰ παραγόμενον ἀποτέλεσμα μεσιτείας.
Ἡ ἐπανόρθωσις τῆς ψυχῆς καὶ ἡ πειθὼ τοῦ νοῦ πρὸς τὴν ἀνάγκην ἀποτελοῦσιν ἕνα σχῆμα: ἡ τάξις ἐπανέρχεται δι᾽ ἀνατάξεως καὶ οὐ δι᾽ ἐξαλείψεως τῆς ἀντιστάσεως.
Ἡ ἀμορφία τῆς χώρας καὶ ἡ ἀκρίβεια τῆς ἐκτυπώσεως ἀποδεικνύουσιν ὅτι ἡ στέρησις ἰδίου χαρακτῆρος δύναται νὰ εἶναι θετικὸς ὅρος δεκτικότητος.
Ἡ μαθηματικὴ περιοδικότης καὶ ὁ εἰκὼς λόγος διακρίνουσι δύο ἐπιστημονικὰ μέτρα: ἀκρίβειαν περὶ σταθερῶν κινήσεων καὶ προσήκουσαν πιθανότητα περὶ γενέσεως.
Ἡ πραγματικότης γίνεται πολυεπίπεδον κύκλωμα, ἐν ᾧ κάθε μετάδοσις τάξεως δύναται συγχρόνως νὰ παράγῃ νέαν ἀστάθειαν.
Ὁ ὑποκείμενος γίνεται κόμβος ῥοῶν καὶ οὐχὶ αὐτάρκης κέντρον, διότι ἐν αὐτῷ συμπίπτουσι κοσμικὸς νόμος, σωματικὸν πάθος, αἴσθησις καὶ κρίσις.
Ὁ χρόνος γίνεται ἀναδραστικὴ ἀκολουθία, ἐν ᾗ ἡ διαταραχὴ παράγει κρίσιν, ἡ κρίσις μορφοποιεῖ τὸν φορέα, καὶ ἡ νέα μορφὴ ἐπανεκκινεί τὸν κύκλον.
Ἡ ἐπιστήμη γίνεται διάγνωσις συνθηκῶν δυνατότητος καὶ ὁρίων λόγου, οὐχὶ κατοχὴ ἀκινήτων ὀνομάτων ἢ αὐτοτελῶν φαινομένων.
Ἡ σωτηρία ἢ ἐλευθερία ὁρίζεται ὡς ἐπανίδρυσις ἡγεμονίας ἐντὸς ὅρων ἀνάγκης καὶ ἐνσωματώσεως, οὐχὶ ὡς ἀπόδρασις ἐκ τοῦ συστήματος.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Δημιουργικὴ αἰτία → σωματικὴ μεσιτεία → αἴσθησις → ψυχικὴ κρίσις → ἀνάταξις ἢ διατάραξις → νέα ἐνσώματος ἔκθεσις.
Ὄψις → περιοδικότης → ἀριθμὸς → χρόνος → φιλοσοφικὴ μίμησις → διόρθωσις ψυχικῶν περιφορῶν.
Νοῦς → πειθὼ → ἀνάγκη → μεικτὴ γένεσις → ἀνάγκη χώρας → ἀποφατικὴ ἀβεβαιότης.
Ἀστάθεια φαινομένων → ἀναζήτησις ὑποκειμένου → ἀφαίρεσις μορφῆς → χώρα → νέα ἐξήγησις τῆς ἀστάθειας.
Ἡ ἱεραρχικὴ ἀνάταξις εἶναι ὁ πρακτικὸς ἑλκτικὸς πόλος, ἡ δὲ χώρα ὁ ὀντολογικὸς ἑλκτικὸς πόλος τοῦ ὅλου μηχανήματος.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Δημιουργικὴ τάξις → κατανεμημένη αἰτιότης → θνητὴ καὶ σωματικὴ σύνθεσις.
Σωματικὴ σύνθεσις → μετάδοσις κινήσεων → αἴσθησις → πάθος καὶ σχετικὸν φαινόμενον.
Σχετικὸν φαινόμενον → παρατήρησις περιοδικότητος → ἀριθμὸς καὶ χρόνος → παιδευτικὴ μίμησις.
Παιδευτικὴ τάξις → ἐρώτησις περὶ γένεσεως → νοῦς καὶ ἀνάγκη → ἀναγνώρισις ἀντιστάσεως.
Ἀντίστασις καὶ μεταβολή → ἀνεπάρκεια δυαδισμοῦ → χώρα ἄνευ ἰδίου εἴδους → τριμερὴς ὀντολογία.
Τριμερὴς ὀντολογία → ἀποφατικὴ γνώσις τοῦ θεμελίου → εἰκὼς λόγος → διαρκὴς ἀνακύκλησις τῆς διακρίσεως.
Δημιουργικὴ διανομή → θνητὴ πληρότης → σωματικὴ μεσιτεία.
Σωματικὴ μεσιτεία → αἴσθησις ὡς μετάδοσις → πλάνη ἢ κοσμικὴ μάθησις.
Κοσμικὴ μάθησις → μέτρησις περιοδικότητος → χρόνος → διόρθωσις τῆς ψυχῆς.
Διόρθωσις → ἀναζήτησις τῆς αἰτίας → νοῦς καὶ ἀνάγκη → προκοσμικὴ ἀντίστασις.
Προκοσμικὴ ἀντίστασις → χώρα → τριμερὴς ὀντολογία → διάκρισις νοῦ καὶ δόξης.
Ἀποφατικὴ σύγκλεισις → ἀναγνώρισις ἀβεβαιότητος → ἐπανέναρξις τῆς ἀναζητήσεως τοῦ θεμελίου.
Ἡ θνητότης ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἀναγκαία πληρότης καὶ ταὐτόχρονος ἐστία κινδύνου καὶ φθορᾶς.
Τὸ σῶμα ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἐνεργὸν δίκτυον μεταδόσεων, καὶ οὐκέτι ὡς ὑλικὸν ὑπόλειμμα ψυχῆς.
Ἡ αἴσθησις ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἀμφίσημος μηχανὴ μετρήσεως, μεσιτείας, πλάνης καὶ παιδείας.
Ἡ ὕλη καὶ ὁ τόπος ἀναταξινομοῦνται ἀπὸ ἐμπειρικὰ περιεχόμενα εἰς ὀντολογικοὺς ὅρους δεκτικότητος καὶ γενέσεως.
Ἡ ἐπιστήμη ἀναπλαισιοῦται ὡς πλῆθος ἀντιστοίχων λόγων, ὧν ἡ ἀκρίβεια κρίνεται κατὰ τὴν σταθερότητα τοῦ ἀντικειμένου.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, θεοὶ, σώματα, ὄργανα, φῶς, ἄστρα, στοιχεῖα καὶ φαινόμενα παρέχουσι τὰ ῥητὰ ἀντικείμενα.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἱεραρχία, ῥοή, μεσιτεία, ἀνάγκη, μίμησις καὶ δεκτικότητα συγκροτοῦσι τὸν μηχανισμὸν τῆς γενέσεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ὀρθὴ μέθοδος ζητεῖ διάκρισιν μεσιτειῶν καὶ κυριαρχίαν τῶν ἐσωτερικῶν κινήσεων μᾶλλον ἢ φυγὴν ἐκ τοῦ φαινομένου.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ εἶδος καὶ ἡ χώρα διαμένουσιν, τὰ δὲ γιγνόμενα κυκλοφοροῦσι διὰ φθορᾶς, μεταβολῆς καὶ ἐπανατάξεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεθοδολογικοῦ καὶ ἐπιτελεστικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ὁ λόγος ἀρχίζει ἀπὸ μηχανισμοὺς καὶ φθάνει εἰς ἀποφατικὴν ἀφαίρεσιν, ἐκτελῶν αὐτὸς τὴν κίνησιν τῆς θεωρίας.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ θεία καὶ νοερὰ τάξις τίθεται ὡς ἀρχή, ἀλλὰ ὁ ἀκριβὴς τρόπος καθ᾽ ὃν ἐνεργεῖ ἐπὶ σωματικῶν κινήσεων καὶ ἀνάγκης μένει ὑποκαθορισμένος.
Ἡ ψυχικὴ εὐθύνη ἀπαιτεῖται, ἀλλὰ τὰ σωματικὰ πάθη καὶ αἱ κοσμικαὶ διανομὰς περιορίζουσι τὴν αὐτονομίαν τῆς κρίσεως.
Ἡ χώρα δεῖ εἶναι ἀπαθὴς πρὸς ἴδιον εἶδος καὶ ὅμως σειομένη πρὸς ἀνίσους δυνάμεις· ἡ διάκρισις ταύτη σώζει τὴν θεωρίαν ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἐξαλείφει τὴν ἀμφισημίαν.
Ὁ λόγος παραιτεῖται τῆς ἀπολύτου βεβαιότητος, ἀλλὰ διατηρεῖ ἰσχυρὰν ἀξίωσιν περὶ τῶν ἀρχῶν, καὶ οὕτως ἡ εἰκὼς ἐξήγησις μένει ἐντάσει πρὸς τὴν ὀντολογικὴν βεβαίωσιν.
Ἡ αἴσθησις μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ παθητικὴν ἐντύπωσιν εἰς δραστικὸν κύκλωμα, ὃ μεταβάλλει ὅσα μεταδίδει.
Ἡ ἀταξία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ στέρησιν εἰς θετικῶς παραγόμενον πλῆθος ἀντικρουομένων κινήσεων.
Ἡ χώρα μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ δεκτικὸν ὑπόβαθρον εἰς ἀναγκαῖον καὶ ἀποφατικὸν πεδίον, ὅπου τὸ πάσχειν δὲν ἐπιφέρει ἴδιον εἶδος.
Ὁ λόγος μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἀπόδειξιν εἰς ἐπιεικῆ καὶ ἀποφατικὴν παρακολούθησιν γιγνομένου κόσμου.
Ἡ πραγματικότης εἶναι μηχανὴ μεταδόσεως καὶ ἐκτυπώσεως, ἐν ᾗ ἡ μορφὴ διανέμεται, ἡ ἀνάγκη ἀνθίσταται, καὶ ἡ χώρα δέχεται χωρὶς νὰ ταυτίζηται.
Ὁ ὑποκείμενος εἶναι κόμβος καὶ μικρογραφία τοῦ κοσμικοῦ μηχανήματος, ἐν ᾧ ἀθάνατοι ρυθμοὶ, σωματικαὶ ῥοαί, πάθη καὶ λόγος συγκρούονται.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι σπειροειδὴς μηχανὴ, ἐν ᾗ ἡ ἐπάνοδος οὐ καταλύει τὴν ἔκθεσιν εἰς νέαν διατάραξιν.
Ἡ δυνατὴ διαφυγὴ συνίσταται εἰς διάκρισιν, ῥύθμισιν καὶ μίμησιν τῆς τάξεως, οὐχὶ εἰς ἀκύρωσιν σώματος, φαινομένου ἢ ἀνάγκης.
Τὰ ἀξιώματα ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευήν τῆς μείζονος κινήσεως ἀπὸ δημιουργικὴν διανομήν διὰ σωματικῆς μεσιτείας πρὸς τριμερῆ καὶ ἀποφατικὴν ὀντολογίαν.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι ἰσχυροτάτη ὅταν συνάπτῃ αἰτίαν, σῶμα, αἴσθησιν, ἀνάγκην, χώραν καὶ κυκλικὴν ψυχικὴν ἀνάταξιν.
Ὑποκαθορίζονται ὁ τρόπος τῆς νοερᾶς ἐνεργείας ἐπὶ τῆς ἀνάγκης, ἡ σχέσις χώρας πρὸς εἶδος, καὶ ἡ ἀκριβὴς ἔκτασις τῆς ψυχικῆς εὐθύνης.
Ἡ συνοχὴ τοῦ μετασυστήματος ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὴν διατήρησιν τῆς σπειροειδοῦς ἐπιστροφῆς καὶ τῆς ἀποφατικῆς ἀσάφειας, ἃ οὐ δύνανται ἀβλαβῶς νὰ μειωθῶσιν εἰς ἀκίνητα ἀξιώματα.
The problem of the system is how order may admit mortal generation, bodily disturbance, necessity, and unstable manifestation without the annihilation of the principle.
Creation ceases to be a simple imposition of form and becomes a distributed transmission of causality through bodies, senses, souls, and receptive fields.
The body is transformed from an inferior covering into an intermediary, which transmits motions, produces affections, and imposes the necessity of judgment.
Sensation rises from bodily impact into a path of cosmic measurement, but at the same time remains a source of error owing to the relative nature of transmission.
Order does not signify the absence of necessity, but persuasion and reordering upon a field of resistant forces.
The inquiry into order compels discourse to introduce χώρα as a formless condition of possibility, which receives forms without itself being one form.
Discourse moves from an arithmetical and teleological apprehension to a likely and apophatic mode, because that which comes to be and χώρα resist complete fixation.
The movement of the whole is spiral: order is transmitted, disturbed, measured, corrected, and finally returns to an apophatic recognition of the foundation.
[Persistent] Every generation requires causal distribution and a receptive field; neither self-generation nor immediate production exhaust reality.
[Persistent] Body and sensation are active intermediaries between cosmic motions and psychic order.
[Mutating] Mortality is at once a condition of cosmic completeness and a site of destruction, so that the necessary is not identical with the harmless.
[Emergent] Order is regulation and persuasion over resistant necessity, not a rigid state pre-existing motion.
[Persistent] The truth of phenomena requires the distinction of causes, mediations, paradigms, and receptacles, not simple attachment to sensation.
[Mutating] Sensation is a twofold power: a measure of cosmic education and a conduit of disturbance and error.
[Emergent] Reality is constituted tripartitely from an immutable paradigm, receptive χώρα, and perishable becoming.
[Attractor] The reordering of psychic motions according to a cosmic measure draws physiology, ethics, education, and cosmology toward one functional convergence.
[Terminal] Discourse concerning generation cannot become absolute demonstration, but must follow change through likely and apophatic discourse.
[Attractor] The absence of a proper form in χώρα becomes the hidden condition through which many forms can appear without the foundation being identified with them.
The hierarchy from creative distribution migrates into the relation of head and body, first and secondary causes, and finally paradigm, χώρα, and becoming.
Sensation retains the function of transmission, but changes from bodily concussion into an instrument of number, time, and philosophical correction.
Necessity mutates from a bodily and mechanical co-cause into a resistant field, which intellect does not dissolve but persuades.
Order reverses its meaning: from presupposed harmony it becomes an achievement of regulation within an unstable and passive field.
The receptacle absorbs the simple notion of matter and place, becoming an ontological condition of manifestation and a dynamic field of reactions.
Discourse retains the claim of distinction, but abandons the claim of immobilizing becoming.
Specific elemental, anatomical, and astronomical descriptions remain local techniques, while the mediation of motion through body and sensation is scaled up into a universal principle.
The ethics of reason and the irrational ceases to be merely a judgment of character and becomes a mechanism for reordering a cosmically embodied subject.
The distinction of first and secondary causes bridges physiology to cosmology, but the tripartite arrangement exceeds dual causality.
Therapy through music and observation of the stars remain local practices, but are gathered together as modes of regulative imitation of cosmic periodicity.
χώρα abolishes the local hypothesis of matter as a self-subsistent element and becomes the common condition that connects generation, phenomenon, and cognitive limit.
Autonomous generation or self-forming matter is excluded, because what comes to be requires cause, receptivity, and relation to a paradigm.
The conception of body and sensation as passive containers without transformative activity is excluded.
A cosmos in which order subsists without necessity, resistance, destruction, or a receptive field is excluded.
The identification of phenomenon, name, and stable essence is excluded, because phenomena are changing imitations.
Absolute certainty concerning becoming is excluded, because the instability of the object alters the fitting mode of discourse.
It must be false that causal necessity and intellect are hostile to one another, because the system employs necessity as a subordinate yet active co-cause.
It must be false that soul or human being can be self-sufficient, since the soul is formed in body, time, and cosmic distribution.
It must be false that phenomenon can possess self-subsistent essence, since manifestation depends upon χώρα and paradigm.
It must be false that χώρα can be positively defined as one substance alongside the others, since a proper form negates universal receptivity.
The deepest absence is impossible immediacy between intellect, cosmos, and being; every access passes through mediations.
χώρα is the necessary yet inexpressible foundation, which neither appears by itself nor can be removed without the collapse of generation.
The perfect coincidence of truth, name, and phenomenon remains impossible, because generation preserves a distance between form and image.
Distributed creation and tripartite ontology entail that causality does not flow from the summit alone, but is actualized through the interaction of paradigm, body, χώρα, and becoming.
Bodily transmission and the relative nature of phenomenon make error not a bare lack of knowledge, but a produced result of mediation.
The restoration of the soul and the persuasion of necessity by intellect constitute one schema: order returns through reordering and not through the elimination of resistance.
The formlessness of χώρα and the precision of imprinting prove that the privation of a proper character can be a positive condition of receptivity.
Mathematical periodicity and likely discourse distinguish two scientific measures: precision concerning stable motions and appropriate probability concerning generation.
Reality becomes a multilevel circuit in which every transmission of order can simultaneously produce new instability.
The subject becomes a node of flows and not a self-sufficient center, because cosmic law, bodily affection, sensation, and judgment converge in it.
Time becomes a recursive sequence in which disturbance produces judgment, judgment gives form to the bearer, and the new form restarts the cycle.
Science becomes a diagnosis of conditions of possibility and limits of discourse, not possession of immutable names or self-subsistent phenomena.
Salvation or freedom is defined as the re-establishment of governance within conditions of necessity and embodiment, not as escape from the system.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Creative cause → bodily mediation → sensation → psychic judgment → reordering or disturbance → new embodied exposure.
Sight → periodicity → number → time → philosophical imitation → correction of psychic revolutions.
Intellect → persuasion → necessity → mixed generation → necessity of χώρα → apophatic uncertainty.
Instability of phenomena → search for substrate → abstraction of form → χώρα → new explanation of instability.
Hierarchical reordering is the practical attractor, while χώρα is the ontological attractor of the whole apparatus.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Creative order → distributed causality → mortal and bodily composition.
Bodily composition → transmission of motions → sensation → affection and relative phenomenon.
Relative phenomenon → observation of periodicity → number and time → educational imitation.
Educational order → question concerning generation → intellect and necessity → recognition of resistance.
Resistance and change → inadequacy of dualism → χώρα without a proper form → tripartite ontology.
Tripartite ontology → apophatic knowledge of the foundation → likely discourse → continuous recurrence of distinction.
Creative distribution → mortal completeness → bodily mediation.
Bodily mediation → sensation as transmission → error or cosmic learning.
Cosmic learning → measurement of periodicity → time → correction of the soul.
Correction → search for the cause → intellect and necessity → pre-cosmic resistance.
Pre-cosmic resistance → χώρα → tripartite ontology → distinction of intellect and opinion.
Apophatic convergence → recognition of uncertainty → recommencement of the search for the foundation.
Mortality is reclassified as necessary completeness and a simultaneous focus of danger and destruction.
The body is reclassified as an active network of transmissions, and no longer as the material residue of soul.
Sensation is reclassified as an ambiguous mechanism of measurement, mediation, error, and education.
Matter and place are reclassified from empirical contents into ontological conditions of receptivity and generation.
Science is reframed as a plurality of corresponding discourses, whose precision is judged according to the stability of the object.
At the surface level, gods, bodies, organs, light, stars, elements, and phenomena provide the explicit objects.
At the structural level, hierarchy, flow, mediation, necessity, imitation, and receptivity constitute the mechanism of generation.
At the meta-strategic level, the correct method seeks the distinction of mediations and mastery of internal motions rather than flight from phenomenon.
At the ontological and temporal level, form and χώρα remain, while things that come to be circulate through destruction, change, and reordering.
At the methodological and performative level, discourse begins from mechanisms and reaches apophatic abstraction, itself enacting the movement of theory.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Divine and intelligible order is posited as principle, but the precise manner in which it acts upon bodily motions and necessity remains underdetermined.
Psychic responsibility is required, but bodily affections and cosmic distributions restrict the autonomy of judgment.
χώρα must be unaffected with respect to a proper form and yet shaken by unequal forces; this distinction saves the theory but does not eliminate the ambiguity.
Discourse renounces absolute certainty, but retains a strong claim concerning principles, and thus likely explanation remains in tension with ontological affirmation.
Sensation mutates from passive impression into an active circuit that changes what it transmits.
Disorder mutates from privation into a positively produced plurality of conflicting motions.
χώρα mutates from a receptive substrate into a necessary and apophatic field, where being affected does not bring about a proper form.
Discourse mutates from demonstration into equitable and apophatic tracking of a world in becoming.
Reality is a machine of transmission and imprinting, in which form is distributed, necessity resists, and χώρα receives without being identified.
The subject is a node and miniature of the cosmic apparatus, in which immortal rhythms, bodily flows, affections, and discourse conflict.
Time is a spiral machine, in which return does not abolish exposure to new disturbance.
Possible escape consists in distinction, regulation, and imitation of order, not in the annulment of body, phenomenon, or necessity.
The axioms suffice for reconstruction of the major movement from creative distribution through bodily mediation toward tripartite and apophatic ontology.
The architecture is strongest when it joins cause, body, sensation, necessity, χώρα, and circular psychic reordering.
The manner of intelligible activity upon necessity, the relation of χώρα to form, and the precise extent of psychic responsibility are underdetermined.
The coherence of the metasystem depends upon preserving spiral return and apophatic indeterminacy, which cannot harmlessly be reduced to immutable axioms.

items.text: Τὸ σύστημα ζητεῖ νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ πῶς ἡ πολλότης γίνεται κόσμος, χωρὶς ἡ γένεσις νὰ καταλήγῃ εἰς ἄμορφον ῥοὴν ἢ ἀκίνητον τάξιν.
Ἡ γεωμετρία μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ ἀρχὴ στατικῆς μορφοποιήσεως εἰς μηχανὴ σχέσεων, ἡ οποία παράγει κίνησιν, ἀντίστασιν, μεῖξιν, πάθος καὶ αἴσθησιν.
Ἡ τάξις δὲν προηγείται τῆς μεταβολῆς, ἀλλὰ διασῴζεται διὰ πεπερασμένων διαφοροποιήσεων, πιέσεων, διαλύσεων καὶ νέων συστάσεων.
Ἡ ἀπουσία κενοῦ καθιστᾷ τὸν κόσμον καθολικῶς συμπεπλεγμένον, ὥστε πᾶσα τοπικὴ εἴσοδος, μετάθεσις ἢ βία νὰ ἀναδιατάσσῃ πλέγμα σχέσεων.
Ἡ ἐξήγησις ἀναβαίνει ἀπὸ τὰ σώματα εἰς τὰ πάθη καὶ τὴν αἴσθησιν, καὶ ἐπιστρέφει εἰς τὴν διόρθωσιν τῶν ὀνομάτων διὰ τῶν μηχανισμῶν οἳ αὐτὰ παράγουσιν.
Ἡ τελικὴ σύνθεσις εἶναι ἐνιαῖος ἀλλὰ μὴ ὁμοιογενὴς κόσμος, ὅπου ἡ ἀκρίβεια τῶν σχέσεων συνυπάρχει μὲ ὅρια ἀποδείξεως καὶ μερικῶς ἀνοικτὰς μεταβάσεις.
[Persistent] Τὰ σώματα δὲν εἰσὶν αὐτοτελεῖς οὐσίαι, ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιραι συστάσεις μορφῆς, ἀριθμοῦ, πυκνότητος, κινήσεως καὶ σχέσεως.
[Mutating] Ἡ γεωμετρικὴ μορφὴ παύει νὰ εἶναι μόνον ὑπόβαθρον εἴδους καὶ γίνεται αἰτία κινήσεως, δυνάμεως, παθήματος καὶ φυσικῆς φορᾶς.
[Persistent] Ἡ διαφορά, ἡ ἀνισότης καὶ ἡ ἀνομοιότης εἰσὶν οἱ παραγωγικοὶ ὅροι κινήσεως, ἀντιμαχίας καὶ νέας συστάσεως.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀπουσία κενοῦ ὑποχρεοῖ τὴν μεταβολὴν νὰ εἶναι ἀμοιβαία, πιεστική, τοπικῶς μεταδοτική καὶ καθολικῶς κυκλοτερής.
[Mutating] Ἡ ταυτότης διατηρεῖται οὐ διὰ ἀκινησίας, ἀλλὰ διὰ ῥυθμιζομένης ἀνασυνθέσεως, συγγενείας, εἰσόδου καὶ ἀντιστάσεως.
[Emergent] Ἡ αἰτιότης εἶναι κατανεμημένη κατὰ κλίμακας: μορφὴ παράγει κίνησιν, κίνησις μετάδοσιν, μετάδοσις πάθος, καὶ πάθος δύναται νὰ γίνῃ αἴσθησις καὶ ὀνομασία.
[Emergent] Ὁ τόπος δὲν εἶναι κενὸν περιέχον, ἀλλὰ δίκτυον συγγενῶν φορῶν, μεταδόσεων, ἀντιστάσεων καὶ ἀναδιανομῶν.
[Attractor] Ἡ τάξις τοῦ κόσμου εἶναι δυναμικὴ διατήρησις, ἥτις διασῴζεται μόνον ἐπειδὴ ἀναπαράγει τὰς ἰδίας προϋποθέσεις τῆς διαφορᾶς.
[Attractor] Ἡ ὀνοματοθεσία εἶναι δευτερογενὴς κρίσις, ἣ ὀφείλει νὰ ἀκολουθῇ τὴν φυσικὴν δομὴν καὶ οὐχὶ νὰ ὑποκαθιστᾷ τὴν αἰτίαν.
[Terminal] Ἡ καθολικὴ ἑνότης δὲν συνεπάγεται ἕνα ἀπόλυτον σύστημα τόπων, φορῶν ἢ ποιοτήτων, ἀλλὰ συνίσταται ἐκ πολλῶν σχετικῶν συστημάτων ἐντὸς σφαιρικῆς τάξεως.
[Terminal] Ἡ ἐξήγησις ἀναγκαίως παραμένει διαβαθμισμένη, διότι ἡ γενετικὴ μηχανὴ δύναται νὰ ἀνακατασκευασθῇ ἀκριβέστερον ἢ αἱ ὑπέρταται ἀρχαὶ καὶ αἱ λεπτομέρειαι τῆς φρονήσεως.
Ἡ κίνησις διατηρεῖ τὴν γενετικὴν λειτουργίαν της, ἀλλὰ μεταπίπτει ἀπὸ κοσμογονικὸν χωρισμὸν εἰς ἀντιμαχίαν, εἴσοδον, μετάδοσιν παθήματος καὶ φυσικὴν φοράν.
Ἡ γεωμετρία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ὀντολογικὸν κριτήριον σωμάτων εἰς δυναμικὴν γραμματικὴν ἀνισότητος καὶ τέλος εἰς ἔμμεσον ὑπόδειγμα τῆς αἰσθήσεως.
Ἡ ταυτότης ἀπορροφᾶται ὑπὸ τῆς σχέσεως: ἀπὸ προσωρινὴ ἑνότης ἀνασυνθέσιμων στοιχείων γίνεται κόμβος πιέσεων, τόπων, χρόνων καὶ μεταδόσεων.
Ἡ ἀπουσία κενοῦ παραμένει σταθερὸς ἀποκλεισμός, ἀλλὰ ἡ λειτουργία της διευρύνεται ἀπὸ κοσμικὴν κυκλοφορίαν εἰς μικροφυσικὴν διαπερατότητα καὶ αἰσθητικὴν μετάδοσιν.
Ἡ συγγένεια μεταστρέφεται ἀπὸ ὅρον περιορισμένης μεταβολῆς εἰς ἀρχὴ τοπολογικῆς φορᾶς, ἀφομοιώσεως καὶ κατανομῆς.
Τὸ κοινὸν ὄνομα ἐκτελεῖ ἀρχικῶς ἐμπειρικὴν λειτουργίαν, ἀλλὰ τελικῶς ὑποτάσσεται εἰς τὸν ἔλεγχον τοῦ δικτύου μορφῆς, κινήσεως καὶ αἰτίας.
Αἱ ἀκριβείς κατασκευαὶ τριγώνων, στερεῶν, βάσεων καὶ ἀριθμητικῶν ἀναλογιῶν μένουσιν κατώτερα τεχνικὰ ὄργανα.
Ἡ μορφολογικὴ αἰτιότης κλιμακοῦται, διότι συνδέει τὴν μικροδομὴν τῶν σωμάτων μὲ τὴν κοσμικὴν κίνησιν, τὴν αἴσθησιν καὶ τὴν γλωσσικὴν κρίσιν.
Ἡ ἀπουσία κενοῦ, ἡ διαπερατότης καὶ ἡ ἀναπλήρωσις γεφυροῦσι τὴν κοσμικὴν θεωρίαν τῆς κυκλοφορίας πρὸς τὴν θεωρίαν τῆς τήξεως, τῆς μεταδόσεως καὶ τοῦ παθήματος.
Ἡ ἀκύρωσις ἀπολύτου ἄνω καὶ κάτω γίνεται καταλύτης γενικωτέρας σχετικοποιήσεως τῶν ποιοτήτων, τῶν τόπων καὶ τῶν ὀνομάτων.
Ἡ ἐξωτερικὴ θεία διακόσμησις ἀνακωδικοποιεῖται ὡς ἐσωτερικὴ συνοχή τῶν σχέσεων, ἀλλὰ δὲν ἐξαλείφεται τελείως ὡς ὅρος τῆς ὑπέρτατης θεμελιώσεως.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἄμορφος, ἀκίνητος καὶ αὐτάρκης ὕλη, διότι πᾶσα ὕλη ὑπάρχει ἤδη ἐν μορφώσει, διαφορᾷ καὶ σχέσει.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ μεταβολὴ ὡς γένεσις ἐκ μηδενὸς ἢ ἄτακτος ῥοή, διότι μεταβολὴ σημαίνει λύσιν, εἴσοδον, ἀντιμαχίαν καὶ ἀνασύνθεσιν σχέσεων.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀπόλυτος ὁμοιότης, ἐπειδὴ ἄνευ ἀνομοιότητος δὲν ὑπάρχει δύναμις, μετάδοσις, φυσικὴ φορά ἢ αἴσθησις.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ὁ τόπος ὡς κενὸν καὶ καθολικὸν πλαίσιον προσανατολισμοῦ, διότι ὁ τόπος ὑφίσταται μόνον διὰ συγγενείας, πιέσεως καὶ φορᾶς.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ταύτισις τοῦ ὀνόματος, τῆς ποιότητος, τοῦ παθήματος καὶ τῆς ἡδονῆς ὡς ἑνὸς ἀδιαιρέτου δεδομένου.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ταύτισις μαθηματικῆς δυνατότητος, φυσικῆς ὑπάρξεως καὶ πλήρους ἀποδείξεως.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι τὰ πράγματα προϋπάρχουσι τῶν διαδικασιῶν, διότι τὸ σῶμα, ἡ ποιότης καὶ ἡ ταυτότης εἰσὶν ἀποτελέσματα γενετικῶν σχέσεων.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι μία μόνη ἀρχὴ δύναται νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ τὴν φύσιν, διότι αἰτιότης διανέμεται εἰς μορφήν, ἀριθμόν, κίνησιν, τόπον, πίεσιν καὶ μετάδοσιν.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι ἡ ἐξωτερικὴ ἐπαφὴ ἀρκεῖ πρὸς μεταβολήν, διότι τὸ εἰσελθεῖν ἢ ἀντιστῆναι κρίνεται ὑπὸ τῆς ἐσωτερικῆς διατάξεως.
Δεῖ νὰ ἀποκλείεται ἡ ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ ἐμπειρία παρέχει αὐτομάτως τὴν αἰτίαν αὐτῆς, διότι ἡ ἀναγνώρισις προϋποθέτει μεσολάβησιν σωμάτων καὶ φρονίμου.
Δεῖ νὰ εἶναι ψεῦδος ὅτι ἡ φύσις δύναται νὰ ἐκτεθῇ ταυτοχρόνως καὶ ἐξ ἴσου ἐπὶ πάσης κλίμακος.
Ἡ βαθύτερα ἀπούσα δυνατότης εἶναι κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἑνότης θὰ ἐσήμαινεν ὁμοιογένειαν, ἡ δὲ διαφορὰ καθαρὰν διάλυσιν τῆς τάξεως.
Ἀπουσιάζει καθολικὸς χάρτης ὁ ὁποῖος θὰ ὥριζε ἀπολύτως τόπον, ποιότητα, πάθος καὶ σημασίαν ἄνευ τῶν σχέσεων αἳ τὰ παράγουσιν.
Ἀπουσιάζει πλήρης καὶ ταυτόχρονος γνῶσις τοῦ ὅλου, διότι τὸ ὅλον ἐνεργεῖ ὡς διαδοχὴ μετασχηματισμῶν καὶ ὄχι ὡς παρόν ἀκίνητον ἀντικείμενον.
Ἀπαγορεύεται ἡ ἔξοδος εἰς ἀπόλυτον ἐκτός, διότι πᾶσα διαφυγὴ εἶναι μετάβασις εἰς ἑτέραν σύστασιν, δύναμιν καὶ σχέσιν.
Ἡ πεπερασμένη γεωμετρικὴ μορφοποίησις καὶ ἡ κυκλοτερὴς ἀναπαραγωγὴ διαφορῶν συντίθενται εἰς κόσμον, ὅπου ἡ μορφὴ οὐ περιορίζει τὴν κίνησιν ἀλλὰ ὁρίζει τοὺς τρόπους τῆς παραγωγῆς της.
Ἡ ἀπουσία κενοῦ καὶ ἡ διαπερατότης τῶν διακένων συγκροτοῦσιν ἀντὶ ἀντιφάσεως μίαν μηχανὴ, καθ᾽ ἣν ἡ πληρότης καθιστᾷ τὴν εἴσοδον αἰτιακῶς δεσμευμένην.
Ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ στοιχειακὴν κίνησιν εἰς αἴσθησιν ἀναγκάζει τὴν αἰτιότητα νὰ γίνῃ ἱεραρχικὴ μετάδοσις καὶ οὐχὶ ἁπλὴ τοπικὴ κρούσις.
Ἡ ἀκύρωσις τοῦ ἀπολύτου τόπου καὶ ἡ ἀκύρωσις τῆς αὐθύπαρκτης ποιότητος ἀποτελοῦσι μίαν καὶ τὴν αὐτὴν σχεσιακὴν ἀρχήν.
Ἡ ἀναγκαία ἀνακατασκευή τῶν σχέσεων καὶ ὁ εἰκὼς χαρακτὴρ τῶν ὑστάτων λεπτομερειῶν ὁρίζουσι γνώσιν ἀκριβῆ κατὰ μηχανισμούς, ἀλλὰ μὴ κυρίαν κατὰ πᾶσαν θεμελίωσιν.
Ἡ πραγματικότης γίνεται πεπερασμένη γενετικὴ τοπολογία, ἐν ᾗ τὰ ὄντα εἰσὶν κόμβοι μεταβαλλομένων σχέσεων καὶ οὐκ ἀνεξάρτηται μονάδες.
Ὁ χρόνος γίνεται ἐσωτερικὸς τρόπος τῆς ὕλης, διότι δηλοῖ λύσιν, παλαίωσιν, κυκλοφορίαν, μετάθεσιν καὶ ἐπανόρθωσιν συστάσεων.
Ἡ ὀντολογία τοῦ σώματος ἐπεκτείνεται εἰς θεωρίαν τοῦ αἰσθανομένου, ὥστε τὸ ὑποκείμενον νὰ γίνεται ἐνδοκοσμικὸς κόμβος μεταδόσεως καὶ ἀναγνώσεως.
Ἡ ἐπιστήμη μετασχηματίζεται ἀπὸ ταξινόμησιν πραγμάτων εἰς ἀνακατασκευήν μεταβάσεων, ἡ δὲ γλῶσσα γίνεται πεδίον ἐλέγχου τῶν ἐξηγητικῶν ἐπιπέδων.
Ἡ ἑνότης τοῦ κόσμου δὲν εἶναι καθολικὴ ὁμοιομορφία, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἱκανότης δικτύου νὰ συνδέῃ ἀσύμμετρα γένη, τοπικὰς φοράς καὶ διακεκριμένα πάθη.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Μορφὴ → ἀνομοιότης → δύναμις → ἀντιμαχία → λύσις → νέα μορφή· ὁ βρόχος μετατρέπει τὴν γεωμετρίαν εἰς αὐτοαναπαραγόμενον φυσικὸν μηχανισμόν.
Πληρότης → ἀναπλήρωσις → πίεσις → εἴσοδος → ἀναδιάταξις → νέα πληρότης· ἡ ἀπουσία κενοῦ ἐνεργεῖ ὡς βρόχος καθολικῆς ἀλληλεξαρτήσεως.
Πάθος σώματος → μετάδοσις ἢ ἀπομόνωσις → αἴσθησις ἢ ἀναισθησία → ἔλεγχος αἰτίας → νέος προσδιορισμὸς παθήματος.
Ἐμπειρικὸν ὄνομα → μηχανιστικὴ ἀναγωγή → σχεσιακὸς ὁρισμός → διόρθωσις ὀνόματος· ἡ γλῶσσα ἐπιστρέφει εἰς ἑαυτὴν ἤδη μετασχηματισμένη.
Ὁ κύριος ἐλκτικὸς πόλος εἶναι ἡ ἀρχὴ ὅτι ἡ τάξις σώζεται μόνον ὅταν ἐμπεριέχῃ, ὁρίζῃ καὶ ἀναπαράγῃ τὴν διαφοράν ἣν ἀποκλείει ὡς ἄτακτον.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Ἄμετρος πολλότης → πεπερασμένη μορφοποίησις → στοιχειακὴ συγγένεια καὶ ἀσυμμετρία.
Γεωμετρικὴ διαφορά → ἀνομοιότης → δύναμις, ἀντίστασις, πίεσις καὶ κυκλοφορία.
Πληρότης τοῦ κόσμου → διαπερατὰ διάκενα → εἴσοδος ἢ ἀντίστασις → λύσις, τήξις, στερεοποίησις ἢ νέα μεῖξις.
Σωματικὴ ἀναδιάταξις → μετάδοσις πάθους → αἴσθησις καὶ βίωμα → ἀναθεώρησις τῆς ὀνοματοθεσίας.
Σχεσιακὸς τόπος → πολλαπλαὶ φυσικαὶ φοραί → ἀναίρεσις ἀπολύτων κατευθύνσεων → ἑνότης διὰ διαφορικῶν δικτύων.
Μηχανικὴ ἀνάγκη → εἰκαστικὴ συμπλήρωσις → διαβαθμισμένη γνώσις, ἣ διατηρεῖ τὴν γενετικὴν δομὴν ἀνοικτήν.
Ἄτακτος πολλότης → γεωμετρικὴ διάκρισις → πεπερασμένα γένη καὶ συγγένειαι.
Πεπερασμένα γένη → ἀνισότης καὶ ἀνομοιότης → ἀντιμαχία, διάλυσις, διαφυγὴ καὶ ἀνασύνθεσις.
Ἀνασύνθεσις → διαπερατότης καὶ πίεσις → πάθη, αἰσθηταὶ ποιότητες καὶ λειτουργικὰ ὀνόματα.
Πάθος καὶ μετάδοσις → αἴσθησις ἢ ἀναισθησία → ἐνδοκοσμικὴ φρόνησις καὶ ἔλεγχος αἰτίας.
Σφαιρικὴ ἑνότης → πολλαπλοὶ συγγενεῖς τόποι → σχεσιακὴ ἀναθεώρησις βάρους, κουφότητος, ἄνω καὶ κάτω.
Σχεσιακὴ φυσικὴ → ἀπόρριψις ἀπολύτων → ἀνοικτὸς καὶ διαβαθμισμένος λόγος περὶ ἑνὸς δυναμικῶς συνεχομένου κόσμου.
Ἡ ὕλη ἐπαναταξινομεῖται ἀπὸ ὑπόστρωμα εἰς πλέγμα μορφοποιημένων, διαπερατῶν καὶ αἰτιακῶς ἀλληλεξαρτωμένων συστάσεων.
Ἡ διάκρισις μικροκλίμακος καὶ μακροκλίμακος παύει νὰ εἶναι ἀπόλυτος, διότι ἡ μικροδομὴ ἐνεργεῖ ὡς μηχανισμὸς κοσμικῆς κινήσεως καὶ βιώματος.
Ἡ ἀντίθεσις σταθερότητος καὶ μεταβολῆς καταρρέει, διότι ἡ σταθερὰ μορφὴ εἶναι πρόσκαιρος ῥύθμισις ἐντὸς κυκλοφορίας.
Ὁ τόπος μετασχηματίζεται ἀπὸ ἀδρανὲς πλαίσιον εἰς παραγόμενον πεδίον φυσικῶν φορῶν, συγγενειῶν καὶ ἀντιστάσεων.
Ἡ αἴσθησις καθίσταται ἰδία βαθμίς τῆς φυσικῆς, ἣ οὔτε ἀποχωρίζεται τοῦ σώματος οὔτε ταυτίζεται πρὸς τὴν ἡδονὴν καὶ τὴν λύπην.
Ἡ ἀνάγνωσις τῶν ὀνομάτων γίνεται μέθοδος ἀνασυστάσεως τῶν μηχανισμῶν, οὐχὶ ἀποδοχὴ φαινομενικῶν κατηγοριῶν.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, θερμόν, ψυχρόν, σκληρόν, μαλακόν, βαρύ, κοῦφον, τήξις, ῥοὴ καὶ αἴσθησις ἐμφανίζονται ὡς προβλήματα φυσικῆς ἐξηγήσεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, μορφή, ἀναλογία, διάκενα, πίεσις, συγγένεια, ἀντίστασις καὶ μετάδοσις συγκροτοῦσι τὴν μηχανὴν τῶν φαινομένων.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ὁ λόγος μετακινείται ἀπὸ τὴν περιγραφὴν ἀντικειμένων καὶ ὀνομάτων εἰς τὴν ἀνακατασκευήν μηχανισμῶν καὶ μεταβάσεων.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ εἶναι εἶναι πρόσκαιρος ἰσορροπία ἐν κυκλοφορίᾳ λύσεως, ἀνασυνθέσεως καὶ ἐπανόδου.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεθοδολογικοῦ καὶ ἐπιτελεστικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ἀκολουθία τοῦ λόγου μιμεῖται τὴν γενετικὴν ἀκολουθίαν τῶν πραγμάτων καὶ ἀναγκάζεται εἰς ἐπανόδους.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ γεωμετρικὴ ἀνάγκη ἐνεργεῖ ὡς ἐσωτερικὸς μηχανισμὸς, ἀλλὰ ἡ τελικὴ ἑνότης ἐξακολουθεῖ νὰ ἀπαιτῇ ὑπερβατικώτερον ὅρον διατάξεως.
Ἡ πληρότης τοῦ κόσμου καὶ ἡ διείσδυσις τῶν στοιχείων συνιστῶσι παραγωγικὴν ἔντασιν, διότι τὸ διάκενον δὲν δύναται νὰ σημαίνῃ κενὸν.
Ἡ σφαιρικὴ καθολικότης καὶ ἡ πολλαπλότης ἀντιθετικῶν φυσικῶν φορῶν δὲν συμφιλιώνονται πλήρως, ἀλλὰ ἀναγκάζουσι τὸν τόπον νὰ νοηθῇ σχεσιακῶς.
Ἡ ἀκρίβεια τῆς μορφολογικῆς ἐξηγήσεως καὶ ἡ ἀδυναμία πλήρους μεταβάσεως εἰς φρόνησιν ἀφήνουσι ἀσθενῆ τὸν δεσμὸν μικροδομῆς καὶ γνώσεως.
Ἡ γεωμετρία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ περιγραφὴν εἰς ἐνεργὸν αἰτίαν, καὶ ἀπὸ αἰτίαν εἰς γενετικὴν λογικὴν ὅλου δικτύου.
Ἡ σχετικότης μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ σχέσιν σωματικῶν μορίων εἰς σχέσιν τόπου, φορᾶς, αἰσθήσεως, φρονήσεως καὶ ὀνόματος.
Ἡ τάξις μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ τελικὴ σταθερότητα εἰς συνεχή ἐπιτέλεσιν, ἣ χρειάζεται τὴν ἀνωμαλίαν ποὺ φαίνεται ἀρχικῶς νὰ ἀπειλῇ αὐτήν.
Ἡ πραγματικότης εἶναι πλήρης καὶ σφαιρικὴ μηχανὴ μορφοποιήσεως, πιέσεως, κυκλοφορίας, διαπερατότητος καὶ ἀνασυστάσεως.
Τὸ σῶμα εἶναι πρόσκαιρος κόμβος, ὅπου ἡ ταυτότης, ἡ ποιότης, ἡ αἴσθησις καὶ ἡ δύναμις ἀποτελοῦσι διαφορετικὰς ὄψεις τῆς αὐτῆς διατάξεως.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι σπειροειδὴς κυκλοφορία, ἐν ᾗ ἡ ἐπάνοδος δὲν ἀποκαθιστᾷ τὸ αὐτό, ἀλλὰ παράγει νέα φάσιν συστάσεως.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον δὲν δύναται νὰ σταθῇ ἐκτὸς τοῦ μηχανισμοῦ, ἀλλὰ δύναται νὰ μετατοπίζῃ σχέσεις διὰ ἀναγνώσεως, διαφυγῆς, ἀφομοιώσεως καὶ νέας συνθέσεως.
Ὁ κόσμος ὑπονοεῖται ὡς μηχανὴ ἧς ἡ ἑνότης δὲν ἐξαλείφει τὴν ἑτερότητα, ἀλλὰ τὴν μετατρέπει εἰς ὅρον τῆς συνεχείας της.
Τὰ ἀξιώματα τῆς μορφολογικῆς αἰτιότητος, τῆς παραγωγικῆς διαφορᾶς, τῆς ἀπουσίας κενοῦ, τῆς σχεσιακῆς ταυτότητος καὶ τῆς διαβαθμισμένης γνώσεως ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευὴν τῆς κεντρικῆς μηχανῆς.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι συνεκτικωτάτη ἐκεῖ ὅπου μορφή, ἀνομοιότης, πίεσις, εἴσοδος, λύσις καὶ ἀνασύνθεσις ἐνεργοῦσιν ὡς μία γενετικὴ ἀκολουθία.
Ὑποκαθορισμένα μένουσιν ἡ ἀρχὴ τῶν στοιχειωδῶν μορφῶν, ὁ μηχανισμὸς τῆς μεταβάσεως εἰς φρόνησιν, καὶ ὁ ἀποκλειστικὸς λόγος τῆς τελικῆς κοσμικῆς ἑνότητος.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευή διασῴζει τὴν πραγματικὴν κίνησιν μόνον ἐὰν διατηρῇ τὴν σπειροειδῆ ἐπάνοδον ἀπὸ τὸ φαινόμενον εἰς τὸν μηχανισμόν καὶ ἀπὸ τὸν μηχανισμὸν εἰς τὴν ὀνοματοθεσίαν.

Ἀντιστέκεται εἰς πλήρη ἀξιωματικὴν μείωσιν ἡ ἀνάγκη τῆς διαδοχῆς, τῆς εἰκαστικῆς συμπληρώσεως καὶ τῆς ἀποφατικῆς ἀναστολῆς, αἵτινες οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐλλείψεις ἔξωθεν τοῦ συστήματος ἀλλὰ ὅροι τῆς λειτουργίας του.
The system seeks to explain how multiplicity becomes cosmos, without genesis ending in formless flux or immobile order.
Geometry is transformed from a principle of static formation into a mechanism of relations that produces motion, resistance, mixture, affection, and sensation.
Order does not precede change, but is preserved through finite differentiations, pressures, dissolutions, and new compositions.
The absence of void renders the cosmos universally interwoven, so that every local entry, displacement, or force rearranges a network of relations.
The explanation ascends from bodies to affections and sensation, and returns to the correction of names through the mechanisms that produce them.
The final synthesis is a unified but non-homogeneous cosmos, in which the precision of relations coexists with limits of demonstration and partially open transitions.
[Persistent] Bodies are not self-subsistent substances, but temporary compositions of form, number, density, motion, and relation.
[Mutating] Geometrical form ceases to be merely the substrate of kind and becomes the cause of motion, power, affection, and natural direction.
[Persistent] Difference, inequality, and dissimilarity are the productive conditions of motion, conflict, and new composition.
[Persistent] The absence of void compels change to be reciprocal, pressurizing, locally transmissive, and universally circular.
[Mutating] Identity is maintained not through immobility, but through regulated recomposition, affinity, entry, and resistance.
[Emergent] Causality is distributed across scales: form produces motion, motion transmission, transmission affection, and affection can become sensation and naming.
[Emergent] Place is not an empty container, but a network of kindred directions, transmissions, resistances, and redistributions.
[Attractor] The order of the cosmos is dynamic preservation, which is sustained only because it reproduces the very presuppositions of difference.
[Attractor] Naming is a secondary judgment, which must follow natural structure and not replace the cause.
[Terminal] Universal unity does not entail one absolute system of places, directions, or qualities, but consists of many relative systems within a spherical order.
[Terminal] Explanation necessarily remains graded, because the generative mechanism can be reconstructed more precisely than the highest principles and the details of intelligence.
Motion retains its generative function, but shifts from cosmogonic separation to conflict, entry, transmission of affection, and natural direction.
Geometry mutates from an ontological criterion of bodies into a dynamic grammar of inequality and finally into an indirect model of sensation.
Identity is absorbed by relation: from the temporary unity of recomposable elements it becomes a node of pressures, places, times, and transmissions.
The absence of void remains a fixed exclusion, but its function expands from cosmic circulation to microphysical penetrability and sensory transmission.
Affinity is transformed from a condition of limited change into a principle of topological direction, assimilation, and distribution.
The common name initially performs an empirical function, but is finally subordinated to the scrutiny of the network of form, motion, and cause.
Precise constructions of triangles, solids, bases, and numerical proportions remain lower-level technical instruments.
Morphological causality is scaled up, because it connects the microstructure of bodies with cosmic motion, sensation, and linguistic judgment.
The absence of void, penetrability, and replenishment bridge the cosmic theory of circulation with the theory of melting, transmission, and affection.
The annulment of absolute above and below becomes a catalyst for a more general relativization of qualities, places, and names.
External divine ordering is recoded as internal coherence of relations, but is not wholly eliminated as a condition of supreme grounding.
Formless, immobile, and self-sufficient matter is rejected, because all matter already exists in formation, difference, and relation.
Change as generation from nothing or disorderly flux is rejected, because change signifies dissolution, entry, conflict, and recomposition of relations.
Absolute sameness is rejected, since without dissimilarity there is no power, transmission, natural direction, or sensation.
Place as an empty and universal framework of orientation is rejected, because place exists only through affinity, pressure, and direction.
The identification of name, quality, affection, and pleasure as one indivisible datum is rejected.
The identification of mathematical possibility, physical existence, and complete demonstration is rejected.
It must be false that things preexist processes, because body, quality, and identity are results of generative relations.
It must be false that a single principle can explain nature, because causality is distributed among form, number, motion, place, pressure, and transmission.
It must be false that external contact suffices for change, because entering or resisting is determined by internal arrangement.
The hypothesis that experience automatically provides its own cause must be excluded, because recognition presupposes the mediation of bodies and intelligence.
It must be false that nature can be expounded simultaneously and equally at every scale.
The deepest absent possibility is a cosmos in which unity would mean homogeneity, and difference the pure dissolution of order.
Absent is a universal map that would define place, quality, affection, and meaning absolutely without the relations that produce them.
Complete and simultaneous knowledge of the whole is absent, because the whole operates as a succession of transformations and not as a present immobile object.
Exit into an absolute outside is prohibited, because every escape is a transition into another composition, power, and relation.
Finite geometrical formation and the circular reproduction of differences combine into a cosmos in which form does not limit motion but determines the modes of its production.
The absence of void and the penetrability of interstices constitute, rather than a contradiction, a mechanism whereby fullness makes entry causally constrained.
The transition from elemental motion to sensation compels causality to become hierarchical transmission and not mere local impact.
The annulment of absolute place and the annulment of self-subsistent quality constitute one and the same relational principle.

The necessary reconstruction of relations and the conjectural character of the ultimate details define knowledge that is precise with respect to mechanisms, but not sovereign with respect to every foundation.
Reality becomes a finite generative topology, in which beings are nodes of changing relations and not independent units.
Time becomes an internal mode of matter, because it signifies dissolution, aging, circulation, displacement, and restoration of compositions.
The ontology of the body extends into a theory of the sentient being, so that the subject becomes an intracosmic node of transmission and recognition.
Science is transformed from a classification of things into a reconstruction of transitions, while language becomes a field for scrutinizing explanatory levels.
The unity of the cosmos is not universal uniformity, but the capacity of a network to connect asymmetrical kinds, local directions, and distinct affections.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Form → dissimilarity → power → conflict → dissolution → new form; the loop transforms geometry into a self-reproducing physical mechanism.
Fullness → replenishment → pressure → entry → rearrangement → new fullness; the absence of void acts as a loop of universal interdependence.
Affection of body → transmission or isolation → sensation or insensibility → examination of cause → new determination of affection.
Empirical name → mechanistic reduction → relational definition → correction of name; language returns to itself already transformed.
The principal attractor is the principle that order is preserved only when it contains, determines, and reproduces the difference that it excludes as disorderly.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Unmeasured multiplicity → finite formation → elemental affinity and asymmetry.
Geometrical difference → dissimilarity → power, resistance, pressure, and circulation.
Fullness of the cosmos → penetrable interstices → entry or resistance → dissolution, melting, solidification, or new mixture.
Bodily rearrangement → transmission of affection → sensation and experience → revision of naming.
Relational place → multiple natural directions → abolition of absolute directions → unity through differential networks.
Mechanical necessity → conjectural supplementation → graded knowledge, which keeps the generative structure open.
Disorderly multiplicity → geometrical distinction → finite kinds and affinities.
Finite kinds → inequality and dissimilarity → conflict, dissolution, escape, and recomposition.
Recomposition → penetrability and pressure → affections, sensible qualities, and functional names.
Affection and transmission → sensation or insensibility → intracosmic intelligence and examination of cause.
Spherical unity → multiple kindred places → relational revision of weight, lightness, above, and below.
Relational physics → rejection of absolutes → open and graded discourse concerning one dynamically continuous cosmos.
Matter is reclassified from substrate into a network of formed, penetrable, and causally interdependent compositions.
The distinction between micro-scale and macro-scale ceases to be absolute, because microstructure operates as a mechanism of cosmic motion and experience.
The opposition between stability and change collapses, because stable form is a temporary regulation within circulation.
Place is transformed from an inert framework into a produced field of natural directions, affinities, and resistances.
Sensation becomes a proper level of physics, which neither separates from the body nor identifies with pleasure and pain.
The reading of names becomes a method of reconstructing mechanisms, not an acceptance of apparent categories.
At the surface level, hot, cold, hard, soft, heavy, light, melting, flux, and sensation appear as problems of physical explanation.
At the structural level, form, proportion, interstices, pressure, affinity, resistance, and transmission constitute the mechanism of phenomena.
At the metastrategic level, discourse shifts from the description of objects and names to the reconstruction of mechanisms and transitions.
At the ontological and temporal level, being is a temporary equilibrium in a circulation of dissolution, recomposition, and return.
At the methodological and performative level, the sequence of discourse imitates the generative sequence of things and is compelled into returns.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Geometrical necessity operates as an internal mechanism, but final unity continues to require a more transcendent condition of arrangement.
The fullness of the cosmos and the penetration of elements constitute a productive tension, because the interstice cannot signify void.
Spherical universality and the multiplicity of opposing natural directions are not fully reconciled, but compel place to be conceived relationally.
The precision of morphological explanation and the inability fully to transition to intelligence leave weak the bond between microstructure and knowledge.
Geometry mutates from description into active cause, and from cause into the generative logic of an entire network.
Relativity mutates from a relation of bodily parts into a relation of place, direction, sensation, intelligence, and name.
Order mutates from final stability into continuous enactment, which requires the irregularity that initially appears to threaten it.
Reality is a full and spherical mechanism of formation, pressure, circulation, penetrability, and recomposition.
The body is a temporary node, where identity, quality, sensation, and power constitute different aspects of the same arrangement.
Time is spiral circulation, in which return does not restore the same thing, but produces a new phase of composition.
The subject cannot stand outside the mechanism, but can displace relations through recognition, escape, assimilation, and new composition.
The cosmos is implied as a mechanism whose unity does not eliminate otherness, but transforms it into a condition of its continuity.
The axioms of morphological causality, productive difference, the absence of void, relational identity, and graded knowledge suffice for reconstruction of the central mechanism.
The architecture is most coherent where form, dissimilarity, pressure, entry, dissolution, and recomposition operate as one generative sequence.
The origin of elementary forms, the mechanism of transition to intelligence, and the exclusive rationale of final cosmic unity remain underdetermined.
The reconstruction preserves real movement only if it retains the spiral return from phenomenon to mechanism and from mechanism to naming.

Resisting complete axiomatic reduction is the necessity of succession, conjectural supplementation, and apophatic suspension, which are not deficiencies external to the system but conditions of its operation.

items.text: Τὸ σύστημα ζητεῖ νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ πῶς τὰ αἰσθητὰ, τὰ ψυχικὰ καὶ τὰ σωματικὰ φαινόμενα γίγνεται ἐκ σχέσεων καὶ μεταβολῶν, οὐκ ἐκ αὐτοτελῶν ποιοτήτων ἢ οὐσιῶν.
Ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς σχεσιακῆς γενέσεως κλιμακοῦται εἰς ἀρχὴν ἱεραρχικῆς τάξεως, καθ᾽ ἣν αἱ διαφοραὶ οὐκ ἐξαλείφονται ἀλλὰ διανέμονται κατὰ λειτουργίαν.
Τὸ σῶμα γίνεται ὁ γενικὸς τόπος ὅπου κίνησις, πάθος, σημεῖον, ὄργανον, ἠθικὴ ῥύθμισις καὶ νοερὸς σκοπὸς συνδέονται.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη οὔτε ἀναιρεῖται οὔτε κυριαρχεῖ τελικῶς, ἀλλὰ γίνεται ὕλη, ὄργανον καὶ ὅριον προνοητικῆς συνθέσεως.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια δὲν δίδοται δι᾽ ἀμέσου παρουσίας, ἀλλὰ διὰ μεταγραφῶν σώματος, παθῶν, σημείων, ἑρμηνείας καὶ κανόνων κρίσεως.
Ἡ ἀτέλεια μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ στέρησιν εἰς παραγωγικὸν ὅρον, διότι ἡ ἀδυναμία, ἡ θνητότης καὶ ἡ ἀνεπάρκεια γεννῶσι μεσολαβήσεις, περιορισμοὺς καὶ νέας δυνάμεις.
Ὁ χρόνος παύει νὰ εἶναι ἐξωτερικὸν μέτρον, διότι ρυθμὸς, καθυστέρησις, ἐπιστροφή καὶ μέλλουσα χρῆσις συγκροτοῦσι τὴν αἰτίαν τῆς παρούσης μορφῆς.
Ἡ κατάληξις εἶναι ἀνοικτὴ συνεκτικὴ μηχανή: ἡ τάξις διατηρεῖται μόνον διὰ συνεχοῦς συνθέσεως, ἑρμηνείας, μετριασμοῦ καὶ ἐπανιδρύσεως.
[Persistent] Τὸ φαινόμενον παράγεται ἐκ σχέσεως κινήσεων, σωμάτων, ὀργάνων καὶ μέτρων, οὐκ ἐκ αὐτοτελοῦς ποιότητος.
[Persistent] Τὸ σῶμα εἶναι ἐνεργὸς μετασχηματιστὴς, μεταφραστὴς καὶ ῥυθμιστὴς τῶν δυνάμεων αἳ εἰσέρχονται εἰς αὐτό.
[Mutating] Ἡ σχέσις μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ αἰσθητικὴν ἀντίδρασιν εἰς κοσμικὴν, ψυχικὴν καὶ ἀνατομικὴν ἀρχιτεκτονικήν.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἑνότης οὐκ ἔστιν ὁμοιογένεια, ἀλλὰ ἱεραρχημένη σύνθεσις διαφορῶν τόπων, βαθμῶν καὶ λειτουργιῶν.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀνάγκη εἶναι ἀναγκαία συναιτία, ἀλλὰ στερεῖται τελικῆς κυριότητος ἐφ᾽ ὅσον ὑπάγεται εἰς ὀργάνωσιν καὶ σκοπόν.
[Emergent] Ἡ μεσολάβησις εἶναι ὁ καθολικὸς νόμος τῆς κυβερνήσεως, τῆς γνῶσεως καὶ τῆς ζωτικῆς συνοχῆς.
[Attractor] Ἡ τάξις παράγεται διὰ διοικήσεως τῆς συγκρούσεως καὶ οὐ διὰ τῆς ἐξαλείψεως τῶν ἀντιθέσεων.
[Mutating] Τὸ ὄργανον μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ τοπικὸν μέρος εἰς κόμβον μεταδόσεως, σημάνσεως, πειθαρχίας καὶ ἱεραρχικῆς ἐπικοινωνίας.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἀλήθεια εἶναι κατανεμημένη διαδικασία, ἐν ᾗ πάθος, σημεῖον, ὄργανον καὶ ἑρμηνευτὴς οὐ δύνανται νὰ συγχωνευθῶσιν εἰς μίαν ἄμεσον κρίσιν.
[Persistent] Ἡ θνητὴ ὕπαρξις διατηρεῖται διὰ ἀντισταθμίσεως, περιορισμοῦ καὶ ἐλεγχόμενης ἀνεπαρκείας.
[Mutating] Ὁ χρόνος γίνεται αἰτιακὴ διάστασις, καθ᾽ ἣν ὁ ρυθμὸς μορφοῖ τὸ παρόν καὶ ἡ μέλλουσα χρῆσις προκατασκευάζει τὴν μορφήν.
[Terminal] Ἡ τελεία αὐτάρκεια τοῦ σώματος, τῆς γνώσεως καὶ τῆς τάξεως ἀποκλείεται· ἀντὶ ταύτης ὑπάρχει διαρκὴς ἐπανίδρυσις μερικῶς ἐλεγχόμενων σχέσεων.
Ἡ κίνησις ἐπαναλαμβάνεται ἐν αἰσθήσει, κράσει καὶ ἀνατομίᾳ, ἀλλὰ μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ τοπικὴν μετάδοσιν εἰς καθολικὴν παραγωγὴν μορφῆς.
Ἡ κράσις μεταναστεύει ἀπὸ φυσικὴν ἐξήγησιν εἰς σχήμα κοσμήσεως, καὶ ἐκεῖθεν εἰς ἱεραρχικὴν διοίκησιν ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη διατηρεῖ τὴν αἰτιακὴν ἐνέργειαν, ἀλλὰ ἀναστρέφει τὴν ἀξίαν αὐτῆς, γιγνομένη πόρος καὶ ὑπηρεσία τῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ ἀφροσύνη μετατρέπεται ἀπὸ στέρησιν κρίσεως εἰς ἀτελῆ φορέα σημείων, ἀλλὰ δὲν γίνεται αὐτόνομος πηγή ἀληθείας.
Ἡ ἀνεπάρκεια μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ ἔλλειψιν εἰς γενετικὴν δύναμιν, διότι ἡ στέρησις ἑνὸς ἀγαθοῦ καθιστᾷ δυνατὴν ἑτέραν λειτουργίαν.
Ἡ προστασία ἀποσπᾶται ἀπὸ τὸ ἐξωτερικὸν περίβλημα καὶ γίνεται ἐσωτερικὴ ἀρχὴ διαφορᾶς, περιορισμοῦ καὶ λειτουργικῆς διαβαθμίσεως.
Ἡ ἀβεβαιότης δὲν ἐξαλείφεται, ἀλλὰ ἀπορροφᾶται εἰς ἑρμηνευτικὸν κανόνα, ὅστις διατηρεῖ τὴν διάκρισιν μεταξὺ ὑλικοῦ σημείου καὶ ἀληθοῦς κρίσεως.
Ἡ ἀρχικὴ διάκρισις νοῦ καὶ σώματος καταργεῖται ὡς ἀπόλυτος χωρισμός καὶ διασῴζεται ὡς ἱεραρχημένη μετάφρασις μεταξὺ ἀοράτου καὶ ὑλικοῦ.
Αἱ τοπικαὶ διακρίσεις γεύσεων, χρωμάτων, ἥπατος, ὀστέων καὶ δερμάτων παραμένουσιν ὑπηρετικὰ παραδείγματα, ἐφ᾽ ὅσον δὲν ἐκτίθενται ὡς καθολικὰ σχήματα σχέσεως.
Ἡ σχεσιακὴ γένεσις κλιμακοῦται εἰς καθολικὴν ἀρχήν μόνον ὅταν συνδέῃ αἴσθησιν, κοσμικὴν τάξιν, ψυχικὴν ἱεραρχίαν καὶ σωματικὴν κατασκευήν.
Ἡ τελεολογία παύει νὰ εἶναι τοπικὴ προσθήκη, ὅταν ἐξηγῇ τὴν ὑπαγωγὴν φυσικῶν συναιτίων, σωματικῶν περιορισμῶν καὶ μελλοντικῶν χρειῶν εἰς κοινὸν τέλος.
Ἡ μαντικὴ λειτουργία γίνεται γέφυρα τοῦ συστήματος μόνον ὅταν ἀναγνωσθῇ ὡς ὑπόδειγμα διαμεσολαβημένης ἀληθείας καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς μεμονωμένη θεία ἀποκάλυψις.
Ἡ ἀντισταθμιστικὴ κατασκευή γίνεται καταλύτης μεταβάσεως, διότι μεταφέρει τὸ σῶμα ἀπὸ τὴν μηχανικὴ περιγραφήν εἰς ἀξιακὴν ἱεράρχησιν.
Ἡ πλήρης ποσολογικὴ ἀκρίβεια ὑποχωρεῖ ὡς τελικὸ κριτήριον, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἀναλογία παραμένει ἀναγκαία ὡς ὅριον καὶ μέσον τῆς ἀνακατασκευῆς.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ αὐτοτελὴς ποιότης, διότι πᾶν αἰσθητὸν καὶ πᾶσα λειτουργία ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ κίνησιν, σχέσιν καὶ ὄργανον.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ μονόδρομος καὶ αὐτάρκης αἰτιότης, διότι ἡ γένεσις ἀπαιτεῖ σύμπραξιν, ἀντίδρασιν, μετάδοσιν καὶ διαβάθμισιν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἄμεσος κοινωνία νοῦ, σώματος, ἀλόγου καὶ ἀληθείας, διότι ἡ τάξις λειτουργεῖ μόνον διὰ ἐνδιάμεσων μηχανῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ἁρμονία ὡς ἀπουσία συγκρούσεως, διότι ἡ συνοχὴ παράγεται διὰ χαλιναγωγήσεως καὶ ἀντισταθμίσεως τῶν ἀντιμαχομένων δυνάμεων.
Ἀποκλείεται τὸ ὁμοιογενὲς καὶ ἀδιαβάθμητον σῶμα, διότι ἡ διαφοροποίησις εἶναι ὁ ὅρος τῆς κινήσεως, τῆς αἰσθήσεως καὶ τῆς φρονήσεως.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ πλήρης αὐτάρκεια τοῦ θνητοῦ, διότι πᾶσα διατήρησις ἀπαιτεῖ φθοράν, περιορισμόν, ἀναβολὴν καὶ συνεχεῖς διορθώσεις.
Εἰ ἡ ὕλη ἢ ἡ ἀνάγκη ἦν αὐτάρκης ἀρχή, οὔτε ἡ ἱεραρχία οὔτε ἡ τελικὴ σύνθεσις θὰ εἶχον ἀναγκαῖον ἔργον.
Εἰ ἡ ψυχὴ ἦν ὁμογενὴς καὶ ὁ νοῦς ἄμεσος, ἡ σωματικὴ μεσολάβησις, τὸ σημεῖον καὶ ὁ ἑρμηνευτὴς θὰ ἦσαν περιττά.
Εἰ ἡ ἀνεπάρκεια ἦν μόνον κακόν, οὐδεμία ἀντιστάθμισις θὰ ἠδύνατο νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ τὴν γένεσιν φρονήσεως, κινήσεως καὶ αἰσθήσεως.
Εἰ ἡ φυσιολογία ἐγγυᾶτο αὐτομάτως τὴν ἀλήθειαν, ἡ διάκρισις μεταξὺ σημείου, ὑποθέσεως, κρίσεως καὶ θείας κυρώσεως θὰ κατέρρεεν.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἀλήθεια εἴη καθαρὰ παρουσία ἀνεξάρτητος σώματος, πάθους, σημείου καὶ ἑρμηνείας.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἑνότης ἐγγίγνεται ἄνευ ἀσυμμετρίας, μεσολαβήσεως καὶ διοικήσεως τῶν κατωτέρων δυνάμεων.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ τὸ θνητὸν σῶμα ἅμα κτᾶται ἀπόλυτον ἰσχύν, ἀσφάλειαν, αἴσθησιν, φρόνησιν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν.
Τὸ σύστημα κυκλοῖ τὴν ἀπουσίαν ἀμέσου ἀρχῆς, διότι πᾶσα κυριότης ὀφείλει νὰ ἐνσαρκωθῇ εἰς ὄργανα, ὅρια καὶ διαδικασίας μεταγραφῆς.
Ἡ αἴσθησις, ἡ κοσμικὴ τάξις καὶ ἡ σωματικὴ μορφὴ εἰσὶν τρεῖς κλίμακες τοῦ αὐτοῦ μηχανισμοῦ, καθ᾽ ὃν ἡ σχέσις παράγει φαινόμενον διὰ διαφορᾶς καὶ μεσολαβήσεως.
Ἡ προνοητικὴ τάξις δὲν ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὴν φυσικὴν αἰτιότητα, ἀλλὰ μετατρέπει τὰ φυσικὰ πάθη εἰς ἐντεταγμένα μέσα διατηρήσεως καὶ κυβερνήσεως.
Ἡ ἐρμηνεία καὶ ἡ ὀργανικὴ ῥύθμισις ἀποτελοῦσιν ὁμόλογα ἔργα, διότι ἀμφότεραι μετατρέπουσιν ἀδιαμόρφωτον πάθος εἰς λειτουργικῶς περιορισμένην τάξιν.
Ἡ ἀτέλεια γίνεται ὁ κοινὸς μηχανισμὸς τῆς γνώσεως καὶ τῆς ζωῆς, διότι ἡ ἀδυναμία κρίσεως γεννᾷ ἑρμηνείαν, ἐνῶ ἡ ὑλικὴ ἀδυναμία γεννᾷ ἀντιστάθμισιν.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία εἶναι ὁ τρόπος καθ᾽ ὃν ἡ ἑνότης διατηρεῖ τὴν διαφοράν δίχως νὰ παραδίδεται εἰς αὐτονομίαν τῶν μερῶν.
Ἡ μελλοντικὴ χρῆσις καὶ ὁ ἐρμηνευτικὸς χρόνος συγκροτοῦσιν κοινὴν ἀναδρομικὴν αἰτιότητα, καθ᾽ ἣν τὸ μὴ παρὸν μορφοῖ τὴν παροῦσαν διάταξιν.
Ἡ ἀξίωσις προνοητικῆς τάξεως καὶ ἡ ἐπιμονὴ τῆς φθορᾶς συγκροτοῦσιν παραγωγικὴν ἔντασιν, διότι ἡ πρόνοια φαίνεται ὡς ῥύθμισις θνητότητος καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς ἄρνησις αὐτῆς.
Ἡ πραγματικότης ἀνασυντίθεται ὡς πολυεπίπεδον δίκτυον μεταφράσεων, ἐν ᾧ τὸ αἰσθητόν, τὸ ψυχικόν, τὸ ἠθικὸν καὶ τὸ σωματικὸν εἰσὶν ἀμοιβαῖαι φάσεις γενέσεως.
Ἡ γνώσις ἀνασχηματίζεται ὡς τέχνη ἀνακατασκευῆς καὶ κρίσεως σχέσεων, οὐχὶ ὡς κατοχὴ αὐτοφανοῦς περιεχομένου.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ καὶ ἠθικὴ τάξις ἐνσωματοῦται, διότι ἡ διακυβέρνησις τῶν παθῶν καὶ ἡ κατανομή τῶν ὀργάνων εἰσὶν ὁμόλογες ἐκφάνσεις μιᾶς ἱεραρχικῆς μηχανῆς.
Ἡ θνητότης παύει νὰ σημαίνῃ ἁπλῶς ἔλλειψιν καὶ γίνεται ὁ τόπος ὅπου προκύπτουσιν ἀνάγκη ἐρμηνείας, ὀργανικὴ παιδεία καὶ προνοητικὴ ἀναστολή.
Ἡ ἐλευθερία δὲν εἶναι ἀπαλλαγὴ ἀπὸ ὅρους, ἀλλὰ ὀρθὴ πλοήγησις διὰ μεσολαβήσεων, περιορισμῶν καὶ διαβαθμίσεων.
Ἡ τελεολογία γίνεται ἀναδρομικὴ λογικὴ, διότι ἡ μελλοντικὴ χρεία ἐνεργεῖ ἐν τῇ παρούσῃ κατασκευῇ χωρὶς νὰ ἐξαλείφῃ τὰ φυσικὰ αἴτια.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Ποιότης → μηχανικὴ ἀνάλυσις → σχέσις → νέον φαινόμενον· ἡ ἐξήγησις ἐπαναχαράσσει τὸ ἐξηγούμενον.
Μίξις → διαφορά → σύνθεσις → ἱεράρχησις → νέα διαίρεσις· ἡ ἑνότης παράγει τὴν πολλαπλότητα ἣν πάλιν διοικεῖ.
Θεία διάταξις → σωματικὴ μετάφρασις → πάθος καὶ σημεῖον → ἑρμηνεία → ἐπανενέργεια τῆς λογικῆς ἀρχῆς.
Προστασία → στερεότης → ἀκαμψία → μεσολάβησις → κίνησις → νέα ἀνάγκη προστασίας· ἡ λύσις μιᾶς ἀνεπαρκείας γεννᾷ τὴν ἑπομένην.
Ἀβεβαιότης → εἰκὼς λόγος → διάκρισις → ἀναζήτησις κυρώσεως → διατήρησις τῆς ἀβεβαιότητος· ἡ ἔλλειψις βεβαιότητος γίνεται μέθοδος.
Ὁ ἑλκυστὴς τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι ἡ ἱεραρχικὴ μεσολάβησις, ἣ ἐπανέρχεται ὡς σχέσις, κράσις, ὄργανον, ἐρμηνεία, διοίκησις καὶ τελικὴ διάταξις.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Δύναμις ἢ ἀνάγκη προσβάλλει ὕλην, καὶ ἡ ὕλη ἀντιδρᾷ διὰ κινήσεως, κράσεως καὶ διαφορᾶς.
Ἡ ἀντίδρασις διανέμεται εἰς ὄργανα καὶ μέρη, ὥστε τὸ πάθος νὰ γίνηται αἴσθησις, μορφή, σήμα ἢ περιορισμὸς.
Ἡ διαφοροποιημένη λειτουργία ὑπάγεται εἰς ἱεραρχίαν, ἣ μετατρέπει τὴν πολλαπλότητα εἰς διατηρήσιμον ἑνότητα.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία ἀπαιτεῖ μεσολαβητικὰ ὄργανα, ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀρχὴ οὐ δύναται νὰ ἐνεργῇ ἀμέσως ἐπὶ τῶν κατωτέρων δυνάμεων.
Ἡ μεσολάβησις παράγει σημεῖα καὶ ὅρια, καὶ τὰ σημεῖα ἀπαιτοῦσιν ἑρμηνείαν πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν λογικῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ προνοητικὴ σύνθεσις οὐκ ἀναιρεῖ τὴν θνητὴν ἀτέλειαν, ἀλλὰ μετατρέπει αὐτὴν εἰς ὅρον ῥυθμίσεως, διατηρήσεως καὶ μελλοντικῆς χρήσεως.
Αἰσθητὴ ποιότης → σωματικὴ κίνησις καὶ πάθος → σχεσιακὴ γένεσις φαινομένου.
Σχεσιακὴ γένεσις → κράσις καὶ διαφορά → κοσμικὴ σύνθεσις καὶ ἱεραρχία.
Ἱεραρχία → σωματικὴ μεσολάβησις → πάθος καὶ σημεῖον → ἑρμηνευτικὴ κρίσις.
Σωματικὴ ἀνεπάρκεια → ἀντιστάθμισις καὶ διαφοροποίησις → κίνησις, αἴσθησις καὶ φρόνησις.
Ἑρμηνεία καὶ ἀντιστάθμισις → προνοητικὴ ῥύθμισις → ἀνοικτὴ τάξις διὰ συνεχοῦς ἐπανιδρύσεως.
Τὸ πεδίον τῶν αἰσθήσεων, τῆς ψυχῆς καὶ τῆς ἀνατομίας ἀναχαράσσεται ἀπὸ κατάλογον οὐσιῶν εἰς χάρτην μεταδόσεων, σχέσεων καὶ μετασχηματισμῶν.
Ἡ διάκρισις φύσεως καὶ ἠθικῆς καταρρεῖ, διότι ἡ βιολογικὴ λειτουργία ἤδη φέρει κανόνα περιορισμοῦ, σκοποῦ καὶ διατηρήσεως.
Ἡ διάκρισις ὕλης καὶ νοῦ ἀντικαθίσταται ὑπὸ διαβαθμισμένης μεταγραφῆς, ἐν ᾗ ἡ ὕλη σημαίνει καὶ ὁ νοῦς ἐνσαρκώνεται.
Ὁ χρόνος ἀναταξινομεῖται ἀπὸ πλαίσιον γεγονότων εἰς ἐνεργὸν αἴτιον ρυθμοῦ, ἀναβολῆς, γενέσεως καὶ προνοητικῆς προδιατάξεως.
Νέος τρόπος ἀναγνώσεως καθίσταται ἀναγκαῖος: ὁ ἐξεταστὴς ὀφείλει νὰ παρακολουθῇ μεσολαβήσεις, μεταβολὰς, ὅρια καὶ ἱεραρχικὰς μεταφράσεις.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ σύστημα πραγματεύεται αἰσθήσεις, χρώματα, ἧπαρ, τροφήν, μυελόν, ὀστᾶ, σάρκας, δέρμα καὶ κεφαλήν.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὰ φαινόμενα εἰσὶ δίκτυα κινήσεων, κράσεων, μεταδόσεων, ὀργάνων, διαφορῶν καὶ ἀντισταθμίσεων.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ὀρθὴ διοίκησις δὲν καταστρέφει τὰ κατώτερα μέρη, ἀλλὰ τὰ μεταβάλλει εἰς δεδεμένα καὶ λειτουργικὰ ὄργανα.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ ὂν εἶναι γεγονὸς διαρκῶς παραγομένης σχέσεως, καθ᾽ ἣν ἀνάγκη, σκοπός, φθορά καὶ μέλλον συμπλέκονται.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεθοδολογικοῦ καὶ ἐπιτελεστικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ὁ λόγος μιμεῖται τὴν ἰδίαν μηχανὴν ἣν ἐξηγεῖ, συνάγων διεσπαρμένα μέρη εἰς ἱεραρχικὴν συνοχήν ἄνευ ἀπολύτου κλεισίματος.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ τελεολογικὴ κυριότης ἀπαιτεῖ τὰ φυσικὰ αἴτια ὡς πραγματικῶς ἐνεργὰ, ἀλλὰ δὲν δύναται νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ πλήρως πῶς ἡ ὑποταγὴ αὐτῶν διασῴζει τὴν αὐτονομίαν τῆς μηχανικῆς.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια ἀπαιτεῖ τὴν ἀδυναμίαν τοῦ πάσχοντος φορέως, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἀδυναμία αὕτη ταυτοχρόνως ἀπειλεῖ τὴν ἀξιοπιστίαν τοῦ σημείου.
Ἡ φρόνησις τίθεται ὡς ὑψηλότερον τέλος, ἀλλὰ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ ὑλικὴν ἀδυναμίαν καὶ μειωμένην προστασίαν, ἃ δύνανται νὰ ἀπειλήσωσι τὴν ἴδιαν αὐτῆς διατήρησιν.
Ἡ ἑνότης διασῴζεται μόνον δι᾽ ἀνίσων μερῶν, ὥστε ἡ συνοχὴ τῆς ὅλης τάξεως νὰ προϋποτίθεται ἀσύμμετρον κυριότητα.
Ἡ ποιότης μεταλλάσσεται εἰς δύναμιν καὶ λειτουργίαν, ὅταν τὸ ἐρώτημα περὶ τοῦ τί ἐστιν ἀντικαθίσταται ὑπὸ τοῦ τί ποιεῖ ἐν σχέσει πρὸς ἕτερον.
Ἡ μεσολάβησις μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ τεχνικὴν ἀνάγκην μετάδοσης εἰς καθολικὸν σχήμα μεταγραφῆς μεταξὺ θείας τάξεως, ψυχῆς, σώματος καὶ ἀληθείας.
Ἡ ἔλλειψις μεταλλάσσεται εἰς θετικὴν ἀρχήν, ὅταν ἡ ἀνεπάρκεια ἑνὸς στοιχείου γίνηται προϋπόθεσις λειτουργίας ἑτέρου.
Ἡ πραγματικότης εἶναι μηχανὴ διαβαθμισμένων μεταδόσεων, ἐν ᾗ πᾶσα δύναμις λαμβάνει μορφὴν μόνον διὰ ἀντιστάσεως, μέτρου καὶ ὀργάνου.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον εἶναι ἱεραρχημένος κόμβος λόγου, πάθους, ἀλόγου καὶ σώματος, οὔτε αὐτοκράτωρ τῶν φαινομένων οὔτε παθητικὸς καθρέπτης.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι ἐπιστρεπτικὴ καὶ προνοιακὴ ἀκολουθία, ἐν ᾗ ῥυθμοί, καθυστερήσεις, φθοραὶ καὶ μέλλουσαι χρεῖαι διαμορφοῦσι τὸ παρόν.
Ἡ δυνατὴ διαφυγὴ εἶναι πλοήγησις καὶ ἀναδιάταξις τῶν μηχανισμῶν, οὐχὶ ἔξοδος ἐκ σώματος, ἀνάγκης ἢ μεσολαβήσεως.

Αἱ ἀρχαὶ τῆς σχεσιακῆς γενέσεως, τῆς ἱεραρχικῆς συνθέσεως, τῆς σωματικῆς μεσολαβήσεως, τῆς προνοητικῆς ἀνάγκης καὶ τῆς παραγωγικῆς ἀτελείας ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνασύστασιν τῆς κύριας κινήσεως τοῦ συστήματος.
Ἡ ἀνασύστασις διασῴζει τὴν κίνησιν ἀπὸ τὴν αἴσθησιν πρὸς τὴν σχέσιν, ἀπὸ τὴν σχέσιν πρὸς τὴν ἱεραρχίαν, καὶ ἀπὸ τὴν ἱεραρχίαν πρὸς τὴν ἐνσώματον ἐρμηνείαν.
Ὑποκαθορισμένα μένει ὁ ἀκριβὴς μηχανισμὸς τῶν μεταδόσεων, ἡ ἀναλογία φυσιολογίας καὶ συμβόλου, καὶ ὁ τρόπος καθ᾽ ὃν ἡ τελικὴ διάνοια ἐπιλέγει μεταξὺ συγκρουομένων ἀγαθῶν.
Τὸ σύστημα εἶναι συνεκτικὸν καθ᾽ ὅσον ἡ ἀβεβαιότης, ἡ ἀναλογία καὶ ἡ ἀτέλεια νοοῦνται ὡς συστατικοὶ ὅροι καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς ἁπλᾶ κενά.
Ἰσχυρότατον μέρος τῆς ἀρχιτεκτονικῆς εἶναι ἡ ἱεραρχικὴ μεσολάβησις· ἀσθενέστατον δὲ ἡ πλήρης μετάβασις ἀπὸ ποσοτικὴν καὶ μηχανικὴν αἰτίαν εἰς ποιοτικὴν καὶ τελεολογικὴν μορφήν.
The system seeks to explain how sensible, psychic, and bodily phenomena come to be from relations and changes, not from self-subsisting qualities or substances.
The principle of relational generation is escalated into a principle of hierarchical order, according to which differences are not eliminated but distributed according to function.
The body becomes the general locus where motion, affection, sign, instrument, ethical regulation, and intellectual purpose are connected.
Necessity is neither abolished nor ultimately sovereign, but becomes matter, instrument, and limit of providential composition.
Truth is not given through immediate presence, but through transcriptions of body, affections, signs, interpretation, and rules of judgment.
Imperfection is transformed from privation into a productive condition, because weakness, mortality, and insufficiency generate mediations, limitations, and new powers.
Time ceases to be an external measure, because rhythm, delay, return, and future use constitute the cause of present form.
The conclusion is an open coherent mechanism: order is maintained only through continuous composition, interpretation, moderation, and refoundation.
[Persistent] The phenomenon is produced from the relation of motions, bodies, instruments, and measures, not from a self-subsisting quality.
[Persistent] The body is an active transformer, translator, and regulator of the powers that enter into it.
[Mutating] Relation changes from sensory reaction into cosmic, psychic, and anatomical architecture.
[Persistent] Unity is not homogeneity, but a hierarchized composition of different places, degrees, and functions.
[Persistent] Necessity is a necessary co-cause, but lacks final sovereignty insofar as it is subordinated to organization and purpose.
[Emergent] Mediation is the universal law of governance, knowledge, and vital cohesion.
[Attractor] Order is produced through the administration of conflict and not through the elimination of oppositions.
[Mutating] The instrument changes from a local part into a node of transmission, signification, discipline, and hierarchical communication.
[Emergent] Truth is a distributed process, in which affection, sign, instrument, and interpreter cannot be fused into a single immediate judgment.
[Persistent] Mortal existence is maintained through compensation, limitation, and controlled insufficiency.
[Mutating] Time becomes a causal dimension, in which rhythm shapes the present and future use preconstructs form.
[Terminal] Complete self-sufficiency of body, knowledge, and order is excluded; in its place there is a continual refoundation of partially controlled relations.
Motion recurs in sensation, mixture, and anatomy, but changes from local transmission into universal production of form.
Mixture migrates from physical explanation into a schema of adornment, and thence into hierarchical governance of soul and body.
Necessity retains its causal efficacy, but reverses its value, becoming a resource and service of order.
Unreason is transformed from a privation of judgment into an imperfect bearer of signs, but does not become an autonomous source of truth.
Insufficiency changes from deficiency into a generative power, because the privation of one good makes another function possible.
Protection is detached from the external covering and becomes an internal principle of difference, limitation, and functional gradation.
Uncertainty is not eliminated, but absorbed into an interpretive rule that preserves the distinction between material sign and true judgment.
The original distinction between intellect and body is abolished as an absolute separation and preserved as a hierarchized translation between the invisible and the material.
The local distinctions of tastes, colors, liver, bones, and skins remain subordinate examples, insofar as they are not set forth as universal schemas of relation.
Relational generation is escalated into a universal principle only when it connects sensation, cosmic order, psychic hierarchy, and bodily construction.
Teleology ceases to be a local addition when it explains the subordination of natural co-causes, bodily limitations, and future needs to a common end.
Divinatory function becomes a bridge of the system only when it is read as a model of mediated truth and not as an isolated divine revelation.
Compensatory construction becomes a catalyst of transition, because it carries the body from mechanical description into evaluative hierarchization.
Complete quantitative precision recedes as a final criterion, but proportion remains necessary as the limit and means of reconstruction.
Self-subsisting quality is excluded, because every sensible thing and every function depends on motion, relation, and instrument.
One-way and self-sufficient causality is excluded, because generation requires cooperation, reaction, transmission, and gradation.
Immediate communion of intellect, body, the irrational, and truth is excluded, because order operates only through intermediate mechanisms.
Harmony as the absence of conflict is excluded, because cohesion is produced through the restraint and compensation of contending powers.
The homogeneous and ungraded body is excluded, because differentiation is the condition of motion, sensation, and practical wisdom.
The complete self-sufficiency of the mortal is excluded, because every preservation requires decay, limitation, delay, and continual corrections.
If matter or necessity were a self-sufficient principle, neither hierarchy nor final composition would have a necessary task.
If the soul were homogeneous and the intellect immediate, bodily mediation, the sign, and the interpreter would be superfluous.
If insufficiency were merely evil, no compensation could explain the generation of practical wisdom, motion, and sensation.
If physiology automatically guaranteed truth, the distinction between sign, hypothesis, judgment, and divine ratification would collapse.
A world in which truth would be pure presence independent of body, affection, sign, and interpretation is rendered impossible.
A world in which unity comes to be without asymmetry, mediation, and governance of inferior powers is rendered impossible.
A world in which the mortal body simultaneously possesses absolute strength, security, sensation, practical wisdom, and incorruptibility is rendered impossible.
The system circles around the absence of an immediate principle, because every sovereignty must be embodied in instruments, limits, and processes of transcription.
Sensation, cosmic order, and bodily form are three scales of the same mechanism, according to which relation produces phenomenon through difference and mediation.
Providential order does not replace natural causality, but transforms natural affections into ordered means of preservation and governance.
Interpretation and organic regulation are homologous works, because both transform unformed affection into functionally delimited order.
Imperfection becomes the common mechanism of knowledge and life, because weakness of judgment generates interpretation, whereas material weakness generates compensation.
Hierarchy is the manner in which unity preserves difference without surrendering to the autonomy of the parts.
Future use and interpretive time constitute a common retroactive causality, according to which what is not present shapes the present arrangement.
The claim of providential order and the persistence of decay constitute a productive tension, because providence appears as regulation of mortality and not as its negation.
Reality is recomposed as a multilayered network of translations, in which the sensible, the psychic, the ethical, and the bodily are reciprocal phases of generation.
Knowledge is reshaped as an art of reconstructing and judging relations, not as possession of self-evident content.
Political and ethical order is embodied, because the governance of affections and the distribution of instruments are homologous manifestations of one hierarchical mechanism.
Mortality ceases simply to signify deficiency and becomes the place where the need for interpretation, organic education, and providential suspension arise.
Freedom is not release from conditions, but right navigation through mediations, limitations, and gradations.
Teleology becomes retroactive logic, because future need operates in present construction without eliminating natural causes.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Quality → mechanical analysis → relation → new phenomenon; explanation redraws what is explained.
Mixture → difference → composition → hierarchization → new division; unity produces the multiplicity that it in turn governs.
Divine arrangement → bodily translation → affection and sign → interpretation → reactivation of the rational principle.
Protection → solidity → rigidity → mediation → motion → new need for protection; the solution of one insufficiency generates the next.
Uncertainty → probable account → distinction → search for ratification → preservation of uncertainty; the lack of certainty becomes method.
The attractor of the system is hierarchical mediation, which returns as relation, mixture, instrument, interpretation, governance, and final arrangement.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Power or necessity impinges upon matter, and matter reacts through motion, mixture, and difference.
The reaction is distributed into instruments and parts, so that affection becomes sensation, form, signal, or limitation.
Differentiated function is subordinated to hierarchy, which transforms multiplicity into sustainable unity.
Hierarchy requires mediating instruments, because the principle cannot act immediately upon inferior powers.
Mediation produces signs and limits, and signs require interpretation for the reconstitution of rational order.
Providential composition does not abolish mortal imperfection, but transforms it into a condition of regulation, preservation, and future use.
Sensible quality → bodily motion and affection → relational generation of phenomenon.
Relational generation → mixture and difference → cosmic composition and hierarchy.
Hierarchy → bodily mediation → affection and sign → interpretive judgment.
Bodily insufficiency → compensation and differentiation → motion, sensation, and practical wisdom.
Interpretation and compensation → providential regulation → open order through continual refoundation.
The field of the senses, the soul, and anatomy is redrawn from a catalogue of substances into a map of transmissions, relations, and transformations.
The distinction between nature and ethics collapses, because biological function already bears a norm of limitation, purpose, and preservation.
The distinction between matter and intellect is replaced by graded transcription, in which matter signifies and intellect is embodied.
Time is reclassified from a framework of events into an active cause of rhythm, delay, generation, and providential prearrangement.
A new mode of reading becomes necessary: the investigator must follow mediations, changes, limits, and hierarchical translations.
At the surface level, the system treats sensations, colors, liver, nourishment, marrow, bones, flesh, skin, and head.
At the structural level, phenomena are networks of motions, mixtures, transmissions, instruments, differences, and compensations.
At the metastrategic level, correct governance does not destroy the inferior parts, but transforms them into bound and functional instruments.
At the ontological and temporal level, being is an event of continuously produced relation, in which necessity, purpose, decay, and the future are intertwined.
At the methodological and performative level, discourse imitates the very mechanism that it explains, gathering dispersed parts into hierarchical cohesion without absolute closure.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Teleological sovereignty requires natural causes as genuinely active, but cannot fully explain how their subordination preserves the autonomy of mechanics.
Truth requires the weakness of the affected bearer, but this weakness simultaneously threatens the reliability of the sign.
Practical wisdom is posited as the highest end, but depends on material weakness and diminished protection, which can threaten its own preservation.
Unity is preserved only through unequal parts, so that the cohesion of the whole order presupposes asymmetric sovereignty.
Quality changes into power and function when the question of what it is is replaced by that of what it does in relation to another.
Mediation changes from a technical necessity of transmission into a universal schema of transcription between divine order, soul, body, and truth.
Deficiency changes into a positive principle when the insufficiency of one element becomes the precondition of another's function.
Reality is a mechanism of graded transmissions, in which every power receives form only through resistance, measure, and instrument.
The subject is a hierarchized node of reason, affection, the irrational, and body, neither sovereign of phenomena nor a passive mirror.
Time is a recurrent and providential sequence, in which rhythms, delays, decays, and future needs shape the present.
Possible escape is navigation and rearrangement of mechanisms, not an exit from body, necessity, or mediation.
The principles of relational generation, hierarchical composition, bodily mediation, providential necessity, and productive imperfection suffice to reconstruct the system's principal movement.
The reconstruction preserves the movement from sensation to relation, from relation to hierarchy, and from hierarchy to embodied interpretation.
The precise mechanism of transmissions, the proportion between physiology and symbol, and the manner in which final intellect chooses among conflicting goods remain underdetermined.
The system is coherent insofar as uncertainty, proportion, and imperfection are understood as constituent conditions and not as mere gaps.
The strongest part of the architecture is hierarchical mediation; the weakest, the complete transition from quantitative and mechanical cause to qualitative and teleological form.
