items.text: Τὸ σύστημα ζητεῖ νὰ ἐξηγήσῃ πῶς τὸ θνητὸν σῶμα διαμένει μόνον διὰ μεταβολῶν, ἀναπληρώσεων καὶ ῥυθμίσεων, ἐνώ ἡ αὐτὴ κίνησις περιέχει τὴν φθορὰν αὐτοῦ.
Ἡ ἐξήγησις ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὴν ἀκίνητον οὐσίαν διὰ δικτύου ῥοῶν, δεσμῶν, πόρων, θερμοτήτων καὶ ἀντιρρόπων κινήσεων.
Ἡ τροφή, ἡ ἀναπνοή καὶ ἡ κίνησις τῆς ὕλης γίνονται κοινὸς μηχανισμὸς, ὃς ἢ ἀφομοιοῖ τὸ ἔξωθεν εἰς σῶμα ἢ ἀναστρέφεται εἰς νοσηρὰν διάλυσιν.
Ἡ ὑγίεια δὲν ἐστὶν ἀκινησία, ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιρος λόγος ῥοῆς, ὁμοιότητος, θερμότητος καὶ διεξόδων.
Ἡ νόσος δὲν προσπίπτει ἔξωθεν ἐπὶ τετελεσμένον σώμα, ἀλλὰ ἐστὶν ἡ ἐσωτερικὴ ἀναστροφὴ τῆς γενέσεως, τῆς ἀφομοιώσεως καὶ τῆς κυκλοφορίας.
Ἡ τοπικὴ βλάβη ἀποκτᾷ καθολικὴν ἰσχύν, ὅταν ἡ διεφθαρμένη ὕλη διὰ τῶν συνδέσμων καὶ τῶν ῥοῶν ἐπανέρχηται ὡς αἰτία νέας βλάβης.
Ὁ χρόνος ἐνεργεῖ ὡς μεταβολὴ τοῦ λόγου τῶν δεσμῶν, δι’ ἧς ἡ συντήρησις μεταπίπτει εἰς γῆρας, λύσιν καὶ θάνατον.
Ἡ τελικὴ κατάληξις εἶναι κυκλικὴ καὶ σπειροειδής: ἡ ζωή διαμένει διὰ τῆς ἀνταποδόσεως, ἡ δὲ φθορὰ ἐπικρατεῖ ὅταν ἡ ἀνταπόδοσις γένηται κατάκλεισις καὶ αὐτοπολλαπλασιαζομένη διάλυσις.
[Persistent] Τὸ ζῶν σῶμα οὐκ ἔστιν ἀκίνητος οὐσία, ἀλλὰ πρόσκαιρος συνοχὴ ῥοῶν, δεσμῶν, μεταβολῶν καὶ διανομῶν.
[Persistent] Ἡ ζωή καὶ ἡ ὑγίεια διατηροῦνται μόνον διὰ συνεχούς ἀναπληρώσεως καὶ ρυθμισμένης ἀναλογίας ἐπιρροῆς καὶ ἀπορροῆς.
[Mutating] Τὸ αὐτὸ δίκτυον τροφῆς, πνεύματος, θερμότητος καὶ ῥοῆς δύναται καὶ νὰ συγκροτῇ καὶ νὰ διαλύῃ τὸ σῶμα.
[Emergent] Ἡ παθολογία εἶναι ἀναστροφὴ τῶν παραγωγικῶν διαδικασιῶν, καθ’ ἣν ἡ ἀφομοίωσις γίνεται διάλυσις καὶ ἡ κυκλοφορία γίνεται μετάδοσις φθορᾶς.
[Attractor] Ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις ὁρίζεται ὡς λόγος συγγενείας, τόπου, μέτρου, ῥοῆς καὶ ἀκεραιότητος συνδέσμων.
[Mutating] Ἡ σωματικὴ ταυτότης παράγεται διὰ μετασχηματισμοῦ τοῦ ἀνομοίου εἰς ὁμοιότητα, οὐ διὰ διατηρήσεως ἀμεταβλήτου πυρήνος.
[Emergent] Ἡ αἰτιότης εἶναι κατανεμημένη καὶ ἀναδραστική, ἐπειδὴ τὸ ἀποτέλεσμα δύναται νὰ ἐπανέλθῃ διὰ τῶν ῥοῶν ὡς αἴτιον.
[Terminal] Ὁ θάνατος εἶναι λύσις δεσμῶν καὶ παῦσις τῆς λειτουργικῆς ἀνταποδόσεως, εἴτε κατὰ φυσικὴν ἐξασθένησιν εἴτε διὰ βιαίας ἀναστροφῆς.
[Attractor] Ἡ διάκρισις φυσικῆς ῥυθμίσεως καὶ παρὰ φύσιν ἀναστροφῆς ἀποφασίζει τὴν ἑρμηνείαν τῆς ζωῆς, τῆς νόσου καὶ τῆς λύσεως.
Ἡ ῥοὴ διατηρεῖ τὴν ταυτότητά της ὡς ὅρος ζωῆς, ἀλλὰ μεταλλάσσεται ἐκ κυκλοφορίας ἀναπληρώσεως εἰς ὁδὸν διασπορᾶς νοσηρᾶς ὕλης.
Ἡ τροφὴ μετακινείται ἀπὸ ἐξωτερικὴν ὕλην πρὸς ἀφομοιωμένην συνοχὴν καὶ τέλος πρὸς διαβρωτικὸν παράγοντα, ὅταν ἀποτύχῃ ὁ μετασχηματισμός.
Ἡ ἀναπνοὴ μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ ἀντίρροπον κύκλον διανομῆς καὶ ψύξεως εἰς τόπον ἀποφράξεως, σήψεως καὶ συστημικῆς φθορᾶς.
Ἡ ὁμοιότης μεταναστεύει ἀπὸ ἀρχὴν αἰσθητικῆς συμφωνίας εἰς μηχανισμὸν θρεπτικῆς ἀφομοιώσεως καὶ κριτήριον σωματικῆς ταυτότητος.
Ἡ φθορὰ μετατρέπεται ἀπὸ ἀναγκαίαν ἐσωτερικὴν κατανάλωσιν εἰς ἀναδρομικὴν μηχανὴν, ἣ τρέφεται ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων αἰτίων τῆς συγκροτήσεως.
Ἡ τάξις παύει νὰ σημαίνῃ μόνον κοσμικὴν ἢ φυσιολογικὴν κανονικότητα καὶ γίνεται ἀνατομικὴ ἀκεραιότης, ῥύθμισις διεξόδων καὶ διαγνωστικὸν μέτρον βάθους.
Αἱ ἀκριβείς ταξινομίαι ψυχικῶν δυνάμεων, χολῶν, φλεγμάτων, τριγώνων καὶ ἰδιαιτέρων λίθων μένουσιν τοπικαὶ ὡς ὑποδείγματα, οὐχὶ ὡς ἀρχαὶ τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ ῥοή, ἡ συγγένεια, ἡ ἀφομοίωσις, ὁ δεσμὸς καὶ ἡ ἀναστροφὴ κλιμακοῦνται εἰς καθολικὰς κατηγορίας, διότι διαπερῶσι φυσιολογίαν, αἴσθησιν, γῆρας καὶ νόσον.
Γέφυρα τῶν μονάδων γίνεται ἡ ἀρχὴ ὅτι ἡ ὑγίεια καὶ ἡ νόσος εἰσὶ φάσεις τοῦ αὐτοῦ συστήματος μετασχηματισμῶν.
Καταλύτης μεταβάσεως εἶναι ἡ μεταφορά τῆς κοσμικῆς κινητικότητος εἰς τὸ σῶμα, δι’ ἧς ἡ ἀνατομία γίνεται τοπικὴ ἐκδοχὴ καθολικῆς αἰτιότητος.
Ἡ ὀνοματολογία τῶν νοσημάτων ὑπερβαίνει τὴν περιγραφὴν, ὅταν ἀκολουθῇ ὁδόν, τόπον, ποιότητα καὶ ἕξιν τῆς ὕλης.
Ἀποκλείεται τὸ σῶμα ὡς ἀδρανὲς περίβλημα ἢ ἄθροισμα αὐτοτελῶν μερῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ταυτότης ὡς ἀμετάβλητος πυρήν, διότι ἡ ὕπαρξις συγκροτεῖται διὰ συνεχῶν ἀναπληρώσεων καὶ μεταβολῶν.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ ὑγίεια ὡς ἀκινησία, διότι ἡ διάρκειά της εἶναι ῥυθμισμένη κίνησις καὶ οὐχὶ ἀπουσία μεταβολῆς.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ νόσος ὡς ἁπλοῦν τοπικὸν συμβεβηκός ἢ ὄνομα τελικοῦ συμπτώματος.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ γραμμικὴ αἰτιότης, καθ’ ἣν ἐξωτερικὴ αἰτία παρὰ ἑνὶ χρόνῳ παράγει ἀμετάβλητον ἀποτέλεσμα.
Ἀποκλείεται ἡ πλήρης διάκρισις φυσικοῦ, αἰσθητικοῦ, βιολογικοῦ καὶ παθολογικοῦ πεδίου.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι ἡ ὑπόθεσις ὅτι λειτουργία δύναται νὰ νοηθῇ χωρὶς ὑλικὴν, γεωμετρικὴν καὶ ἀνατομικὴν διάταξιν.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι ἡ ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ ἐξωτερικὴ ὕλη προστίθεται εἰς τὸ σῶμα ἄνευ μετασχηματισμοῦ καὶ ὁμοιώσεως.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι ἡ ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ φθορὰ εἶναι ἑτερότης πρὸς τὴν γένεσιν, διότι ἐκ τῆς ἀναστροφῆς τῆς γενέσεως παράγεται.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι ἡ ὑπόθεσις ὅτι αἴτιον, ὁδὸς, τόπος καὶ ἕξις τῆς ὕλης δύνανται νὰ χωρισθῶσιν.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι ἡ ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἢ ταυτίζονται ἁπλῶς ἢ χωρίζονται ἀπολύτως.
Ἀπούσης μένει ἡ δυνατότης ζωῆς ἄνευ κυκλοφορίας, διαμεσολαβήσεως καὶ ἀνταποδόσεως.
Ἀπούσης μένει ἡ δυνατότης ἀκινήτου κέντρου, ὃ κινεῖ τὰ πάντα χωρὶς αὐτὸ μεταβάλλεσθαι.
Ἀδύνατος ἐστὶ κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ὕλη παραμένει ἁπλῆ, ἀδρανὴς καὶ ἀνεπηρέαστος ὑπὸ τόπου, μίξεως, θερμότητος καὶ κινήσεως.
Ἀδύνατος ἐστὶν ἀσφαλὴς διάκρισις μεταξὺ τοῦ θεραπεύοντος καὶ τοῦ νοσοποιοῦ μηχανισμοῦ, διότι ἡ αὐτὴ ῥοὴ δύναται νὰ γένηται ἀνάτασις ἢ διάλυσις.
Ἀδύνατος μένει ἡ πλήρης μετάβασις ἀπὸ κινήσεις καὶ συστάσεις εἰς τὴν ποιοτικὴν ἐμπειρίαν ἡδονῆς ἢ πόνου.
Ἡ φυσιολογία καὶ ἡ παθολογία ἀποτελοῦσιν μίαν θεωρίαν μετασχηματισμοῦ, διότι ἡ αὐτὴ ἀναπλήρωσις ὑπὸ ὀρθὸν λόγον συντηρεῖ, ὑπὸ ἀναστροφὴν δὲ διαφθείρει.
Ἡ θρέψις καὶ ἡ ἀναπνοὴ εἰσὶ συμμετρικαὶ πύλαι, δι’ ὧν τὸ ἐκτὸς εἴτε μεταβάλλεται εἰς ἐσωτερικὴν ὁμοιότητα εἴτε ἐγκαθιδρύει κατάκλεισιν καὶ διάλυσιν.
Ἡ νόσος κλιμακοῦται μόνον ἐπειδὴ ἡ ἀνατομικὴ συνδεσιμότης μετατρέπει τὴν τοπικὴν ἀλλοίωσιν εἰς κυκλοφοροῦσαν καὶ αὐτοενισχυομένην αἰτίαν.
Ὁ χρόνος δὲν προστίθεται ἐξωτερικῶς εἰς τὸ σῶμα, ἀλλὰ ἐκδηλοῖ τὴν βαθμιαίαν μεταβολὴν τοῦ λόγου μεταξὺ ἀφομοιώσεως καὶ λύσεως.
Ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις δὲν εἶναι θετικῶς παροῦσα οὐσία, ἀλλὰ ὁρατὸς γίνεται διὰ τῆς ἀπουσίας διεξόδου, τοῦ σπασμοῦ τῶν δεσμῶν καὶ τῆς ἐπιστροφῆς τῆς νοσηρᾶς ὕλης.
Ἡ ἐνότητα τοῦ σώματος ἀπαιτεῖ νὰ νοηθῇ ἅμα ὡς ἐσωτερικὴ μηχανὴ καὶ ὡς κοσμικὴ ἀναλογία, ἀλλὰ ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ τὴν κίνησιν εἰς τὴν αἴσθησιν μένει ἀνεπίλυτος.
Ἡ ὀντολογία τοῦ σώματος γίνεται θεωρία σχέσεων: οὐδὲν μέρος ἔχει τὴν ἰδίαν λειτουργίαν χωρὶς τὸ δίκτυον ὅπερ τὸ τρέφει, θερμαίνει, ψύχει καὶ διανέμει.
Ἡ αἰτιότης γίνεται γενεαλογία μεταβολῶν, ἐν ᾗ τὸ πάθημα οὐχὶ τέλος ἀλλὰ κόμβος νέας αἰτιακῆς ἀκολουθίας ἐστίν.
Ἡ θνητότης ἀνασημαίνεται ὡς ὅριον διατηρήσεως λόγου καὶ συνδέσμου, οὐχὶ ὡς ἁπλὴ ἀπώλεια ὕλης.
Ἡ διάγνωσις γίνεται ἀνάγνωσις ὁδῶν καὶ μετασχηματισμῶν, διότι τὸ ἐμφανὲς σύμπτωμα δὲν ἀρκεί πρὸς τὴν γνῶσιν τοῦ μηχανισμοῦ.
Ἡ διαφορά μεταξὺ ζωῆς καὶ νόσου δὲν ἐστι διαφορά οὐσίας, ἀλλὰ διαφορά κατευθύνσεως, μέτρου, τόπου καὶ ἀναδράσεως τῶν αὐτῶν δυνάμεων.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Φθορὰ → ἀνάγκη ἀναπληρώσεως → τροφή καὶ πνεῦμα → ἀφομοίωσις καὶ διανομή → ἐσωτερικὴ θερμότης → νέα φθορὰ.
Ὁμοιότης → συμφωνία → σωματικὴ συνοχή → ἐξασθένησις δεσμῶν → ἀνομοιότης → λύσις.
Ρυθμισμένη ῥοή → ἀποφόρτισις → συντήρησις· κατάκλεισις → ἀλλοίωσις → ἐπανείσοδος νοσηρᾶς ὕλης → πολλαπλασιασμὸς βλάβης.
Ἡ ἀναστροφή τῆς γενέσεως εἶναι μεταβατικὸν σημεῖον, ὅπου ὁ μηχανισμὸς ὁ τρέφων τὴν ταυτότητα γίνεται φορεὺς διαλύσεως.
Ἐλκτικὸς πόλος τοῦ συστήματος ἐστὶν οὐκ ἀκίνητον κέντρον, ἀλλὰ ἡ κυκλικὴ ἀνταπόδοσις ἢ, ἐν τῇ παθολογίᾳ, ἡ σπειροειδὴς αὐτοδιαφθορά.
Ἡ ἐπανάληψις δὲν δηλοῖ ταὐτότητα, ἀλλὰ μεταβολὴν φάσεως, καθ’ ἣν ἡ συντήρησις γίνεται γῆρας καὶ ἡ ῥοὴ γίνεται νόσος.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Ἐσωτερικὴ κατανάλωσις → κένωσις καὶ φθορά → ἀνάγκη ἐξωτερικῆς ὕλης.
Ἐξωτερικὴ ὕλη → διαμεσολάβησις διὰ κοιλοτήτων, πλεγμάτων, φλεβῶν καὶ πνεύματος → ἀφομοίωσις ἢ ἀποτυχία μετασχηματισμοῦ.
Ὀρθὸς λόγος ῥοῆς, θερμότητος, πυκνότητος καὶ διεξόδων → προσωρινὴ σωματικὴ ταυτότης καὶ ὑγίεια.
Ἀπόφραξις, ἀνομοιότης ἢ ἀναστροφὴ διαδοχῆς → διεφθαρμένη ὕλη → μετάδοσις διὰ ἱστῶν καὶ αἵματος → συστημικὴ φθορά.
Ἡ ἐπανείσοδος τοῦ ἀποτελέσματος εἰς τὰς αἰτίας αὐτοῦ → αὐτοενίσχυσις νόσου → λύσις δεσμῶν ἢ παῦσις τῆς συστάσεως.
Φθορὰ τοῦ θνητοῦ → ἀνάγκη ἀναπληρώσεως → ἀνατομικὴ διαμεσολάβησις.
Ἀνατομικὴ διαμεσολάβησις → ῥοὴ, ἀφομοίωσις καὶ ὁμοιότης → δυναμικὴ σωματικὴ ταυτότης.
Δυναμικὴ ταυτότης → χρονικὴ ἐξασθένησις δεσμῶν → γῆρας, φυσικὴ λύσις ἢ βίαιος θάνατος.
Ἀναστροφὴ ῥοῆς ἢ μίξεως → νόσος → μετάδοσις καὶ βάθυνσις τῆς βλάβης.
Βάθυνσις καὶ ἀναδρομὴ τῆς φθορᾶς → συστημικὴ ἀναστροφή → ἀναχαρτογράφησις τοῦ σώματος ὡς δικτύου.
Καταλύεται ἡ διαίρεσις ἐσωτερικοῦ καὶ ἐξωτερικοῦ, διότι τὸ ζῷον ὑπάρχει μόνον ἐν τῇ ἀνταλλαγῇ πρὸς τὸ περιβάλλον.
Καταλύεται ἡ διαίρεσις κοσμολογίας καὶ φυσιολογίας, διότι ἡ σωματικὴ κίνησις γίνεται μικρογραφία καθολικῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ ὑγίεια ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς διαρκὴς ῥύθμισις καὶ ἡ νόσος ὡς μετρήσιμος ἀπόκλισις ὁδοῦ, τόπου, ποσότητος καὶ βάθους.
Ἡ διάγνωσις ἀναγκάζεται νὰ ζητῇ τὴν γενετικὴν ἀκολουθίαν τοῦ πάθους καὶ οὐ τὸ ὄνομα μόνον.
Ἡ ἐπιφάνεια τοῦ συμπτώματος ὑποτάσσεται εἰς τὴν ἱεραρχίαν τοῦ βάθους, ὅπου ἡ ἀνατομικὴ συνδεσιμότης καθορίζει τὴν βαρύτητα τῆς νόσου.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τροφή, πνεῦμα, αἷμα, χυμοί, πυρετός, πόνος καὶ σπασμὸς δηλοῦσι τὰ ἐμφανῆ πάθη τοῦ σώματος.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, πλέγματα, φλέβες, ἱστοί, δεσμοί, διεξόδοι, μίξεις καὶ θερμότητες συγκροτοῦσι τὴν λειτουργικὴν τάξιν.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ἔρευνα μετακινείται ἀπὸ τὸ σύμπτωμα πρὸς τὴν γενεαλογίαν, τὴν ὁδὸν καὶ τὴν ἀναστροφὴν τῆς διαδικασίας.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ ὂν ἐστὶ προσωρινὴ σύστασις, ἣ ὁ χρόνος μεταβάλλει διὰ ἐπαναλήψεως, ἐξασθενήσεως καὶ λύσεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεθοδολογικοῦ καὶ ἐπιτελεστικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ὁ λόγος μιμεῖται τὸ ἀντικείμενον διὰ τῆς ἐπαναλήψεως, τῆς συνδέσεως, τοῦ μετασχηματισμοῦ καὶ τῆς ἀναστροφῆς.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ θεία τελεολογία καὶ ἡ ἐσωτερικὴ μηχανικὴ συμπίπτουσι λειτουργικῶς, ἀλλὰ οὐκ ἀνάγονται εἰς μίαν ἀδιαίρετον ἀρχήν.
Ἡ φυσικὴ τάξις ἀπαιτεῖ λόγον καὶ ἀναλογίαν, ἀλλὰ ὁ αὐτὸς χρόνος ὅστις τὴν διατηρεῖ ἐνεργεῖ καὶ τὴν ἐξασθένησιν αὐτῆς.
Ἡ ἀναγωγὴ τῶν πολλῶν νοσημάτων εἰς ὀλίγους μηχανισμοὺς ἀπειλεῖ τὴν ἑτερογένειαν, ἣν ἡ διαγνωστικὴ ταξινόμησις ὀφείλει συγχρόνως νὰ διασώζῃ.
Ἡ ἔννοια τῆς ῥοῆς δὲν ἀντιτίθεται ἁπλῶς πρὸς τὴν πήξιν, διότι ἡ πήξις δύναται καὶ νὰ ῥυθμίζῃ καὶ νὰ κατακλείῃ.
Ἡ «ζωή» μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἱεραρχίαν ψυχικῶν δυνάμεων εἰς διαρκῆ παραγωγὴν καὶ ῥύθμισιν ῥευμάτων.
Ἡ «ἀναπνοή» μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ δίοδο ἀέρος εἰς καθολικὸν μηχανισμὸν διανομῆς, ψύξεως, ἀποφορτίσεως καὶ ἐνδεχομένης παθολογικῆς ἀποφράξεως.
Ἡ «νόσος» μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἀνωμαλίαν ποιότητος εἰς αὐτοτροφοδοτούμενον κύκλον, ἐν ᾧ τὸ ἀποτέλεσμα ἐνισχύει τὴν προτέραν αἰτίαν.
Ἡ πραγματικότης νοεῖται ὡς ὑδραυλικὸν, ἀναπνευστικὸν καὶ μετασχηματιστικὸν δίκτυον, ἐν ᾧ ἡ ὕπαρξις εἶναι σχέσις ῥοῶν.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον εἶναι κόμβος καὶ τόπος διελεύσεως, οὐχὶ αὐτοτελὴς κύριος τῶν κινήσεων αὐτοῦ.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι κύκλος καὶ λύσις ἐν κινήσει, ἐν ᾧ ἡ διατήρησις περιέχει ἤδη τὴν δυνατότητα τῆς ἀναστροφῆς.
Ἡ μόνη δυνατὴ πράξις ἐντὸς τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι ἡ διατήρησις ἢ ἀποκατάστασις ῥοῆς, μέτρου, διεξόδου καὶ συνδέσμου, οὐχὶ ἡ ἔξοδος ἐκ τοῦ δικτύου.
Τὰ παρόντα ἀξιώματα ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευὴν τῆς κινήσεως ἀπὸ φθορὰν καὶ ἀναπλήρωσιν πρὸς ὑγίειαν, γῆρας, νόσον καὶ λύσιν.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι συνεκτικωτάτη ὅπου ἡ αἰτιότης νοεῖται ὡς ῥοή, γενετικὴ διαδοχή, ἀναλογία, ἀνατροφοδότησις καὶ ἀναστροφή.
Ὑποκαθορισμέναι μένουσιν ἡ ἀκριβὴς σχέσις πυρός, πνεύματος καὶ ἀέρος, ἡ μετάβασις ἀπὸ φυσικὴν κίνησιν εἰς ποιοτικὴν ἐμπειρίαν, καὶ ἡ πλήρης ἱεράρχησις τῶν μίξεων.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευή διασῴζει τὴν πραγματικὴν κίνησιν μόνον ἐὰν διατηρῇ τὴν ἀναδρομὴν, καθ’ ἣν ἡ ῥύθμισις δύναται νὰ γένηται αἰτία διαφθορᾶς.
Ἀνθεκτικὸν εἰς ἀξιωματικὴν συμπίεσιν μένει ὅτι οἱ αὐτοὶ μηχανισμοὶ οὔτε καθαρῶς ζωτικοὶ οὔτε καθαρῶς νοσοποιοὶ εἰσίν, ἀλλὰ μεταβάλλουσι λειτουργίαν κατὰ λόγον, τόπον καὶ χρόνον.
The system seeks to explain how the mortal body persists only through changes, replenishments, and regulations, while that same movement contains its decay.
The explanation replaces immobile substance with a network of flows, bonds, passages, heats, and countervailing movements.
Nourishment, respiration, and the movement of matter become a common mechanism, which either assimilates what is external into body or reverses into diseased dissolution.
Health is not immobility, but a temporary proportion of flow, likeness, heat, and outlets.
Disease does not befall a completed body from outside, but is the internal reversal of generation, assimilation, and circulation.
Local damage acquires universal force when corrupted matter, through connections and flows, returns as the cause of new damage.
Time operates as a change in the proportion of bonds, through which maintenance passes into old age, dissolution, and death.
The final outcome is circular and spiral: life persists through reciprocity, while decay prevails when reciprocity becomes enclosure and self-multiplying dissolution.
[Persistent] The living body is not an immobile substance, but a temporary cohesion of flows, bonds, changes, and distributions.
[Persistent] Life and health are maintained only through continuous replenishment and a regulated proportion of influx and absorption.
[Mutating] The same network of nourishment, pneuma, heat, and flow can both constitute and dissolve the body.
[Emergent] Pathology is a reversal of productive processes, in which assimilation becomes dissolution and circulation becomes the transmission of decay.
[Attractor] Natural order is defined as a proportion of kinship, place, measure, flow, and the integrity of connections.
[Mutating] Bodily identity is produced through the transformation of the dissimilar into likeness, not through the preservation of an unchanging core.
[Emergent] Causality is distributed and recursive, because the effect can return through the flows as a cause.
[Terminal] Death is the dissolution of bonds and cessation of functional reciprocity, whether by natural weakening or violent reversal.
[Attractor] The distinction between natural regulation and reversal contrary to nature determines the interpretation of life, disease, and dissolution.
Flow retains its identity as a condition of life, but mutates from a circuit of replenishment into a path for the dissemination of diseased matter.
Nourishment moves from external matter to assimilated cohesion and finally to a corrosive agent when transformation fails.
Respiration changes from a countervailing cycle of distribution and cooling into a site of obstruction, putrefaction, and systemic decay.
Likeness migrates from a principle of perceptual concord to a mechanism of nutritive assimilation and a criterion of bodily identity.
Decay is transformed from necessary internal consumption into a recursive engine nourished by the very causes of constitution.
Order ceases to signify only cosmic or physiological regularity and becomes anatomical integrity, regulation of outlets, and a diagnostic measure of depth.
Precise classifications of psychic powers, biles, phlegms, triangles, and particular stones remain local as examples, not as principles of the whole.
Flow, kinship, assimilation, bond, and reversal are scaled up into universal categories because they traverse physiology, sensation, old age, and disease.
The bridge between the units is the principle that health and disease are phases of the same system of transformations.
The catalyst of transition is the transfer of cosmic mobility into the body, through which anatomy becomes a local version of universal causality.
The nomenclature of diseases surpasses description when it follows the path, place, quality, and condition of matter.
The body as an inert covering or an aggregate of self-sufficient parts is excluded.
Identity as an unchanging core is excluded, because existence is constituted through continuous replenishments and changes.
Health as immobility is excluded, because its duration is regulated movement and not the absence of change.
Disease as a simple local accident or the name of a final symptom is excluded.
Linear causality is excluded, according to which an external cause at one time produces an unchanging effect.
The complete distinction of the physical, perceptual, biological, and pathological domains is excluded.
The hypothesis that function can be conceived without material, geometrical, and anatomical arrangement must be false.
The hypothesis that external matter is added to the body without transformation and assimilation must be false.
The hypothesis that decay is other than generation must be false, because it is produced from the reversal of generation.
The hypothesis that cause, path, place, and the condition of matter can be separated must be false.
The hypothesis that soul and body are either simply identical or absolutely separated must be false.
The possibility of life without circulation, mediation, and reciprocity remains absent.
The possibility of an immobile center which moves everything without itself changing remains absent.
A world in which matter remains simple, inert, and unaffected by place, mixture, heat, and movement is impossible.
A secure distinction between the healing and disease-producing mechanism is impossible, because the same flow can become restoration or dissolution.
The complete transition from movements and constitutions to the qualitative experience of pleasure or pain remains impossible.
Physiology and pathology constitute one theory of transformation, because the same replenishment under a correct proportion preserves, but under reversal corrupts.
Nutrition and respiration are symmetrical gates through which the external either changes into internal likeness or establishes enclosure and dissolution.
Disease escalates only because anatomical connectivity transforms local alteration into a circulating and self-reinforcing cause.
Time is not externally added to the body, but manifests the gradual change in the proportion between assimilation and dissolution.
Natural order is not a positively present substance, but becomes visible through the absence of an outlet, the rupture of bonds, and the return of diseased matter.
The unity of the body requires being conceived at once as an internal mechanism and as a cosmic analogy, but the transition from movement to sensation remains unresolved.
The ontology of the body becomes a theory of relations: no part has its own function without the network that nourishes, heats, cools, and distributes it.
Causality becomes a genealogy of changes, in which the affection is not an end but a node of a new causal sequence.
Mortality is resignified as a limit to the preservation of proportion and bond, not as a simple loss of matter.
Diagnosis becomes a reading of paths and transformations, because the manifest symptom is insufficient for knowledge of the mechanism.
The difference between life and disease is not a difference of substance, but a difference of direction, measure, place, and feedback of the same powers.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Decay → need for replenishment → nourishment and pneuma → assimilation and distribution → internal heat → new decay.
Likeness → concord → bodily cohesion → weakening of bonds → dissimilarity → dissolution.
Regulated flow → discharge → maintenance; enclosure → alteration → re-entry of diseased matter → multiplication of damage.
The reversal of generation is a transitional point at which the mechanism that nourishes identity becomes a bearer of dissolution.
The system's attractive pole is not an immobile center, but circular reciprocity or, in pathology, spiral self-corruption.
Repetition does not signify identity, but a change of phase, in which maintenance becomes old age and flow becomes disease.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Internal consumption → emptiness and decay → need for external matter.
External matter → mediation through cavities, networks, veins, and pneuma → assimilation or failure of transformation.
Correct proportion of flow, heat, density, and outlets → temporary bodily identity and health.
Obstruction, dissimilarity, or reversal of succession → corrupted matter → transmission through tissues and blood → systemic decay.
The re-entry of the effect into its causes → self-reinforcement of disease → dissolution of bonds or cessation of constitution.
Decay of the mortal → need for replenishment → anatomical mediation.
Anatomical mediation → flow, assimilation, and likeness → dynamic bodily identity.
Dynamic identity → temporal weakening of bonds → old age, natural dissolution, or violent death.
Reversal of flow or mixture → disease → transmission and deepening of damage.
Deepening and recursion of decay → systemic reversal → remapping of the body as a network.
The division between internal and external is dissolved, because the living creature exists only in exchange with its environment.
The division between cosmology and physiology is dissolved, because bodily movement becomes a microcosm of universal order.
Health is reclassified as continuous regulation and disease as a measurable deviation of path, place, quantity, and depth.
Diagnosis is compelled to seek the generative sequence of the affection and not the name alone.
The surface of the symptom is subordinated to the hierarchy of depth, in which anatomical connectivity determines the gravity of disease.
At the surface level, nourishment, pneuma, blood, humors, fever, pain, and spasm indicate the manifest affections of the body.
At the structural level, networks, veins, tissues, bonds, outlets, mixtures, and heats constitute functional order.
At the metastrategic level, inquiry moves from the symptom toward the genealogy, path, and reversal of the process.
At the ontological and temporal level, being is a temporary constitution, which time transforms through repetition, weakening, and dissolution.
At the methodological and performative level, discourse imitates the object through repetition, connection, transformation, and reversal.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Divine teleology and internal mechanics coincide functionally, but are not reducible to one indivisible principle.
Natural order requires proportion and analogy, but the same time that preserves it also effects its weakening.
The reduction of many diseases to a few mechanisms threatens the heterogeneity that diagnostic classification must simultaneously preserve.
The concept of flow is not simply opposed to coagulation, because coagulation can both regulate and enclose.
“Life” mutates from a hierarchy of psychic powers into the continuous production and regulation of currents.
“Respiration” mutates from a passage of air into a universal mechanism of distribution, cooling, discharge, and possible pathological obstruction.
“Disease” mutates from an abnormality of quality into a self-feeding cycle in which the effect reinforces the prior cause.
Reality is conceived as a hydraulic, respiratory, and transformative network in which existence is a relation of flows.
The subject is a node and place of passage, not the self-sufficient master of its movements.
Time is cycle and dissolution in movement, in which preservation already contains the possibility of reversal.
The only possible action within the system is the preservation or restoration of flow, measure, outlet, and bond, not exit from the network.
The present axioms suffice to reconstruct the movement from decay and replenishment toward health, old age, disease, and dissolution.
The architecture is most coherent where causality is conceived as flow, generative succession, analogy, feedback, and reversal.
The precise relation of fire, pneuma, and air, the transition from physical movement to qualitative experience, and the complete hierarchy of mixtures remain underdetermined.
The reconstruction preserves the real movement only if it retains the recursion through which regulation can become a cause of corruption.
What remains resistant to axiomatic compression is that the same mechanisms are neither purely vital nor purely disease-producing, but change function according to proportion, place, and time.

items.text: Τὸ πρόβλημα γίνεται ἡ σύλληψις τοῦ ζῴου ὡς πεδίου ἐν ᾧ ἠθικὴ παρεκτροπή, νόσος, μάθησις, μορφὴ καὶ πολιτεία συμπαράγονται.
Ἡ αἰτιότης μετακινείται ἀπὸ ἀτομικὴν βούλησιν εἰς διανεμημένον κύκλον σώματος, ψυχῆς, ἀγωγῆς, ἐπιθυμίας καὶ κοσμικῆς τάξεως.
Ἡ θεραπεία γίνεται ῥύθμισις καὶ μετασχηματισμὸς κινήσεων, οὐχὶ διόρθωσις ἑνὸς μεμονωμένου συμπτώματος.
Ἡ γνώσις ἰσχύει μόνον ὅταν ἐπανεισέρχηται εἰς τὸν γνωρίζοντα καὶ ἀνατάσσῃ τὸν ῥυθμὸν τῆς ψυχῆς καὶ τοῦ σώματος.
Ἡ μορφὴ παύει νὰ εἶναι ἀδρανὴς ἐπιφάνεια καὶ γίνεται ὁρατὴ ἐγγραφή νοῦ, ἀνοίας, ἐπιθυμίας καὶ προτέρου βίου.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία τῶν ὄντων διατηρεῖ τὴν ἀξιακὴν φοράν, ἀλλὰ μεταβάλλεται εἰς κύκλον μεταπτώσεων καὶ ἀνατάσεων.
Ἡ κοσμικὴ τάξις λειτουργεῖ ἅμα ὡς πρότυπον θεραπείας καὶ ὡς ὅρος ὃς περιλαμβάνει τὰ κατώτερα δίχως νὰ ἀναιρῇ τὴν διαβάθμισιν.
Ἡ κίνησις τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι σπειροειδής: ἀπὸ διαταραχὴν εἰς ἐξήγησιν, ἀπὸ ἐξήγησιν εἰς ἀγωγήν, ἀπὸ ἀγωγὴν εἰς κοσμικὴν ἐξομοίωσιν, καὶ ἐκεῖθεν πάλιν εἰς μεταμόρφωσιν τοῦ ἐνσώματου βίου.
[Persistent] Τὸ ζῷον εἶναι συναμφότερον ψυχῆς, σώματος, ἔθους καὶ περιβάλλοντος, καὶ οὐδὲν τούτων ἐνεργεῖ αὐτάρκως.
[Mutating] Ἡ κίνησις μεταβάλλεται ἀπὸ φυσιολογικὸν συμβεβηκὸς εἰς καθολικὸν κριτήριον ὑγείας, γνώσεως, ἀρετῆς, μορφῆς καὶ κοσμικῆς συγγενείας.
[Persistent] Ἡ ἀσυμμετρία καὶ ἡ ἀταξία τῶν κινήσεων παράγουσι νόσον, ἄνοιαν, κακίαν καὶ μορφολογικὴν καθίζησιν.
[Emergent] Ἡ θεραπεία, ἡ παιδεία καὶ ἡ φιλοσοφία συγκροτοῦσιν ἓν μηχανισμὸν ἐπανενεργοποιήσεως καὶ ἀνατάξεως τῆς ἐσωτερικῆς τάξεως.
[Mutating] Ἡ αὐτονομία δὲν σημαίνει ἀνεξαρτησίαν, ἀλλὰ ἱκανότητα τοῦ μέρους νὰ συνεργῇ ἐντὸς προϋπαρχούσης φυσικῆς καὶ κοσμικῆς τάξεως.
[Emergent] Ἡ γνώσις εἶναι θεραπευτικὴ μόνον ἐὰν μεταβάλῃ τὰς περιφορὰς τοῦ γνωρίζοντος καὶ ἀνοίγῃ δυνατὸτητα ἀναβάσεως.
[Mutating] Ἡ ἠθικὴ ποιότης δὲν μένει ἐσωτερικὴ κρίσις, ἀλλὰ ἐγγράφεται εἰς σῶμα, στάσιν, ἀναπνοήν, οἴκησιν καὶ εἶδος.
[Attractor] Ἡ συμμετρία εἶναι δυναμικὴ ἀνταπόδοσις τῶν μερῶν κατὰ τὸ πρότυπον τοῦ παντός, οὐχὶ στατικὴ ἰσότης.
[Terminal] Ἡ τελείωσις δὲν συνίσταται εἰς φυγὴν ἀπὸ τὸ σῶμα ἢ εἰς ἐξάλειψιν τῶν κατωτέρων, ἀλλὰ εἰς ἐξομοίωσιν καὶ συμπλήρωσιν τοῦ ὅλου.
[Attractor] Ὁ κόσμος νοεῖται ὡς ἓν ἔμψυχον καὶ ὁρατὸν σύστημα, ἐν ᾧ αἱ διαβαθμίσεις τῶν μορφῶν ἀναφέρονται εἰς κοινὴν τάξιν.
[Terminal] Ἡ ἐπιθυμία εἶναι ἀντιστασιακὴ δύναμις ἡ ὁποία, ἀντὶ νὰ μένῃ ἔξω τῆς τάξεως, ἀποτελεῖ τὸν ἐνσώματον τρόπον τῆς γενέσεως καὶ τῆς τελεολογίας.
Ἡ ἀλληλεξάρτησις ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος διατηρεῖται, ἀλλὰ μετακινείται ἀπὸ μετάδοσιν παθήματος εἰς παραγωγὴν μορφῆς καὶ εἴδους.
Ἡ κίνησις ἐπαναλαμβάνεται κατὰ κλίμακας σώματος, ψυχῆς, ἀγωγῆς καὶ κόσμου, ἀλλὰ ἑκάστη κλίμαξ μετασχηματίζει τὸ νόημα τῆς προηγουμένης.
Ἡ συμμετρία μεταπίπτει ἀπὸ κριτήριον κάλλους εἰς τελεστὴν θεραπείας καὶ τέλος εἰς κανόνα κοσμικῆς ἐξομοιώσεως.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ κατηγορία ἀπορροφᾶται εἰς γενεαλογίαν κρασέων, τροφῶν, παιδείας καὶ προτέρων ψυχικῶν μεταβολῶν.
Ἡ θεραπεία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἐπανόρθωσιν πάσχοντος σώματος εἰς ἀναδιοργάνωσιν τοῦ τρόπου καθ᾽ ὃν τὸ ὂν κινείται, γιγνώσκει καὶ κατοικεῖ.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία τῶν εἰδῶν διατηρεῖ τὴν ἀξιακὴν φοράν, ἀλλὰ χάνει τὴν ἀκινησίαν της διὰ τῆς ἀμφιδρόμου μεταβολῆς.
Ἡ ἐπιθυμία ἀπὸ μερικὸν γενετήσιον πάθος γίνεται γενικὸν πρότυπον φύσεως ἡ ὁποία ἐνεργεῖ διὰ ἐντάσεως καὶ ἀντιστάσεως.
Ἡ κοσμολογία παύει νὰ εἶναι τελικὴ θεωρία καὶ γίνεται ἀναδρομικὸς κανὼν κρίσεως πάσης θεραπείας, παιδείας καὶ μορφολογικῆς μεταβολῆς.
Αἱ θεωρίαι χυμῶν, στοιχείων, μήτρας, φαρμάκων καὶ ἐπιμέρους ψυχικῶν μερῶν μένουσι τοπικαὶ μηχαναί, ὅταν δὲ ἀναβαίνωσιν διασώζουσι μόνον τὸν τύπον τῆς διανεμημένης αἰτιότητος.
Ἡ διαβάθμισις μέσων θεραπείας κλιμακοῦται εἰς καθολικὴν ἀρχὴν ὅτι ἡ ὀρθὴ παρέμβασις αὐξάνει τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν ἐνεργοποίησιν καὶ περιορίζει τὴν βίαν.
Ἡ τριμερὴς ψυχὴ καὶ αἱ εἰδικαὶ ζωικαὶ διαιρέσεις ὑποχωροῦσιν ὑπὸ τὴν καθολικωτέραν ἀρχὴν διαφοροποιημένων ῥυθμῶν καὶ μεταβάσεων.
Ἡ γέφυρα τῶν μονάδων εἶναι ἡ κίνησις, διότι αὕτη συνδέει φυσιολογίαν, ψυχικὴν ἀγωγήν, ἠθικὴν μεταβολὴν καὶ ζωικὴν μορφολογίαν.
Ἡ κοσμικὴ μίμησις ἀναβαθμίζεται εἰς ὑπερκείμενον μέτρον, ὃ ἀνακωδικοποιεῖ τὴν ὑγείαν, τὴν παιδείαν καὶ τὴν τελείωσιν.
Ἡ ἀκριβὴς μεσότης τῆς κινήσεως καὶ ὁ μηχανισμὸς μεταπλάσεως ψυχῆς εἰς εἶδος μένουσιν ὑποκαθορισμένα ὡς ὅρια τῆς παρούσης ἀρχιτεκτονικῆς.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ψυχὴ ὡς αὐτοτελὴς καὶ ἀμέτοχος κυβερνήτης τοῦ σώματος, τῶν παθῶν καὶ τῶν πράξεων.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ κακία ὡς καθαρῶς ἑκούσιος καὶ ἀδιαμεσολάβητος ἀπόφασις ἀποκεκομμένη ἀπὸ κράσιν, τροφήν καὶ ἀγωγήν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ θεραπεία ὡς ἐξωτερικὴ κυριαρχία ἢ βιαία ἀντικατάστασις τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεραπευομένου.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ γνώσις ἡ ὁποία μένει πληροφορία καὶ δὲν μετασχηματίζει τὸν τρόπον τοῦ γιγνώσκειν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ φύσις ὡς ἀξιολογικῶς οὐδετέρα ὕλη ἢ ἄτακτος πολλαπλότης ἀνεξαρτήτων εἰδῶν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ τελείωσις ὡς μονομερὴς ὑπεροχὴ ἢ ἐκκαθάρισις τῶν κατωτέρων μορφῶν.
Ἀπορρίπτεται ἡ ἀκινησία ὡς σωτηρία, διότι ἡ ὑγεία προϋποτίθεται τεταγμένην, μετρίαν καὶ συνεχή κίνησιν.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι πᾶσα ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ψυχή, σῶμα, πολιτεία, παιδεία καὶ κόσμος ἔχουσιν ἀνεξαρτήτους αἰτίας.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι πᾶσα ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ θεραπεία δύναται νὰ ἐπιβάλληται ἔξωθεν ἄνευ χρόνου, μέτρου καὶ ἐσωτερικῆς μεταβολῆς.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι πᾶσα ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ γνώσις μόνη ἀρκεῖ, ἐὰν μὴ συμπράττῃ πρὸς ἔξιν, κίνησιν καὶ περιβάλλον.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι πᾶσα ὑπόθεσις ὅτι ἡ μορφὴ, ἡ ἀναπνοὴ καὶ ὁ τόπος εἶναι ἐξωτερικὰ δεδομένα ἄνευ ψυχικῆς καὶ ὀντολογικῆς συνεπείας.
Ψευδὴς δεῖ εἶναι πᾶσα ὑπόθεσις ὅτι τὸ κατώτατον εἶδος διαθέτει ἀνεξάρτητον νόημα ἔξω τῆς κοσμικῆς ὁλότητος.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται ἡ ὕπαρξις ἀσυσχετίστου ὑποκειμένου, ὃ ἂν ἦν αὐτοκυβέρνητον καὶ ἀπρόσβλητον ὑπὸ σώματος, χρόνου καὶ κόσμου.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται κόσμος ἐν ᾧ ἡ ἠθικὴ ἀξία δὲν ἐνσαρκώνεται εἰς μορφὰς, κινήσεις καὶ τόπους.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται θεραπεία ἡ ὁποία σώζει ἓν μέρος χωρὶς νὰ μεταβάλλῃ τὴν σχέσιν αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸ ὅλον.
Ἀδύνατος καθίσταται χρόνος καθαρῶς γραμμικὸς ἢ ἄμοιρος ἐπιστροφῆς, διότι ὁ πρότερος βίος ἐπανέρχεται ὡς ἕξις, μορφὴ καὶ ὅρος μεταβολῆς.
Ἡ θεραπεία γίνεται πολιτικὴ καὶ κοσμολογικὴ τέχνη, ἐπειδὴ ἡ διόρθωσις τῶν ἐσωτερικῶν κινήσεων ἀπαιτεῖ μεταβολὴν τῶν ὅρων οἳ παράγουσι σώματα, ἔθη καὶ μορφάς.
Ἡ αὐτοκίνησις γίνεται ὄρος ἠθικῆς ἀνατάσεως, ἀλλὰ οὐκ ἀναιρεῖ τὴν ἀνάγκην ἐξωτερικῆς ἀγωγῆς· ἡ ἐπέμβασις κρίνεται ἐκ τοῦ εἰ ἐπαναφέρει ἢ ὑποκαθιστᾷ τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν ἐνέργειαν.
Ἡ μορφολογία γίνεται θεραπευτικὸν καὶ γνωστικὸν πεδίον, διότι τὸ σῶμα δεικνύει τὰς ψυχικὰς περιφορὰς αἳ δύνανται νὰ μεταβληθῶσιν διὰ παιδείας καὶ θεωρίας.
Ἡ πτῶσις δὲν εἶναι ἁπλῶς ἀπώλεια, διότι συγχρόνως ἐκφράζει ἀξιακὴν καθίζησιν καὶ πληροῖ τὴν κοσμικὴν ὁλότητα.
Ἡ ἐπιθυμία ἀποδεικνύει ὅτι ἡ τάξις οὐκ ἐνεργεῖ διὰ ἀπλῆς ὑποταγῆς, ἀλλὰ διὰ δυνάμεων αἳ ἀντιστέκονται καὶ ὅμως φέρουσι τὴν γένεσιν.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον γίνεται μεταβατικὸς κόμβος, ἐν ᾧ προγενέστεραι κράσεις, παιδεύσεις, ἐπιθυμίαι καὶ κοσμικαὶ σχέσεις ἐγγράφονται εἰς παροῦσαν πράξιν καὶ μορφήν.
Ἡ ὀντολογία γίνεται ὀντολογία ῥυθμῶν καὶ μεταμορφώσεων, ὅπου τὸ εἶναι τοῦ ὄντος κρίνεται ἐκ τῆς ἱκανότητος πρὸς διατήρησιν, διόρθωσιν ἢ ἀπώλειαν τάξεως.
Ὁ χρόνος γίνεται γενεαλογικὸς καὶ σπειροειδής, διότι τὸ πρὸτερον οὐ παρέρχεται ἀλλὰ ἐπανεμφανίζεται ὡς σωματικὴ καὶ ἠθικὴ δυνατότης τοῦ ὕστερον.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ καὶ ἡ παιδεία παύουσι νὰ εἶναι ἐξωτερικαὶ διοικήσεις καὶ γίνονται διαχείρισις τῶν συνθηκῶν ὑφ᾽ ὧν δύναται νὰ γεννηθῇ αὐτορύθμισις.
Ἡ τελείωσις τοῦ ὅλου δὲν καταργεῖ τὴν ἱεραρχίαν, ἀλλὰ μετατρέπει τὴν ἱεραρχίαν εἰς λειτουργικὴν συνάρτησιν διαβαθμίσεων ἐντὸς ἑνὸς κόσμου.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Κρᾶσις καὶ ἀταξία → πάθος καὶ ἄνοια → φαινομένη κακία → ἀναγωγὴ εἰς παιδευτικὰ καὶ πολιτικὰ αἴτια → ἀνασύνταξις τοῦ πεδίου τῶν κινήσεων.
Ἐσωτερικὴ κίνησις → αὐτονομία → ἁρμονία → ἐνίσχυσις τῆς ἱκανότητος πρὸς ἑαυτορρύθμισιν.
Ψυχικὴ ποιότης → σωματικὴ μορφή → ζωικὴ βαθμίς → νέος ὁρίζων ψυχικῆς μεταβολῆς.
Θεωρία τοῦ κόσμου → ἐπανόρθωσις ἐσωτερικῶν περιφορῶν → ἐξομοίωσις → ἀναδρομικὴ ἐπικύρωσις τῆς θεραπείας ὡς συνεργίας πρὸς τάξιν.
Ἐπιθυμία → γένεσις ἢ νόσος → σωματικὴ ἔνδειξις ἀνεκπληρώτου λειτουργίας → ἐπανεγγραφή τῆς τελεολογίας διὰ τῆς ὕλης.
Ὁ ἐλκυστὴς τοῦ συστήματος εἶναι ἡ ἐξομοίωσις ἡ ὁποία ἀξιολογεῖ τὴν κίνησιν, τὴν γνώσιν, τὴν θεραπείαν καὶ τὴν μορφολογικὴν ἀνάβασιν.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Κρᾶσις, πάθος, τροφή καὶ ἀγωγή → διαμόρφωσις κινήσεων ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος.
Ἀσύμμετρος κίνησις → νόσος, ἄνοια καὶ διαταραχὴ κρίσεως → πράξις φαινομένη ἑκούσιος.
Διάγνωσις τῆς ἀλληλεξαρτήσεως → ἀπόρριψις μονομεροῦς κυριαρχίας → ἡπία ἀγωγὴ καὶ ἐνεργοποίησις τοῦ θεραπευομένου.
Ἐπανόρθωσις ῥυθμῶν → συμμετρία ψυχῆς καὶ σώματος → γνώσις ὡς ἐσωτερικὴ μεταβολή.
Κτῆσις ἢ ἀποβολὴ νοῦ → μεταβολὴ μορφῆς, κινήσεως, ἀναπνοῆς καὶ οἰκήσεως → δυναμικὴ ἱεραρχία εἰδῶν.
Ἱεραρχικὴ πολλαπλότης → κοσμικὴ πληρότης → ἐξομοίωσις πρὸς τὴν τάξιν τοῦ ὁρατοῦ ζῴου.
Σωματικὴ καὶ ψυχικὴ ἀταξία → ἠθικὴ παρεκτροπή καὶ διανεμημένη αἰτιότης.
Διανεμημένη αἰτιότης → θεραπευτικὴ ἀντιστροφή → ἀνασύνταξις σώματος, ἔθους, παιδείας καὶ πολιτείας.
Ἱεράρχησις κινήσεων → προτίμησις ἡπίας αὐτορυθμίσεως → ἐπανόρθωσις τῶν ψυχικῶν περιφορῶν.
Ἐπανόρθωσις τοῦ γνωρίζοντος → κοσμικὴ θεωρία → ἐξομοίωσις καὶ ἄριστος βίος.
Ψυχικὴ πτῶσις ἢ ἀνάτασις → μορφολογικὴ καὶ ζωικὴ μεταβολή → ἱεραρχικὴ πολλαπλότης ἐντός κοσμικῆς πληρότητος.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ κρίσις ἀντικαθίσταται ὑπὸ γενεαλογικῆς χαρτογραφήσεως τῶν σωματικῶν, παιδευτικῶν καὶ κοσμικῶν ὅρων τῆς πράξεως.
Ἡ διάκρισις φύσεως καὶ τέχνης ἀνασυντάσσεται ὡς διάκρισις συνεργοῦσης τέχνης καὶ βιαίας τέχνης.
Ἡ μορφή, τὸ φύλον, τὸ εἶδος καὶ ἡ οἴκησις γίνονται ἀναγνώσιμα ὡς ἀποτυπώματα ψυχικῆς ἱστορίας καὶ ὀντολογικῆς βαθμίδος.
Ἡ ὑγεία ἀναταξινομεῖται ὡς ἐνεργὸς τάξις σχέσεων, ἡ δὲ τελείωσις ὡς πληρότης τοῦ συνόλου καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς ὑπεροχὴ ἑνὸς μέρους.
Ἡ κοσμολογία καθίσταται πρακτικὸν ὄργανον ἀνασχηματισμοῦ, διότι ἡ θεωρία τοῦ ὅλου ρυθμίζει τὸν τρόπον θεραπείας τοῦ μέρους.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐπιφανειακοῦ ἐπιπέδου, νοσήματα, πάθη, τροφαί, φάρμακα, φύλα, εἴδη, ἀναπνοαὶ καὶ τόποι φαίνονται ὡς διακεκριμένα φαινόμενα.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ δομικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὰ φαινόμενα ταῦτα συγκροτοῦν δίκτυον ῥυθμῶν, διαβαθμίσεων, μεταδόσεων καὶ ἀμοιβαίων διαμορφώσεων.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεταστρατηγικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, ἡ ἐπέμβασις μετακινείται ἀπὸ μομφὴν καὶ κατάκτησιν εἰς ὅρους γενέσεως αὐτορυθμίσεως.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ ὀντολογικοῦ καὶ χρονικοῦ ἐπιπέδου, τὸ ζῷον εἶναι γίγνεσθαι σχέσεων, ὅπου ὁ πρότερος βίος ἐπανέρχεται ὡς ὕστερον σῶμα καὶ δυνατότης.
Ἐπὶ τοῦ μεθοδολογικοῦ καὶ performative ἐπιπέδου, ἡ σύνθεσις ἐπιτελεῖ τὸ λεγόμενον, συνδέουσα κατακερματισμένα σώματα, ψυχὰς, μορφὰς καὶ κόσμον εἰς μίαν ἀρχιτεκτονικὴν.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ ἀπόρριψις τῆς καθαρᾶς ἑκουσιότητος ἀποδυναμοῖ τὴν προσωπικὴν ἐνοχήν, ἀλλὰ δὲν καταργεῖ τὴν ἀνάγκην ὑπευθύνου παιδευτικῆς κατευθύνσεως.
Ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς αὐτοκινήσεως συγκρούεται πρὸς τὴν ἀνάγκην ἰατρικῆς καὶ παιδαγωγικῆς ἐπεμβάσεως, ἥτις ὀφείλει νὰ ἐνεργῇ χωρίς νὰ ἀκυροῖ τὸν θεραπευόμενον.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία τῶν μορφῶν διατηρεῖ ἀξιακὴν σταθερότητα, ἐνῶ ἡ ἀμφίδρομος μετάβασις εἰδῶν καταλύει τὴν σταθερὰν ταυτότητα τῶν βαθμίδων.
Ἡ τελείωσις ἀπαιτεῖ καὶ τὴν ἀνάβασιν πρὸς νοῦν καὶ τὴν διατήρησιν τῶν κατωτέρων ὡς ἀναγκαίων μερῶν τοῦ κόσμου.
Ἡ κακία μεταλλάσσεται εἰς νόσον, ἡ νόσος εἰς ἀταξίαν κινήσεων, καὶ ἡ ἀταξία εἰς γενικὴν λογικὴν κοσμικῆς καὶ μορφολογικῆς μεταβολῆς.
Ἡ συμμετρία μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ μορφολογικὸν κριτήριον εἰς θεραπευτικὸν τελεστὴν καὶ τέλος εἰς κοσμικὸν μέτρον ἐξομοιώσεως.
Ἡ φύσις μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ σωματικὸν ὑπόβαθρον εἰς ἠθικο-κοσμολογικὸν μηχανισμόν, ἐν ᾧ ἡ μορφὴ καὶ ὁ χῶρος ἤδη φέρουσι κρίσιν.
Ἡ πραγματικότης εἶναι ζῶν μεταμορφωτικὸν δίκτυον ἀλληλοκρατουμένων κινήσεων, ἐν ᾧ τὸ μέρος οὐδέποτε ὑφίσταται ἔξω τοῦ ὅλου.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον εἶναι θεραπευόμενος καὶ θεραπευτής, μεταβατικὸς φορεὺς νοῦ ἢ ἀνοίας, ὃς παράγεται ἐν τῇ ἀνταποδόσει ψυχικῶν, σωματικῶν καὶ παιδευτικῶν κινήσεων.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι ῥυθμικὴ καὶ γενεαλογικὴ σπείρα, ἡ ὁποία συσσωρεύει κράσεις καὶ βίους, ἀλλὰ παρέχει δυνατότητα ἐπανoρθώσεως.
Ἡ δυνατὴ ἔξοδος δὲν εἶναι ἀπόδρασις ἐκ τοῦ σώματος ἢ ἐκ τῆς ὁλότητος, ἀλλὰ μεταβολὴ τῆς ἐχθρᾶς κρατήσεως εἰς φιλικὴν σύνταξιν καὶ θεωρητικὴν ἀνάτασιν.
Αἱ ἀρχαὶ τῆς διανεμημένης αἰτιότητος, τῆς δυναμικῆς συμμετρίας, τῆς θεραπευτικῆς γνώσεως καὶ τῆς μορφολογικῆς μεταβολῆς ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευὴν τῆς κεντρικῆς κινήσεως.
Ἡ ἀνακατασκευὴ διασώζει τὸν σπειροειδῆ μηχανισμόν: διαταραχὴ → ἀναγωγὴ εἰς αἴτια → ῥύθμισις → ἐξομοίωσις → μεταβολὴ μορφῆς καὶ βίου.
Ὑποκαθορισμένα μένουσι τὸ ἀκριβὲς μέτρον τῆς μετρίας κινήσεως, τὸ ὅριον τῆς ἐξωτερικῆς ἐπεμβάσεως καὶ ὁ μηχανισμὸς τῆς μεταπλάσεως ψυχικῆς διαθέσεως εἰς συγκεκριμένην μορφήν.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι ἰσχυροτάτη ἐν τῇ συνδέσει σώματος, ψυχῆς, κινήσεως, γνώσεως, μορφῆς καὶ κόσμου, ἀλλὰ ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ παραγωγικὰς ἐντάσεις μεταξὺ ἀνάγκης, παιδείας, αὐτονομίας καὶ ἱεραρχίας.
The problem becomes the conception of the living being as a field in which ethical deviation, disease, learning, form, and polity are jointly produced.
Causality shifts from individual will to a distributed cycle of body, soul, upbringing, desire, and cosmic order.
Therapy becomes the regulation and transformation of motions, not the correction of a single isolated symptom.
Knowledge is valid only when it re-enters the knower and restores the rhythm of soul and body.
Form ceases to be an inert surface and becomes a visible inscription of intellect, folly, desire, and prior life.
The hierarchy of beings retains its axiological direction, but is transformed into a cycle of descents and ascents.
Cosmic order functions at once as a model of therapy and as a condition that includes the lower things without abolishing gradation.
The movement of the system is spiral: from disturbance to explanation, from explanation to education, from education to cosmic assimilation, and thence again to transformation of embodied life.
[Persistent] The living being is conjointly of soul, body, habit, and environment, and none of these acts self-sufficiently.
[Mutating] Motion changes from a physiological concomitant into a universal criterion of health, knowledge, virtue, form, and cosmic kinship.
[Persistent] Asymmetry and disorder of motions produce disease, folly, vice, and morphological decline.
[Emergent] Therapy, education, and philosophy constitute one mechanism of reactivation and restoration of internal order.
[Mutating] Autonomy does not mean independence, but the capacity of the part to cooperate within a pre-existing natural and cosmic order.
[Emergent] Knowledge is therapeutic only if it changes the circuits of the knower and opens the possibility of ascent.
[Mutating] Ethical quality does not remain an internal judgment, but is inscribed in body, posture, breathing, dwelling, and species.
[Attractor] Symmetry is a dynamic reciprocity of the parts according to the model of the whole, not static equality.
[Terminal] Perfection consists not in flight from the body or in the elimination of lower things, but in assimilation to and completion of the whole.
[Attractor] The cosmos is conceived as one ensouled and visible system, in which the gradations of forms refer to a common order.
[Terminal] Desire is a resistant force which, rather than remaining outside order, constitutes the embodied mode of generation and teleology.
The interdependence of soul and body is retained, but shifts from transmission of affection to production of form and species.
Motion recurs across the scales of body, soul, education, and cosmos, but each scale transforms the meaning of the preceding one.
Symmetry passes from a criterion of beauty to an operator of therapy and finally to a rule of cosmic assimilation.
The ethical category is absorbed into a genealogy of mixtures, foods, education, and prior psychic changes.
Therapy changes from the repair of a suffering body to the reorganization of the way in which the being moves, knows, and dwells.
The hierarchy of species retains its axiological direction, but loses its immobility through reciprocal transformation.
Desire changes from a particular generative passion into a general model of nature that acts through tension and resistance.
Cosmology ceases to be a final theory and becomes a retrospective rule for judging every therapy, education, and morphological change.
The theories of humors, elements, womb, drugs, and particular parts of the soul remain local mechanisms; when they ascend, they preserve only the type of distributed causality.
The gradation of therapeutic means is elevated into the universal principle that correct intervention increases internal activation and limits force.
The tripartite soul and specific animal divisions recede beneath the more universal principle of differentiated rhythms and transitions.
The bridge between the units is motion, because it connects physiology, psychic education, ethical change, and animal morphology.
Cosmic imitation is elevated into a superordinate measure that recodes health, education, and perfection.
The exact mean of motion and the mechanism of the transformation of soul into species remain underdetermined as limits of the present architecture.
The soul is rejected as a self-subsistent and uninvolved governor of the body, affections, and actions.
Vice is rejected as a purely voluntary and unmediated decision severed from mixture, food, and education.
Therapy is rejected as external domination or violent substitution for the activity of the person being treated.
Knowledge that remains information and does not transform the manner of knowing is rejected.
Nature is rejected as axiologically neutral matter or a disorderly multiplicity of independent species.
Perfection is rejected as one-sided superiority or the purgation of lower forms.
Immobility is rejected as salvation, because health presupposes ordered, moderate, and continuous motion.
Every hypothesis that soul, body, polity, education, and cosmos have independent causes must be false.
Every hypothesis that therapy can be imposed externally without time, measure, and internal change must be false.
Every hypothesis that knowledge alone suffices, unless it cooperates with habit, motion, and environment, must be false.
Every hypothesis that form, breathing, and place are external givens without psychic and ontological consequence must be false.
Every hypothesis that the lowest species possesses independent meaning outside cosmic totality must be false.
The existence of an unrelated subject, which would be self-governing and unaffected by body, time, and cosmos, becomes impossible.
A cosmos in which ethical value is not embodied in forms, motions, and places becomes impossible.
A therapy that saves one part without changing its relation to the whole becomes impossible.
Time that is purely linear or devoid of return becomes impossible, because prior life returns as habit, form, and a condition of change.
Therapy becomes a political and cosmological art, because the correction of internal motions requires changing the conditions that produce bodies, habits, and forms.
Self-motion becomes a condition of ethical restoration, but does not abolish the need for external education; intervention is judged by whether it restores or substitutes for internal activity.
Morphology becomes a therapeutic and cognitive field, because the body shows psychic circuits that can be changed through education and contemplation.
Descent is not simply loss, because it simultaneously expresses axiological decline and completes cosmic totality.
Desire proves that order does not act through simple subordination, but through forces that resist and yet carry generation.
The subject becomes a transitional node in which prior mixtures, educations, desires, and cosmic relations are inscribed in present action and form.
Ontology becomes an ontology of rhythms and transformations, where the being of a being is judged by its capacity to preserve, correct, or lose order.
Time becomes genealogical and spiral, because what is prior does not pass away but reappears as the bodily and ethical possibility of what is later.
Politics and education cease to be external administrations and become management of the conditions under which self-regulation can arise.
The perfection of the whole does not abolish hierarchy, but transforms hierarchy into a functional interdependence of gradations within one cosmos.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Mixture and disorder → affection and folly → apparent vice → reduction to educational and political causes → reorganization of the field of motions.
Internal motion → autonomy → harmony → strengthening of the capacity for self-regulation.
Psychic quality → bodily form → animal grade → new horizon of psychic change.
Theory of the cosmos → restoration of internal circuits → assimilation → retrospective validation of therapy as cooperation with order.
Desire → generation or disease → bodily indication of unfulfilled function → reinscription of teleology through matter.
The attractor of the system is assimilation, which evaluates motion, knowledge, therapy, and morphological ascent.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Mixture, affection, food, and education → formation of the motions of soul and body.
Asymmetrical motion → disease, folly, and disturbance of judgment → action appearing voluntary.
Diagnosis of interdependence → rejection of one-sided domination → gentle education and activation of the person being treated.
Restoration of rhythms → symmetry of soul and body → knowledge as internal change.
Acquisition or loss of intellect → change of form, motion, breathing, and dwelling → dynamic hierarchy of species.
Hierarchical multiplicity → cosmic completeness → assimilation to the order of the visible living being.
Bodily and psychic disorder → ethical deviation and distributed causality.
Distributed causality → therapeutic reversal → reorganization of body, habit, education, and polity.
Hierarchization of motions → preference for gentle self-regulation → restoration of psychic circuits.
Restoration of the knower → cosmic contemplation → assimilation and the best life.
Psychic descent or ascent → morphological and animal change → hierarchical multiplicity within cosmic completeness.
Ethical judgment is replaced by genealogical mapping of the bodily, educational, and cosmic conditions of action.
The distinction between nature and art is reorganized as the distinction between cooperative art and violent art.
Form, sex, species, and dwelling become legible as imprints of psychic history and ontological grade.
Health is reclassified as an active order of relations, and perfection as completeness of the whole rather than superiority of one part.
Cosmology becomes a practical instrument of reshaping, because the theory of the whole regulates the mode of treating the part.
At the surface level, diseases, affections, foods, drugs, sexes, species, breathings, and places appear as distinct phenomena.
At the structural level, these phenomena constitute a network of rhythms, gradations, transmissions, and mutual formations.
At the metastrategic level, intervention shifts from blame and conquest to the conditions for the emergence of self-regulation.
At the ontological and temporal level, the living being is a becoming of relations, where prior life returns as later body and possibility.
At the methodological and performative level, the synthesis performs what it says, connecting fragmented bodies, souls, forms, and cosmos into one architecture.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: The rejection of pure voluntariness weakens personal guilt, but does not abolish the need for responsible educational direction.
The principle of self-motion conflicts with the need for medical and pedagogical intervention, which must act without nullifying the person being treated.
The hierarchy of forms retains axiological stability, while reciprocal transition of species dissolves the stable identity of the grades.
Perfection requires both ascent toward intellect and preservation of the lower things as necessary parts of the cosmos.
Vice changes into disease, disease into disorder of motions, and disorder into a general logic of cosmic and morphological change.
Symmetry changes from a morphological criterion into a therapeutic operator and finally into a cosmic measure of assimilation.
Nature changes from a bodily substrate into an ethical-cosmological mechanism, in which form and space already bear judgment.
Reality is a living transformative network of mutually sustaining motions, in which the part never exists outside the whole.
The subject is both patient and healer, a transitional bearer of intellect or folly, produced in the reciprocity of psychic, bodily, and educational motions.
Time is a rhythmic and genealogical spiral that accumulates mixtures and lives, yet affords the possibility of restoration.
The possible exit is not escape from the body or from totality, but transformation of hostile holding into friendly arrangement and theoretical restoration.
The principles of distributed causality, dynamic symmetry, therapeutic knowledge, and morphological change suffice for reconstructing the central movement.
The reconstruction preserves the spiral mechanism: disturbance → reduction to causes → regulation → assimilation → change of form and life.
The exact measure of moderate motion, the limit of external intervention, and the mechanism by which psychic disposition is transformed into a determinate form remain underdetermined.
The architecture is strongest in its connection of body, soul, motion, knowledge, form, and cosmos, but depends on productive tensions among necessity, education, autonomy, and hierarchy.

items.text: Τὸ σύστημα ζητεῖ νὰ κατανοήσῃ πῶς κόσμος, πόλις, ζῷον καὶ σῶμα συγκροτοῦνται ἐν διαφορᾷ, θνητότητι καὶ μεταβολῇ, χωρὶς ἀναγωγὴν εἰς ἀκίνητον οὐσίαν.
Ἡ ἑνότης ἀναπλάττεται ὡς ἱεραρχημένη ἀλλὰ ἀμφίδρομος μεσιτεία σχέσεων, οὐχὶ ὡς ὁμοιογενὴς ταυτότης ἢ γυμνὴ κυριότης.
Τὸ παράδειγμα καὶ ὁ σκοπὸς καθίστανται ἐνεργοί, μόνον ἐπειδὴ μεταγράφονται εἰς σώματα, κινήσεις, ὄργανα, θεσμοὺς καὶ μνήμας.
Ἡ ἀνάγκη καὶ ἡ ἀντίστασις οὔτε ἀναιροῦνται οὔτε μένουσιν ἔξω τῆς τάξεως, ἀλλὰ παράγουσι ζωήν ἢ φθορὰν κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τῆς ῥοῆς.
Ὁ λόγος γίνεται διαβαθμισμένη ἀνακατασκευή, ἥτις ἀληθεύει πρακτικῶς ὅταν ἐπανέρχηται ὡς παιδεία, διάγνωσις, θεραπεία καὶ πολιτικὴ κρίσις.
Ὁ χρόνος συνάπτει κοσμικὴν περιοδικότητα, σωματικὴν γενεαλογίαν καὶ ἱστορικὴν διακοπήν εἰς σπείραν, ἐν ᾗ ἡ ἐπάνοδος μεταμορφοῖ τὸ ἐπανερχόμενον.
Ἡ κίνησις τοῦ ὅλου εἶναι ἀναδρομική: μορφὴ γεννᾷ ῥοήν, ἡ ῥοὴ διαταράσσεται, ἡ διαταραχὴ γίνεται σημεῖον, καὶ ἡ κρίσις ἐπιχειρεῖ νέαν μορφήν.
Ἡ σύγκλεισις μένει πρόσκαιρος καὶ ἀνοικτή, διότι πᾶσα διατήρησις φέρει ἐν ἑαυτῇ δεκτικότητα, φθοράν, ἀναθεώρησιν καὶ νέαν ἀνάγκην ῥυθμίσεως.
[Persistent] Τὸ ὂν καὶ ἡ ἑνότης παράγονται ἐκ σχέσεων, κινήσεων καὶ λειτουργικῶς διακεκριμένων μερῶν, οὐκ ἐξ αὐτοτελοῦς πυρῆνος.
[Persistent] Πᾶσα διατηρήσιμος τάξις ἀπαιτεῖ μεσότητα, ἀναλογίαν καὶ ἱεραρχημένην συμπλοκὴν διαφορών.
[Mutating] Τὸ παράδειγμα μεταλλάσσεται εἰς τελεολογικὴν καὶ κατανεμημένην αἰτιότητα, ἥτις διοικεῖ τὴν ἀνάγκην διὰ τῶν ἰδίων αὐτῆς ἀντιστάσεων.
[Persistent] Ἡ μεσολάβησις εἶναι καθολικὴ ἀρχὴ μεταγραφῆς, δι᾽ ἧς μορφή, αἴσθησις, ψυχή, μνήμη, σημεῖον καὶ ἀλήθεια συνδέονται.
[Mutating] Τὸ σῶμα μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ μεσίτην κινήσεων εἰς κατανεμημένον ἀρχεῖον, ὄργανον καὶ τόπον ἐγγραφῆς φυσικῆς καὶ ἠθικῆς ἱστορίας.
[Attractor] Τάξις, ὑγίεια καὶ φρόνησις εἰσὶν ὀνόματα ῥυθμισμένης ἀνταποδόσεως, ἐν ᾗ λόγος, ῥοή, μέτρον καὶ διέξοδος ἀμοιβαίως διατηροῦνται.
[Emergent] Γένεσις καὶ φθορά, ἀρετὴ καὶ κακία, ὑγίεια καὶ νόσος παράγονται ὑπὸ τῆς αὐτῆς μηχανῆς, διαφέροντα κατὰ φοράν, μέτρον καὶ ἀνάδρασιν.
[Mutating] Ὁ χρόνος μεταλλάσσεται εἰς πολυμερῆ σπείραν περιοδικότητος, φθορᾶς, γενεαλογικῆς συσσωρεύσεως, διακοπῆς καὶ προδιατάξεως.
[Emergent] Ἡ ἀλήθεια εἶναι διαβαθμισμένη καὶ θεραπευτικὴ ἀνασύνθεσις, ἧς τὸ κύρος ἐξαρτᾶται ἀπὸ τὰς μεσιτείας καὶ τὴν δύναμιν μεταβολῆς τοῦ γιγνώσκοντος.
[Attractor] Ἡ δεκτικότης καὶ ἡ ἀπόστασις δὲν εἰσὶ στερήσεις, ἀλλὰ οἱ ὅροι δι᾽ ὧν μορφὴ, ὁμοίωσις καὶ γνώσις καθίστανται δυναταί.
[Terminal] Τὸ ὑποκείμενον εἶναι μεταβατικὸς κόμβος σωμάτων, ῥοῶν, παθημάτων, μνημῶν καὶ κρίσεων, ὃς μεταβάλλεται ὑπὸ τῶν σχέσεων ἃς ρυθμίζει.
[Terminal] Ἡ ἐλευθερία εἶναι συνεργὸς αὐτορρύθμισις, πλοήγησις καὶ ἐπανόρθωσις ἐντὸς σώματος, χρόνου, κόσμου καὶ δυνάμεως.
Ἡ σχέσις διατηρεῖ τὴν γενετικὴν ταυτότητα αὐτῆς, ἀλλὰ ἐπεκτείνεται ἀπὸ κοσμικὴν συγκρότησιν εἰς φυσιολογίαν, παθολογίαν, παιδείαν καὶ πολιτικήν.
Ἡ μεσότης μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ τοπικὸν δεσμὸν εἰς καθολικὴν μηχανὴ μεταδόσεως, κυβερνήσεως, σημειώσεως καὶ ἀληθείας.
Ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα παύουσιν νὰ ἀντιτίθενται ὡς κυβερνήτης καὶ ὄργανον, καὶ συμπλέκονται εἰς κόμβον πάθους, κρίσεως καὶ ἐγγεγραμμένης ἕξεως.
Ἡ κίνησις μεταναστεύει ἀπὸ φυσικὴν αἰτίαν εἰς κοινὸν κριτήριον γνώσεως, θεραπείας, ἀρετῆς καὶ κοσμικῆς ὁμοιώσεως.
Τὸ μέτρον καὶ ἡ συμμετρία διατηροῦσι τὴν κανονιστικὴν λειτουργίαν, ἀλλὰ μεταβάλλονται ἀπὸ στατικὴν ἰσότητα εἰς δυναμικὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν.
Ἡ μνήμη μετατοπίζεται ἀπὸ ἀρχειακὴν διατήρησιν εἰς σωματικὴν αἰτιότητα, καθ᾽ ἣν τὸ παρελθὸν ἐπανέρχεται ὡς μορφή, ἕξις καὶ φθορά.
Ἡ καταστροφὴ καὶ ἡ νόσος ἀπορροφῶνται εἰς κοινὸν σχήμα ἀναστροφῆς, ὅπου ἡ διατήρησις μεταπίπτει εἰς αὐτοτροφοδοτουμένην λύσιν.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία ἀντιστρέφει τὴν λειτουργίαν αὐτῆς: ἀπὸ σταθερὰν ἀνωτερότητα γίνεται τέχνη διοχετεύσεως καὶ ἀμοιβαίας ἀποδόσεως.
Ἡ χώρα ὑποχωρεῖ ὡς ἴδιον ὄνομα, ἀλλ᾽ ἡ λειτουργία αὐτῆς διασπείρεται εἰς ὁδούς, πλέγματα καὶ δεκτικὰ σώματα ἃ μορφοῦνται διὰ ἀντιστάσεως.
Αἱ ἀριθμητικαί, γεωμετρικαί, ἀστρονομικαί, χυμικαί, ἀνατομικαὶ καὶ φαρμακολογικαὶ διατάξεις μένουσι τοπικαὶ μηχαναὶ παραδειγματισμοῦ.
Εἰς τὸ παρὸν ἐπίπεδον κλιμακοῦνται μόνον αἱ ἀρχαὶ τῆς διανεμημένης αἰτιότητος, τῆς ῥοῆς, τῆς μεσιτείας καὶ τῆς λειτουργικῆς διαφορᾶς.
Τὸ σῶμα γεφυροῖ κοσμολογίαν, φυσιολογίαν, ἠθικὴν καὶ πολιτικήν, ἐπειδὴ μεταγράφει τὰς ἀφανεῖς σχέσεις εἰς κινήσεις, μορφὰς καὶ σημεῖα.
Χρόνος καὶ μνήμη γεφυροῦσι τὰς μονάδας, ἐπειδὴ μετατρέπουσι τὴν περιοδικότητα, τὴν ἕξιν καὶ τὴν καταστροφὴν εἰς παροῦσαν αἰτιότητα.
Ἡ διαταραχὴ κλιμακοῦται ἀπὸ τοπικὸν συμβεβηκὸς εἰς καταλύτην, ὅταν τὸ σύμπτωμα ἀναγκάζῃ γενεαλογικὴν ἀνασύνθεσιν τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ αὐτοτελὴς οὐσία καὶ ἡ γυμνὴ ἱεραρχία καθίστανται ἀπαρχαιωμένα σχήματα καὶ ἀνακωδικοποιοῦνται ὡς παράγωγα σχέσεων καὶ λειτουργικῶν ἀνταποδόσεων.
Ἀποκλείεται ἑνότης διὰ ὁμοιογενείας, μίξεως ἢ ἐκκαθαρίσεως τῆς ἑτερότητος.
Ἀποκλείεται αὐτοτελὴς οὐσία καὶ ἀδρανὲς σῶμα, ἐπειδὴ ταυτότης καὶ λειτουργία παράγονται σχεσιακῶς.
Ἀποκλείονται γραμμικὸς χρόνος καὶ μονόδρομος αἰτιότης, ἐπειδὴ τὰ ἀποτελέσματα ἐπανέρχονται ὡς αἴτια.
Ἀποκλείονται ἀσώματος ψυχή, ἀδιαμεσολάβητος ἀλήθεια καὶ γνώσις ἥτις οὐ μεταβάλλει τὸν βίον.
Ἀποκλείονται ὑγίεια ὡς ἀκινησία καὶ τελείωσις ὡς φυγὴ ἀπὸ σῶμα, ἐπιθυμίαν καὶ πολλαπλότητα.
Ψευδὲς δεῖ εἶναι ὅτι μέρος, σῶμα ἢ ποιότης δύναται νὰ ἀποτελέσῃ ἔσχατον καὶ ἀσυσχέτιστον ὑποκείμενον.
Ψευδὲς δεῖ εἶναι ὅτι ψυχή, σῶμα, πόλις, μνήμη καὶ κόσμος ἔχουσιν ἀνεξαρτήτους αἰτιακὰς ἱστορίας.
Ψευδὲς δεῖ εἶναι ὅτι φθορὰ καὶ καταστροφὴ προσπίπτουσιν ἔξωθεν, ἀντὶ νὰ παράγωνται ἐκ τῆς ἀναστροφῆς τῆς γενέσεως.
Ψευδὲς δεῖ εἶναι ὅτι ἐλευθερία, θεραπεία ἢ ἀλήθεια δύνανται νὰ ἐπιβληθῶσιν ἔξωθεν ἄνευ χρόνου καὶ ἐσωτερικῆς μεταβολῆς.
Ψευδὲς δεῖ εἶναι ὅτι ἡ ὁμοίωσις ἀπαιτεῖ ταύτισιν ἢ ὅτι ἡ ἱεραρχία σώζεται διὰ καταστροφῆς τῶν κατωτέρων.
Ἡ βαθύτατη ἀπουσία εἶναι ἡ ἀμεσότης: παράδειγμα, ἀλήθεια, κυριότης καὶ μνήμη οὐδέποτε δίδονται ἄνευ σώματος, εἰκόνος, σημείου ἢ μαρτυρίας.
Ἀπουσιάζει ἀδιάσπαστον ἀρχεῖον καὶ ἀκριβὲς καθολικὸν μέτρον, ὥστε πᾶσα ἀνακατασκευή νὰ μένῃ ἐπιλεκτικὴ καὶ ἀναθεωρήσιμος.
Καθαρὸν ἐκτὸς καὶ ἀκίνητον κέντρον εἰσὶν ὀντολογικῶς ἀδύνατα, ἐπειδὴ πᾶς κυβερνῶν μεταβάλλεται ὑπὸ τοῦ κυβερνωμένου δικτύου.
Ἀπουσιάζει τελικὴ τάξις ἀπαλλαγμένη φθορᾶς, διότι ἡ συνέχεια περιέχει τὴν ἕξιν, τὴν διακοπὴν καὶ τὴν δυνατότητα νέας λύσεως.
Ἡ παραδειγματικὴ αἰτιότης δύναται νὰ γένηται πραγματικὴ μόνον ἐὰν μεταγράφηται εἰς σχεσιακὴν σωματικὴν γένεσιν.
Ἡ ἱστορικὴ καταστροφὴ καὶ ἡ σωματικὴ παθολογία εἰσὶν ὁμόλογοι ἀναστροφαί, καθ᾽ ἃς ἡ μηχανὴ διατηρήσεως ἐνισχύει τὴν ἰδίαν λύσιν.
Ἀρχεῖον καὶ σῶμα εἰσὶ δύο μορφαὶ αἰτιακῆς μνήμης, δι᾽ ὧν τὸ ἀπόν παρελθὸν διατάσσει τὴν παροῦσαν μορφήν.
Ἡ ἑρμηνεία, ἡ διάγνωσις καὶ ἡ θεραπεία συγκροτοῦσι μίαν πράξιν, ἐπειδὴ ἀνασυνθέτουσι τὴν ἀφανῆ τάξιν καὶ ἐπανενεργοῦσιν ἐπ᾽ αὐτῆς.
Παιδεία, πολιτική καὶ θεραπεία δικαιοῦνται ὡς κατασκευαὶ ὅρων αὐτορρυθμίσεως, οὐχὶ ὡς ἐξωτερικαὶ ἀντικαταστάσεις τοῦ δρώντος.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία διατηρεῖ συστημικὸν κύρος μόνον ὅταν λειτουργῇ ὡς ἀμφίδρομος διοχέτευσις καὶ οὐχὶ ὡς μονόδρομος ἐπιβολή.
Ἡ ἐλευθερωτικὴ ἐπέμβασις ἀποτυγχάνει ὅταν ἡ ἰσχὺς ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὴν ἐσωτερικὴν ῥύθμισιν, ἀλλ᾽ ἄνευ ἰσχύος ἀδυνατεῖ νὰ λύσῃ τὴν κατάκλεισιν.
Ἡ δεκτικότης δὲν εἶναι κενὸν ὑπόβαθρον, ἀλλὰ κατανεμημένον πεδίον ὁδῶν καὶ ἀντιστάσεων, ὃ συναποφασίζει τὴν μορφήν.
Ἡ πραγματικότης καθίσταται πολυεπίπεδος τοπολογία μετασχηματισμῶν, ἐν ᾗ κοσμολογία, φυσιολογία, πολιτικὴ καὶ ἠθικὴ εἰσὶ κλίμακες μιᾶς σχεσιακῆς παραγωγῆς.
Ὁ χρόνος γίνεται τριπλῆ αἰτιότης: κύκλος μετρήσεως, γενεαλογικὴ ἐγγραφή, καὶ διακοπὴ ἡ ὁποία ἀναγκάζει νέαν σύνθεσιν.
Ἡ κυριότης μετατίθεται ἀπὸ κατοχὴν δυνάμεως εἰς διοίκησιν ῥοῶν, μεταβάσεων, μνημῶν καὶ ὅρων αὐτορρυθμίσεως.
Ἡ αἰτιότης γίνεται κύκλωμα, ἐπειδὴ τὸ ἀποτέλεσμα δύναται νὰ ἐπανέλθῃ ὡς αἴτιον διατηρήσεως ἢ φθορᾶς.
Ἡ ἐπιστήμη γίνεται ἱεραρχία προσηκόντων καὶ ἐπεμβατικῶν λόγων, ὧν ἡ ἀκρίβεια κρίνεται κατὰ τὸ ἀντικείμενον καὶ τὴν θεραπευτικὴν ἀπόδοσιν.
Ὁ δρῶν καθίσταται φύλαξ μεσιτειῶν, ἅμα θεραπευόμενος καὶ θεραπευτής, ὃς ρυθμίζει δίκτυα ὑφ᾽ ὧν αὐτὸς συγκροτεῖται.
Ἡ πολιτικὴ γίνεται οἰκολογία μεσιτειῶν, ἐπειδὴ ἡ πάλη μεταφέρεται εἰς τοὺς ὅρους παραγωγῆς μνήμης, ὑγιείας, κρίσεως καὶ αὐτορρυθμίσεως.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Παράδειγμα → μεσιτεία → σωματικὴ μορφὴ → μέτρον → ἀναγνώρισις παραδείγματος· ἡ ἐπιστροφή διατηρεῖ τὴν ὁμοιότητα διὰ τῆς ἀποστάσεως.
Διαφορά → ἀντίστασις → δύναμις → μορφὴ → νέα διαφορά· ἡ ἀπειλὴ τῆς τάξεως γίνεται ὕλη τῆς ἀναπαραγωγῆς αὐτῆς.
Φθορά → ἀναπλήρωσις → ῥυθμισμένη ῥοή → νέα φθορά· ἡ συντήρησις περιέχει τὴν δυνατότητα τῆς ἰδίας ἐξασθενήσεως.
Κατάκλεισις → ἀναστροφὴ ῥοῆς → νόσος ἢ καταστροφή → γενεαλογικὴ διάγνωσις → δυνατὴ ἐπανόρθωσις.
Σημεῖον → ἑρμηνεία → μεταβολὴ τοῦ ἑρμηνεύοντος → νέα σύνθεσις· ἡ ἐξήγησις ἐπανενεργεῖ ἐπὶ τοῦ πράγματος.
Ὁ θετικὸς ἑλκυστὴς εἶναι ἡ ῥυθμισμένη ἀνταπόδοσις, ἥτις ἐπανέρχεται ὡς τάξις, ὑγίεια, φρόνησις, μνήμη καὶ ἐλευθερία.
Ὁ ἀρνητικὸς ἑλκυστὴς εἶναι ἡ κατάκλεισις, ἐν ᾗ ἡ διατήρησις χάνει τὴν διέξοδον καὶ μεταστρέφεται εἰς αὐτοενισχυομένην διάλυσιν.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Διαφορά + δεκτικὸν πεδίον + αἰτιακὴ σχέσις → γενητὸν καὶ πολυμερὲς ὄν.
Παράδειγμα + τελεολογικὴ διοίκησις τῆς ἀνάγκης → κατανεμημένη μορφοποιὸς αἰτιότης.
Κατανεμημένη αἰτιότης + σωματικαὶ ὁδοί → κίνησις, πάθος, σημεῖον καὶ ἐγγεγραμμένη μορφή.
Μέτρον + διέξοδος + ἀμφίδρομος ἀνταπόδοσις → πρόσκαιρος τάξις, ὑγίεια καὶ φρόνησις.
Ἀσυμμετρία + κατάκλεισις + θετικὴ ἀνάδρασις → νόσος, λήθη, καταστροφὴ καὶ συστημικὴ λύσις.
Θραύσματα + σημεῖα + διαβαθμισμένη κρίσις → γενεαλογικὴ διάγνωσις τῆς ἀφανοῦς τάξεως.
Διάγνωσις + παιδεία + ἐσωτερικὴ μεταβολή → ἐπανόρθωσις ἡ ὁποία παραμένει ἀνοικτὴ εἰς νέαν φθοράν.
Ἀκίνητον παράδειγμα → ἀδυναμία ἀμέσου ἐπιβολῆς → ἀνάγκη μεσιτείας.
Μεσιτεία → δεκτικὴ διαφορά → μορφοποιημένη σχεσιακὴ γένεσις.
Σχεσιακὴ γένεσις → σωματικὴ κίνησις → πάθος, ὄργανον, σημεῖον καὶ μνήμη.
Μέτρον καὶ ἀνταπόδοσις → πρόσκαιρος συνοχὴ → ζωή, ὑγίεια καὶ πολιτικὴ τάξις.
Κατάκλεισις καὶ ἀσυμμετρία → ἀναστροφὴ τῆς γενέσεως → νόσος, κακία καὶ καταστροφή.
Σύμπτωμα, θραῦσμα καὶ μαρτυρία → γενεαλογικὴ ἀνάγνωσις → διάγνωσις τῶν ἀφανῶν σχέσεων.
Διάγνωσις → θεραπευτικὴ παιδεία → αὐτορρύθμισις → ἀνοικτὴ συνοχὴ ἢ νέα σπειροειδὴς φθορά.
Κόσμος, πόλις καὶ σῶμα ἀναταξινομοῦνται ὡς διαφορετικαὶ κλίμακες διανεμημένης καὶ μεσιτευμένης παραγωγῆς.
Ἡ ὕλη παύει νὰ εἶναι παθητικὸν ὑπόλειμμα καὶ γίνεται ἐνεργὸς ἀντίστασις, ὁδὸς μεταδόσεως καὶ ἀρχεῖον μορφῶν.
Ὑγίεια, τάξις καὶ ταυτότης γίνονται χρονικὰ καθεστῶτα ῥυθμίσεως, οὐχὶ σταθεραὶ οὐσίαι.
Ἡ γνώσις μεταβαίνει ἀπὸ κατοχὴν πραγμάτων εἰς ἀνακατασκευήν μηχανισμῶν καὶ ἐπανόρθωσιν σχέσεων.
Τὰ δίπολα φύσεως καὶ ἠθικῆς, ὑγιείας καὶ νόσου, σταθερότητος καὶ μεταβολῆς μετατρέπονται εἰς διαφορὰς φοράς, μέτρου καὶ ἀναδράσεως.
Ἡ στρατηγικὴ μεταφέρεται ἀπὸ κατάληψιν ἀντικειμένων εἰς κατασκευήν τῶν ὅρων δι᾽ ὧν σχέσεις δύνανται νὰ αὐτορρυθμίζωνται.
Ἐπιφανειακῶς, πόλεις, πόλεμοι, ἄστρα, στοιχεῖα, τροφαί, χυμοί, πάθη, φάρμακα καὶ μορφαὶ φαίνονται ὡς διακεκριμένα ἀντικείμενα.
Δομικῶς, τὰ ἀντικείμενα συνδέονται διὰ μεσότητος, ῥοῆς, δεκτικότητος, ὀργάνων, ἀρχείων καὶ ἀναδράσεων.
Μεταστρατηγικῶς, ἡ πάλη ἀφορᾷ τίς ρυθμίζει τὰς μεσιτείας δι᾽ ὧν δύναμις, μνήμη καὶ πάθος γίνονται κυριαρχία ἢ αὐτορρύθμισις.
Ὀντολογικῶς καὶ χρονικῶς, τὸ ὂν εἶναι πρόσκαιρος σύστασις σχέσεων, ἣ διατηρεῖται καὶ λύεται διὰ σπειροειδοῦς αἰτιότητος.
Μεθοδολογικῶς καὶ ἐπιτελεστικῶς, ὁ λόγος μιμεῖται τὴν μηχανὴν ἣν ἐξετάζει, διαιρῶν, συνδέων, ἀναστρέφων καὶ ἐπανασυνθέτων θραύσματα.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Ἡ νοερὰ καὶ τελεολογικὴ διοίκησις προϋποθέτει ἐνεργὰ φυσικὰ αἴτια, ἀλλὰ οὐ διευκρινίζει πλήρως πῶς ἡ ὑπαγωγὴ διασῴζει τὴν αὐτονομίαν αὐτῶν.
Ἡ ἱεραρχία χρειάζεται ἀσυμμετρίαν πρὸς διατήρησιν ἑνότητος, ἀλλ᾽ ἡ ἀμφίδρομος μεταβολὴ τῶν μερῶν ἀποσταθεροποιεῖ τὴν μόνιμον ἀξιακὴν τάξιν.
Ἡ σχεσιακὴ γενεαλογία μειοῖ τὴν καθαρὰν προσωπικὴν αἰτιότητα, ἀλλὰ τὸ σύστημα διατηρεῖ κρίσιν, παιδείαν καὶ πολιτικὴν εὐθύνην.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια ἀπαιτεῖ κοινὴν κρίσιν, ἀλλὰ τὰ θραύσματα, τὰ συμπτώματα καὶ τὰ ἀνίσως διανεμημένα ἀρχεῖα οὐ παρέχουσιν ἀκριβὲς καθολικὸν μέτρον.
Ὁ αὐτὸς μηχανισμὸς δύναται νὰ παράγῃ τάξιν ἢ διάλυσιν, ἀλλὰ τὸ ἀκριβὲς κατώφλιον τῆς μεταπτώσεως μένει ἀπροσδιόριστον.
Ἡ ἐπέμβασις πρέπει συγχρόνως νὰ ἔχῃ ἰσχὺν λύσεως τῆς κατακλείσεως καὶ νὰ μὴν ἀντικαθιστᾷ τὴν αὐτορρύθμισιν.
Τὸ παράδειγμα μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἀΐδιον ἀρχέτυπον εἰς κανόνα ὀργανώσεως ὕλης, κινήσεως καὶ ἀντιστάσεως.
Ἡ μνήμη μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ διατήρησιν τοῦ παρελθόντος εἰς σωματικὴν καὶ πολιτικὴν αἰτίαν τοῦ παρόντος.
Ἡ ἀλήθεια μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ὀρθὴν παράστασιν εἰς μετασχηματιστικὴν πράξιν ἐπὶ τοῦ γιγνώσκοντος καὶ τοῦ γιγνωσκομένου.
Ἡ χώρα μεταλλάσσεται ἀπὸ ἄμορφον δεκτικὸν ὅρον εἰς κατανεμημένον δίκτυον σωματικῶν ὁδῶν καὶ μεταγραφῶν.
Ἡ ἠθικὴ μεταλλάσσεται εἰς φυσιολογίαν κινήσεων, ἀλλὰ διατηρεῖ ἀμείωτον κανονιστικὴν φοράν πρὸς ὑγίειαν, φρόνησιν καὶ τάξιν.
Ἡ πραγματικότης εἶναι διαβαθμισμένη μηχανὴ ῥοῶν, μεταδόσεων καὶ μεταγραφῶν, ἐν ᾗ μορφὴ καὶ δύναμις ἀλληλοπαράγονται διὰ ἀντιστάσεως.
Τὸ ὑποκείμενον εἶναι ἐνδοκοσμικὸς καὶ μεταβατικὸς κόμβος, οὔτε ἀμέτοχος κριτὴς οὔτε αὐτοκράτωρ τῶν κινήσεων αὐτοῦ.
Ὁ χρόνος εἶναι ρυθμικὴ καὶ γενεαλογικὴ σπείρα, ἐν ᾗ πᾶσα διατήρησις φέρει δυνατότητα φθορᾶς καὶ ἐπανορθώσεως.
Ἡ μόνη δυνατὴ διαφυγὴ εἶναι ἐσωτερικὴ μεταβολὴ τῶν δεσμῶν: φύλαξις μνήμης, διάνοιξις ῥοῶν καὶ μετατροπὴ ἐχθρᾶς κρατήσεως εἰς φιλικὴν σύνταξιν.
Τὰ ἀξιώματα τῆς σχεσιακῆς γενέσεως, τῆς μεσιτείας, τῆς σωματικῆς μεταγραφῆς, τῆς ρυθμισμένης ἀνταποδόσεως καὶ τῆς θεραπευτικῆς γνώσεως ἀρκοῦσι πρὸς ἀνακατασκευήν τοῦ ὅλου.
Ἡ ἀρχιτεκτονικὴ εἶναι ἰσχυροτάτη ὅπου μορφή, σῶμα, ἀνάγκη, ἀναλογία, μνήμη καὶ ἀνασύνθεσις λειτουργοῦσιν ὡς μία σπειροειδὴς αἰτιότης.
Ὑποκαθορισμένα μένουσιν ἡ σχέσις νοερᾶς διοικήσεως καὶ μηχανικῆς αὐτονομίας, τὸ ἀκριβὲς μέτρον ὀρθῆς κινήσεως καὶ τὸ ὅριον θεμιτῆς ἐπεμβάσεως.
Ἡ συνοχὴ τοῦ συστήματος διατηρεῖται μόνον ἐὰν ἡ ἀνακατασκευή φυλάσσῃ τὴν ἀναδρομήν, καθ᾽ ἣν οἱ αὐτοὶ μηχανισμοὶ γίγνονται ζωτικοὶ ἢ νοσοποιοί.
Εἰς ἀξιωματικὴν συμπίεσιν ἀνθίσταται ἡ παραγωγικὴ ἔντασις μεταξὺ ἀνάγκης, ἱεραρχίας, αὐτονομίας, παιδείας καὶ θνητῆς φθορᾶς· ἄνευ αὐτῆς ἡ μηχανὴ μένει σχῆμα ἀλλ᾽ οὐ κίνησις.
The system seeks to understand how cosmos, city, animal, and body are constituted in difference, mortality, and change, without reduction to an unmoving substance.
Unity is recast as a hierarchical yet reciprocal mediation of relations, not as homogeneous identity or naked sovereignty.
The paradigm and the end become active only because they are transcribed into bodies, movements, organs, institutions, and memories.
Necessity and resistance are neither annulled nor remain outside order, but produce life or decay according to the measure of flow.
Discourse becomes a graduated reconstruction that is practically true when it returns as education, diagnosis, therapy, and political judgment.
Time joins cosmic periodicity, bodily genealogy, and historical interruption into a spiral, in which return transforms what returns.
The movement of the whole is recursive: form generates flow, flow is disturbed, disturbance becomes a sign, and judgment undertakes a new form.
Closure remains temporary and open, because every preservation bears within itself receptivity, decay, revision, and a new need for regulation.
[Persistent] Being and unity are produced from relations, movements, and functionally differentiated parts, not from a self-sufficient core.
[Persistent] Every sustainable order requires a mean, proportion, and a hierarchical interweaving of differences.
[Mutating] The paradigm mutates into teleological and distributed causality, which governs necessity through its own resistances.
[Persistent] Mediation is a universal principle of transcription through which form, sensation, soul, memory, sign, and truth are connected.
[Mutating] The body shifts from mediator of movements into a distributed archive, instrument, and site of inscription of natural and ethical history.
[Attractor] Order, health, and practical wisdom are names for regulated reciprocity, in which discourse, flow, measure, and outlet are mutually sustained.
[Emergent] Generation and decay, virtue and vice, health and disease are produced by the same mechanism, differing in direction, measure, and feedback.
[Mutating] Time mutates into a multipart spiral of periodicity, decay, genealogical accumulation, interruption, and predisposition.
[Emergent] Truth is a graduated and therapeutic recomposition whose authority depends on mediations and on the power to transform the knower.
[Attractor] Receptivity and distance are not privations, but the conditions through which form, assimilation, and knowledge become possible.
[Terminal] The subject is a transitional node of bodies, flows, affections, memories, and judgments, altered by the relations it regulates.
[Terminal] Freedom is cooperative self-regulation, navigation, and restoration within body, time, cosmos, and power.
Relation preserves its genetic identity, but extends from cosmic constitution into physiology, pathology, education, and politics.
The mean mutates from a local bond into a universal mechanism of transmission, governance, signification, and truth.
Soul and body cease to be opposed as governor and instrument, and are interwoven into a node of affection, judgment, and inscribed disposition.
Motion migrates from a natural cause into a common criterion of knowledge, therapy, virtue, and cosmic assimilation.
Measure and symmetry retain their normative function, but change from static equality into dynamic reciprocity.
Memory shifts from archival preservation into bodily causality, according to which the past returns as form, disposition, and decay.
Destruction and disease are absorbed into a common schema of reversal, where preservation turns into self-feeding dissolution.
Hierarchy reverses its function: from fixed superiority it becomes an art of channeling and mutual return.
χώρα recedes as a proper name, but its function is dispersed into pathways, networks, and receptive bodies formed through resistance.
Numerical, geometrical, astronomical, humoral, anatomical, and pharmacological arrangements remain local engines of exemplification.
At the present level, only the principles of distributed causality, flow, mediation, and functional difference are scaled up.
The body bridges cosmology, physiology, ethics, and politics because it transcribes invisible relations into movements, forms, and signs.
Time and memory bridge the units because they transform periodicity, disposition, and destruction into present causality.
Disturbance is scaled up from a local accident into a catalyst when the symptom compels a genealogical recomposition of the whole.
Self-sufficient substance and naked hierarchy become obsolete schemas and are recoded as products of relations and functional reciprocities.
Unity through homogeneity, mixture, or the purification of otherness is excluded.
Self-sufficient substance and an inert body are excluded, because identity and function are produced relationally.
Linear time and one-way causality are excluded, because effects return as causes.
A bodiless soul, unmediated truth, and knowledge that does not transform life are excluded.
Health as immobility and perfection as flight from body, desire, and multiplicity are excluded.
It must be false that a part, body, or quality can constitute an ultimate and unrelated subject.
It must be false that soul, body, city, memory, and cosmos have independent causal histories.
It must be false that decay and destruction befall from outside, rather than being produced from the reversal of generation.
It must be false that freedom, therapy, or truth can be imposed from outside without time and internal change.
It must be false that assimilation requires identity or that hierarchy is preserved through the destruction of the lower.
The deepest absence is immediacy: paradigm, truth, sovereignty, and memory are never given without body, image, sign, or testimony.
An unbroken archive and an exact universal measure are absent, such that every reconstruction remains selective and revisable.
A pure outside and an unmoving center are ontologically impossible, because every governor is altered by the governed network.
A final order free of decay is absent, because continuity contains disposition, interruption, and the possibility of a new dissolution.
Paradigmatic causality can become real only if it is transcribed into relational bodily generation.
Historical destruction and bodily pathology are homologous reversals, in which the mechanism of preservation reinforces its own dissolution.
Archive and body are two forms of causal memory through which the absent past orders present form.
Interpretation, diagnosis, and therapy constitute one practice, because they recompose the invisible order and act back upon it.
Education, politics, and therapy are justified as constructions of conditions of self-regulation, not as external substitutions for the agent.
Hierarchy retains systemic validity only when it functions as reciprocal channeling and not as one-way imposition.
Liberating intervention fails when force replaces internal regulation, but without force it is unable to undo enclosure.
Receptivity is not an empty substrate, but a distributed field of pathways and resistances that co-determines form.
Reality becomes a multilevel topology of transformations, in which cosmology, physiology, politics, and ethics are scales of one relational production.
Time becomes threefold causality: a cycle of measurement, genealogical inscription, and interruption that compels a new synthesis.
Sovereignty shifts from possession of power to governance of flows, transitions, memories, and conditions of self-regulation.
Causality becomes a circuit, because an effect can return as a cause of preservation or decay.
Knowledge becomes a hierarchy of appropriate and interventional discourses, whose precision is judged according to the object and therapeutic effect.
The agent becomes guardian of mediations, at once patient and healer, regulating networks by which it is itself constituted.
Politics becomes an ecology of mediations, because struggle shifts to the conditions of producing memory, health, judgment, and self-regulation.

sections.name: Recursive Loops, Escalation Paths, and Conceptual Attractors

items.text: Paradigm → mediation → bodily form → measure → recognition of paradigm; the return preserves similarity through distance.
Difference → resistance → power → form → new difference; the threat to order becomes material for its reproduction.
Decay → replenishment → regulated flow → new decay; maintenance contains the possibility of its own weakening.
Enclosure → reversal of flow → disease or destruction → genealogical diagnosis → possible restoration.
Sign → interpretation → transformation of the interpreter → new synthesis; explanation acts back upon the thing.
The positive attractor is regulated reciprocity, which returns as order, health, practical wisdom, memory, and freedom.
The negative attractor is enclosure, in which preservation loses its outlet and turns into self-reinforcing dissolution.

sections.name: Formal Generative Schema of the Whole Book

items.text: Difference + receptive field + causal relation → generated and multipart being.
Paradigm + teleological governance of necessity → distributed formative causality.
Distributed causality + bodily pathways → motion, affection, sign, and inscribed form.
Measure + outlet + reciprocal return → temporary order, health, and practical wisdom.
Asymmetry + enclosure + positive feedback → disease, forgetfulness, destruction, and systemic dissolution.
Fragments + signs + graduated judgment → genealogical diagnosis of the invisible order.
Diagnosis + education + internal change → restoration that remains open to new decay.
Unmoving paradigm → impossibility of immediate imposition → necessity of mediation.
Mediation → receptive difference → form-giving relational generation.
Relational generation → bodily motion → affection, instrument, sign, and memory.
Measure and reciprocity → temporary cohesion → life, health, and political order.
Enclosure and asymmetry → reversal of generation → disease, vice, and destruction.
Symptom, fragment, and testimony → genealogical reading → diagnosis of invisible relations.
Diagnosis → therapeutic education → self-regulation → open cohesion or new spiral decay.
Cosmos, city, and body are reclassified as different scales of distributed and mediated production.
Matter ceases to be a passive remainder and becomes active resistance, a pathway of transmission, and an archive of forms.
Health, order, and identity become temporal regimes of regulation, not stable substances.
Knowledge shifts from possession of things to reconstruction of mechanisms and restoration of relations.
The binaries of nature and ethics, health and disease, stability and change are transformed into differences of direction, measure, and feedback.
Strategy shifts from seizure of objects to construction of the conditions through which relations can self-regulate.
On the surface, cities, wars, stars, elements, foods, humors, affections, drugs, and forms appear as distinct objects.
Structurally, objects are connected through mediation, flow, receptivity, instruments, archives, and feedback.
Metastrategically, struggle concerns who regulates the mediations through which power, memory, and affection become domination or self-regulation.
Ontologically and temporally, being is a temporary composition of relations, preserved and dissolved through spiral causality.
Methodologically and performatively, discourse imitates the mechanism it examines, dividing, connecting, reversing, and recomposing fragments.

sections.name: Internal Tensions, Mutation Points, and Fault Lines

items.text: Intellectual and teleological governance presupposes active natural causes, but does not fully clarify how subordination preserves their autonomy.
Hierarchy requires asymmetry to preserve unity, but the reciprocal transformation of the parts destabilizes permanent axiological order.
Relational genealogy diminishes pure personal causality, but the system retains judgment, education, and political responsibility.
Truth requires common judgment, but fragments, symptoms, and unequally distributed archives do not provide an exact universal measure.
The same mechanism can produce order or dissolution, but the precise threshold of transition remains indeterminate.
Intervention must at once possess the power to undo enclosure and not replace self-regulation.
The paradigm mutates from an eternal archetype into a principle for organizing matter, motion, and resistance.
Memory mutates from preservation of the past into a bodily and political cause of the present.
Truth mutates from correct representation into a transformative practice upon knower and known.
χώρα mutates from a formless receptive condition into a distributed network of bodily pathways and transcriptions.
Ethics mutates into a physiology of movements, yet retains an undiminished normative direction toward health, practical wisdom, and order.
Reality is a graduated mechanism of flows, transmissions, and transcriptions, in which form and power mutually produce one another through resistance.
The subject is an intracosmic and transitional node, neither a detached judge nor an autocrat of its movements.
Time is a rhythmic and genealogical spiral, in which every preservation bears the possibility of decay and restoration.
The only possible escape is an internal transformation of bonds: preservation of memory, opening of flows, and conversion of hostile holding into friendly arrangement.
The axioms of relational generation, mediation, bodily transcription, regulated reciprocity, and therapeutic knowledge suffice for reconstruction of the whole.
The architecture is strongest where form, body, necessity, proportion, memory, and recomposition function as a single spiral causality.
The relation of intellectual governance and mechanical autonomy, the exact measure of correct movement, and the limit of legitimate intervention remain underdetermined.
The system's coherence is maintained only if reconstruction preserves the recursion by which the same mechanisms become life-sustaining or disease-producing.
Axiomatic compression is resisted by the productive tension between necessity, hierarchy, autonomy, education, and mortal decay; without it, the mechanism remains a schema but not movement.
